## 问题5修复：FCU冷凝水排放系统

```yaml
Condensate_Drain_System:

  identity:
    name: FCU冷凝水排放系统
    description: 定义风机盘管冷凝水的完整排放链路
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024
    applicable_systems:
      - HVAC-FCU

  # ========================================
  # 系统设计原则
  # ========================================
  design_principles:
    
    purpose:
      - 收集FCU运行时产生的冷凝水
      - 安全排放至排水系统
      - 防止积水、漏水、溢出
      - 避免滋生细菌/霉菌
      
    requirements:
      - 重力自流为主，避免积水
      - 管道保温防止二次冷凝
      - 设置水封/存水弯防臭
      - 关键区域设置溢流报警
      
  # ========================================
  # 冷凝水产生量
  # ========================================
  condensate_generation:
    
    calculation:
      formula: |
        冷凝水量 = 空气处理量 × (进口含湿量 - 出口含湿量)
      
    typical_values:
      small_fcu:
        cooling_capacity: {value: 3.5, unit: kW}
        condensate: {value: "0.5-1.0", unit: "L/h"}
      medium_fcu:
        cooling_capacity: {value: 7, unit: kW}
        condensate: {value: "1.0-2.0", unit: "L/h"}
      large_fcu:
        cooling_capacity: {value: 14, unit: kW}
        condensate: {value: "2.0-4.0", unit: "L/h"}
        
    influencing_factors:
      - 室内湿度（湿度高→冷凝水多）
      - 冷冻水温度（温度低→冷凝水多）
      - FCU运行时间
      - 季节（夏季>其他季节）
      
  # ========================================
  # 排放系统设计
  # ========================================
  drain_system_design:
    
    fcu_drain_pan:
      name: FCU集水盘
      material:
        options:
          - 镀锌钢板（喷涂防腐）
          - 不锈钢
          - ABS塑料
        recommendation: 不锈钢或ABS（医院推荐）
      insulation:
        required: true
        material: 橡塑保温
        thickness: {value: 10, unit: mm}
        purpose: 防止盘外冷凝
      slope:
        direction: 向排水口倾斜
        value: {value: ">1", unit: "%"}
      drain_outlet:
        size: DN20
        position: 最低点
        
    condensate_drain_pipe:
      name: 冷凝水排水管
      
      material:
        options:
          - UPVC（常用）
          - HDPE（柔韧性好）
          - PPR（耐低温）
        recommendation: UPVC或HDPE
        
      sizing:
        principle: 根据FCU数量和冷凝水量
        typical_sizes:
          single_fcu: DN20
          branch_pipe: DN25-DN32
          floor_main: DN40-DN50
          riser: DN50-DN75
          
      slope:
        horizontal_pipe: {value: ">2", unit: "%"}
        note: 确保重力自流
        
      insulation:
        required: true
        material: 橡塑保温
        thickness: {value: 10, unit: mm}
        purpose: 防止管外冷凝
        
    routing_methods:
      method_1:
        name: 立管式集中排放（推荐）
        description: 各楼层冷凝水汇集至专用立管
        
        configuration:
          floor_branch:
            description: 楼层水平支管
            slope: 2%
            connection: 各FCU排水口
          riser:
            description: 冷凝水立管
            location: 管井内
            size: DN50-DN75
          bottom_outlet:
            description: 底部排出
            connection: 污水排水系统
            
        advantages:
          - 集中管理
          - 便于维护
          - 减少堵塞风险
        disadvantages:
          - 需要专用管井空间
          
      method_2:
        name: 分散就近排放
        description: 各FCU冷凝水就近接入卫生间排水
        
        configuration:
          drain_route:
            description: FCU→附近卫生间地漏
            distance: {value: "<5", unit: m}
          trap:
            description: 存水弯
            purpose: 防臭
            
        advantages:
          - 管路短
          - 不需要专用立管
        disadvantages:
          - 分散，难以统一管理
          - 可能影响卫生间
          
    trap_water_seal:
      name: 存水弯/水封
      purpose: 防止排水管臭气倒流
      
      configuration:
        p_trap:
          name: P型存水弯
          location: 每台FCU排水口后
          seal_depth: {value: 50, unit: mm}
        s_trap:
          name: S型存水弯
          application: 特殊安装条件
          
      maintenance:
        issue: 长期不用导致水封干涸
        prevention:
          - 定期补水
          - 使用自动补水装置
          - 空调不运行时保持少量通风
          
  # ========================================
  # 楼层集水系统
  # ========================================
  floor_collection_system:
    
    for_high_rise:
      description: 高层建筑冷凝水收集
      
      floor_header:
        name: 楼层冷凝水汇集管
        size: DN40-DN50
        slope: 2%
        location: 走廊吊顶
        
      cleanout:
        name: 检查口
        interval: {value: 15, unit: m}
        purpose: 清通堵塞
        
    for_basement:
      description: 地下室冷凝水收集
      
      sump_pit:
        name: 集水坑
        size:
          length: {value: 1.0, unit: m}
          width: {value: 0.8, unit: m}
          depth: {value: 0.6, unit: m}
        volume: {value: "0.5-1.0", unit: "m³"}
        location: 地下室最低点
        
      sump_pump:
        name: 潜水排水泵
        type: 小型潜水泵
        flow: {value: 5, unit: "m³/h"}
        head: {value: 10, unit: m}
        quantity: 2台（1用1备）
        control:
          method: 液位开关
          start: 高液位
          stop: 低液位
          alarm: 超高液位
          
      discharge:
        destination: 污水排水系统
        pipe_size: DN50
        check_valve: required
        
  # ========================================
  # 溢出保护
  # ========================================
  overflow_protection:
    
    water_level_switch:
      name: 集水盘水位开关
      type: 浮球开关/电容式开关
      location: FCU集水盘内
      
      trigger_levels:
        normal: 0-30%水位
        warning: 50%水位
        alarm: 80%水位
        
    alarm_response:
      level_warning:
        action:
          - 本地蜂鸣器提示（可听）
          - BA系统显示警告
        operator_action: 检查排水是否通畅
        
      level_alarm:
        action:
          step_1: 关闭该FCU冷水阀
          step_2: 继续运行风机（帮助蒸发）
          step_3: BA系统报警
          step_4: 通知维修人员
        purpose: 防止溢出
        
      recovery:
        condition: 水位恢复正常
        action:
          step_1: 维修人员检查并清理堵塞
          step_2: 手动复位报警
          step_3: 恢复FCU正常运行
          
    secondary_drain:
      name: 备用排水口
      description: 主排水堵塞时的溢流通道
      
      configuration:
        location: 集水盘较高位置
        size: DN20
        route: 独立排水管或接入主排水
        indicator: 如有水流出，表示主排水堵塞
        
  # ========================================
  # 医疗区域特殊要求
  # ========================================
  medical_area_special:
    
    standard_ward:
      name: 普通病房
      
      requirements:
        - 冷凝水不能积存
        - 排水管保温防冷凝
        - 设置溢流报警
        
      drain_system:
        method: 集中立管排放
        outlet: 污水处理系统
        retention_time: {value: "<1", unit: h}
        note: 冷凝水不积存
        
    isolation_ward:
      name: 隔离病房/负压病房
      
      special_requirements:
        - 冷凝水单独收集
        - 消毒处理后排放
        - 防止交叉感染
        
      drain_system:
        collection:
          description: 隔离病房FCU冷凝水独立收集
          tank: 专用消毒收集罐
          capacity: {value: 50, unit: L}
        treatment:
          method: 化学消毒（次氯酸钠）
          contact_time: {value: 30, unit: min}
          concentration: {value: 500, unit: "mg/L"}
        discharge:
          destination: 消毒后进入污水系统
          monitoring: 记录消毒和排放
          
    operating_room:
      name: 手术室
      
      special_requirements:
        - 不产生冷凝水（设计要求）
        - 空调系统采用干盘管或无冷凝设计
        - 如有冷凝，立即排走
        
      drain_system:
        design: 尽量避免冷凝
        backup: 如有冷凝水，直接排入专用管道
        
    icu:
      name: ICU
      
      drain_system:
        method: 与普通病房类似
        additional:
          - 加强保温
          - 双重溢流保护
          - 快速响应报警
          
  # ========================================
  # 维护与清洁
  # ========================================
  maintenance_cleaning:
    
    routine_maintenance:
      frequency: 每月1次
      content:
        - 检查集水盘清洁度
        - 检查排水管通畅
        - 清理存水弯
        - 测试水位开关
        
    deep_cleaning:
      frequency: 每年1次（夏季前）
      content:
        - 集水盘消毒清洗
        - 排水管路冲洗
        - 更换老化密封件
        - 检查保温层完整性
        
    blockage_clearing:
      trigger: 排水不畅或溢流报警
      method:
        step_1: 关闭FCU冷水阀
        step_2: 清理集水盘杂物
        step_3: 疏通排水管（使用疏通器）
        step_4: 冲洗管路
        step_5: 恢复运行，观察
        
    hygiene_control:
      purpose: 防止细菌/霉菌滋生
      measures:
        - 保持排水通畅，不积水
        - 定期消毒集水盘
        - 使用抑菌型集水盘（可选）
        - 空调停用期间保持通风干燥
```

## 系统 6.1: PLUMB-RW 雨水排水系统

```yaml
System_Topology:

  identity:
    system_id: PLUMB-RW
    system_name: 雨水排水系统
    system_name_en: Rainwater Drainage System
    system_category: PLUMB
    system_type: 给排水-雨水
    priority_level: P3-GENERAL
    
    description: |
      医院建筑雨水排水系统，收集屋面、露台、广场等区域雨水并排放。
      采用重力流排水为主，必要时设置雨水泵站。
      设置雨水收集回用系统，用于绿化灌溉和道路冲洗。
      系统设计满足暴雨重现期要求，防止内涝。
      
    design_basis:
      rainfall:
        design_return_period: {value: 50, unit: "年", note: "重要公共建筑"}
        rainfall_intensity:
          formula: "q = 167A₁(1+C·lgP)/(t+b)ⁿ"
          note: 根据当地暴雨强度公式
        duration: {value: 5, unit: min}
      roof_area:
        total: {value: 15000, unit: "m²", note: "典型大型医院"}
      runoff_coefficient:
        roof: {value: 0.9}
        pavement: {value: 0.85}
        green: {value: 0.15}
        
    design_standards:
      - GB 50015-2019 建筑给水排水设计标准
      - GB 50014-2021 室外排水设计标准
      - GB 50400-2016 建筑与小区雨水控制及利用工程技术规范
      - 海绵城市建设技术指南
    
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024

  boundary:
    inputs:
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_IN_001
        name: 屋面雨水
        from_system: 建筑屋面
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_IN_002
        name: 露台雨水
        from_system: 室外露台/平台
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_IN_003
        name: 场地雨水
        from_system: 室外场地
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_IN_004
        name: 电力供应
        from_system: ELEC-LV
        medium: ELEC-LV
        parameters:
          for: 雨水泵站
          
    outputs:
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_OUT_001
        name: 市政雨水管网
        to_system: 市政雨水
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_OUT_002
        name: 雨水回用
        to_system: 绿化/道路冲洗
        medium: WATER-RECLAIM
        
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_OUT_003
        name: 状态反馈
        to_system: INT-BA
        medium: SIGNAL-BMS

  nodes:
  
    source_nodes:
    
      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
        node_name: 屋面雨水收集
        node_name_en: Roof Rainwater Collection
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 收集屋面雨水
        medium_in: RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        is_boundary_input: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          roof_types:
            flat_roof:
              name: 平屋面
              slope: {value: "1-3", unit: "%"}
              drainage: 有组织排水
            sloped_roof:
              name: 坡屋面
              slope: {value: ">10", unit: "%"}
              drainage: 檐沟收集
            green_roof:
              name: 绿化屋面
              drainage: 蓄排水板+溢流
              retention: {value: 50, unit: "mm"}
              
          collection_components:
            roof_drain:
              name: 雨水斗
              type:
                gravity: 重力式雨水斗
                siphon: 虹吸式雨水斗
              material: 铸铁/不锈钢
              size: DN75-DN150
              strainer: 防叶片格栅
            gutter:
              name: 天沟/檐沟
              material: 镀锌钢板/不锈钢
              size: 根据汇水面积
              slope: {value: ">0.5", unit: "%"}
            overflow:
              name: 溢流口
              purpose: 超设计暴雨时溢流
              size: 不小于雨水斗
              
        design_calculation:
          flow_rate:
            formula: "Q = ψ × q × F / 10000"
            parameters:
              ψ: 径流系数
              q: 暴雨强度 (L/s·ha)
              F: 汇水面积 (m²)
            
        location_hint:
          space_type: 屋面
          distribution: 按汇水分区布置

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_SRC_GROUND
        node_name: 场地雨水收集
        node_name_en: Ground Rainwater Collection
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 收集场地雨水
        medium_in: RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        is_boundary_input: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          collection_facilities:
            catch_basin:
              name: 雨水口
              type: 平箅式/立箅式
              grate: 铸铁/球墨铸铁
              size: 400×600mm
              capacity: {value: 20, unit: "L/s"}
              spacing: {value: "25-50", unit: m}
            trench_drain:
              name: 线性排水沟
              material: 树脂混凝土
              width: {value: 150, unit: mm}
              grate: 不锈钢格栅
              application: 广场、入口
            permeable_pavement:
              name: 透水铺装
              type: 透水砖/透水混凝土
              infiltration: {value: ">1", unit: "mm/min"}
              application: 停车场、人行道
              
          sponge_city_facilities:
            rain_garden:
              name: 雨水花园
              purpose: 滞留、净化
              depth: {value: 150, unit: mm}
            bioswale:
              name: 植草沟
              purpose: 传输、净化
              slope: {value: "1-4", unit: "%"}
            detention_pond:
              name: 滞留塘
              purpose: 调蓄峰值流量
              volume: 根据设计计算
              
        location_hint:
          space_type: 室外场地
          areas: 停车场、广场、道路

    distribution_nodes:
    
      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
        node_name: 重力流排水系统
        node_name_en: Gravity Drainage System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: PIP
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 重力排放屋面雨水
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_type: 重力流内排水
          
          components:
            vertical_stack:
              name: 雨水立管
              material: HDPE/铸铁
              size: {value: "DN100-DN150", unit: mm}
              location: 建筑内管井
              quantity: 按汇水分区
            horizontal_pipe:
              name: 雨水横管
              material: HDPE/铸铁
              size: {value: "DN150-DN300", unit: mm}
              location: 地下室顶板下/室外埋地
              slope: {value: ">1", unit: "%"}
            check_valve:
              name: 逆止阀
              location: 出户管
              purpose: 防止市政倒灌
              
          design_parameters:
            max_flow_velocity: {value: 3, unit: "m/s"}
            min_slope: {value: 1, unit: "%"}
            fullness: {value: "<0.8"}
            
        location_hint:
          space_type: 建筑内/地下

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_DST_SIPHON_SYSTEM
        node_name: 虹吸式排水系统
        node_name_en: Siphonic Drainage System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: PIP
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 虹吸原理快速排水
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_type: 虹吸式屋面雨水排水
          
          principle: |
            利用虹吸原理，管道满流运行，
            排水能力大，管径小，不需要坡度。
            
          components:
            siphon_drain:
              name: 虹吸雨水斗
              type: 气水分离型
              material: HDPE/不锈钢
              features:
                - 防涡流
                - 气水分离
                - 自清洁
            siphon_pipe:
              name: 虹吸管道
              material: HDPE（热熔连接）
              pressure_rating: PN10
              features:
                - 满流设计
                - 无需坡度
                - 可水平敷设
            transition_point:
              name: 虹吸/重力转换点
              location: 建筑底部
              function: 虹吸转为重力流
              
          advantages:
            - 管径小（比重力流小30-50%）
            - 横管无需坡度
            - 排水能力大
            - 适合大跨度屋面
            
          design_parameters:
            design_depth: {value: 55, unit: mm, note: "斗前水深"}
            max_negative_pressure: {value: -80, unit: kPa}
            flow_velocity: {value: "3-10", unit: "m/s"}
            
        applicable: 大型裙房屋面、门诊大厅屋面
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: 大跨度屋面

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_DST_PUMP_STATION
        node_name: 雨水提升泵站
        node_name_en: Rainwater Pump Station
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: PMP
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 提升低洼区域雨水
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        multiplicity: optional
        condition: 当雨水无法重力排放时设置
        
        equipment_parameters:
          application:
            - 地下室车道入口
            - 下沉广场
            - 低于市政管网标高区域
            
          components:
            sump:
              name: 集水池
              material: 钢筋混凝土
              volume: 根据来水量计算
              depth: {value: ">1.5", unit: m}
            pump:
              name: 潜水排污泵
              type: 潜水轴流泵/混流泵
              quantity: {value: "≥2", unit: "台", note: "1用1备"}
              material: 铸铁/不锈钢
              capacity: 根据汇水面积
            level_control:
              name: 液位控制
              type: 浮球开关/超声波液位计
              levels:
                start: 高液位
                stop: 低液位
                alarm: 超高液位
            check_valve:
              name: 止回阀
              location: 泵出口
            gate_valve:
              name: 闸阀
              location: 泵进出口
              
          control_logic:
            normal:
              - 水位达到启动液位→启动1台泵
              - 水位继续上升→启动2台泵
              - 水位下降至停止液位→停泵
            alarm:
              - 超高液位报警
              - 泵故障报警
            alternation:
              - 双泵交替运行
              - 故障自动切换
              
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - point_id: RW_SUMP_LEVEL
              point_name: 集水池液位
              point_type: AI
              unit: m
          status:
            - point_id: RW_PUMP_RUN
              point_name: 雨水泵运行
              point_type: DI
          alarms:
            - point_id: RW_HIGH_LEVEL
              alarm_name: 液位超高
              severity: HIGH
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: 地下室/室外
          position: 汇水最低点

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_DST_RECLAIM
        node_name: 雨水收集回用系统
        node_name_en: Rainwater Harvesting System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: TRT
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 雨水收集处理回用
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RECLAIM
        
        multiplicity: optional
        condition: 节水要求或海绵城市要求
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_components:
            initial_diversion:
              name: 初期雨水弃流装置
              function: 弃除初期污染雨水
              volume: {value: "2-5", unit: "mm降雨"}
              method: 容积式/流量式
            storage_tank:
              name: 雨水蓄水池
              material: 钢筋混凝土/PP模块
              volume:
                calculation: 根据汇水面积和回用量
                typical: {value: "200-500", unit: "m³"}
              location: 地下
            treatment:
              name: 雨水处理设备
              process:
                - 格栅过滤
                - 沉淀
                - 过滤（砂滤/膜滤）
                - 消毒（次氯酸钠）
              output_quality: 符合《城市污水再生利用 城市杂用水水质》
            supply_pump:
              name: 雨水供水泵
              type: 变频供水
              pressure: 根据供水点需求
            monitoring:
              parameters:
                - 浊度
                - pH
                - 余氯
                
          reuse_applications:
            greening:
              name: 绿化灌溉
              percentage: {value: 60, unit: "%"}
            road_washing:
              name: 道路冲洗
              percentage: {value: 20, unit: "%"}
            car_wash:
              name: 洗车
              percentage: {value: 10, unit: "%"}
            toilet_flushing:
              name: 冲厕（可选）
              percentage: {value: 10, unit: "%"}
              note: 需要独立中水管道
              
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - point_id: RW_TANK_LEVEL
              point_name: 蓄水池液位
              point_type: AI
              unit: m
            - point_id: RW_TURBIDITY
              point_name: 浊度
              point_type: AI
              unit: NTU
          status:
            - point_id: RW_SUPPLY_PUMP
              point_name: 供水泵运行
              point_type: DI
              
        location_hint:
          space_type: 地下室/室外
          area: 绿化带附近

    sink_nodes:
    
      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_SNK_MUNICIPAL
        node_name: 市政雨水管网
        node_name_en: Municipal Storm Sewer
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        function: 排入市政雨水系统
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        is_boundary_output: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          connection:
            point: 院区雨水出口
            pipe_size: {value: "DN400-DN600", unit: mm}
            check_valve: required
            
          requirements:
            elevation: 高于市政管网
            flow_control: 必要时设置调蓄
            water_quality: 符合排放标准
            
        location_hint:
          space_type: 院区边界
          connection: 市政雨水井

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_SNK_REUSE
        node_name: 雨水回用点
        node_name_en: Rainwater Reuse Point
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        function: 雨水回用末端
        medium_in: WATER-RECLAIM
        medium_out: WATER-RECLAIM
        
        is_boundary_output: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          outlets:
            irrigation_valve:
              name: 绿化灌溉阀门
              type: 电磁阀
              control: 定时/智能灌溉
              location: 绿化带
            wash_tap:
              name: 冲洗龙头
              type: 自闭式水嘴
              marking: "非饮用水"标识
              location: 道路边、停车场
              
        location_hint:
          space_type: 室外绑定化区域

  edges:
  
    collection_edges:
      - edge_id: PLUMB-RW_EDGE_001
        edge_name: 屋面至雨水斗
        edge_type: SURFACE
        from_node: 屋面
        to_node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: RAIN
        
    drainage_edges:
      - edge_id: PLUMB-RW_EDGE_011
        edge_name: 雨水立管
        edge_type: PIP
        from_node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
        to_node: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - edge_id: PLUMB-RW_EDGE_012
        edge_name: 出户雨水管
        edge_type: PIP
        from_node: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
        to_node: PLUMB-RW_SNK_MUNICIPAL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: WATER-RAIN

  typical_paths:
  
    - path_id: PLUMB-RW_PATH_GRAVITY
      path_name: 重力排水路径
      path_type: DRAIN
      description: 屋面雨水重力排放
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
          action: 雨水斗收集屋面雨水
        - step: 2
          node: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
          action: 立管、横管输送
        - step: 3
          node: PLUMB-RW_SNK_MUNICIPAL
          action: 排入市政雨水管

    - path_id: PLUMB-RW_PATH_RECLAIM
      path_name: 雨水回用路径
      path_type: RECLAIM
      description: 雨水收集处理回用
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
          action: 收集初期弃流后的雨水
        - step: 2
          node: PLUMB-RW_DST_RECLAIM
          action: 蓄水、处理、消毒
        - step: 3
          node: PLUMB-RW_SNK_REUSE
          action: 供绿化灌溉使用

  control_logic:
  
    pump_station_control:
      name: 雨水泵站控制
      description: 液位控制启停泵
      
      control_sequence:
        start_1:
          trigger: 液位>启动1
          action: 启动1#泵
        start_2:
          trigger: 液位>启动2
          action: 启动2#泵
        stop:
          trigger: 液位<停止
          action: 停止所有泵
        alarm:
          trigger: 液位>报警
          action: 超高液位报警
          
    reclaim_system_control:
      name: 雨水回用控制
      description: 雨水收集和供水控制
      
      control_sequence:
        collection:
          - 初期雨水弃流（前2mm降雨）
          - 弃流后雨水进入蓄水池
          - 池满后溢流至市政
        treatment:
          - 蓄水池液位>处理启动→启动处理设备
          - 清水池满→停止处理
        supply:
          - 用水信号→启动供水泵
          - 变频恒压供水
          - 蓄水池液位低→切换至自来水

  alarm_protection:
  
    drainage_alarms:
      - alarm_id: ALM_RW_OVERFLOW
        alarm_name: 雨水溢流
        severity: MEDIUM
        trigger: 屋面溢流口有水流出
        action: 检查排水系统
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_RW_PUMP_FAIL
        alarm_name: 雨水泵故障
        severity: HIGH
        trigger: 泵运行信号与液位矛盾
        action: 检修泵，启动备用
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_RW_HIGH_LEVEL
        alarm_name: 集水池超高液位
        severity: CRITICAL
        trigger: 液位超限
        action: 紧急排水，防止内涝

  dependencies:
    
    upstream_dependencies:
      - dependency_id: DEP_RW_POWER
        from_system: ELEC-LV
        dependency_type: POWER_SUPPLY
        criticality: MEDIUM
        for: 雨水泵站
        
    downstream_dependencies:
      - dependency_id: DEP_TO_MUNICIPAL
        to_system: 市政雨水
        dependency_type: DRAINAGE
        criticality: MEDIUM
```

## 系统 6.2: ELEC-LTG 照明系统

```yaml

                  - 故障检测
                  - 消防联动
                  - 疏散路径规划
              area_controller:
                name: 区域控制器
                location: 各防火分区
                function:
                  - 区域监控
                  - 就地控制
              luminaires:
                name: 可寻址灯具
                feature: 双向通讯
                function:
                  - 方向可变
                  - 状态反馈
                  - 故障报告
                  
            operation_modes:
              normal:
                description: 平时状态
                luminaires: 充电待机
                signs: 常亮指示
              fire_mode:
                description: 火灾状态
                trigger: FAS火灾信号
                action:
                  - 所有应急灯亮
                  - 疏散指示按计算路径指向
                  - 着火区域指示改变方向
              blackout:
                description: 停电状态
                trigger: 正常电源失电
                action: 应急灯自动点亮
                
        control_points:
          status:
            - point_id: EL_SYSTEM_STATUS
              point_name: 系统状态
              point_type: DI
              values: [正常, 故障, 应急]
            - point_id: EL_BATTERY_STATUS
              point_name: 电池状态
              point_type: DI
          commands:
            - point_id: EL_FIRE_MODE
              point_name: 消防模式
              point_type: DI
              from: FIRE-FAS
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: 全院
          distribution: 疏散通道/关键区域

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_CONTROL
        node_name: 智能照明控制系统
        node_name_en: Intelligent Lighting Control System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: CTR
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 照明智能控制
        medium_in: SIGNAL
        medium_out: CONTROL
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_type: 智能照明控制系统
          protocol:
            field_bus:
              - KNX
              - DALI
              - Modbus
            integration: BACnet（与BA集成）
            
          components:
            central_controller:
              name: 照明主控制器
              location: BA机房
              function:
                - 全院照明监控
                - 场景控制
                - 定时控制
                - 能耗统计
            area_controller:
              name: 区域控制器
              location: 各楼层/区域
              function:
                - 区域照明控制
                - 传感器采集
            field_devices:
              switch_actuator:
                name: 开关执行器
                type: 继电器模块
                channels: {value: "4-12", unit: "路"}
              dimming_actuator:
                name: 调光执行器
                type: 0-10V/DALI
                channels: {value: "4-8", unit: "路"}
              sensor:
                types:
                  - 人体感应传感器
                  - 照度传感器
                  - 多功能面板
                  
          control_strategies:
            time_schedule:
              name: 时间表控制
              description: 按作息时间开关
              application: 公共区域、办公室
              example:
                - "07:00 开启公共区域照明"
                - "18:00 调暗非必要区域"
                - "22:00 切换夜间模式"
                
            occupancy_sensing:
              name: 人体感应控制
              description: 检测人员进入/离开
              application: 走廊、卫生间、会议室
              parameters:
                detection_range: {value: 8, unit: m}
                hold_time: {value: "5-15", unit: min}
                
            daylight_harvesting:
              name: 日光补偿控制
              description: 根据自然光调节人工照明
              application: 窗边区域
              parameters:
                target_illuminance: {value: 300, unit: lux}
                control_band: {value: "±50", unit: lux}
                
            scene_control:
              name: 场景控制
              description: 预设照明场景
              scenes:
                ward_day:
                  name: 病房-日间
                  illuminance: {value: 100, unit: lux}
                  color_temp: {value: 4000, unit: K}
                ward_night:
                  name: 病房-夜间
                  illuminance: {value: 10, unit: lux}
                  color_temp: {value: 2700, unit: K}
                examination:
                  name: 检查模式
                  illuminance: {value: 500, unit: lux}
                  color_temp: {value: 5000, unit: K}
                cleaning:
                  name: 清洁模式
                  illuminance: {value: 300, unit: lux}
                  duration: {value: 30, unit: min}
                  
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - point_id: LCS_ILLUMINANCE
              point_name: 环境照度
              point_type: AI
              unit: lux
            - point_id: LCS_OCCUPANCY
              point_name: 人员在场
              point_type: DI
          commands:
            - point_id: LCS_SCENE
              point_name: 场景切换
              point_type: DO
            - point_id: LCS_DIMMING
              point_name: 调光控制
              point_type: AO
              range: [0, 100]
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: BA机房/各区域

    sink_nodes:
    
      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_SNK_SPACE
        node_name: 照明空间
        node_name_en: Illuminated Space
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        function: 接受照明效果
        medium_in: LIGHT
        medium_out: ILLUMINATED_ENVIRONMENT
        
        is_boundary_output: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          space_categories:
            medical_treatment:
              areas:
                - 手术室
                - 诊室
                - 治疗室
                - 检查室
              requirements:
                - 高照度
                - 高显色性
                - 无频闪
                - 专业灯具
            patient_care:
              areas:
                - 病房
                - ICU
                - 观察室
              requirements:
                - 舒适照明
                - 夜间照明
                - 分区控制
                - 患者个人控制
            public_circulation:
              areas:
                - 门诊大厅
                - 走廊
                - 电梯厅
              requirements:
                - 均匀照明
                - 节能控制
                - 应急照明
            support_service:
              areas:
                - 办公室
                - 会议室
                - 餐厅
                - 库房
              requirements:
                - 标准照明
                - 智能控制
                
        location_hint:
          space_type: 全院建筑空间

  edges:
  
    power_edges:
      - edge_id: ELEC-LTG_EDGE_001
        edge_name: 正常电源至配电箱
        edge_type: CAB
        from_node: ELEC-LTG_SRC_NORMAL
        to_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: ELEC-LV
        
      - edge_id: ELEC-LTG_EDGE_002
        edge_name: 配电箱至灯具
        edge_type: CAB
        from_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
        to_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_GENERAL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: ELEC-LV

    control_edges:
      - edge_id: ELEC-LTG_EDGE_011
        edge_name: 控制系统至配电箱
        edge_type: SIG
        from_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_CONTROL
        to_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: SIGNAL-CONTROL

  typical_paths:
  
    - path_id: ELEC-LTG_PATH_NORMAL
      path_name: 正常照明路径
      path_type: PWR
      description: 正常供电照明
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          node: ELEC-LTG_SRC_NORMAL
          action: 从低压配电供电
        - step: 2
          node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
          action: 配电箱分配
        - step: 3
          node: ELEC-LTG_DST_GENERAL
          action: 灯具点亮
        - step: 4
          node: ELEC-LTG_SNK_SPACE
          action: 空间照明

    - path_id: ELEC-LTG_PATH_EMERGENCY
      path_name: 应急照明路径
      path_type: EMR
      description: 火灾或停电时应急照明
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          trigger: 火灾信号或停电
        - step: 2
          node: ELEC-LTG_SRC_EMERGENCY
          action: EPS或电池供电
        - step: 3
          node: ELEC-LTG_DST_EMERGENCY
          action: 应急灯具点亮
        - step: 4
          node: 疏散通道
          action: 提供疏散照明

  control_logic:
  
    daily_schedule:
      name: 日常时间表控制
      description: 按医院作息自动控制
      
      schedule:
        "06:30":
          action: 开启公共区域照明
          areas: 走廊、大厅、电梯厅
        "07:00":
          action: 开启诊室照明
          areas: 门诊、医技
        "08:00":
          action: 全部照明正常
        "18:00":
          action: 关闭部分照明
          areas: 非必要办公区
        "21:00":
          action: 切换夜间模式
          areas: 病房（降低照度）
        "22:00":
          action: 公共区域减光
          areas: 走廊（50%亮度）
          
    fire_interlock:
      name: 消防联动
      description: 火灾时照明控制
      
      trigger: FIRE-FAS火灾确认信号
      
      response:
        emergency_lighting:
          action: 所有应急照明点亮
          mode: 100%亮度
        evacuation_signs:
          action: 疏散指示启动
          mode: 智能疏散（如有）
        non_fire_floors:
          action: 保持正常照明
          purpose: 避免恐慌

  alarm_protection:
  
    lighting_alarms:
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_LAMP_FAIL
        alarm_name: 灯具故障
        severity: LOW
        trigger: 灯具不亮/闪烁
        action: 更换灯具
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_CIRCUIT_TRIP
        alarm_name: 照明回路跳闸
        severity: MEDIUM
        trigger: 回路断路器跳闸
        action: 检查短路/过载
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_EMERGENCY_FAIL
        alarm_name: 应急照明故障
        severity: HIGH
        trigger: 应急灯自检失败
        action: 立即检修

  dependencies:
    
    upstream_dependencies:
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_NORMAL
        from_system: ELEC-LV
        dependency_type: POWER_SUPPLY
        criticality: HIGH
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_EMERGENCY
        from_system: ELEC-EPS
        dependency_type: EMERGENCY_POWER
        criticality: CRITICAL
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_FAS
        from_system: FIRE-FAS
        dependency_type: FIRE_SIGNAL
        criticality: CRITICAL
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_BA
        from_system: INT-BA
        dependency_type: CONTROL
        criticality: MEDIUM
```

---

## 系统间完整依赖关系总图

```yaml
System_Dependency_Matrix:

  identity:
    name: 医院机电系统依赖关系总图
    description: 展示所有系统间的依赖和联动关系
    version: 1.0
    total_systems: 26
    last_updated: 2024

  # ========================================
  # 系统清单
  # ========================================
  system_inventory:
    
    electrical_systems:
      - id: ELEC-HV
        name: 高压配电系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-LV
        name: 低压配电系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-EPS
        name: 应急电源系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-UPS
        name: 不间断电源系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-EL
        name: 电梯系统
        priority: P2
      - id: ELEC-LTG
        name: 照明系统
        priority: P2
        
    hvac_systems:
      - id: HVAC-CHP
        name: 冷热源系统
        priority: P1
      - id: HVAC-AHU
        name: 空调机组系统
        priority: P2
      - id: HVAC-FCU
        name: 风机盘管系统
        priority: P3
        
    plumbing_systems:
      - id: PLUMB-DWS
        name: 生活给水系统
        priority: P2
      - id: PLUMB-HWS
        name: 生活热水系统
        priority: P3
      - id: PLUMB-SAN
        name: 污废水系统
        priority: P2
      - id: PLUMB-RW
        name: 雨水排水系统
        priority: P3
        
    medical_gas_systems:
      - id: MGAS-O2
        name: 医用氧气系统
        priority: P1
      - id: MGAS-VAC
        name: 医用负压系统
        priority: P1
      - id: MGAS-AIR
        name: 医用压缩空气系统
        priority: P1
      - id: MGAS-N2O
        name: 笑气系统
        priority: P2
        
    fire_protection_systems:
      - id: FIRE-FAS
        name: 火灾自动报警系统
        priority: P1
      - id: FIRE-SPS
        name: 自动喷水灭火系统
        priority: P1
      - id: FIRE-EXH
        name: 防排烟系统
        priority: P1
        
    integration_systems:
      - id: INT-BA
        name: 楼宇自动化系统
        priority: P2
      - id: INT-SEC
        name: 安防系统
        priority: P2
      - id: INT-NUR
        name: 护理呼叫系统
        priority: P2
        
    medical_environment_systems:
      - id: MED-OR
        name: 手术室净化系统
        priority: P1
      - id: MED-ICU
        name: ICU净化系统
        priority: P1
      - id: MED-LAB
        name: 检验科通风系统
        priority: P2

  # ========================================
  # 电力依赖关系（Power Dependencies）
  # ========================================
  power_dependencies:
    
    primary_power_chain:
      description: 主电源供应链
      flow:
        - from: 市电
          to: ELEC-HV
          type: PRIMARY
        - from: ELEC-HV
          to: ELEC-LV
          type: TRANSFORM
        - from: ELEC-LV
          to: ALL_SYSTEMS
          type: DISTRIBUTION
          
    emergency_power_chain:
      description: 应急电源供应链
      flow:
        - from: ELEC-LV
          to: ELEC-EPS
          type: CHARGING
        - from: ELEC-EPS
          to: CRITICAL_LOADS
          type: BACKUP
          targets:
            - ELEC-EL（消防电梯）
            - ELEC-LTG（应急照明）
            - FIRE-FAS
            - FIRE-EXH
            - MGAS-O2
            - MGAS-VAC
            - MED-OR
            - MED-ICU
            
    ups_power_chain:
      description: UPS电源供应链
      flow:
        - from: ELEC-LV
          to: ELEC-UPS
          type: CHARGING
        - from: ELEC-UPS
          to: IT_LOADS
          type: UNINTERRUPTED
          targets:
            - INT-BA（控制器）
            - INT-SEC（服务器）
            - INT-NUR（主机）
            - FIRE-FAS（主机）
            - 手术室设备
            
  # ========================================
  # 冷热源依赖关系（Thermal Dependencies）
  # ========================================
  thermal_dependencies:
    
    cooling_chain:
      description: 冷源供应链
      flow:
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: HVAC-AHU
          type: CHW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: HVAC-FCU
          type: CHW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: MED-OR
          type: CHW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: MED-ICU
          type: CHW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: MED-LAB
          type: CHW_SUPPLY
          
    heating_chain:
      description: 热源供应链
      flow:
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: HVAC-AHU
          type: HW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: HVAC-FCU
          type: HW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: PLUMB-HWS
          type: STEAM/HW_SUPPLY
          
    air_conditioning_chain:
      description: 空调供应链
      flow:
        - from: HVAC-AHU
          to: MED-OR
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR
        - from: HVAC-AHU
          to: MED-ICU
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR
        - from: HVAC-AHU
          to: MED-LAB
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR
        - from: HVAC-FCU
          to: WARDS
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR
          
  # ========================================
  # 消防联动关系（Fire Protection Interlocks）
  # ========================================
  fire_interlocks:
    
    fas_master:
      description: FAS作为消防主控系统
      sends_to:
        - target: ELEC-EL
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 电梯迫降/消防模式
        - target: FIRE-SPS
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 喷淋泵启动
        - target: FIRE-EXH
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 排烟系统启动
        - target: HVAC-AHU
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 空调停止/新风关闭
        - target: HVAC-FCU
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 着火层FCU停止
        - target: ELEC-LTG
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 应急照明启动
        - target: INT-BA
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 广播疏散/状态显示
        - target: INT-SEC
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 门禁紧急开启
          
    fire_floor_isolation:
      description: 着火楼层隔离
      actions:
        - system: HVAC-AHU
          action: 关闭着火区域AHU
        - system: HVAC-FCU
          action: 关闭着火区域水阀
        - system: HVAC-CHP
          action: 关闭着火楼层供水阀
        - system: FIRE-EXH
          action: 开启着火区域排烟
          
  # ========================================
  # 医疗气体依赖关系（Medical Gas Dependencies）
  # ========================================
  medical_gas_dependencies:
    
    primary_users:
      MED-OR:
        requires:
          - MGAS-O2（氧气）
          - MGAS-VAC（负压）
          - MGAS-AIR（压缩空气）
          - MGAS-N2O（笑气）
      MED-ICU:
        requires:
          - MGAS-O2
          - MGAS-VAC
          - MGAS-AIR
      WARDS:
        requires:
          - MGAS-O2
          - MGAS-VAC
          
    alarm_integration:
      from: MGAS-ALL
      to: INT-NUR
      signals:
        - 区域报警盘状态
        - 气源压力异常
        - 真空度异常
        
  # ========================================
  # 楼宇自动化集成（BA Integration）
  # ========================================
  ba_integration:
    
    monitored_systems:
      mechanical:
        - HVAC-CHP（完全控制）
        - HVAC-AHU（完全控制）
        - HVAC-FCU（监控+温度设定）
        - MED-OR（监控）
        - MED-ICU（监控）
        - MED-LAB（监控）
      electrical:
        - ELEC-LV（监控）
        - ELEC-EPS（监控）
        - ELEC-UPS（监控）
        - ELEC-EL（监控）
        - ELEC-LTG（完全控制）
      plumbing:
        - PLUMB-DWS（监控）
        - PLUMB-HWS（监控+控制）
        - PLUMB-SAN（监控）
        - PLUMB-RW（监控）
      medical_gas:
        - MGAS-O2（监控）
        - MGAS-VAC（监控）
        - MGAS-AIR（监控）
      fire:
        - FIRE-FAS（信号接收）
        - FIRE-SPS（监控）
        - FIRE-EXH（监控）
        
    integration_protocols:
      primary: BACnet IP
      secondary:
        - Modbus TCP
        - OPC UA
      legacy:
        - Modbus RTU
        - Lonworks

  # ========================================
  # 依赖关系矩阵
  # ========================================
  dependency_matrix:
    
    format: |
      行：依赖方（需要...的系统）
      列：被依赖方（提供...的系统）
      值：依赖类型和关键程度
      
    matrix:
      # ELEC-HV依赖
      ELEC-HV:
        市电: {type: PRIMARY, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # ELEC-LV依赖
      ELEC-LV:
        ELEC-HV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # ELEC-EPS依赖
      ELEC-EPS:
        ELEC-LV: {type: CHARGING, criticality: HIGH}
        
      # ELEC-UPS依赖
      ELEC-UPS:
        ELEC-LV: {type: CHARGING, criticality: HIGH}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}
        
      # ELEC-EL依赖
      ELEC-EL:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}
        INT-SEC: {type: CONTROL, criticality: MEDIUM}
        
      # ELEC-LTG依赖
      ELEC-LTG:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: HIGH}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: MEDIUM}
        
      # HVAC-CHP依赖
      HVAC-CHP:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}
        PLUMB-DWS: {type: WATER, criticality: HIGH}
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: HIGH}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: HIGH}
        
      # HVAC-AHU依赖
      HVAC-AHU:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: HIGH}
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: HIGH}
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: HIGH}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # HVAC-FCU依赖
      HVAC-FCU:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: MEDIUM}
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: HIGH}
        HVAC-AHU: {type: FRESH_AIR, criticality: MEDIUM}
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: LOW}
        
      # MED-OR依赖
      MED-OR:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: CRITICAL}
        HVAC-AHU: {type: CONDITIONED_AIR, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-O2: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-VAC: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-AIR: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-N2O: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: HIGH}
        INT-BA: {type: MONITOR, criticality: MEDIUM}
        
      # MED-ICU依赖
      MED-ICU:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: CRITICAL}
        HVAC-AHU: {type: CONDITIONED_AIR, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-O2: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-VAC: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-AIR: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: HIGH}
        INT-NUR: {type: NURSE_CALL, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # FIRE-FAS依赖
      FIRE-FAS:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # FIRE-SPS依赖
      FIRE-SPS:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        PLUMB-DWS: {type: WATER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # FIRE-EXH依赖
      FIRE-EXH:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # INT-BA依赖
      INT-BA:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: HIGH}
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: HIGH}
```

## 跨系统联动场景汇总

```yaml
Cross_System_Scenarios:

  identity:
    name: 跨系统联动场景汇总
    description: 涉及多个系统协同的典型运行场景
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024

  scenarios:
  
    # ========================================
    # 场景1：火灾应急响应
    # ========================================
    - scenario_id: SCN_FIRE_EMERGENCY
      scenario_name: 火灾应急响应
      trigger: 火灾报警确认
      priority: CRITICAL
      
      participating_systems:
        - FIRE-FAS（主控）
        - FIRE-SPS
        - FIRE-EXH
        - ELEC-EL
        - ELEC-LTG
        - HVAC-AHU
        - HVAC-FCU
        - HVAC-CHP
        - INT-BA
        - INT-SEC
        
      sequence:
        t_0:
          event: 火灾探测器动作
          system: FIRE-FAS
          
        t_30s:
          event: 火灾确认
          system: FIRE-FAS
          action: 发出联动信号
          
        t_32s:
          event: 电梯迫降
          system: ELEC-EL
          action: 就近停靠，返回基站
          
        t_35s:
          event: 排烟启动
          system: FIRE-EXH
          action: 开启排烟阀和排烟风机
          
        t_35s:
          event: 加压送风
          system: FIRE-EXH
          action: 开启楼梯间加压风机
          
        t_40s:
          event: 空调停止
          system: HVAC-AHU
          action: 关闭着火区域AHU
          
        t_40s:
          event: FCU关闭
          system: HVAC-FCU
          action: 关闭着火楼层水阀
          
        t_45s:
          event: 应急照明
          system: ELEC-LTG
          action: 所有应急灯点亮
          
        t_45s:
          event: 疏散指示
          system: ELEC-LTG
          action: 智能疏散系统启动
          
        t_50s:
          event: 喷淋启动
          system: FIRE-SPS
          action: 着火区域喷头动作
          
        t_60s:
          event: 门禁开启
          system: INT-SEC
          action: 所有防火门解锁
          
        t_60s:
          event: 广播疏散
          system: INT-BA
          action: 消防广播启动
          
      post_fire_recovery:
        trigger: 消防确认火灾扑灭
        sequence:
          - 消防系统复位
          - 排烟系统停止
          - HVAC系统逐步恢复
          - 电梯恢复正常
          - 门禁恢复正常
          
    # ========================================
    # 场景2：市电中断应急响应
    # ========================================
    - scenario_id: SCN_POWER_OUTAGE
      scenario_name: 市电中断应急响应
      trigger: 市电失电
      priority: CRITICAL
      
      participating_systems:
        - ELEC-HV
        - ELEC-LV
        - ELEC-EPS
        - ELEC-UPS
        - ELEC-EL
        - ELEC-LTG
        - HVAC-CHP
        - MED-OR
        - MED-ICU
        - MGAS-O2
        - MGAS-VAC
        - INT-BA
        
      sequence:
        t_0:
          event: 市电失电
          system: ELEC-HV
          detection: 失压保护动作
          
        t_0~15s:
          event: UPS接管
          system: ELEC-UPS
          action: 无缝切换，IT负载不中断
          loads:
            - BA系统控制器
            - 手术室关键设备
            - ICU监护设备
            - 消防主机
            
        t_10s:
          event: 发电机启动
          system: ELEC-EPS
          action: 柴油发电机自启动
          
        t_15s:
          event: 发电机并网
          system: ELEC-EPS
          action: ATS切换至发电机
          
        t_15~30s:
          event: EPS负载恢复
          action: 分批恢复EPS负载
          loads:
            - 消防电梯
            - 应急照明
            - 手术室空调
            - ICU空调
            - 医用气体机组
            
        t_30s:
          event: 应急照明
          system: ELEC-LTG
          action: 应急灯已点亮（EPS供电）
          
        t_60s:
          event: 冷热源调整
          system: HVAC-CHP
          action:
            - 关闭非关键冷机
            - 保留关键区域冷源
            - 电锅炉停止，切换燃气锅炉
            
        ongoing:
          event: 监控管理
          system: INT-BA
          action:
            - 监控发电机运行
            - 优化负载分配
            - 记录事件
            
      power_restoration:
        trigger: 市电恢复
        sequence:
          - 确认市电稳定（5分钟）
          - ATS切换回市电
          - 逐步恢复正常负载
          - 发电机冷却后停止
          - UPS恢复充电
          
    # ========================================
    # 场景3：手术室紧急启用
    # ========================================
    - scenario_id: SCN_OR_EMERGENCY_START
      scenario_name: 手术室紧急启用
      trigger: 急诊手术请求
      priority: HIGH
      
      participating_systems:
        - MED-OR
        - HVAC-CHP
        - HVAC-AHU
        - MGAS-O2
        - MGAS-VAC
        - MGAS-AIR
        - MGAS-N2O
        - ELEC-LTG
        - INT-BA
        
      sequence:
        t_0:
          event: 急诊手术请求
          system: 临床系统
          action: 指定手术室
          
        t_0:
          event: 启动手术室
          system: INT-BA
          action: 触发手术室启动程序
          
        t_0~5min:
          event: 空调启动
          system: MED-OR + HVAC-AHU
          action:
            - 启动手术室AHU
            - 建立正压
            - 温湿度调节
            
        t_5min:
          event: 洁净度达标
          system: MED-OR
          verification:
            - 压差≥5Pa
            - 换气次数≥20次/h
            - 温度22±2℃
            
        t_0~2min:
          event: 医用气体确认
          system: MGAS-ALL
          verification:
            - O2压力正常
            - VAC真空度正常
            - AIR压力正常
            - N2O压力正常（如需）
            
        t_0~1min:
          event: 照明就绪
          system: ELEC-LTG
          action:
            - 无影灯预热
            - 一般照明100%
            
        t_5min:
          event: 手术室就绪
          system: INT-BA
          action: 确认就绪，通知手术团队
          
    # ========================================
    # 场景4：夏季高峰负荷管理
    # ========================================
    - scenario_id: SCN_PEAK_LOAD_SUMMER
      scenario_name: 夏季高峰负荷管理
      trigger: 室外温度>35℃ 或 电力负荷>90%
      priority: MEDIUM
      
      participating_systems:
        - HVAC-CHP
        - HVAC-AHU
        - HVAC-FCU
        - ELEC-LV
        - ELEC-LTG
        - INT-BA
        
      sequence:
        t_0:
          event: 高峰负荷检测
          system: INT-BA
          trigger: 室外>35℃ 或 电力>90%
          
        t_0:
          event: 负荷优化启动
          system: INT-BA
          action: 触发负荷削减程序
          
        t_1min:
          event: 冷源优化
          system: HVAC-CHP
          action:
            - 启动所有冷机（冰蓄冷放冷）
            - 冷冻水供水温度维持7℃
            - 冷却塔全速运行
            
        t_2min:
          event: 温度设定调整
          system: HVAC-FCU
          action:
            - 非关键区域温度设定+2℃
            - 关键区域（手术室/ICU）不变
            
        t_3min:
          event: 照明负荷削减
          system: ELEC-LTG
          action:
            - 公共区域照明降至80%
            - 关闭装饰照明
            - 利用自然光的区域降至60%
            
        t_5min:
          event: 非关键设备降载
          system: INT-BA
          action:
            - 电热水器暂停
            - 非关键电梯减速
            
        ongoing:
          event: 持续监控
          system: INT-BA
          action:
            - 监控室温和电力
            - 根据情况动态调整
            
      recovery:
        trigger: 室外<32℃ 或 电力<80%
        action: 逐步恢复正常设定
        
    # ========================================
    # 场景5：负压隔离病房启用
    # ========================================
    - scenario_id: SCN_ISOLATION_WARD_ACTIVATE
      scenario_name: 负压隔离病房启用
      trigger: 传染病患者入院
      priority: HIGH
      
      participating_systems:
        - HVAC-AHU（隔离区新风机组）
        - HVAC-FCU（隔离区）
        - FIRE-EXH（排风）
        - MGAS-O2
        - MGAS-VAC
        - INT-BA
        - INT-NUR
        
      sequence:
        t_0:
          event: 隔离病房启用请求
          system: 临床系统
          
        t_0:
          event: 启动隔离模式
          system: INT-BA
          action: 触发隔离病房启动程序
          
        t_1min:
          event: 排风启动
          system: 隔离区排风系统
          action:
            - 启动排风机
            - 建立负压
            
        t_2min:
          event: 新风启动
          system: HVAC-AHU（隔离区）
          action:
            - 启动新风机组
            - 100%新风，无回风
            
        t_3min:
          event: 负压建立
          system: 隔离病房
          verification:
            - 负压≥-5Pa（相对走廊）
            - 气流从走廊→病房→卫生间→排风
            
        t_3min:
          event: FCU调节
          system: HVAC-FCU
          action:
            - 温度设定24℃
            - 独立控制
            
        t_5min:
          event: 医用气体确认
          system: MGAS-O2, MGAS-VAC
          verification: 压力正常
          
        t_5min:
          event: 护理呼叫就绪
          system: INT-NUR
          action: 确认呼叫系统正常
          
        t_5min:
          event: 隔离病房就绪
          system: INT-BA
          action: 通知临床可收治患者

  # ========================================
  # 场景汇总表
  # ========================================
  scenario_summary:
    
    - id: SCN_FIRE_EMERGENCY
      name: 火灾应急响应
      trigger: 火灾确认
      systems: 10个
      priority: CRITICAL
      response_time: <60s
      
    - id: SCN_POWER_OUTAGE
      name: 市电中断应急
      trigger: 市电失电
      systems: 12个
      priority: CRITICAL
      response_time: <15s（UPS）, <30s（EPS）
      
    - id: SCN_OR_EMERGENCY_START
      name: 手术室紧急启用
      trigger: 急诊手术请求
      systems: 9个
      priority: HIGH
      response_time: <5min
      
    - id: SCN_PEAK_LOAD_SUMMER
      name: 夏季高峰负荷管理
      trigger: 高温/高负荷
      systems: 6个
      priority: MEDIUM
      response_time: <5min
      
    - id: SCN_ISOLATION_WARD_ACTIVATE
      name: 负压隔离病房启用
      trigger: 传染病患者入院
      systems: 7个
      priority: HIGH
      response_time: <5min
```

## 数据点统计与分类

```yaml
Data_Point_Statistics:

  identity:
    name: 医院机电系统数据点统计
    description: 各系统监控点数统计和分类
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024

  # ========================================
  # 总体统计
  # ========================================
  overall_statistics:
    
    total_systems: 26
    
    estimated_total_points:
      small_hospital:
        beds: 300
        total_points: {value: "8,000-12,000", unit: "点"}
      medium_hospital:
        beds: 600
        total_points: {value: "15,000-25,000", unit: "点"}
      large_hospital:
        beds: 1000
        total_points: {value: "30,000-50,000", unit: "点"}
        
    point_type_distribution:
      AI: {percentage: 35, description: "模拟量输入（温度、压力、流量等）"}
      AO: {percentage: 15, description: "模拟量输出（阀门开度、频率等）"}
      DI: {percentage: 35, description: "数字量输入（状态、报警等）"}
      DO: {percentage: 15, description: "数字量输出（启停命令等）"}

  # ========================================
  # 各系统点数估算
  # ========================================
  system_point_estimates:
    
    # 电气系统
    electrical_systems:
      
      ELEC-HV:
        name: 高压配电系统
        base_points:
          per_switch: {value: 15, note: "电压、电流、功率、状态、报警"}
          per_transformer: {value: 20}
        typical_quantity:
          switches: 10
          transformers: 4
        estimated_total: {value: "200-300", unit: "点"}
        
      ELEC-LV:
        name: 低压配电系统
        base_points:
          per_panel: {value: 25, note: "进线、馈线、状态"}
          per_feeder: {value: 5}
        typical_quantity:
          panels: 50
          feeders: 500
        estimated_total: {value: "3,000-4,000", unit: "点"}
        
      ELEC-EPS:
        name: 应急电源系统
        base_points:
          generator: {value: 100, note: "发动机+发电机+控制"}
          ats: {value: 20}
          eps_cabinet: {value: 30}
        typical_quantity:
          generators: 2
          ats: 10
          eps_cabinets: 20
        estimated_total: {value: "600-800", unit: "点"}
        
      ELEC-UPS:
        name: UPS系统
        base_points:
          per_ups: {value: 50, note: "输入、输出、电池、报警"}
        typical_quantity:
          ups_units: 10
        estimated_total: {value: "400-600", unit: "点"}
        
      ELEC-EL:
        name: 电梯系统
        base_points:
          per_elevator: {value: 30, note: "位置、状态、故障、能耗"}
        typical_quantity:
          elevators: 20
        estimated_total: {value: "500-700", unit: "点"}
        
      ELEC-LTG:
        name: 照明系统
        base_points:
          per_panel: {value: 15}
          per_zone: {value: 5}
        typical_quantity:
          panels: 100
          zones: 300
        estimated_total: {value: "2,000-3,000", unit: "点"}
        
    # 暖通系统
    hvac_systems:
      
      HVAC-CHP:
        name: 冷热源系统
        base_points:
          per_chiller: {value: 80, note: "运行参数+控制+报警"}
          per_boiler: {value: 60}
          per_cooling_tower: {value: 30}
          per_pump: {value: 15}
          header_system: {value: 100}
        typical_quantity:
          chillers: 4
          boilers: 3
          cooling_towers: 4
          pumps: 20
        estimated_total: {value: "800-1,200", unit: "点"}
        
      HVAC-AHU:
        name: 空调机组系统
        base_points:
          per_ahu: {value: 40, note: "温湿度、风阀、风机、过滤器"}
          per_mau: {value: 35}
          per_fau: {value: 25}
        typical_quantity:
          ahu: 30
          mau: 10
          fau: 20
        estimated_total: {value: "1,500-2,500", unit: "点"}
        
      HVAC-FCU:
        name: 风机盘管系统
        base_points:
          per_fcu: {value: 5, note: "温度、开关、阀门（简化监控）"}
          per_floor_header: {value: 20}
        typical_quantity:
          fcu: 800
          floor_headers: 20
        estimated_total: {value: "4,000-5,000", unit: "点"}
        note: FCU数量多，点数占比大
        
    # 给排水系统
    plumbing_systems:
      
      PLUMB-DWS:
        name: 生活给水系统
        base_points:
          per_pump_set: {value: 30}
          per_tank: {value: 15}
          per_zone: {value: 10}
        typical_quantity:
          pump_sets: 5
          tanks: 4
          zones: 10
        estimated_total: {value: "250-400", unit: "点"}
        
      PLUMB-HWS:
        name: 生活热水系统
        base_points:
          per_heater: {value: 25}
          per_circulation_pump: {value: 10}
        typical_quantity:
          heaters: 4
          pumps: 8
        estimated_total: {value: "150-250", unit: "点"}
        
      PLUMB-SAN:
        name: 污废水系统
        base_points:
          per_sump: {value: 20}
          per_treatment: {value: 30}
        typical_quantity:
          sumps: 10
          treatment: 2
        estimated_total: {value: "200-300", unit: "点"}
        
      PLUMB-RW:
        name: 雨水系统
        base_points:
          per_pump_station: {value: 20}
          reclaim_system: {value: 50}
        typical_quantity:
          pump_stations: 3
          reclaim: 1
        estimated_total: {value: "100-150", unit: "点"}
        
    # 医用气体系统
    medical_gas_systems:
      
      MGAS-O2:
        name: 医用氧气系统
        base_points:
          source: {value: 50, note: "液氧罐+汇流排+切换"}
          per_area_alarm: {value: 15}
          per_zone_valve: {value: 5}
        typical_quantity:
          area_alarms: 20
          zone_valves: 50
        estimated_total: {value: "400-600", unit: "点"}
        
      MGAS-VAC:
        name: 医用负压系统
        base_points:
          vacuum_station: {value: 60}
          per_area_alarm: {value: 15}
        typical_quantity:
          area_alarms: 15
```

```yaml
BMS_Point_Database:

  identity:
    name: 医院机电系统BMS点表数据库
    description: 全院监控点位完整数据库，可导出为Excel/SQL格式
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024
    total_points_estimated: 30000

  # ========================================
  # 数据库表结构定义
  # ========================================
  database_schema:
    
    tables:
      
      # 主点表
      tbl_points:
        description: 监控点位主表
        fields:
          - name: point_id
            type: VARCHAR(50)
            primary_key: true
            description: 点位唯一标识
            example: "HVAC-CHP_MB_B1_CH01_AI_CHWST"
            
          - name: point_name_cn
            type: NVARCHAR(100)
            description: 中文名称
            example: "1号冷机冷冻水供水温度"
            
          - name: point_name_en
            type: VARCHAR(100)
            description: 英文名称
            example: "Chiller-01 CHW Supply Temp"
            
          - name: system_id
            type: VARCHAR(20)
            foreign_key: tbl_systems.system_id
            description: 所属系统
            example: "HVAC-CHP"
            
          - name: subsystem_id
            type: VARCHAR(30)
            description: 子系统
            example: "HVAC-CHP-CHILLER"
            
          - name: building_code
            type: VARCHAR(10)
            description: 建筑编码
            example: "MB"
            
          - name: floor_code
            type: VARCHAR(10)
            description: 楼层编码
            example: "B1"
            
          - name: room_code
            type: VARCHAR(20)
            description: 房间编码
            example: "MECH-01"
            
          - name: equipment_id
            type: VARCHAR(30)
            foreign_key: tbl_equipment.equipment_id
            description: 设备编号
            example: "CH-01"
            
          - name: point_type
            type: VARCHAR(5)
            description: 点位类型
            values: [AI, AO, DI, DO, ACC, CALC]
            example: "AI"
            
          - name: data_type
            type: VARCHAR(20)
            description: 数据类型
            values: [REAL, INT, BOOL, ENUM, STRING]
            example: "REAL"
            
          - name: unit
            type: VARCHAR(20)
            description: 工程单位
            example: "℃"
            
          - name: range_min
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)
            description: 量程下限
            example: 0
            
          - name: range_max
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)
            description: 量程上限
            example: 50
            
          - name: precision
            type: INT
            description: 小数位数
            example: 1
            
          - name: default_value
            type: VARCHAR(50)
            description: 默认值
            example: "7.0"
            
          - name: alarm_enabled
            type: BOOLEAN
            description: 是否启用报警
            example: true
            
          - name: alarm_high_high
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)
            description: 高高报警值
            example: 15
            
          - name: alarm_high
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)
            description: 高报警值
            example: 12
            
          - name: alarm_low
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)
            description: 低报警值
            example: 5
            
          - name: alarm_low_low
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)
            description: 低低报警值
            example: 3
            
          - name: alarm_deadband
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)
            description: 报警死区
            example: 0.5
            
          - name: alarm_delay
            type: INT
            description: 报警延时(秒)
            example: 30
            
          - name: alarm_priority
            type: VARCHAR(10)
            description: 报警优先级
            values: [CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, INFO]
            example: "HIGH"
            
          - name: trend_enabled
            type: BOOLEAN
            description: 是否记录趋势
            example: true
            
          - name: trend_interval
            type: INT
            description: 趋势记录间隔(秒)
            example: 60
            
          - name: controller_id
            type: VARCHAR(30)
            foreign_key: tbl_controllers.controller_id
            description: 控制器编号
            example: "DDC-CHP-01"
            
          - name: controller_address
            type: VARCHAR(50)
            description: 控制器内地址
            example: "AI1"
            
          - name: protocol
            type: VARCHAR(20)
            description: 通讯协议
            values: [BACnet, Modbus, LON, KNX, OPC]
            example: "BACnet"
            
          - name: object_type
            type: VARCHAR(30)
            description: BACnet对象类型
            example: "Analog-Input"
            
          - name: object_instance
            type: INT
            description: BACnet对象实例
            example: 1001
            
          - name: cov_enabled
            type: BOOLEAN
            description: COV订阅
            example: true
            
          - name: cov_increment
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)
            description: COV增量
            example: 0.2
            
          - name: security_level
            type: VARCHAR(10)
            description: 安全级别
            values: [READ, WRITE, ADMIN]
            example: "READ"
            
          - name: display_group
            type: VARCHAR(50)
            description: 显示分组
            example: "冷冻站监控"
            
          - name: graphic_page
            type: VARCHAR(50)
            description: 画面页面
            example: "CHP_CHILLER_01"
            
          - name: description
            type: NVARCHAR(500)
            description: 详细描述
            
          - name: install_location
            type: NVARCHAR(200)
            description: 安装位置描述
            example: "B1层冷冻机房1号冷机冷冻水出口"
            
          - name: sensor_type
            type: VARCHAR(50)
            description: 传感器类型
            example: "Pt100"
            
          - name: signal_type
            type: VARCHAR(20)
            description: 信号类型
            example: "4-20mA"
            
          - name: is_virtual
            type: BOOLEAN
            description: 是否虚拟点
            example: false
            
          - name: calculation_formula
            type: VARCHAR(500)
            description: 计算公式(虚拟点)
            example: null
            
          - name: status
            type: VARCHAR(20)
            description: 状态
            values: [ACTIVE, INACTIVE, MAINTENANCE, DELETED]
            example: "ACTIVE"
            
          - name: create_date
            type: DATETIME
            description: 创建时间
            
          - name: update_date
            type: DATETIME
            description: 更新时间
            
      # 系统表
      tbl_systems:
        description: 系统信息表
        fields:
          - name: system_id
            type: VARCHAR(20)
            primary_key: true
          - name: system_name_cn
            type: NVARCHAR(50)
          - name: system_name_en
            type: VARCHAR(50)
          - name: system_category
            type: VARCHAR(20)
          - name: priority_level
            type: VARCHAR(10)
          - name: description
            type: NVARCHAR(500)
            
      # 设备表
      tbl_equipment:
        description: 设备信息表
        fields:
          - name: equipment_id
            type: VARCHAR(30)
            primary_key: true
          - name: equipment_name_cn
            type: NVARCHAR(100)
          - name: equipment_name_en
            type: VARCHAR(100)
          - name: system_id
            type: VARCHAR(20)
          - name: equipment_type
            type: VARCHAR(50)
          - name: manufacturer
            type: NVARCHAR(100)
          - name: model
            type: VARCHAR(100)
          - name: location
            type: NVARCHAR(200)
          - name: install_date
            type: DATE
          - name: warranty_expire
            type: DATE
            
      # 控制器表
      tbl_controllers:
        description: 控制器信息表
        fields:
          - name: controller_id
            type: VARCHAR(30)
            primary_key: true
          - name: controller_name
            type: NVARCHAR(100)
          - name: controller_type
            type: VARCHAR(50)
          - name: manufacturer
            type: NVARCHAR(100)
          - name: model
            type: VARCHAR(100)
          - name: ip_address
            type: VARCHAR(15)
          - name: bacnet_id
            type: INT
          - name: location
            type: NVARCHAR(200)
          - name: system_id
            type: VARCHAR(20)
            
      # 报警配置表
      tbl_alarm_config:
        description: 报警配置表
        fields:
          - name: alarm_id
            type: VARCHAR(50)
            primary_key: true
          - name: point_id
            type: VARCHAR(50)
          - name: alarm_type
            type: VARCHAR(20)
          - name: alarm_text_cn
            type: NVARCHAR(200)
          - name: alarm_text_en
            type: VARCHAR(200)
          - name: response_action
            type: NVARCHAR(500)
          - name: notification_group
            type: VARCHAR(50)

  # ========================================
  # HVAC-CHP 冷热源系统点表（示例）
  # ========================================
  HVAC_CHP_Points:
    
    system_info:
      system_id: HVAC-CHP
      system_name: 冷热源系统
      total_points: 1200
      
    subsystems:
      
      # ------ 冷水机组 ------
      HVAC-CHP-CHILLER:
        name: 冷水机组
        equipment_count: 4
        points_per_unit: 80
        
        point_template:
          # 运行状态类
          - template_id: CH_RUN_STS
            point_suffix: DI_RUN
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机运行状态"
            point_type: DI
            data_type: BOOL
            values: {0: "停止", 1: "运行"}
            alarm_enabled: false
            trend_enabled: true
            trend_interval: 60
            
          - template_id: CH_FAULT_STS
            point_suffix: DI_FLT
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机故障状态"
            point_type: DI
            data_type: BOOL
            values: {0: "正常", 1: "故障"}
            alarm_enabled: true
            alarm_priority: HIGH
            alarm_text: "{n}号冷机故障"
            
          - template_id: CH_AUTO_STS
            point_suffix: DI_AUTO
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机自动/手动"
            point_type: DI
            data_type: BOOL
            values: {0: "手动", 1: "自动"}
            
          # 温度类
          - template_id: CH_CHWST
            point_suffix: AI_CHWST
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机冷冻水供水温度"
            point_type: AI
            data_type: REAL
            unit: "℃"
            range: [0, 30]
            precision: 1
            signal_type: "4-20mA"
            sensor_type: "Pt100"
            alarm_enabled: true
            alarm_high: 12
            alarm_low: 5
            alarm_priority: HIGH
            trend_enabled: true
            trend_interval: 60
            cov_enabled: true
            cov_increment: 0.2
            
          - template_id: CH_CHWRT

            alarm_high: 800
            
          - template_id: CH_POWER

            data_type: REAL
            unit: "kW"
            range: [0, 1000]
            precision: 1
            trend_enabled: true
            
          - template_id: CH_LOAD

            data_type: REAL
            unit: "%"
            range: [0, 100]
            precision: 1
            
          # 压力类

            range: [0, 1000]

          - template_id: CH_COND_P

            unit: "kPa"
            range: [0, 2000]
            precision: 0
            alarm_enabled: true
            alarm_high: 1800
            
          # 控制命令类

            point_type: AO
            data_type: REAL
            unit: "%"
            range: [0, 100]
            precision: 0
            default_value: 100
            security_level: ADMIN
```
