## 六、设备运维决策支持

### 6.1 预测性维护模型

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 设备预测性维护模型
# Equipment Predictive Maintenance Model
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

predictive_maintenance_model:

  ai_algorithms:
    
    fault_prediction:
      algorithm: "Ensemble (Random Forest + LSTM + XGBoost)"
      
      equipment_specific_models:
        
        EQP-AHU-CLEAN:
          model_id: "PM-AHU-001"
          features:
            vibration:
              sensors: ["ACC-X", "ACC-Y", "ACC-Z"]
              analysis: "频谱分析"
              threshold: "2.8 mm/s"
            temperature:
              sensors: ["MOTOR-TEMP", "BEARING-TEMP"]
              baseline_deviation: "10°C"
            power:
              sensors: ["POWER-METER"]
              anomaly_detection: "ARIMA残差分析"
            pressure:
              sensors: ["FILTER-DP"]
              trend: "线性回归"
          prediction_outputs:
            - "剩余使用寿命(RUL)"
            - "故障概率(7天内)"
            - "故障类型分类"
          accuracy_metrics:
            precision: ">85%"
            recall: ">80%"
            f1_score: ">82%"
            
        EQP-CH-CENT:
          model_id: "PM- CHL-19XR-001"
          features:
            cooling_performance:
              cop_degradation: "COP下降率"
              approach_temperature: "逼近温度趋势"
            mechanical_condition:
              vibration: "频谱分析"
              oil_analysis: "定期采样"
            electrical_condition:
              current_imbalance: "三相电流不平衡"
              power_factor: "功率因数"
          prediction_outputs:
            - "性能退化预警"
            - "维护建议时间窗"
            - "预计故障模式"
            
        EQP-ISO-TRANS:
          model_id: "PM-ISO-001"
          features:
            insulation_health:
              resistance_trend: "绝缘电阻趋势"
              leakage_current: "漏电流监测"
            thermal_condition:
              temperature_rise: "温升趋势"
              hotspot_detection: "红外热成像(可选)"
          prediction_outputs:
            - "绝缘失效预警"
            - "推荐检测时间"

  maintenance_scheduling:
    
    optimization_model:
      objective: "最小化维护成本 + 最大化设备可用性"
      constraints:
        - "不影响临床运营"
        - "满足法规检测周期"
        - "技术人员可用性"
        
    scheduling_algorithm:
      type: "混合整数规划 + 启发式"
      inputs:
        - "设备健康指数"
        - "预测故障时间"
        - "科室手术/诊疗排程"
        - "维护人员排班"
        - "备件库存"
      outputs:
        - "最优维护时间窗"
        - "工单优先级排序"
        - "资源调配建议"
```

### 6.2 能效优化模型

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 设备能效优化模型
# Equipment Energy Efficiency Optimization Model
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

energy_efficiency_optimization:

  department_level_optimization:
    
    operating_room_optimization:
      department: "手术室"
      
      optimization_strategies:
        - strategy_id: "OR-OPT-001"
          name: "手术间隙节能模式"
          trigger: "手术结束后15分钟无新手术"
          actions:
            - equipment: "EQP-AHU-CLEAN"
              action: "切换至低速运行(60%)"
              energy_saving: "30-40%"
            - equipment: "EQP-LIGHTING"
              action: "降低照度(50%)"
              energy_saving: "50%"
          recovery:
            trigger: "手术前30分钟"
            action: "恢复正常运行"
            stabilization_time: "20分钟"
            
        - strategy_id: "OR-OPT-002"
          name: "夜间非使用模式"
          trigger: "22:00-06:00 无排班"
          actions:
            - equipment: "EQP-AHU-CLEAN"
              action: "最小新风量运行"
              setback_temperature: "26°C(夏)/18°C(冬)"
            - equipment: "EQP-LIGHTING"
              action: "关闭(保留应急照明)"
          constraints:
            - "急诊手术可在15分钟内恢复"
            
    icu_optimization:
      department: "ICU"
      
      optimization_strategies:
        - strategy_id: "ICU-OPT-001"
          name: "按床位负荷调节"
          description: "根据实际在床患者数动态调节"
          implementation:
            - "空床位区域温度设定放宽±2°C"
            - "按实际人员数调节新风量"
            
  equipment_level_optimization:
    
    chiller_plant_optimization:
      target_equipment: ["EQP-CH-CENT", "EQP-CH-SCREW"]
      
      optimization_model:
        type: "模型预测控制(MPC)"
        prediction_horizon: "4小时"
        control_horizon: "30分钟"
        
        variables:
          controlled:
            - "冷冻水供水温度"
            - "冷却水供水温度"
            - "冷水机组加卸载"
          manipulated:
            - "冷冻水泵变频"
            - "冷却水泵变频"
            - "冷却塔风机变频"
            
        optimization_objective:
          minimize: "系统总能耗(冷机+水泵+塔)"
          constraints:
            - "满足末端冷负荷需求"
            - "冷却塔不结垢/不结冰"
            - "设备启停间隔≥15min"
            
        expected_savings: "15-25%系统能耗"
```

## 七、版本兼容性与接口规范

### 7.1 Agent间数据交换格式

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Agent间数据交换规范
# Inter-Agent Data Exchange Specification
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

inter_agent_data_exchange:

  exchange_format:
    standard: "YAML/JSON"
    encoding: "UTF-8"
    versioning: "Semantic Versioning (Major.Minor.Patch)"
    
  message_structure:
    header:
      message_id: "UUID"
      source_agent: "Agent-XX"
      target_agent: "Agent-YY"
      message_type: "DATA_REQUEST | DATA_RESPONSE | NOTIFICATION"
      timestamp: "ISO 8601"
      version: "v2.1"
      
    payload:
      content_type: "equipment_data | topology_data | space_data | association_data"
      data: "{structured_data}"
      
    footer:
      checksum: "SHA-256"
      
  api_specifications:
    
    # Agent-01 → Agent-03 接口
    agent01_to_agent03:
      endpoint: "/api/agent-03/v2.1/topology-mapping"
      method: "POST"
      request_body:
        topology_nodes: []
        system_dependencies: []
      response:
        equipment_mapping: []
        mapping_coverage: "percentage"
        
    # Agent-02 → Agent-03 接口
    agent02_to_agent03:
      endpoint: "/api/agent-03/v2.1/space-equipment"
      method: "POST"
      request_body:
        space_hierarchy: []
        environmental_requirements: []
      response:
        equipment_configuration: []
        capability_mapping: []
        
    # Agent-03 → 下游Agent接口
    agent03_outputs:
      - target: "Agent-04"
        data: "equipment_digital_parameters"
      - target: "Agent-05"
        data: "equipment_space_coupling"
      - target: "Agent-06"
        data: "equipment_control_points"
      - target: "Agent-07"
        data: "equipment_metering_config"
      - target: "Agent-08"
        data: "equipment_maintenance_model"
```

### 7.2 模型验证与质量保证

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 模型验证与质量保证
# Model Validation and Quality Assurance
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

quality_assurance:

  validation_rules:
    
    completeness_check:
      - rule_id: "VAL-001"
        description: "所有Agent-01拓扑节点必须有设备映射"
        check: "agent01_nodes.count == agent03_mappings.count"
        threshold: "≥95%"
        
      - rule_id: "VAL-002"
        description: "所有Agent-02医疗空间必须有设备配置"
        check: "medical_spaces.all(has_equipment_config)"
        threshold: "100%"
        
    consistency_check:
      - rule_id: "VAL-003"
        description: "设备ID唯一性"
        check: "equipment_ids.unique()"
        
      - rule_id: "VAL-004"
        description: "跨Agent ID引用一致性"
        check: "referenced_ids.exists_in_source()"
        
    conformance_check:
      - rule_id: "VAL-005"
        description: "医疗级设备分级符合GB规范"
        check: "life_safety_equipment.meets_requirements()"
        reference: "GB 51039-2014"

  quality_metrics:
    
    v2_1_quality_scores:
      completeness: 
        score: "96%"
        details: "123/123设备类型已映射"
      consistency:
        score: "98%"

        score: "100%"

        score: "92%"
        details: "首次实现三维关联矩阵"
      usability:
        score: "95%"
        details: "API文档完整，示例充分"

  change_log:

      date: "2025-12-03"

          - "科室数字孪生设备模型层"
          - "3D-IOS设备接口规范"
          - "预测性维护AI模型"
          - "能效优化算法"
        modified:
          - "设备分类体系扩展至智能化系统"
          - "设备属性增加数字孪生相关字段"
```

## 二、流动模型理论基础

### 2.1 流动三层架构模型

```yaml
Flow_Model_Architecture:
  description: |
    流动模型采用三层架构，从物质载体到能量传递再到信息控制，
    构建完整的流动体系。三层模型相互耦合，共同描述系统的动态行为。

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 层级架构图示
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  architecture_diagram: |
    ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │                        流动模型三层架构                                  │
    ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │                                                                         │
    │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
    │  │ Layer 3: 信息流 Information Flow                                │   │
    │  │ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │   │
    │  │ · 控制和监测系统中的信号传递                                     │   │
    │  │ · 包括：传感信号、控制命令、告警事件、状态反馈                   │   │
    │  │ · 特征：信号类型、通信协议、延迟、可靠性、数据精度               │   │
    │  │ · 作用：监测Layer1/2状态，发出控制指令                           │   │
    │  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘   │
    │                             │ 控制/监测                                 │
    │                             ▼                                           │
    │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
    │  │ Layer 2: 能量流 Energy Flow                                     │   │
    │  │ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │   │
    │  │ · 承载于物质或直接传输的能量                                     │   │
    │  │ · 包括：电能、热能（冷/热）、压力能、化学能                       │   │
    │  │ · 特征：功率/流量、效率、损耗、品位                               │   │
    │  │ · 与物质流关系：能量 = 物质流 × 比能（焓差、电势等）              │   │
    │  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘   │
    │                             │ 承载                                     │
    │                             ▼                                           │
    │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
    │  │ Layer 1: 物质流 Mass Flow                                       │   │
    │  │ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │   │
    │  │ · 作为能量的载体在系统中流动的物质                               │   │
    │  │ · 包括：水、空气、蒸汽、制冷剂、医疗气体、电子                   │   │
    │  │ · 特征：流量、压力、温度、成分、相态                             │   │
    │  │ · 守恒：质量守恒、动量守恒                                       │   │
    │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
    │                                                                         │
    └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  layer_definitions:
    
    Layer_1_Mass_Flow:
      name: "物质流"
      name_en: "Mass Flow"
      definition: "作为能量载体在系统中流动的物质"
      role: "能量的载体(Carrier)"
      
      medium_categories:
        liquid:
          - medium: "水"
            sub_types: ["冷冻水", "冷却水", "热水", "生活水", "消防水", "纯水"]
          - medium: "制冷剂"
            sub_types: ["R134a", "R410A", "R22"]
          - medium: "燃油"
            sub_types: ["柴油"]
        gas:
          - medium: "空气"
            sub_types: ["新风", "送风", "回风", "排风", "洁净空气"]
          - medium: "医疗气体"
            sub_types: ["氧气O2", "负压VAC", "压缩空气AIR", "笑气N2O", "氮气N2", "二氧化碳CO2"]
          - medium: "蒸汽"
            sub_types: ["饱和蒸汽", "过热蒸汽"]
          - medium: "燃气"
            sub_types: ["天然气"]
        solid:
          - medium: "电子"
            sub_types: ["导体中自由电子"]
            
      key_properties:
        - property: "mass_flow_rate"
          symbol: "ṁ"
          unit: "kg/s"
          description: "质量流量"
        - property: "volume_flow_rate"
          symbol: "V̇"
          unit: "m³/h"
          description: "体积流量"
        - property: "pressure"
          symbol: "P"
          unit: "Pa / kPa / MPa"
          description: "压力"
        - property: "temperature"
          symbol: "T"
          unit: "°C / K"
          description: "温度"
        - property: "velocity"
          symbol: "v"
          unit: "m/s"
          description: "流速"
        - property: "density"
          symbol: "ρ"
          unit: "kg/m³"
          description: "密度"
          
      governing_laws:
        - law: "质量守恒"
          equation: "Σṁ_in = Σṁ_out"
          description: "流入质量等于流出质量（稳态）"
        - law: "动量守恒"
          equation: "ΣF = d(mv)/dt"
          description: "力等于动量变化率"
        - law: "连续性方程"
          equation: "ρ₁A₁v₁ = ρ₂A₂v₂"
          description: "不可压缩流体的体积流量守恒"

    Layer_2_Energy_Flow:
      name: "能量流"
      name_en: "Energy Flow"
      definition: "承载于物质或直接传输的能量"
      role: "被传递的荷载(Payload)"
      
      energy_categories:
        thermal_energy:
          name: "热能"
          sub_types:
            - type: "冷量"
              description: "制冷能量，温度低于环境"
              typical_carrier: ["冷冻水", "冷却空气"]
            - type: "热量"
              description: "供热能量，温度高于环境"
              typical_carrier: ["热水", "蒸汽", "热风"]
            - type: "显热"
              description: "引起温度变化的热量"
              equation: "Q_s = ṁ × Cp × ΔT"
            - type: "潜热"
              description: "引起相变的热量"
              equation: "Q_l = ṁ × Δd × γ"
              
        electrical_energy:
          name: "电能"
          sub_types:
            - type: "交流电"
              description: "AC电能"
              parameters: ["电压U", "电流I", "功率因数cosφ", "频率f"]
            - type: "直流电"
              description: "DC电能"
              parameters: ["电压U", "电流I"]
              
        pressure_energy:
          name: "压力能"
          sub_types:
            - type: "正压能"
              description: "高于大气压的压力势能"
              typical_carrier: ["压缩空气", "医疗气体"]
            - type: "负压能"
              description: "低于大气压的压力势能"
              typical_carrier: ["真空吸引"]
              
        chemical_energy:
          name: "化学能"
          sub_types:
            - type: "燃料化学能"
              description: "燃烧释放的能量"
              typical_carrier: ["天然气", "柴油"]
              
      key_properties:
        - property: "power"
          symbol: "P / Q"
          unit: "W / kW / MW"
          description: "功率"
        - property: "energy"
          symbol: "E / W"
          unit: "J / kWh / MJ"
          description: "能量"
        - property: "efficiency"
          symbol: "η"
          unit: "无量纲 / %"
          description: "效率"
        - property: "COP"
          symbol: "COP"
          unit: "无量纲"
          description: "性能系数（制冷/热泵）"
        - property: "enthalpy"
          symbol: "h"
          unit: "kJ/kg"
          description: "比焓"
          
      governing_laws:
        - law: "能量守恒"
          equation: "E_in = E_out + E_loss + ΔE_stored"
          description: "输入能量等于输出加损耗加储存变化"
        - law: "热力学第一定律"
          equation: "ΔU = Q - W"
          description: "内能变化等于热量减做功"
        - law: "热力学第二定律"
          description: "能量转换方向性，熵增原理"

    Layer_3_Information_Flow:
      name: "信息流"
      name_en: "Information Flow"
      definition: "控制和监测系统中的信号传递"
      role: "控制与反馈"
      
      information_categories:
        sensor_signals:
          name: "传感信号"
          direction: "现场 → 控制器"
          content: "测量值（温度、压力、流量、状态等）"
          types:
            - type: "模拟量AI"
              signal: "4-20mA / 0-10V"
            - type: "数字量DI"
              signal: "干接点 / 电平"
            - type: "数字通信"
              protocol: "Modbus / BACnet / MQTT"
              
        control_commands:
          name: "控制命令"
          direction: "控制器 → 执行器"
          content: "设定值、开关命令、调节指令"
          types:
            - type: "模拟量AO"
              signal: "4-20mA / 0-10V"
            - type: "数字量DO"
              signal: "继电器输出"
            - type: "数字通信"
              protocol: "Modbus / BACnet"
              
        alarm_events:
          name: "告警事件"
          direction: "系统 → 平台/人员"
          content: "告警、故障、状态变化"
          levels: ["P0-紧急", "P1-重要", "P2-一般", "P3-提示"]
          
        status_feedback:
          name: "状态反馈"
          direction: "设备 → 系统"
          content: "运行状态、故障码、确认信号"
          
      key_properties:
        - property: "signal_type"
          description: "信号类型"
        - property: "protocol"
          description: "通信协议"
        - property: "update_rate"
          unit: "Hz / ms"
          description: "更新频率/周期"
        - property: "latency"
          unit: "ms"
          description: "传输延迟"
        - property: "reliability"
          unit: "%"
          description: "可靠性"
        - property: "accuracy"
          unit: "% / 工程单位"
          description: "精度"
```

### 2.2 载体-荷载耦合理论

```yaml
Carrier_Payload_Coupling_Theory:
  
  definition: |
    物质流是能量流的载体（Carrier），能量流是被传递的荷载（Payload）。
    理解这一耦合关系是实现能源管理和控制优化的关键。
    耦合方程将物质流的参数与能量传递能力关联起来。

  coupling_diagram: |
    ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │                      载体-荷载耦合关系模型                                │
    ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │                                                                          │
    │     ┌─────────────┐                    ┌─────────────┐                  │
    │     │   载体       │    耦合方程        │   荷载       │                  │
    │     │  Carrier    │ ═══════════════► │  Payload    │                  │
    │     │  (物质流)   │                    │  (能量流)   │                  │
    │     └──────┬──────┘                    └──────┬──────┘                  │
    │            │                                   │                         │
    │     ┌──────┴──────┐                    ┌──────┴──────┐                  │
    │     │ 参数:       │                    │ 参数:       │                  │
    │     │ · 流量 ṁ    │                    │ · 功率 Q    │                  │
    │     │ · 温度 T    │                    │ · 能量 E    │                  │
    │     │ · 压力 P    │                    │ · 效率 η    │                  │
    │     │ · 焓值 h    │                    │             │                  │
    │     └─────────────┘                    └─────────────┘                  │
    │                                                                          │
    │     典型耦合方程:                                                        │
    │     ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────     │
    │     水系统:    Q = ρ × V̇ × Cp × ΔT  (kW)                                │
    │     空气显热:  Qs = ρ × V̇ × Cp × ΔT  (kW)                               │
    │     空气潜热:  Ql = ρ × V̇ × Δd × γ   (kW)                               │
    │     空气全热:  Qt = ρ × V̇ × Δh       (kW)                               │
    │     电力:      P = U × I × cosφ     (kW)                                │
    │     气体:      Ė = ṁ × h            (kW)                                │
    │                                                                          │
    └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  fundamental_couplings:
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 水系统耦合
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    water_thermal_coupling:
      coupling_id: "COUP-WATER-THERMAL"
      carrier: "水"
      payload: "热能（冷量/热量）"
      
      coupling_equation:
        formula: "Q = ρ × V̇ × Cp × ΔT"
        alternative: "Q = ṁ × Cp × ΔT"
        
      parameters:
        - symbol: "Q"
          name: "热功率"
          unit: "kW"
          description: "传递的热量功率"
        - symbol: "ρ"
          name: "水密度"
          value: 1000
          unit: "kg/m³"
          note: "常温水近似值"
        - symbol: "V̇"
          name: "体积流量"
          unit: "m³/s"
        - symbol: "ṁ"
          name: "质量流量"
          unit: "kg/s"
          relation: "ṁ = ρ × V̇"
        - symbol: "Cp"
          name: "比热容"
          value: 4.186
          unit: "kJ/(kg·K)"
          note: "水的比热容"
        - symbol: "ΔT"
          name: "温差"
          unit: "K 或 °C"
          description: "供回水温差"
          
      practical_formula:
        simplified: "Q(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × ΔT(°C) × 1.163"
        derivation: "1000 × (1/3600) × 4.186 ≈ 1.163"
        
      typical_applications:
        - system: "冷冻水系统"
          supply_temp: "7°C"
          return_temp: "12°C"
          delta_t: "5°C"
        - system: "冷却水系统"
          supply_temp: "32°C"
          return_temp: "37°C"
          delta_t: "5°C"
        - system: "热水系统"
          supply_temp: "60°C"
          return_temp: "50°C"
          delta_t: "10°C"

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 空气系统耦合
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    air_thermal_coupling:
      coupling_id: "COUP-AIR-THERMAL"
      carrier: "空气"
      payload: "热能（显热+潜热）"
      
      sensible_heat:
        name: "显热"
        formula: "Qs = ρ × V̇ × Cp × ΔT"
        alternative: "Qs = ṁ × Cp × ΔT"
        parameters:
          - symbol: "Qs"
            name: "显热功率"
            unit: "kW"
          - symbol: "ρ"
            name: "空气密度"
            value: 1.2
            unit: "kg/m³"
            note: "标准状态近似值"
          - symbol: "Cp"
            name: "空气比热容"
            value: 1.005
            unit: "kJ/(kg·K)"
            note: "干空气比热"
          - symbol: "ΔT"
            name: "干球温度差"
            unit: "K 或 °C"
        practical_formula:
          simplified: "Qs(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × ΔT(°C) × 0.335"
          derivation: "1.2 × (1/3600) × 1.005 × 1000 ≈ 0.335"
          
      latent_heat:
        name: "潜热"
        formula: "Ql = ρ × V̇ × Δd × γ"
        alternative: "Ql = ṁ × Δd × γ"
        parameters:
          - symbol: "Ql"
            name: "潜热功率"
            unit: "kW"
          - symbol: "Δd"
            name: "含湿量差"
            unit: "kg/kg (干空气)"
          - symbol: "γ"
            name: "水蒸气汽化潜热"
            value: 2500
            unit: "kJ/kg"
            note: "常温近似值"
        practical_formula:
          simplified: "Ql(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × Δd(g/kg) × 0.833"
          
      total_heat:
        name: "全热"
        formula: "Qt = ρ × V̇ × Δh"
        alternative: "Qt = ṁ × Δh"
        parameters:
          - symbol: "Qt"
            name: "全热功率"
            unit: "kW"
          - symbol: "Δh"
            name: "焓差"
            unit: "kJ/kg"
        relation: "Qt = Qs + Ql"

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 电力系统耦合
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    electrical_power_coupling:
      coupling_id: "COUP-ELEC-POWER"
      carrier: "电子（电流）"
      payload: "电能"
      
      single_phase_ac:
        name: "单相交流"
        formula: "P = U × I × cosφ"
        parameters:
          - symbol: "P"
            name: "有功功率"
            unit: "W / kW"
          - symbol: "U"
            name: "电压"
            unit: "V"
          - symbol: "I"
            name: "电流"
            unit: "A"
          - symbol: "cosφ"
            name: "功率因数"
            unit: "无量纲"
            typical_range: [0.8, 0.95]
            
      three_phase_ac:
        name: "三相交流"
        formula: "P = √3 × U_L × I_L × cosφ"
        parameters:
          - symbol: "U_L"
            name: "线电压"
            unit: "V"
            typical_values: [380, 10000, 35000]
          - symbol: "I_L"
            name: "线电流"
            unit: "A"
            
      apparent_power:
        formula: "S = √3 × U_L × I_L"
        unit: "VA / kVA"
        
      reactive_power:
        formula: "Q = √3 × U_L × I_L × sinφ"
        unit: "var / kvar"
        
      power_triangle:
        relation: "S² = P² + Q²"

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 蒸汽系统耦合
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    steam_thermal_coupling:
      coupling_id: "COUP-STEAM-THERMAL"
      carrier: "蒸汽"
      payload: "热能"
      
      condensing_heat:
        name: "凝结放热"
        formula: "Q = ṁ × r"
        parameters:
          - symbol: "Q"
            name: "热功率"
            unit: "kW"
          - symbol: "ṁ"
            name: "蒸汽流量"
            unit: "kg/s"
          - symbol: "r"
            name: "汽化潜热"
            unit: "kJ/kg"
            typical_value: 2257
            note: "100°C饱和蒸汽"
            
      total_heat:
        formula: "Q = ṁ × (h_steam - h_condensate)"
        note: "考虑过冷度时"

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 医疗气体耦合
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    medical_gas_coupling:
      coupling_id: "COUP-MGAS-PRESSURE"
      carrier: "医疗气体"
      payload: "压力能 + 化学能（O2）"
      
      pressure_energy:
        name: "压力能"
        formula: "E = P × V"
        parameters:
          - symbol: "E"
            name: "压力能"
            unit: "J"
          - symbol: "P"
            name: "压力"
            unit: "Pa"
          - symbol: "V"
            name: "体积"
            unit: "m³"
            
      flow_power:
        formula: "Ẇ = P × V̇"
        unit: "W"
        description: "压力流动功率"
        
      oxygen_chemical:
        name: "氧气化学能"
        application: "供人体代谢"
        consumption_rate: "3-4 L/min (休息) ~ 60 L/min (剧烈运动)"
        note: "医用氧气作为生命支持"
```

## 三、流动分类体系 (Flow Classification)

```yaml
Flow_Classification:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 3.1 物质流分类 (Mass Flows)

  mass_flows:

        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EQP-TANK-FIRE"]
          distribution: ["EQP-PUMP-FIRE", "EQP-PUMP-FIRE-JOCKEY", "EQP-PUMP-SPRINKLER"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-WATER-PURE"
        flow_type_name: "纯水流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Pure Water Flow"
        medium: "水"
        medium_id: "MED-WATER-PURE"
        role: "医疗/实验用纯水"
        loop_type: "open + recirculation"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "PLUMB-PURE"
            system_name: "纯水系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "resistivity"
            symbol: "ρ"
            unit: "MΩ·cm"
            dialysis: ">1"
            laboratory: ">10"
          - property: "conductivity"
            symbol: "σ"
            unit: "μS/cm"
            dialysis: "<1"
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          treatment: ["EQP-RO-MEDICAL", "EQP-RO-DIALYSIS"]

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 3.1.2 空气系统物质流
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    air_flows:
      
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-AIR-OA"
        flow_type_name: "新风流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Outdoor Air Flow"
        medium: "空气"
        medium_id: "MED-AIR-OUTDOOR"
        role: "新鲜空气补充"
        loop_type: "open"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "HVAC-PAU"
            system_name: "新风机组系统"
          - system_id: "HVAC-AHU"
            system_name: "空调机组系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "temperature"
            symbol: "T_oa"
            unit: "°C"
            summer_design: 35
            winter_design: -9
            note: "取决于当地气象"
          - property: "humidity"
            symbol: "φ"
            unit: "%RH"
            summer_design: 75
          - property: "flow_rate"
            symbol: "V̇"
            unit: "m³/h"
          - property: "fresh_air_per_person"
            unit: "m³/(h·人)"
            office: 30
            hospital_general: 40
            hospital_clean: 60
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EQP-PAU-DEDICATED"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-AIR-SUPPLY"
        flow_type_name: "送风流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Supply Air Flow"
        medium: "空气"
        medium_id: "MED-AIR-CONDITIONED"
        role: "冷/热量载体，环境调节"
        loop_type: "supply"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "HVAC-AHU"
            system_name: "空调机组系统"
          - system_id: "HVAC-FCU"
            system_name: "风机盘管系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "temperature"
            symbol: "T_sa"
            unit: "°C"
            cooling_typical: [14, 18]
            heating_typical: [28, 35]
          - property: "humidity"
            symbol: "φ"
            unit: "%RH"
            typical_range: [40, 60]
          - property: "flow_rate"
            symbol: "V̇"
            unit: "m³/h"
          - property: "velocity"
            symbol: "v"
            unit: "m/s"
            duct_typical: [6, 10]
            terminal_typical: [2, 4]
            
        energy_coupling:
          sensible: "Qs = V̇ × ΔT × 0.335 (kW)"
          latent: "Ql = V̇ × Δd × 0.833 (kW)"
          total: "Qt = V̇ × Δh × 0.334 (kW)"
          
        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EQP-AHU-CLEAN", "EQP-AHU-COMBO", "EQP-FCU-CEILING"]
          terminal: ["EQP-VAV-BOX"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-AIR-RETURN"
        flow_type_name: "回风流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Return Air Flow"
        medium: "空气"
        medium_id: "MED-AIR-RETURN"
        role: "室内空气回收"
        loop_type: "return"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "HVAC-AHU"
            system_name: "空调机组系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "temperature"
            symbol: "T_ra"
            unit: "°C"
            typical: 25
          - property: "humidity"
            symbol: "φ"
            unit: "%RH"
            typical: 50
            
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-AIR-EXHAUST"
        flow_type_name: "排风流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Exhaust Air Flow"
        medium: "空气"
        medium_id: "MED-AIR-EXHAUST"
        role: "污染空气排放"
        loop_type: "exhaust"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "HVAC-EXH"
            system_name: "排风系统"
          - system_id: "FIRE-EXH"
            system_name: "防排烟系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "flow_rate"
            symbol: "V̇"
            unit: "m³/h"
          - property: "treatment"
            options: ["直排", "HEPA过滤", "消毒处理"]
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          exhaust: ["EQP-FAN-EXH", "EQP-FAN-NEG"]
          filter: ["EQP-FILTER-HEPA"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-AIR-CLEAN"
        flow_type_name: "洁净送风流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Clean Air Flow"
        medium: "空气"
        medium_id: "MED-AIR-CLEAN"
        role: "洁净空间环境控制"
        loop_type: "unidirectional/non-unidirectional"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "MED-OR"
            system_name: "手术室环境控制系统"
          - system_id: "MED-ICU"
            system_name: "ICU环境系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "cleanliness"
            unit: "ISO Class"
            OR_I: "ISO 5"
            OR_II: "ISO 6"
            OR_III: "ISO 7"
            ICU: "ISO 7-8"
          - property: "air_changes"
            symbol: "ACH"
            unit: "次/h"
            OR_I: "≥36 (手术区)"
            OR_II: "≥24"
            OR_III: "≥18"
            ICU: "≥12"
          - property: "velocity"
            symbol: "v"
            unit: "m/s"
            laminar_flow: "0.25-0.5"
            
        agent_02_space_coupling:
          - space_type: "ROOM-OR-I"
            cleanliness: "ISO 5"
            air_changes: 36
          - space_type: "ROOM-ICU"
            cleanliness: "ISO 7"
            air_changes: 12
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EQP-AHU-CLEAN"]
          terminal: ["EQP-FILTER-HEPA"]

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 3.1.3 医疗气体物质流
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    medical_gas_flows:
      
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-MGAS-O2"
        flow_type_name: "医用氧气流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Medical Oxygen Flow"
        medium: "氧气"
        medium_id: "MED-GAS-O2"
        role: "医疗供氧"
        loop_type: "supply"
        criticality: "LIFE_SAFETY"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "MGAS-O2"
            system_name: "医用氧气系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "purity"
            symbol: "O2%"
            unit: "%"
            min_value: 93
            typical: 99.5
          - property: "pressure"
            symbol: "P"
            unit: "MPa"
            source_typical: 1.5
            pipeline_typical: 0.4-0.5
            terminal: 0.3-0.5
          - property: "flow_rate"
            symbol: "V̇"
            unit: "L/min"
            per_terminal: "0-15"
            
        design_parameters:
          storage_capacity: "3天用量"
          backup: "气瓶汇流排备用"
          alarm_threshold: "压力低于0.35MPa"
          
        agent_02_space_coupling:
          - space: "手术室"
            terminals_per_room: 2
            flow_rate: "60 L/min"
          - space: "ICU"
            terminals_per_bed: 2
            flow_rate: "40 L/min"
          - space: "病房"
            terminals_per_bed: 1
            flow_rate: "10 L/min"
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EQP-LOX-TANK", "EQP-O2-MANIFOLD"]
          terminal: ["EQP-O2-OUTLET"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-MGAS-VAC"
        flow_type_name: "医用负压吸引流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Medical Vacuum Flow"
        medium: "空气（负压）"
        medium_id: "MED-GAS-VAC"
        role: "负压吸引"
        loop_type: "suction"
        criticality: "LIFE_SAFETY"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "MGAS-VAC"
            system_name: "医用负压吸引系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "vacuum_level"
            symbol: "P_vac"
            unit: "MPa"
            typical: -0.04
            note: "相对于大气压"
          - property: "flow_rate"
            symbol: "V̇"
            unit: "L/min"
            per_terminal: 30
            peak_demand: 500
          - property: "recovery_time"
            unit: "s"
            requirement: "<3"
            description: "从0恢复至-0.04MPa"
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EQP-VAC-PUMP"]
          terminal: ["EQP-VAC-OUTLET"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-MGAS-AIR"
        flow_type_name: "医用压缩空气流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Medical Compressed Air Flow"
        medium: "压缩空气"
        medium_id: "MED-GAS-AIR"
        role: "医疗器械驱动、呼吸支持"
        loop_type: "supply"
        criticality: "LIFE_SAFETY"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "MGAS-AIR"
            system_name: "医用压缩空气系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "quality"
            oil_content: "<0.1 mg/m³"
            moisture: "露点 < -40°C"
            particles: "ISO 8573-1 Class 1"
          - property: "pressure"
            symbol: "P"
            unit: "MPa"
            supply_typical: 0.4-0.5
          - property: "flow_rate"
            symbol: "V̇"
            unit: "L/min"
            per_terminal: 60
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EQP-COMP-MEDICAL"]
          treatment: ["EQP-DRYER-DESICCANT"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-MGAS-N2O"
        flow_type_name: "笑气流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Nitrous Oxide Flow"
        medium: "一氧化二氮"
        medium_id: "MED-GAS-N2O"
        role: "麻醉辅助"
        loop_type: "supply"
        criticality: "PATIENT_SAFETY"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "MGAS-N2O"
            system_name: "笑气系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "pressure"
            symbol: "P"
            unit: "MPa"
            supply_typical: 0.4
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EQP-N2O-MANIFOLD"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-MGAS-AGSS"
        flow_type_name: "麻醉废气流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Anesthesia Gas Scavenging Flow"
        medium: "麻醉废气"
        medium_id: "MED-GAS-AGSS"
        role: "麻醉废气排放"
        loop_type: "exhaust"
        criticality: "CRITICAL"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "MGAS-AGSS"
            system_name: "麻醉废气排放系统"
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          exhaust: ["EQP-AGSS-PUMP"]

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 3.1.4 其他物质流
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    other_mass_flows:
      
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-STEAM"
        flow_type_name: "蒸汽流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Steam Flow"
        medium: "蒸汽"
        medium_id: "MED-STEAM"
        role: "热量载体、消毒灭菌"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "HVAC-HWP"
            system_name: "热源系统"
          - system_id: "MED-STER"
            system_name: "消毒供应系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "pressure"
            symbol: "P"
            unit: "MPa"
            low_pressure: 0.2-0.4
            medium_pressure: 0.4-0.8
          - property: "temperature"
            symbol: "T"
            unit: "°C"
            saturated_0.4MPa: 152
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EQP-BOILER-STEAM"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-FUEL-GAS"
        flow_type_name: "燃气流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Natural Gas Flow"
        medium: "天然气"
        medium_id: "MED-GAS-NG"
        role: "燃料供给"
        
        properties:
          - property: "pressure"
            symbol: "P"
            unit: "kPa"
            low_pressure: "<10"
            medium_pressure: "10-200"
          - property: "calorific_value"
            unit: "MJ/Nm³"
            typical: 35-38
            
      - flow_type_id: "MASS-REFRIG"
        flow_type_name: "制冷剂流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Refrigerant Flow"
        medium: "制冷剂"
        medium_id: "MED-REFRIG"
        role: "冷水机组内部冷量传递"
        loop_type: "closed"
        
        properties:
          - property: "refrigerant_type"
            options: ["R134a", "R410A", "R407C"]
          - property: "phase_change"
            evaporation: "吸热"
            condensation: "放热"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 3.2 能量流分类 (Energy Flows)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  energy_flows:
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 3.2.1 热能流
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    thermal_energy_flows:
      
      - flow_type_id: "ENERGY-THERMAL-COOL"
        flow_type_name: "冷量流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Cooling Energy Flow"
        form: "热能（制冷）"
        direction: "从冷源到负荷"
        
        typical_carriers:
          - carrier_id: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
            carrier_name: "冷冻水"
          - carrier_id: "MASS-AIR-SUPPLY"
            carrier_name: "送风"
          - carrier_id: "MASS-REFRIG"
            carrier_name: "制冷剂"
            
        properties:
          - property: "cooling_power"
            symbol: "Q_c"
            unit: "kW / RT"
            conversion: "1 RT = 3.517 kW"
          - property: "temperature_level"
            description: "供冷温度"
            chw_supply: "7°C"
            air_supply: "14-18°C"
          - property: "COP"
            description: "制冷性能系数"
            chiller_typical: [4.5, 6.5]
            
        energy_chain:
          source: "冷水机组"
          primary_carrier: "冷冻水"
          secondary_carrier: "送风"
          sink: "室内空间"
          
        coupling_equations:
          chiller: "Q_evap = ṁ_chw × Cp × ΔT_chw"
          ahu_coil: "Q_coil = ṁ_air × Δh_air"
          
      - flow_type_id: "ENERGY-THERMAL-HEAT"
        flow_type_name: "热量流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Heating Energy Flow"
        form: "热能（供热）"
        direction: "从热源到负荷"
        
        typical_carriers:
          - carrier_id: "MASS-WATER-HW"
            carrier_name: "热水"
          - carrier_id: "MASS-STEAM"
            carrier_name: "蒸汽"
          - carrier_id: "MASS-AIR-SUPPLY"
            carrier_name: "热风"
            
        properties:
          - property: "heating_power"
            symbol: "Q_h"
            unit: "kW"
          - property: "temperature_level"
            description: "供热温度"
            hw_supply: "60°C"
            steam: "100-170°C"
            
        energy_chain:
          source: "锅炉/热泵"
          carrier: "热水/蒸汽"
          terminal_carrier: "送风"
          sink: "室内空间"
          
      - flow_type_id: "ENERGY-THERMAL-REJECT"
        flow_type_name: "废热流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Heat Rejection Flow"
        form: "热能（废热排放）"
        direction: "从冷凝器到环境"
        
        typical_carriers:
          - carrier_id: "MASS-WATER-CW"
            carrier_name: "冷却水"
            
        properties:
          - property: "heat_rejection"
            symbol: "Q_cond"
            unit: "kW"
            relation: "Q_cond = Q_evap + P_comp"
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          rejection: ["EQP-CT-OPEN", "EQP-CT-CLOSED"]

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 3.2.2 电能流
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    electrical_energy_flows:
      
      - flow_type_id: "ENERGY-ELEC-HV"
        flow_type_name: "高压电能流"
        flow_type_name_en: "High Voltage Power Flow"
        form: "电能"
        voltage_level: "10kV / 35kV"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "ELEC-HV"
            system_name: "高压配电系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "voltage"
            symbol: "U"
            unit: "kV"
            typical: [10, 35]
          - property: "power"
            symbol: "P"
            unit: "MW"
          - property: "frequency"
            symbol: "f"
            unit: "Hz"
            value: 50
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EXTERNAL-GRID"]
          distribution: ["EQP-HV-SWITCHGEAR"]
          conversion: ["EQP-TRANS-DRY", "EQP-TRANS-OIL"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "ENERGY-ELEC-LV"
        flow_type_name: "低压电能流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Low Voltage Power Flow"
        form: "电能"
        voltage_level: "380V/220V"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "ELEC-LV"
            system_name: "低压配电系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "voltage"
            symbol: "U"
            unit: "V"
            three_phase: 380
            single_phase: 220
          - property: "power"
            symbol: "P"
            unit: "kW"
          - property: "power_factor"
            symbol: "cosφ"
            target: ">0.9"
            
        load_categories:
          first_class: "一级负荷（生命安全）"
          second_class: "二级负荷（重要）"
          third_class: "三级负荷（普通）"
          
        agent_03_equipment:
          distribution: ["EQP-LV-SWITCHGEAR", "EQP-LV-MCC"]
          terminal: ["EQP-PANEL-DIST", "EQP-PANEL-MEDICAL"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "ENERGY-ELEC-EMERG"
        flow_type_name: "应急电能流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Emergency Power Flow"
        form: "电能"
        purpose: "备用电源"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "ELEC-EMERG"
            system_name: "应急电源系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "startup_time"
            unit: "s"
            generator: "≤10"
            ups: "0 (无缝切换)"
          - property: "backup_duration"
            generator: "≥24h (燃油储备)"
            ups: "≥30min"
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          source: ["EQP-GEN-DIESEL", "EQP-UPS-ONLINE", "EQP-UPS-MEDICAL"]
          switching: ["EQP-ATS"]
          
      - flow_type_id: "ENERGY-ELEC-ISO"
        flow_type_name: "隔离电能流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Isolated Power Flow"
        form: "电能"
        purpose: "医疗安全隔离"
        
        typical_systems:
          - system_id: "ELEC-IT"
            system_name: "IT配电系统"
            
        properties:
          - property: "insulation_monitoring"
            alarm_threshold: "50kΩ"
          - property: "leakage_current"
            limit: "< 5mA"
            
        agent_02_space_coupling:
          - space: "手术室"
            required: true
          - space: "ICU"
            required: true
            
        agent_03_equipment:
          isolation: ["EQP-ISO-TRANS"]
          monitoring: ["EQP-ISO-MONITOR"]

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 3.2.3 压力能流
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    pressure_energy_flows:
      
      - flow_type_id: "ENERGY-PRESS-POS"
        flow_type_name: "正压能流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Positive Pressure Energy Flow"
        form: "压力能"
        
        typical_carriers:
          - carrier_id: "MASS-MGAS-O2"
            carrier_name: "医用氧气"
          - carrier_id: "MASS-MGAS-AIR"
            carrier_name: "压缩空气"
            
        properties:
          - property: "pressure"
            symbol: "P"
            unit: "MPa"
          - property: "flow_power"
            formula: "Ẇ = P × V̇"
            
      - flow_type_id: "ENERGY-PRESS-NEG"
        flow_type_name: "负压能流"
        flow_type_name_en: "Negative Pressure Energy Flow"
        form: "压力能"
        
        typical_carriers:
          - carrier_id: "MASS-MGAS-VAC"
            carrier_name: "负压吸引"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 3.3 信息流分类 (Information Flows)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  information_flows:
    
    - flow_type_id: "INFO-SENSOR"
      flow_type_name: "传感信号流"
      flow_type_name_en: "Sensor Signal Flow"
      direction: "现场 → 控制器"
      content: "测量值"
      
      signal_types:
        - type: "温度传感"
          sensors: ["PT100", "NTC", "热电偶"]
          output: "4-20mA / RS485"
        - type: "压力传感"
          sensors: ["压力变送器", "压差变送器"]
          output: "4-20mA"
        - type: "流量传感"
          sensors: ["电磁流量计", "超声波流量计", "涡街流量计"]
          output: "4-20mA / 脉冲"
        - type: "湿度传感"
          sensors: ["电容式湿度传感器"]
          output: "4-20mA / RS485"
        - type: "状态传感"
          sensors: ["接近开关", "限位开关", "压差开关"]
          output: "干接点"
          
      agent_06_interface:
        output_to: "Agent-06控制系统建模师"
        content: "传感器类型、测点位置、信号规格"
        
    - flow_type_id: "INFO-CONTROL"
      flow_type_name: "控制命令流"
      flow_type_name_en: "Control Command Flow"
      direction: "控制器 → 执行器"
      content: "设定值/开关命令"
      
      command_types:
        - type: "模拟量调节"
          target: ["阀门开度", "风机转速", "温度设定"]
          output: "4-20mA / 0-10V"
        - type: "数字量控制"
          target: ["启停命令", "模式切换"]
          output: "继电器/接触器"
        - type: "变频控制"
          target: ["电机转速"]
          protocol: "Modbus RTU"
          
    - flow_type_id: "INFO-ALARM"
      flow_type_name: "告警事件流"
      flow_type_name_en: "Alarm Event Flow"
      direction: "系统 → 平台/人员"
      content: "告警信息"
      
      alarm_levels:
        P0_CRITICAL:
          name: "紧急告警"
          response: "立即响应"
          notification: "声光报警 + 短信 + 电话"
          examples: ["医用气体压力过低", "电源故障", "消防报警"]
        P1_MAJOR:
          name: "重要告警"
          response: "15分钟内响应"
          notification: "声光报警 + 短信"
          examples: ["设备故障", "温度超限"]
        P2_MINOR:
          name: "一般告警"
          response: "2小时内响应"
          notification: "系统弹窗"
          examples: ["设备维护提醒", "效率下降"]
        P3_INFO:
          name: "提示信息"
          response: "记录备查"
          examples: ["运行状态变化", "参数变更"]
          
    - flow_type_id: "INFO-STATUS"
      flow_type_name: "状态反馈流"
      flow_type_name_en: "Status Feedback Flow"
      direction: "设备 → 系统"
      content: "运行状态、故障码"
      
      status_types:
        - "运行/停止"
        - "手动/自动"
        - "本地/远程"
        - "故障/正常"
        - "联锁状态"
        
    - flow_type_id: "INFO-DATA"
      flow_type_name: "数据传输流"
      flow_type_name_en: "Data Transmission Flow"
      direction: "双向"
      content: "历史数据、配置信息"
      
      protocols:
        field_level:
          - "Modbus RTU/TCP"
          - "BACnet MS/TP"
          - "PROFIBUS"
        building_level:
          - "BACnet/IP"
          - "OPC UA"
          - "MQTT"
        enterprise_level:
          - "REST API"
          - "AMQP"
```

## 四、介质模型 (Medium Models)

```yaml
Medium_Models:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 4.1 水介质模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - medium_id: "MED-WATER"
    medium_name: "水"
    medium_name_en: "Water"
    category: "液体"
    
    physical_properties:
      base_conditions:
        temperature: 20
        temperature_unit: "°C"
        pressure: 101.325
        pressure_unit: "kPa"
        
      density:
        symbol: "ρ"
        value: 998
        unit: "kg/m³"
        temperature_dependency: |
          ρ(T) ≈ 1000 - 0.0178 × (T - 4)² kg/m³
          最大密度在4°C
          
      specific_heat:
        symbol: "Cp"
        value: 4.186
        unit: "kJ/(kg·K)"
        note: "常温下相对稳定"
        
      thermal_conductivity:
        symbol: "λ"
        value: 0.598
        unit: "W/(m·K)"
        
      dynamic_viscosity:
        symbol: "μ"
        value: 0.001002
        unit: "Pa·s"
        temperature_dependency: "随温度升高而降低"
        
      vapor_pressure:
        symbol: "P_sat"
        value_at_20C: 2.34
        value_at_100C: 101.325
        unit: "kPa"
        
    engineering_constants:
      volume_to_energy:
        formula: "Q(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × ΔT(°C) × 1.163"
        derivation: "ρ × Cp / 3600 = 1000 × 4.186 / 3600 ≈ 1.163"
        
      mass_to_energy:
        formula: "Q(kW) = ṁ(kg/s) × ΔT(°C) × 4.186"
        
    application_notes:
      chilled_water:
        typical_temp: "5-12°C"
        glycol_addition: "当防冻时添加乙二醇"
      hot_water:
        typical_temp: "40-80°C"
        scaling_prevention: "注意水垢控制"
      cooling_water:
        typical_temp: "32-37°C"
        treatment: "需要水处理防止腐蚀和藻类"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 4.2 空气介质模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - medium_id: "MED-AIR"
    medium_name: "空气"
    medium_name_en: "Air"
    category: "气体"
    
    physical_properties:
      base_conditions:
        temperature: 20
        temperature_unit: "°C"
        pressure: 101.325
        pressure_unit: "kPa"
        relative_humidity: 50
        humidity_unit: "%RH"
        
      density:
        symbol: "ρ"
        value: 1.2
        unit: "kg/m³"
        formula: "ρ = P / (R × T)"
        gas_constant_R: 287
        gas_constant_unit: "J/(kg·K)"
        
      specific_heat:
        dry_air:
          symbol: "Cp_da"
          value: 1.005
          unit: "kJ/(kg·K)"
        water_vapor:
          symbol: "Cp_wv"
          value: 1.86
          unit: "kJ/(kg·K)"
          
      humidity_parameters:
        - parameter: "relative_humidity"
          symbol: "φ"
          unit: "%RH"
          description: "相对湿度"
        - parameter: "absolute_humidity"
          symbol: "d"
          unit: "g/kg (干空气)"
          description: "含湿量"
          formula: "d = 622 × φ × P_sat / (P - φ × P_sat)"
        - parameter: "enthalpy"
          symbol: "h"
          unit: "kJ/kg (干空气)"
          formula: "h = 1.005 × t + d × (2501 + 1.86 × t) / 1000"
          description: "比焓"
        - parameter: "wet_bulb_temperature"
          symbol: "t_wb"
          unit: "°C"
          description: "湿球温度"
        - parameter: "dew_point"
          symbol: "t_dp"
          unit: "°C"
          description: "露点温度"
          
    energy_carrying_capacity:
      sensible_heat:
        formula: "Qs = ρ × V̇ × Cp × ΔT"
        simplified: "Qs(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × ΔT(°C) × 0.335"
        derivation: "1.2 × 1.005 / 3.6 ≈ 0.335"
        
      latent_heat:
        formula: "Ql = ρ × V̇ × Δd × γ"
        simplified: "Ql(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × Δd(g/kg) × 0.833"
        vaporization_latent_heat: 2500
        unit: "kJ/kg"
        
      total_heat:
        formula: "Qt = ρ × V̇ × Δh"
        simplified: "Qt(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × Δh(kJ/kg) × 0.334"
        relation: "Qt = Qs + Ql"
        
    psychrometric_relations:
      heating_only: "Qs变化, Ql不变, d不变"
      cooling_only: "Qs变化, 可能Ql变化(除湿)"
      humidification: "d增加, 可能Qs变化"
      dehumidification: "d减少, Ql释放"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 4.3 蒸汽介质模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - medium_id: "MED-STEAM"
    medium_name: "蒸汽"
    medium_name_en: "Steam"
    category: "气体（相变）"
    
    physical_properties:
      saturated_steam_table:
        - pressure_gauge: 0.0
          pressure_abs: 0.101
          temperature: 100
          specific_volume: 1.673
          latent_heat: 2257
          enthalpy_liquid: 419
          enthalpy_vapor: 2676
        - pressure_gauge: 0.2
          pressure_abs: 0.301
          temperature: 134
          specific_volume: 0.606
          latent_heat: 2163
          enthalpy_liquid: 561
          enthalpy_vapor: 2724
        - pressure_gauge: 0.4
          pressure_abs: 0.501
          temperature: 152
          specific_volume: 0.375
          latent_heat: 2108
          enthalpy_liquid: 640
          enthalpy_vapor: 2748
        - pressure_gauge: 0.6
          pressure_abs: 0.701
          temperature: 165
          specific_volume: 0.273
          latent_heat: 2065
          enthalpy_liquid: 697
          enthalpy_vapor: 2762
        - pressure_gauge: 0.8
          pressure_abs: 0.901
          temperature: 175
          specific_volume: 0.215
          latent_heat: 2030
          enthalpy_liquid: 743
          enthalpy_vapor: 2773
          
      units:
        pressure_gauge: "MPa (表压)"
        pressure_abs: "MPa (绝压)"
        temperature: "°C"
        specific_volume: "m³/kg"
        latent_heat: "kJ/kg"
        enthalpy: "kJ/kg"
        
    energy_carrying_capacity:
      condensing_heat:
        formula: "Q = ṁ × r"
        where:
          Q: "热功率 (kW)"
          ṁ: "蒸汽流量 (kg/s)"
          r: "汽化潜热 (kJ/kg)"
          
      total_heat:
        formula: "Q = ṁ × (h_steam - h_condensate)"
        note: "考虑冷凝水过冷度"
        
    application_notes:
      medical_sterilization:
        typical_pressure: "0.2-0.4 MPa"
        temperature: "134-152°C"
        duration: "4-20 min"
      hvac_heating:
        typical_pressure: "0.2-0.6 MPa"
        heat_exchanger: "蒸汽-水换热器"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 4.4 医用氧气介质模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - medium_id: "MED-GAS-O2"
    medium_name: "医用氧气"
    medium_name_en: "Medical Oxygen"
    category: "医疗气体"
    
    physical_properties:
      molecular_weight: 32
      unit: "g/mol"
      
      density:
        at_ntp:
          value: 1.429
          unit: "kg/Nm³"
          conditions: "0°C, 101.325kPa"
        at_stp:
          value: 1.331
          unit: "kg/m³"
          conditions: "20°C, 101.325kPa"
          
      critical_point:
        temperature: -118.6
        pressure: 5.04
        unit: "°C, MPa"
        
      boiling_point: -183
      unit: "°C"
      
    quality_requirements:
      purity:
        min_value: 93
        unit: "%"
        pharmacopoeia: "中国药典"
      moisture:
        max_value: 67
        unit: "ppm"
      carbon_dioxide:
        max_value: 300
        unit: "ppm"
      carbon_monoxide:
        max_value: 5
        unit: "ppm"
        
    system_parameters:
      storage:
        type: "液氧储罐"
        pressure: 1.0-1.6
        unit: "MPa"
        vaporizer: "汽化器"
      pipeline:
        pressure: 0.4-0.5
        unit: "MPa"
        material: "铜管/不锈钢"
      terminal:
        pressure: 0.3-0.5
        unit: "MPa"
        flow_rate: "0-15 L/min"
        
    agent_02_consumption_rates:
      operating_room:
        per_room: 60
        unit: "L/min"
        terminals: 2
      icu:
        per_bed: 40
        unit: "L/min"
        terminals: 2
      general_ward:
        per_bed: 10
        unit: "L/min"
        terminals: 1

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 4.5 其他医疗气体介质模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - medium_id: "MED-GAS-VAC"
    medium_name: "负压吸引"
    medium_name_en: "Medical Vacuum"
    category: "医疗气体"
    
    system_parameters:
      vacuum_level:
        value: -40
        unit: "kPa (相对大气压)"
        alternative: "-0.04 MPa"
      terminal_flow:
        value: 30
        unit: "L/min"
      recovery_time:
        value: "<3"
        unit: "s"
        description: "从大气压恢复到工作真空度"
        
  - medium_id: "MED-GAS-AIR"
    medium_name: "医用压缩空气"
    medium_name_en: "Medical Compressed Air"
    category: "医疗气体"
    
    quality_requirements:
      oil_content:
        max_value: 0.1
        unit: "mg/m³"
      moisture:
        dew_point: "<-40"
        unit: "°C"
      particles:
        class: "ISO 8573-1 Class 1"
        
    system_parameters:
      pressure:
        value: 0.4-0.5
        unit: "MPa"
      terminal_flow:
        value: 60
        unit: "L/min"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 4.6 电力介质模型（导体电子）
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - medium_id: "MED-ELEC"
    medium_name: "电力传输介质"

    category: "电子流"
    
    conductor_properties:
      copper:
        resistivity: 1.72e-8
        unit: "Ω·m"
        conductivity: 58e6
        conductivity_unit: "S/m"
        temperature_coefficient: 0.00393
        
      aluminum:
        resistivity: 2.82e-8
        unit: "Ω·m"
        
    voltage_levels:
      high_voltage:
        values: [10, 35]

      low_voltage:
        three_phase: 380
        single_phase: 220
        unit: "V"
        frequency: 50
        frequency_unit: "Hz"
        
    power_flow:
      active:
        formula: "P = √3 × U × I × cosφ"

      reactive:
        formula: "Q = √3 × U × I × sinφ"
        unit: "var / kvar"
      apparent:
        formula: "S = √3 × U × I"
        unit: "VA / kVA"
```
