## 五、流动路径模型 (Flow Path Models)

```yaml
Flow_Path_Models:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 5.1 HVAC冷源系统流动路径
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  HVAC_CHP_Paths:
    system_id: "HVAC-CHP"
    system_name: "冷热源系统"
    
    paths:
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # 冷冻水供水路径
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      - path_id: "PATH-CHW-SUPPLY"
        path_name: "冷冻水供水主路径"
        path_name_en: "Chilled Water Supply Path"
        flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
        path_type: "supply"
        
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "HVAC-CHP_SRC_CHILLER"
            node_type: "Source"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-CH-CENT / EQP-CH-SCREW"
            flow_action: "generate"
            description: "冷水机组制取冷冻水"
            parameters:
              output_temperature: 7
              unit: "°C"
              tolerance: "±0.5"
              
          - step: 2
            edge_id: "EDGE-CHW-PRI-SUPPLY"
            edge_type: "trunk"
            medium: "冷冻水"
            direction: "供水"
            
          - step: 3
            node_id: "HVAC-CHP_DST_CHW_PRI_PUMP"
            node_type: "Regulator"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-PUMP-CHW (一次泵)"
            flow_action: "pressurize"
            description: "一次泵定流量循环"
            parameters:
              flow_type: "定流量"
              
          - step: 4
            node_id: "HVAC-CHP_DST_CHW_HEADER_S"
            node_type: "Junction"
            flow_action: "merge/split"
            description: "供水集分水器"
            
          - step: 5
            node_id: "HVAC-CHP_DST_CHW_SEC_PUMP"
            node_type: "Regulator"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-PUMP-CHW (二次泵)"
            flow_action: "pressurize"
            description: "二次泵变频加压"
            parameters:
              flow_type: "变流量"
              control: "压差控制"
              
          - step: 6
            edge_id: "EDGE-CHW-RISER"
            edge_type: "branch"
            medium: "冷冻水"
            direction: "供水立管"
            
          - step: 7
            node_id: "HVAC-AHU_SINK"
            node_type: "Sink"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-AHU-CLEAN / EQP-AHU-COMBO / EQP-FCU-CEILING"
            flow_action: "consume"
            description: "末端换热消耗冷量"
            parameters:
              temperature_rise: 5
              unit: "°C"
              
        operating_conditions:
          season: "夏季（5月-10月）"
          supply_temp:
            value: 7
            unit: "°C"
            tolerance: "±0.5"
          return_temp:
            value: 12
            unit: "°C"
          delta_t:
            value: 5
            unit: "°C"
          design_flow:
            value: 1400
            unit: "m³/h"
          design_cooling:
            value: 8141
            unit: "kW"
            calculation: "1400 × 5 × 1.163"
            
        path_diagram: |
          ┌─────────┐    ┌─────────┐    ┌─────────┐    ┌─────────┐
          │ 冷水机组 │───►│ 一次泵  │───►│ 分水器  │───►│ 二次泵  │
          │ 7°C出水 │    │ 定流量  │    │         │    │ 变流量  │
          └─────────┘    └─────────┘    └────┬────┘    └────┬────┘
                                             │              │
                         ┌───────────────────┼──────────────┤
                         ▼                   ▼              ▼
                    ┌─────────┐        ┌─────────┐    ┌─────────┐
                    │ AHU-1   │        │ AHU-2   │    │ FCU-N   │
                    │ 手术室  │        │ ICU     │    │ 病房    │
                    └─────────┘        └─────────┘    └─────────┘

      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # 冷冻水回水路径
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      - path_id: "PATH-CHW-RETURN"
        path_name: "冷冻水回水主路径"
        path_name_en: "Chilled Water Return Path"
        flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
        path_type: "return"
        
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "HVAC-AHU_SINK"
            node_type: "Sink"
            flow_action: "discharge"
            description: "末端排出回水"
            parameters:
              output_temperature: 12
              unit: "°C"
              
          - step: 2
            edge_id: "EDGE-CHW-RETURN-RISER"
            edge_type: "branch"
            medium: "冷冻水"
            direction: "回水立管"
            
          - step: 3
            node_id: "HVAC-CHP_DST_CHW_HEADER_R"
            node_type: "Junction"
            flow_action: "merge"
            description: "回水集水器"
            
          - step: 4
            edge_id: "EDGE-CHW-PRI-RETURN"
            edge_type: "trunk"
            medium: "冷冻水"
            direction: "回水"
            
          - step: 5
            node_id: "HVAC-CHP_SRC_CHILLER"
            node_type: "Source"
            flow_action: "receive"
            description: "回到蒸发器再冷却"
            
        operating_conditions:
          return_temp:
            value: 12
            unit: "°C"

      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # 冷却水循环路径
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      - path_id: "PATH-CW-LOOP"
        path_name: "冷却水循环路径"
        path_name_en: "Condenser Water Loop Path"
        flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CW"
        path_type: "closed_loop"
        
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "HVAC-CHP_SRC_CHILLER_COND"
            node_type: "Heat_Source"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-CH-CENT (冷凝器侧)"
            flow_action: "heat_reject"
            description: "冷凝器排出废热"
            parameters:
              inlet_temp: 32
              outlet_temp: 37
              unit: "°C"
              
          - step: 2
            edge_id: "EDGE-CW-SUPPLY"
            edge_type: "trunk"
            medium: "冷却水"
            direction: "去冷却塔"
            
          - step: 3
            node_id: "HVAC-CHP_DST_CW_PUMP"
            node_type: "Regulator"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-PUMP-CW"
            flow_action: "pressurize"
            
          - step: 4
            node_id: "HVAC-CHP_SNK_CT"
            node_type: "Heat_Sink"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-CT-OPEN / EQP-CT-CLOSED"
            flow_action: "reject_to_ambient"
            description: "冷却塔散热至大气"
            parameters:
              outlet_temp: 32
              approach: 5
              unit: "°C"
              
          - step: 5
            edge_id: "EDGE-CW-RETURN"
            edge_type: "trunk"
            medium: "冷却水"
            direction: "回冷凝器"
            
        operating_conditions:
          supply_temp:
            value: 32
            unit: "°C"
          return_temp:
            value: 37
            unit: "°C"
          design_flow:
            value: 1680
            unit: "m³/h"
            note: "约为冷冻水流量的1.2倍"
            
        energy_balance:
          heat_rejection: "Q_cond = Q_evap + P_comp"
          typical_ratio: "Q_cond ≈ 1.25 × Q_evap (COP=5时)"

    flow_loops:
      - loop_id: "LOOP-CHW"
        loop_name: "冷冻水循环"
        supply_path: "PATH-CHW-SUPPLY"
        return_path: "PATH-CHW-RETURN"
        closed_loop: true
        energy_transfer: "冷量从冷水机组传递至末端"
        
      - loop_id: "LOOP-CW"
        loop_name: "冷却水循环"
        path: "PATH-CW-LOOP"
        closed_loop: true
        energy_transfer: "废热从冷凝器排至冷却塔"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 5.2 空气处理系统流动路径
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  HVAC_AHU_Paths:
    system_id: "HVAC-AHU"
    system_name: "空调机组系统"
    
    paths:
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # 洁净手术室送风路径
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      - path_id: "PATH-AIR-OR-SUPPLY"
        path_name: "手术室送风路径"
        path_name_en: "Operating Room Supply Air Path"
        flow_type: "MASS-AIR-CLEAN"
        path_type: "supply"
        
        agent_02_space_ref:
          space_type: "ROOM-OR-I"
          cleanliness: "ISO 5"
          
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "HVAC-AHU_SRC_OA"
            node_type: "Source"
            flow_action: "intake"
            description: "室外新风取入"
            parameters:
              fresh_air_ratio: 100
              unit: "%"
              note: "全新风系统"
              
          - step: 2
            node_id: "HVAC-AHU_PROC_PREFILTER"
            node_type: "Processor"
            equipment_ref: "初效过滤器 G4"
            flow_action: "filter"
            description: "初效过滤"
            parameters:
              efficiency: "G4"
              pressure_drop: 50
              unit: "Pa"
              
          - step: 3
            node_id: "HVAC-AHU_PROC_COIL"
            node_type: "Processor"
            equipment_ref: "表冷器/加热器"
            flow_action: "heat_exchange"
            description: "冷却/加热处理"
            parameters:
              chw_inlet: 7
              chw_outlet: 12
              air_outlet_temp: 14
              unit: "°C"
              
          - step: 4
            node_id: "HVAC-AHU_PROC_HUMIDIFIER"
            node_type: "Processor"
            equipment_ref: "电极加湿器/蒸汽加湿器"
            flow_action: "humidify"
            description: "加湿处理"
            parameters:
              target_humidity: 50
              unit: "%RH"
              tolerance: "±5%"
              
          - step: 5
            node_id: "HVAC-AHU_PROC_MEDFILTER"
            node_type: "Processor"
            equipment_ref: "中效过滤器 F8"
            flow_action: "filter"
            description: "中效过滤"
            parameters:
              efficiency: "F8"
              pressure_drop: 100
              unit: "Pa"
              
          - step: 6
            node_id: "HVAC-AHU_PROC_FAN"
            node_type: "Regulator"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-AHU-CLEAN 送风机"
            flow_action: "pressurize"
            description: "送风机加压"
            parameters:
              static_pressure: 800
              unit: "Pa"
              control: "变频调节"
              
          - step: 7
            edge_id: "EDGE-AIR-SUPPLY-DUCT"
            edge_type: "trunk"
            medium: "洁净空气"
            velocity: 8
            unit: "m/s"
            
          - step: 8
            node_id: "HVAC-AHU_PROC_HEPA"
            node_type: "Processor"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-FILTER-HEPA H14"
            flow_action: "filter"
            description: "高效过滤"
            parameters:
              efficiency: "H14 (99.995%)"
              pressure_drop: 250
              unit: "Pa"
              
          - step: 9
            node_id: "HVAC-AHU_TERM_DIFFUSER"
            node_type: "Terminal"
            equipment_ref: "层流送风天花"
            flow_action: "distribute"
            description: "层流送风"
            parameters:
              face_velocity: 0.35
              unit: "m/s"
              coverage: "手术区3m×3m"
              
          - step: 10
            node_id: "ROOM-OR-I"
            node_type: "Sink"
            flow_action: "supply_to_space"
            description: "送入手术室"
            
        operating_conditions:
          supply_temp:
            summer: 18
            winter: 22
            unit: "°C"
          supply_humidity:
            value: 50
            unit: "%RH"
            tolerance: "±5%"
          supply_flow:
            value: 12000
            unit: "m³/h"
            air_changes: 36
            unit_ach: "次/h"
            
        agent_02_environmental_compliance:
          temperature: "22-25°C"
          humidity: "40-60%RH"
          pressure: "+15Pa (相对走廊)"
          cleanliness: "ISO 5"
          
        path_diagram: |
          室外 ──► 初效G4 ──► 表冷器 ──► 加湿器 ──► 中效F8 ──► 送风机
                     │                                           │
                     └───────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                            │
                     ┌───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┐
                     ▼                                               ▼
               HEPA H14 ──► 层流天花 ──► 手术室           HEPA ──► 其他净化区

      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # 负压隔离病房排风路径
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      - path_id: "PATH-AIR-ISO-EXHAUST"
        path_name: "负压隔离病房排风路径"
        path_name_en: "Negative Pressure Isolation Room Exhaust Path"
        flow_type: "MASS-AIR-EXHAUST"
        path_type: "exhaust"
        
        agent_02_space_ref:
          space_type: "ROOM-ISO-NEG"
          pressure_requirement: "-15Pa"
          
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "ROOM-ISO-NEG"
            node_type: "Source"
            flow_action: "extract"
            description: "从病房抽取空气"
            parameters:
              room_pressure: -15
              unit: "Pa"
              reference: "相对走廊"
              
          - step: 2
            node_id: "HVAC-EXH_PROC_HEPA"
            node_type: "Processor"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-FILTER-HEPA"
            flow_action: "filter"
            description: "HEPA过滤"
            parameters:
              efficiency: "H14 (99.995%)"
              note: "防止病原体排放"
              
          - step: 3
            node_id: "HVAC-EXH_PROC_UV"
            node_type: "Processor"
            flow_action: "disinfect"
            description: "紫外消毒（可选）"
            
          - step: 4
            node_id: "HVAC-EXH_FAN"
            node_type: "Regulator"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-FAN-NEG"
            flow_action: "exhaust"
            description: "负压排风机"
            parameters:
              redundancy: "N+1"
              
          - step: 5
            node_id: "ATMOSPHERE"
            node_type: "Sink"
            flow_action: "discharge"
            description: "高空排放"
            parameters:
              discharge_height: ">屋顶3m"
              
        control_strategy:
          pressure_control: "排风量 > 送风量"
          monitoring: "压差传感器持续监测"
          alarm: "压差 > -10Pa 时报警"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 5.3 医疗气体系统流动路径
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  MGAS_O2_Paths:
    system_id: "MGAS-O2"
    system_name: "医用氧气系统"
    
    paths:
      - path_id: "PATH-O2-SUPPLY"
        path_name: "氧气供应主路径"
        path_name_en: "Medical Oxygen Supply Path"
        flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-O2"
        path_type: "supply"
        criticality: "LIFE_SAFETY"
        
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "MGAS-O2_SRC_LOX"
            node_type: "Source"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-LOX-TANK"
            flow_action: "store"
            description: "液氧储罐"
            parameters:
              storage_pressure: 1.5
              unit: "MPa"
              capacity: "3天用量"
              
          - step: 2
            node_id: "MGAS-O2_PROC_VAPORIZER"
            node_type: "Processor"
            equipment_ref: "汽化器"
            flow_action: "vaporize"
            description: "液氧汽化"
            parameters:
              outlet_temp: ">5"
              unit: "°C"
              
          - step: 3
            node_id: "MGAS-O2_REG_PRESSURE"
            node_type: "Regulator"
            equipment_ref: "减压阀组"
            flow_action: "regulate"
            description: "一级减压"
            parameters:
              outlet_pressure: 0.8
              unit: "MPa"
              
          - step: 4
            edge_id: "EDGE-O2-TRUNK"
            edge_type: "trunk"
            medium: "氧气"
            material: "铜管/不锈钢"
            
          - step: 5
            node_id: "MGAS-O2_DST_VALVE_BOX"
            node_type: "Distribution"
            equipment_ref: "区域阀箱"
            flow_action: "distribute"
            description: "区域分配"
            parameters:
              outlet_pressure: 0.5
              unit: "MPa"
              
          - step: 6
            node_id: "MGAS-O2_REG_ZONE"
            node_type: "Regulator"
            equipment_ref: "二级减压阀"
            flow_action: "regulate"
            description: "二级减压"
            parameters:
              outlet_pressure: 0.4
              unit: "MPa"
              
          - step: 7
            edge_id: "EDGE-O2-BRANCH"
            edge_type: "branch"
            medium: "氧气"
            
          - step: 8
            node_id: "MGAS-O2_TERM_OUTLET"
            node_type: "Terminal"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-O2-OUTLET"
            flow_action: "supply"
            description: "氧气终端"
            parameters:
              terminal_pressure: 0.3-0.5
              unit: "MPa"
              flow_rate: "0-15"
              flow_unit: "L/min"
              
        backup_path:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "MGAS-O2_SRC_MANIFOLD"
            node_type: "Backup_Source"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-O2-MANIFOLD"
            description: "气瓶汇流排备用"
            activation: "当液氧压力低于设定值时自动切换"
            
        safety_requirements:
          alarm_low: "压力 < 0.35MPa"
          alarm_high: "压力 > 0.6MPa"
          emergency_shutoff: "区域阀门可紧急关闭"
          
        agent_02_space_distribution:
          - space: "ROOM-OR-I"
            terminals: 2
            design_flow: "60 L/min"
          - space: "ROOM-ICU"
            terminals_per_bed: 2
            design_flow: "40 L/min"
          - space: "ROOM-WARD"
            terminals_per_bed: 1
            design_flow: "10 L/min"

  MGAS_VAC_Paths:
    system_id: "MGAS-VAC"
    system_name: "医用负压吸引系统"
    
    paths:
      - path_id: "PATH-VAC-SUCTION"
        path_name: "负压吸引路径"
        path_name_en: "Medical Vacuum Suction Path"
        flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-VAC"
        path_type: "suction"
        criticality: "LIFE_SAFETY"
        
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "MGAS-VAC_TERM_OUTLET"
            node_type: "Terminal"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-VAC-OUTLET"
            flow_action: "suction"
            description: "负压吸引终端"
            parameters:
              vacuum_level: -40
              unit: "kPa"
              flow_rate: 30
              flow_unit: "L/min"
              
          - step: 2
            edge_id: "EDGE-VAC-BRANCH"
            edge_type: "branch"
            medium: "空气+吸引物"
            direction: "反向（吸引方向）"
            
          - step: 3
            node_id: "MGAS-VAC_DST_COLLECTOR"
            node_type: "Processor"
            equipment_ref: "收集器"
            flow_action: "separate"
            description: "液体分离"
            
          - step: 4
            edge_id: "EDGE-VAC-TRUNK"
            edge_type: "trunk"
            medium: "空气"
            
          - step: 5
            node_id: "MGAS-VAC_DST_TANK"
            node_type: "Buffer"
            equipment_ref: "真空储气罐"
            flow_action: "buffer"
            description: "稳压缓冲"
            
          - step: 6
            node_id: "MGAS-VAC_SRC_PUMP"
            node_type: "Source"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-VAC-PUMP"
            flow_action: "create_vacuum"
            description: "真空泵组产生负压"
            parameters:
              redundancy: "N+1"
              
          - step: 7
            node_id: "MGAS-VAC_PROC_FILTER"
            node_type: "Processor"
            equipment_ref: "细菌过滤器"
            flow_action: "filter"
            description: "排气过滤"
            
          - step: 8
            node_id: "ATMOSPHERE"
            node_type: "Sink"
            flow_action: "exhaust"
            description: "过滤后排放"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 5.4 电气系统流动路径
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  ELEC_Paths:
    system_id: "ELEC"
    system_name: "电气系统"
    
    paths:
      - path_id: "PATH-ELEC-MAIN"
        path_name: "主供电路径"
        path_name_en: "Main Power Supply Path"
        flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-HV"
        path_type: "supply"
        
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "ELEC_SRC_GRID"
            node_type: "Source"
            flow_action: "input"
            description: "市电输入"
            parameters:
              voltage: 10
              unit: "kV"
              supply_type: "双路进线"
              
          - step: 2
            node_id: "ELEC_DST_HV_SWITCH"
            node_type: "Distribution"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-HV-SWITCHGEAR"
            flow_action: "distribute"
            description: "高压配电"
            
          - step: 3
            node_id: "ELEC_TRANS_MAIN"
            node_type: "Transformer"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-TRANS-DRY"
            flow_action: "transform"
            description: "降压变压"
            parameters:
              input_voltage: 10
              output_voltage: 0.4
              unit: "kV"
              capacity: 2000
              capacity_unit: "kVA"
              
          - step: 4
            node_id: "ELEC_DST_LV_SWITCH"
            node_type: "Distribution"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-LV-SWITCHGEAR"
            flow_action: "distribute"
            description: "低压配电"
            parameters:
              voltage: 380
              unit: "V"
              
          - step: 5
            node_id: "ELEC_DST_PANEL"
            node_type: "Distribution"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-PANEL-DIST"
            flow_action: "distribute"
            description: "楼层配电"
            
          - step: 6
            node_id: "ELEC_TERM_LOAD"
            node_type: "Terminal"
            flow_action: "consume"
            description: "用电设备"
            
        path_diagram: |
          市电10kV ──► 高压开关柜 ──► 变压器 ──► 低压开关柜
              │            │                         │
              │            ├───► 变压器2 ───────────►│
              │            │                         │
         双路进线         N+1冗余                    ├──► 一级负荷馈线
                                                    ├──► 二级负荷馈线
                                                    └──► 三级负荷馈线

      - path_id: "PATH-ELEC-EMERG"
        path_name: "应急供电路径"
        path_name_en: "Emergency Power Supply Path"
        flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-EMERG"
        path_type: "backup"
        criticality: "LIFE_SAFETY"
        
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "ELEC_SRC_GEN"
            node_type: "Backup_Source"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-GEN-DIESEL"
            flow_action: "generate"
            description: "柴油发电机组"
            parameters:
              capacity: 1500
              unit: "kW"
              startup_time: "≤10s"
              fuel_reserve: "24h运行"
              
          - step: 2
            node_id: "ELEC_SWITCH_ATS"
            node_type: "Switch"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-ATS"
            flow_action: "switch"
            description: "自动转换开关"
            parameters:
              transfer_time: "≤15s (合计)"
              
          - step: 3
            node_id: "ELEC_DST_EMERG"
            node_type: "Distribution"
            equipment_ref: "应急配电柜"
            flow_action: "distribute"
            description: "应急负荷配电"
            
          - step: 4
            node_id: "ELEC_TERM_CRITICAL"
            node_type: "Terminal"
            flow_action: "supply"
            description: "一级负荷供电"
            load_types:
              - "手术室照明"
              - "ICU设备"
              - "医用气体设备"
              - "消防设备"
              
        activation_condition: "市电断电 > 0.2s"
        
      - path_id: "PATH-ELEC-ISO"
        path_name: "隔离电源路径"
        path_name_en: "Isolated Power Supply Path"
        flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-ISO"
        path_type: "isolated"
        criticality: "LIFE_SAFETY"
        
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "ELEC_SRC_UPS"
            node_type: "Source"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-UPS-MEDICAL"
            flow_action: "condition"
            description: "UPS供电"
            parameters:
              transfer_time: "0ms"
              backup_time: "≥30min"
              
          - step: 2
            node_id: "ELEC_TRANS_ISO"
            node_type: "Transformer"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-ISO-TRANS"
            flow_action: "isolate"
            description: "隔离变压器"
            parameters:
              capacity: "7.5-10"
              unit: "kVA"
              isolation_type: "IT系统"
              
          - step: 3
            node_id: "ELEC_MON_ISO"
            node_type: "Monitor"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-ISO-MONITOR"
            flow_action: "monitor"
            description: "绝缘监测"
            parameters:
              alarm_threshold: 50
              unit: "kΩ"
              
          - step: 4
            node_id: "ELEC_TERM_OR"
            node_type: "Terminal"
            flow_action: "supply"
            description: "手术室插座"
            
        agent_02_space_application:
          - space: "ROOM-OR-I"
            required: true
          - space: "ROOM-ICU"
            required: true

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 5.5 给排水系统流动路径
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  PLUMB_Paths:
    system_id: "PLUMB"
    system_name: "给排水系统"
    
    paths:
      - path_id: "PATH-DW-SUPPLY"
        path_name: "生活给水供水路径"
        path_name_en: "Domestic Water Supply Path"
        flow_type: "MASS-WATER-DW"
        path_type: "supply"
        
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "PLUMB_SRC_MAINS"
            node_type: "Source"
            flow_action: "input"
            description: "市政给水"
            parameters:
              pressure: 0.25
              unit: "MPa"
              
          - step: 2
            node_id: "PLUMB_DST_TANK"
            node_type: "Buffer"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-TANK-WATER"
            flow_action: "store"
            description: "生活水箱"
            parameters:
              capacity: "日用水量的20%"
              
          - step: 3
            node_id: "PLUMB_DST_PUMP"
            node_type: "Regulator"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-PUMP-DW-VFD"
            flow_action: "pressurize"
            description: "变频供水泵"
            parameters:
              outlet_pressure: 0.45
              unit: "MPa"
              control: "恒压变频"
              
          - step: 4
            edge_id: "EDGE-DW-RISER"
            edge_type: "branch"
            medium: "生活水"
            
          - step: 5
            node_id: "PLUMB_TERM_FIXTURE"
            node_type: "Terminal"
            flow_action: "supply"
            description: "卫生器具"

      - path_id: "PATH-FIRE-HYDRANT"
        path_name: "消火栓供水路径"
        path_name_en: "Fire Hydrant Supply Path"
        flow_type: "MASS-WATER-FIRE"
        path_type: "standby"
        criticality: "LIFE_SAFETY"
        
        sequence:
          - step: 1
            node_id: "FIRE_SRC_TANK"
            node_type: "Source"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-TANK-FIRE"
            flow_action: "store"
            description: "消防水池"
            parameters:
              capacity: "室内外消防用水量之和"
              fire_duration: "2h"
              
          - step: 2
            node_id: "FIRE_DST_PUMP"
            node_type: "Regulator"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-PUMP-FIRE"
            flow_action: "pressurize"
            description: "消火栓泵"
            parameters:
              pressure: 0.7
              unit: "MPa"
              startup_time: "≤30s"
              
          - step: 3
            node_id: "FIRE_DST_JOCKEY"
            node_type: "Regulator"
            equipment_ref: "EQP-PUMP-FIRE-JOCKEY"
            flow_action: "maintain_pressure"
            description: "稳压泵"
            parameters:
              standby_pressure: 0.05
              unit: "MPa"
              
          - step: 4
            edge_id: "EDGE-FIRE-RISER"
            edge_type: "trunk"
            medium: "消防水"
            
          - step: 5
            node_id: "FIRE_TERM_HYDRANT"
            node_type: "Terminal"
            flow_action: "standby"
            description: "消火栓"
            parameters:
              flow_rate: 20
              unit: "L/s"
              
        activation: "火灾报警联动启动"
```

---

## 六、守恒模型 (Conservation Models)

```yaml
Conservation_Models:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 6.1 节点平衡方程
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  node_balance_equations:
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 质量守恒节点
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    - equation_id: "CONS-NODE-JUNCTION"
      node_type: "Junction"
      principle: "质量守恒"
      
      equation:
        general: "Σṁ_in = Σṁ_out"
        description: "流入质量流量之和等于流出质量流量之和"
        
      applications:
        - name: "分集水器"
          equation: "ṁ_main = Σṁ_branch_i"
        - name: "风管汇合点"
          equation: "V̇_oa + V̇_ra = V̇_ma"
          where: "oa=新风, ra=回风, ma=混合风"
          
    - equation_id: "CONS-NODE-SPLITTER"
      node_type: "Splitter"
      principle: "质量守恒 + 分配"
      
      equation:
        general: "ṁ_in = Σṁ_out_i"
        distribution: "按支路阻力或设定比例分配"
        
      distribution_modes:
        - mode: "阻力分配"
          relation: "ṁ_i ∝ 1/√R_i"
          where: "R_i为支路阻力"
        - mode: "比例分配"
          relation: "ṁ_i = ṁ_in × ratio_i"
          
    - equation_id: "CONS-NODE-MIXER"
      node_type: "Mixer"
      principle: "质量守恒 + 能量守恒"
      
      equations:
        mass: "ṁ_out = Σṁ_in_i"
        energy: "ṁ_out × h_out = Σ(ṁ_in_i × h_in_i)"
        
      applications:
        - name: "新风回风混合"
          mass: "ṁ_ma = ṁ_oa + ṁ_ra"
          energy: "T_ma = (ṁ_oa × T_oa + ṁ_ra × T_ra) / ṁ_ma"
          humidity: "d_ma = (ṁ_oa × d_oa + ṁ_ra × d_ra) / ṁ_ma"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 能量转换节点
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    - equation_id: "CONS-NODE-TRANSFORMER"
      node_type: "Transformer"
      principle: "能量守恒"
      
      equation:
        general: "E_in = E_out + E_loss"
        efficiency: "η = E_out / E_in"
        
      applications:
        - device: "冷水机组"
          equation: "Q_evap = P_comp × (COP - 1)"
          alternative: "COP = Q_evap / P_comp"
          typical_COP: [4.5, 6.0]
          
        - device: "电力变压器"
          equation: "P_out = P_in × η"
          typical_efficiency: 0.98
          losses: "铁损 + 铜损"
          
        - device: "换热器"
          equation: "ṁ_1 × Cp_1 × ΔT_1 = ṁ_2 × Cp_2 × ΔT_2 × η"
          typical_efficiency: [0.85, 0.95]
          
        - device: "电动机"
          equation: "P_mech = P_elec × η"
          typical_efficiency: [0.90, 0.95]
          
    - equation_id: "CONS-NODE-GENERATOR"
      node_type: "Generator"
      principle: "能量转换"
      
      applications:
        - device: "燃气锅炉"
          equation: "Q_out = ṁ_fuel × LHV × η"
          where:
            LHV: "燃料低位发热值 (kJ/kg)"
            η: "锅炉效率 (0.90-0.95)"
            
        - device: "柴油发电机"
          equation: "P_elec = ṁ_fuel × LHV × η_thermal × η_elec"
          typical_fuel_consumption: "0.2-0.25 kg/kWh"
          
    - equation_id: "CONS-NODE-STORAGE"
      node_type: "Storage"
      principle: "能量储存"
      
      equation:
        general: "dE_stored/dt = Ė_in - Ė_out"
        
      applications:
        - device: "蓄水池/水箱"
          equation: "dV/dt = V̇_in - V̇_out"
        - device: "蓄电池/UPS"
          equation: "dE/dt = P_charge - P_discharge - P_loss"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 6.2 路径平衡方程
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  path_balance_equations:
    
    - equation_id: "CONS-PATH-CLOSED-LOOP"
      path_type: "closed_loop"
      principle: "循环守恒"
      
      equations:
        - name: "流量守恒"
          equation: "V̇ = 常数 (无分支时)"
          with_branches: "Σ分支流量 = 主管流量"
          
        - name: "能量平衡"
          equation: "Q_source = Q_load + Q_loss"
          where:
            Q_source: "热源/冷源产能"
            Q_load: "负荷消耗"
            Q_loss: "管路损失"
            
        - name: "压力平衡"
          equation: "ΔP_pump = Σ(ΔP_friction + ΔP_fittings)"
          where: "泵扬程 = 管路阻力损失之和"
          
      applications:
        - system: "冷冻水循环"
          energy_balance: "Q_chiller = Σ(Q_coil_i) + Q_pipe_loss"
          temperature_balance: "ṁ × Cp × (T_return - T_supply) = Q_chiller"
          
    - equation_id: "CONS-PATH-OPEN-LOOP"
      path_type: "open_loop"
      principle: "起止平衡"
      
      equations:
        - name: "质量平衡"
          equation: "ṁ_inlet = ṁ_outlet (稳态)"
          
        - name: "能量平衡"
          equation: "E_inlet + E_input = E_outlet + E_loss"
          
        - name: "压力平衡"
          equation: "P_supply - P_terminal = ΔP_friction + ρgh"
          where:
            ΔP_friction: "摩擦损失"
            ρgh: "位差压力"
            
      applications:
        - system: "医用氧气供应"
          pressure_cascade: "P_tank > P_pipeline > P_terminal"
          flow_balance: "Σ(V̇_terminal_i) ≤ V̇_supply_capacity"
          
    - equation_id: "CONS-PATH-BRANCHED"
      path_type: "branched"
      principle: "分支平衡"
      
      equations:
        - name: "并联分支流量"
          equation: "ṁ_main = Σṁ_branch_i"
          
        - name: "并联分支压降"
          equation: "ΔP_branch_1 = ΔP_branch_2 = ... = ΔP_branch_n"
          note: "并联支路压降相等"
          
        - name: "串联分支压降"
          equation: "ΔP_total = Σ ΔP_section_i"
          
      hydraulic_resistance:
        formula: "ΔP = R × ṁ²"
        parallel: "1/R_eq = Σ(1/R_i)"
        series: "R_eq = ΣR_i"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 6.3 系统级能量平衡
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_energy_balance:
    
    - system_id: "HVAC-COOLING"
      system_name: "制冷系统"
      
      energy_chain:
        - stage: "冷水机组"
          input: "电能 (P_comp)"
          output: "冷量 (Q_evap)"
          relation: "COP = Q_evap / P_comp"
          
        - stage: "冷冻水输配"
          input: "电能 (P_pump)"
          output: "输送冷量"
          loss: "泵功转热 + 管路热增益"
          
        - stage: "末端换热"
          input: "冷冻水冷量"
          output: "空气冷量"
          efficiency: "盘管效率 0.85-0.95"
          
        - stage: "送风输配"
          input: "电能 (P_fan)"
          output: "输送冷空气"
          loss: "风机发热"
          
        - stage: "空间换热"
          input: "送风冷量"
          output: "消除室内热负荷"
          balance: "Q_supply = Q_room_load"
          
      overall_efficiency:
        formula: "η_system = Q_room / (P_chiller + P_pumps + P_fans)"
        typical_value: [3.5, 4.5]
        note: "系统综合COP"
        
    - system_id: "ELEC-POWER"
      system_name: "电力系统"
      
      power_balance:
        input: "P_grid + P_gen"
        output: "Σ P_load_i"
        loss: "P_trans_loss + P_cable_loss"
        balance: "P_grid + P_gen = Σ P_load_i + P_losses"
        
      load_categories:
        - category: "一级负荷"
          description: "生命安全"
          backup: "UPS + 发电机"
        - category: "二级负荷"
          description: "重要负荷"
          backup: "发电机"
        - category: "三级负荷"
          description: "普通负荷"
          backup: "无"
```

## 七、载体-荷载耦合模型 (Carrier-Payload Coupling Models)

```yaml
Carrier_Payload_Coupling_Models:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 7.1 水-热能耦合
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - coupling_id: "COUP-CHW-COOL"
    coupling_name: "冷冻水-冷量耦合"
    carrier:
      medium: "水"
      flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
      flow_direction: "供水方向"
    payload:
      energy: "冷量"
      flow_type: "ENERGY-THERMAL-COOL"
      transfer_direction: "从冷水机组到末端"
      
    coupling_equation:
      primary_formula: "Q = ρ × V̇ × Cp × ΔT"
      practical_formula: "Q(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × ΔT(°C) × 1.163"
      
    parameters:
      - symbol: "Q"
        name: "冷量"
        unit: "kW"
      - symbol: "V̇"
        name: "冷冻水流量"
        unit: "m³/h"
      - symbol: "ΔT"
        name: "供回水温差"
        unit: "°C"
        design_value: 5
      - symbol: "1.163"
        name: "水的换算系数"
        derivation: "ρ × Cp / 3600 = 1000 × 4.186 / 3600"
        
    design_examples:
      - example_id: "COUP-CHW-001"
        description: "手术室洁净空调冷量"
        inputs:
          design_flow: 100
          flow_unit: "m³/h"
          supply_temp: 7
          return_temp: 12
          delta_t: 5
        calculation: "Q = 100 × 5 × 1.163 = 581.5 kW"
        output:
          cooling_capacity: 581.5
          unit: "kW"
          equivalent_rt: 165.3
          
    control_implications:
      variable_flow_system:
        description: "变流量系统调节"
        method: "调节流量V̇改变冷量Q"
        control: "二次泵变频，压差控制"
      constant_flow_system:
        description: "定流量系统调节"
        method: "调节供水温度改变ΔT"
        control: "冷水机组出水温度调节"
        
  - coupling_id: "COUP-HW-HEAT"
    coupling_name: "热水-热量耦合"
    carrier:
      medium: "水"
      flow_type: "MASS-WATER-HW"
    payload:
      energy: "热量"
      flow_type: "ENERGY-THERMAL-HEAT"
      
    coupling_equation:
      formula: "Q = V̇ × ΔT × 1.163 (kW)"
      
    parameters:
      design_supply_temp: 60
      design_return_temp: 50
      design_delta_t: 10
      
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 7.2 空气-热能耦合
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - coupling_id: "COUP-AIR-SENS"
    coupling_name: "空气-显热耦合"
    carrier:
      medium: "空气"
      flow_type: "MASS-AIR-SUPPLY"
    payload:
      energy: "显热"
      component: "sensible"
      
    coupling_equation:
      formula: "Qs = ρ × V̇ × Cp × ΔT"
      practical: "Qs(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × ΔT(°C) × 0.335"
      
    parameters:
      - symbol: "0.335"
        derivation: "1.2 × 1.005 / 3.6"
        
  - coupling_id: "COUP-AIR-LAT"
    coupling_name: "空气-潜热耦合"
    carrier:
      medium: "空气"
      flow_type: "MASS-AIR-SUPPLY"
    payload:
      energy: "潜热"
      component: "latent"
      
    coupling_equation:
      formula: "Ql = ρ × V̇ × Δd × γ"
      practical: "Ql(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × Δd(g/kg) × 0.833"
      
    parameters:
      - symbol: "Δd"
        name: "含湿量差"
        unit: "g/kg干空气"
      - symbol: "γ"
        name: "汽化潜热"
        value: 2500
        unit: "kJ/kg"
        
  - coupling_id: "COUP-AIR-TOTAL"
    coupling_name: "空气-全热耦合"
    carrier:
      medium: "空气"
      flow_type: "MASS-AIR-SUPPLY"
    payload:
      energy: "全热"
      component: "total"
      
    coupling_equation:
      formula: "Qt = ρ × V̇ × Δh"
      practical: "Qt(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × Δh(kJ/kg) × 0.334"
      relation: "Qt = Qs + Ql"
      
    design_examples:
      - example_id: "COUP-AIR-001"
        description: "手术室送风冷量"
        conditions:
          supply_air:
            dry_bulb: 18
            humidity: 50
            enthalpy: 39.5
          return_air:
            dry_bulb: 25
            humidity: 55
            enthalpy: 53.5
          air_flow: 12000
          unit: "m³/h"
        calculation:
          sensible: "12000 × (25-18) × 0.335 = 28.14 kW"
          delta_enthalpy: "53.5 - 39.5 = 14 kJ/kg"
          total: "12000 × 14 × 0.334 = 56.11 kW"
          latent: "56.11 - 28.14 = 27.97 kW"
        outputs:
          sensible_cooling: 28.14
          latent_cooling: 27.97
          total_cooling: 56.11
          unit: "kW"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 7.3 电力耦合
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - coupling_id: "COUP-ELEC-AC3"
    coupling_name: "三相交流电力耦合"
    carrier:
      medium: "电子流"
      flow_type: "三相交流电流"
    payload:
      energy: "电能"
      flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-LV"
      
    coupling_equations:
      active_power:
        formula: "P = √3 × U × I × cosφ"
        unit: "kW"
      reactive_power:
        formula: "Q = √3 × U × I × sinφ"
        unit: "kvar"
      apparent_power:
        formula: "S = √3 × U × I"
        unit: "kVA"
      power_triangle:
        relation: "S² = P² + Q²"
        
    parameters:
      - symbol: "U"
        name: "线电压"
        typical: 380
        unit: "V"
      - symbol: "I"
        name: "线电流"
        unit: "A"
      - symbol: "cosφ"
        name: "功率因数"
        target: ">0.9"
        
    design_examples:
      - example_id: "COUP-ELEC-001"
        description: "冷水机组电力需求"
        inputs:
          cooling_capacity: 2000
          unit: "kW"
          COP: 5.0
        calculation:
          power_consumption: "2000 / 5 = 400 kW"
          at_400V_pf09:
            current: "400000 / (√3 × 400 × 0.9) = 641 A"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 7.4 蒸汽耦合
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - coupling_id: "COUP-STEAM-HEAT"
    coupling_name: "蒸汽-热量耦合"
    carrier:
      medium: "蒸汽"
      flow_type: "MASS-STEAM"
    payload:
      energy: "热量"
      mechanism: "凝结放热"
      
    coupling_equation:
      condensing: "Q = ṁ × r"
      total_heat: "Q = ṁ × (h_steam - h_condensate)"
      
    parameters:
      - symbol: "r"
        name: "汽化潜热"
        at_0.4MPa: 2108
        unit: "kJ/kg"
        
    design_examples:
      - example_id: "COUP-STEAM-001"
        description: "消毒供应蒸汽需求"
        inputs:
          heat_demand: 500
          unit: "kW"
          steam_pressure: 0.4
          steam_pressure_unit: "MPa"
        calculation:
          latent_heat: 2108
          steam_consumption: "500 / (2108/3600) = 0.854 t/h"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 7.5 医疗气体耦合
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  - coupling_id: "COUP-O2-SUPPLY"
    coupling_name: "氧气-供气耦合"
    carrier:
      medium: "氧气"
      flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-O2"
    payload:
      energy: "压力能 + 化学能"
      purpose: "医疗供氧"
      
    coupling_equation:
      flow_power: "Ẇ = P × V̇"
      pressure_drop: "ΔP = f × (L/D) × (ρv²/2)"
      
    consumption_rates:
      source: "Agent-02 医疗空间要求"
      operating_room:
        per_room: 60
        unit: "L/min"
        terminals: 2
        simultaneous_factor: 1.0
      icu:
        per_bed: 40
        unit: "L/min"
        terminals: 2
        simultaneous_factor: 0.8
      general_ward:
        per_bed: 10
        unit: "L/min"
        terminals: 1
        simultaneous_factor: 0.3
        
    design_examples:
      - example_id: "COUP-O2-001"
        description: "医院氧气总需求计算"
        inputs:
          operating_rooms: 12
          icu_beds: 48
          general_ward_beds: 400
        calculation:
          or_demand: "12 × 60 × 1.0 = 720 L/min"
          icu_demand: "48 × 40 × 0.8 = 1536 L/min"
          ward_demand: "400 × 10 × 0.3 = 1200 L/min"
          total_peak: "720 + 1536 + 1200 = 3456 L/min"
        output:
          peak_demand: 3456
          unit: "L/min"
          hourly: 207.36
          hourly_unit: "Nm³/h"
```

## 八、空间-流动耦合模型 (Space-Flow Coupling)

```yaml
Space_Flow_Coupling:
  
  description: |
    基于Agent-02空间本体的环境要求，与Agent-04流动模型的映射关系。
    定义各类医疗空间所需的流动服务及其参数要求。

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 8.1 手术室空间-流动耦合
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  operating_room_coupling:
    space_type: "ROOM-OR-I"
    space_name: "I级洁净手术室"
    source: "Agent-02 医疗专用空间模型"
    
    environmental_requirements:
      temperature:
        range: [22, 25]
        unit: "°C"
        tolerance: "±0.5"
      humidity:
        range: [40, 60]
        unit: "%RH"
        tolerance: "±5%"
      pressure:
        value: "+15"
        unit: "Pa"
        reference: "相对走廊"
      cleanliness:
        class: "ISO 5"
        particle_count: "≤3520/m³ (≥0.5μm)"
      air_changes:
        min_value: 36
        unit: "次/h"
        note: "手术区"
      fresh_air:
        min_value: 100
        unit: "%"
        note: "全新风"
        
    required_flows:
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-OR-AIR-SUPPLY"
        flow_type: "MASS-AIR-CLEAN"
        purpose: "洁净送风"
        parameters:
          flow_rate:
            calculation: "房间面积 × 层高 × 换气次数"
            example: "50m² × 3m × 36 = 5400 m³/h (手术区)"
          velocity:
            laminar: "0.25-0.5 m/s"
            area: "手术区顶送"
          filtration: "HEPA H14"
          
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-OR-AIR-EXHAUST"
        flow_type: "MASS-AIR-EXHAUST"
        purpose: "下回风"
        parameters:
          flow_rate: "送风量的85%"
          note: "保持正压"
          
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-OR-CHW"
        flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
        purpose: "空调冷量供给"
        parameters:
          demand_estimation: "150-200 W/m²"
          supply_temp: 7
          return_temp: 12
          
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-OR-O2"
        flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-O2"
        purpose: "医用氧气"
        parameters:
          terminals: 2
          design_flow: "60 L/min"
          pressure: "0.3-0.5 MPa"
          
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-OR-VAC"
        flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-VAC"
        purpose: "负压吸引"
        parameters:
          terminals: 2
          vacuum_level: "-40 kPa"
          design_flow: "30 L/min/终端"
          
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-OR-AIR-MED"
        flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-AIR"
        purpose: "医用压缩空气"
        parameters:
          terminals: 2
          pressure: "0.4-0.5 MPa"
          design_flow: "60 L/min"
          
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-OR-N2O"
        flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-N2O"
        purpose: "笑气（麻醉）"
        parameters:
          terminals: 1
          pressure: "0.4 MPa"
          
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-OR-AGSS"
        flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-AGSS"
        purpose: "麻醉废气排放"
        parameters:
          terminals: 1
          
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-OR-ELEC-ISO"
        flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-ISO"
        purpose: "隔离电源"
        parameters:
          system: "IT系统"
          transformer_capacity: "7.5-10 kVA"
          monitoring: "绝缘监测"
          
    flow_diagram: |
      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
      │                    手术室流动服务模型                                │
      ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
      │                                                                     │
      │    ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐     │
      │    │                    送风系统                              │     │
      │    │  新风100% → AHU-CLEAN → HEPA → 层流天花 → 手术区        │     │
      │    │  参数: 36ACH, ISO 5, 0.35m/s                            │     │
      │    └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘     │
      │                              ↓                                      │
      │    ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐     │
      │    │                   手术室空间                             │     │
      │    │  温度: 22-25°C  湿度: 40-60%  压差: +15Pa              │     │
      │    │                                                         │     │
      │    │  ┌───────┐ ┌───────┐ ┌───────┐ ┌───────┐ ┌───────┐    │     │
      │    │  │ O2×2  │ │VAC×2  │ │AIR×2  │ │N2O×1  │ │AGSS×1 │    │     │
      │    │  └───────┘ └───────┘ └───────┘ └───────┘ └───────┘    │     │
      │    │                                                         │     │
      │    │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │     │
      │    │  │ 隔离电源: IT系统 + 绝缘监测 + UPS备用           │   │     │
      │    │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │     │
      │    └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘     │
      │                              ↓                                      │
      │    ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐     │
      │    │                    排风系统                              │     │
      │    │  下回风 → 排风(85%) + 新风补充                          │     │
      │    └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘     │
      │                                                                     │
      └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 8.2 ICU空间-流动耦合
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  icu_coupling:
    space_type: "ROOM-ICU"
    space_name: "重症监护室"
    source: "Agent-02 医疗专用空间模型"
    
    environmental_requirements:
      temperature:
        range: [22, 26]
        unit: "°C"
        tolerance: "±1"
      humidity:
        range: [40, 60]
        unit: "%RH"
      pressure:
        value: "+10"
        unit: "Pa"
        reference: "相对走廊"
      cleanliness:
        class: "ISO 7"
      air_changes:
        min_value: 12
        unit: "次/h"
        
    per_bed_requirements:
      - flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-O2"
        terminals: 2
        design_flow: "40 L/min"
      - flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-VAC"
        terminals: 2
        vacuum_level: "-40 kPa"
      - flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-AIR"
        terminals: 1
        pressure: "0.4 MPa"
      - flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-ISO"
        capacity: "5-7.5 kVA/床"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 8.3 负压隔离病房空间-流动耦合
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  negative_pressure_room_coupling:
    space_type: "ROOM-ISO-NEG"
    space_name: "负压隔离病房"
    source: "Agent-02 医疗专用空间模型"
    
    environmental_requirements:
      temperature:
        range: [22, 26]
        unit: "°C"
      humidity:
        range: [30, 60]
        unit: "%RH"
      pressure:
        病室_vs_缓冲: "-5 Pa"
        缓冲_vs_走廊: "-5 Pa"
        病室_vs_走廊: "-10 Pa (总压差)"
      air_changes:
        min_value: 12
        unit: "次/h"
        fresh_air: "100%"
      exhaust_mode: "HEPA过滤后直排室外"
      
    required_flows:
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-ISO-AIR-SUPPLY"
        flow_type: "MASS-AIR-CLEAN"
        purpose: "洁净送风"
        parameters:
          fresh_air_ratio: 100
          filtration: "HEPA"
          
      - flow_coupling_id: "SFC-ISO-AIR-EXHAUST"
        flow_type: "MASS-AIR-EXHAUST"
        purpose: "HEPA过滤排风"
        parameters:
          flow_rate: "> 送风量"
          filtration: "HEPA H14"
          discharge: "高空排放"
          note: "维持负压"
          
    pressure_control:
      strategy: "排风量 > 送风量"
      monitoring: "压差传感器持续监测"
      alarm_setpoint: "> -10 Pa"
      interlock: "门禁与压力互锁"
```

```yaml
Cross_Agent_Reference_Index:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 9.1 Agent-01 系统拓扑 → Agent-04 流动模型

    mappings:

        flow_paths:

            role: "冷量源"
          - path_id: "PATH-CW-LOOP"
            role: "废热源"
        flow_types:
          - "MASS-WATER-CHW"
          - "MASS-WATER-CW"
          
      - topology_node: "HVAC-CHP_DST_CHW_PUMP"
        flow_paths:
          - path_id: "PATH-CHW-SUPPLY"
            role: "加压输配"
        flow_action: "pressurize"
        
      - topology_node: "HVAC-AHU_PROC_COIL"
        flow_paths:
          - path_id: "PATH-CHW-SUPPLY"
            role: "冷量末端"
          - path_id: "PATH-AIR-OR-SUPPLY"
            role: "空气处理"
        coupling: "水-空气换热"
        
      - topology_node: "MGAS-O2_SRC_LOX"
        flow_paths:
          - path_id: "PATH-O2-SUPPLY"
            role: "氧气源"

      - topology_node: "ELEC_TRANS_MAIN"
        flow_paths:

            role: "电压变换"
        flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-HV → ENERGY-ELEC-LV"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 9.2 Agent-02 空间本体 → Agent-04 流动模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  agent02_to_agent04:
    description: "从空间环境要求到流动服务需求的映射"
    
    space_flow_matrix:
      - space_type: "ROOM-OR-I"
        required_flows:
          - "MASS-AIR-CLEAN"
          - "MASS-WATER-CHW"
          - "MASS-MGAS-O2"
          - "MASS-MGAS-VAC"
          - "MASS-MGAS-AIR"
          - "MASS-MGAS-N2O"
          - "MASS-MGAS-AGSS"
          - "ENERGY-ELEC-ISO"
        special_requirements:
          cleanliness: "ISO 5"
          pressure: "+15 Pa"
          
      - space_type: "ROOM-ICU"
        required_flows:
          - "MASS-AIR-CLEAN"
          - "MASS-WATER-CHW"
          - "MASS-MGAS-O2"
          - "MASS-MGAS-VAC"
          - "MASS-MGAS-AIR"
          - "ENERGY-ELEC-ISO"
        special_requirements:
          cleanliness: "ISO 7"
          pressure: "+10 Pa"
          
      - space_type: "ROOM-ISO-NEG"
        required_flows:
          - "MASS-AIR-CLEAN"
          - "MASS-AIR-EXHAUST"
          - "MASS-WATER-CHW"
          - "MASS-MGAS-O2"
          - "MASS-MGAS-VAC"
        special_requirements:
          pressure: "-15 Pa"
          exhaust: "HEPA过滤"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 9.3 Agent-03 设备本体 → Agent-04 流动模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  agent03_to_agent04:
    description: "从设备类型到流动产生/传输/消耗的映射"
    
    equipment_flow_roles:
      - equipment_type: "EQP-CH-CENT"
        flow_roles:
          - flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
            role: "generator"
            action: "制取冷冻水"
          - flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CW"
            role: "source"
            action: "排出冷凝热"
          - flow_type: "ENERGY-THERMAL-COOL"
            role: "producer"
          - flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-LV"
            role: "consumer"
            
      - equipment_type: "EQP-PUMP-CHW"
        flow_roles:
          - flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
            role: "transporter"
            action: "加压输配"
          - flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-LV"
            role: "consumer"
            
      - equipment_type: "EQP-AHU-CLEAN"
        flow_roles:
          - flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
            role: "consumer"
            action: "盘管换热"
          - flow_type: "MASS-AIR-CLEAN"
            role: "generator"
            action: "处理送风"
          - flow_type: "ENERGY-THERMAL-COOL"
            role: "consumer/transformer"
          - flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-LV"
            role: "consumer"
            
      - equipment_type: "EQP-LOX-TANK"
        flow_roles:
          - flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-O2"
            role: "source"
            action: "储存供给"
            
      - equipment_type: "EQP-VAC-PUMP"
        flow_roles:
          - flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-VAC"
            role: "generator"
            action: "产生负压"
          - flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-LV"
            role: "consumer"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 9.4 Agent-04 → 下游Agent接口
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  agent04_to_downstream:
    
    to_agent06:
      description: "控制系统建模师所需的流动参数"
      outputs:
        - output_type: "controlled_flow_parameters"
          content:
            - flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
              controlled_params: ["temperature", "flow_rate", "pressure"]
            - flow_type: "MASS-AIR-SUPPLY"
              controlled_params: ["temperature", "humidity", "flow_rate", "pressure"]
            - flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-O2"
              controlled_params: ["pressure"]
        - output_type: "coupling_equations"
          purpose: "控制算法设计"
          
    to_agent07:
      description: "计量体系建模师所需的计量点定义"
      outputs:
        - output_type: "metering_points"
          content:
            - flow_type: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
              meters: ["流量计", "温度传感器×2", "热量表"]
            - flow_type: "ENERGY-ELEC-LV"
              meters: ["电能表", "功率表"]
            - flow_type: "MASS-MGAS-O2"
              meters: ["压力表", "流量计"]
              
    to_agent08:
      description: "运维管理建模师所需的流动系统信息"
      outputs:
        - output_type: "flow_maintenance_requirements"
          content:
            - "流动路径完整性检查"
            - "介质参数定期监测"
            - "能效分析基准"
```

以上是基于知识库中Agent-01系统拓扑、Agent-02空间本体、Agent-03设备本体输出的Agent-04流动模型建模师完整输出文档v2.1。该版本实现了：

1. **三层流动架构**：物质流(18类)、能量流(8类)、信息流(5类)的完整分类
2. **介质物理模型**：水、空气、蒸汽、医疗气体等8种介质的工程属性
3. **流动路径建模**：HVAC、医疗气体、电气、给排水等18条主要路径
4. **守恒方程体系**：节点平衡、路径平衡、系统能量平衡的完整方程
5. **载体-荷载耦合**：8种核心耦合模型及工程计算公式
6. **空间-流动耦合**：手术室、ICU、负压病房的流动服务需求映射
7. **跨Agent集成**：与Agent-01/02/03的完整双向引用

### Flow Model Architect - FSO Ontology Compliant Edition

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    AGENT-04: 流动模型建模师 v2.2
#                    FLOW MODEL ARCHITECT
#                    FSO Ontology Compliant - Hypergraph Ready
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
```

## 一、FSO本体对齐说明

### 1.1 核心概念映射

```yaml
FSO_Ontology_Alignment:
  
  description: |
    基于论文"An ontology to support flow system descriptions from design 
    to operation of buildings"(Kukkonen et al., 2022)的FSO本体框架，
    重构流动模型以支持:
    1. RDF三元组表示 (Subject-Predicate-Object)
    2. 语义网技术 (SPARQL查询)
    3. 超图拓扑耦合 (Agent-05需求)

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # FSO核心类与Agent-04概念对齐
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  class_alignment:
    
    # FSO顶层类
    fso_System:
      definition: "虚拟的组件集合，可分配属性如设计要求"
      agent04_mapping: "Flow_System"
      characteristics:
        - "可有子系统 (hasSubSystem)"
        - "可被多个父系统包含 (isSubSystemOf)"
        - "系统可重叠共享子系统"
      examples:
        - "HeatingSystem"
        - "CoolingSystem"
        - "VentilationSystem"
        - "MedicalGasSystem"
        
    fso_Component:
      definition: "参与质量或能量流动的实体对象"
      agent04_mapping: "Flow_Component"
      agent03_alignment: "Equipment"
      characteristics:
        - "隶属于系统 (isComponentOf)"
        - "可隶属于多个系统"
        - "通过流动关系连接"
      subclasses:
        - "EnergyConversionDevice"  # 能量转换设备
        - "Fitting"                  # 连接件
        - "FlowController"          # 流量控制器
        - "FlowMovingDevice"        # 流动驱动设备
        - "Segment"                 # 管段
        - "StorageDevice"           # 储存设备
        - "Terminal"                # 末端设备
        - "TreatmentDevice"         # 处理设备

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # FSO核心关系属性
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  property_alignment:
    
    # 系统组成关系
    composition_properties:
      fso_hasSubSystem:
        definition: "系统包含子系统"
        inverse: "fso:isSubSystemOf"
        subproperties:
          - "hasSupplySystem"   # 包含供给子系统
          - "hasReturnSystem"   # 包含回流子系统
          
      fso_hasComponent:
        definition: "系统包含组件"
        inverse: "fso:isComponentOf"
        
      fso_hasSourceComponent:
        definition: "系统的源组件(能量/物质输入)"
        
      fso_hasConsumerComponent:
        definition: "系统的消费组件(能量/物质输出)"

    # 流动连接关系 (核心)
    flow_properties:
      fso_connectedWith:
        definition: "通用连接关系(对称)"
        symmetric: true
        subproperties:
          - "exchangesFluidWith"
          - "exchangesHeatWith"
          - "exchangesElectricChargeWith"
          
      fso_exchangesFluidWith:
        definition: "流体交换关系(对称)"
        symmetric: true
        subproperties:
          - "feedsFluidTo"
          - "hasFluidFedBy"
          
      fso_feedsFluidTo:
        definition: "流体供给方向(非对称)"
        symmetric: false
        inverse: "hasFluidFedBy"
        subproperties:
          - "suppliesFluidTo"   # 供给侧流动
          - "returnsFluidTo"    # 回流侧流动
          
      fso_exchangesHeatWith:
        definition: "热量交换关系(对称)"
        symmetric: true
        subproperties:
          - "transfersHeatTo"
          - "transfersHeatFrom"
          
      fso_transfersHeatTo:
        definition: "热量传递方向(非对称)"
        symmetric: false
        inverse: "transfersHeatFrom"
        
      fso_exchangesElectricChargeWith:
        definition: "电荷交换关系(对称)"
        symmetric: true
```

### 1.2 双系统模型：耗散系统与循环系统

```yaml
Dual_System_Model:
  
  description: |
    基于建筑系统服务本体文档的核心概念，将MEP系统分解为两个耦合的功能系统:
    - 耗散系统 (Dissipation System) = 物流系统: 能量/物质/信息投送到耗散节点
    - 循环系统 (Circulation System) = 路径系统: 介质循环承载投送任务

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 耗散系统模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  dissipation_system:
    definition: |
      将能量、物质、信息投送到末端节点的功能系统。
      用户关心的是耗散系统的性能/能力/效率。
    
    structure:
      source: "能量/物质源头"
      routing: "路由/分配网络"
      dissipation_node: "耗散节点"
      
    dissipation_node_composition:
      space: "空间(bot:Space)"
      terminal: "末端设备/接口(fso:Terminal)"
      occupancy: "占用行为"
      
    examples:
      - system: "供水系统"
        dissipated_resource: "水资源"
      - system: "供电系统"
        dissipated_resource: "电力资源"
      - system: "供热供冷系统"
        dissipated_resource: "热能/冷量"
      - system: "燃气系统"
        dissipated_resource: "可燃气体"
      - system: "医疗气体系统"
        dissipated_resource: "医用气体"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 循环系统模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  circulation_system:
    definition: |
      承载能量/物质投送任务的介质循环系统。
      运维关心的是循环系统的性能/能力/效率。
    
    characteristics:
      - "介质在管路中循环往复"
      - "一会儿接受能量，一会儿释放能量"
      - "依赖控制或数据驱动"
      
    control_modes:
      complete_control:
        description: "通过控制介质循环路径 + 控制换热率"
        advantages: "控制效果好，状态清晰可控"
        disadvantages: "需要更多电控装置"
        
      partial_control:
        description: "仅通过控制换热率"
        advantages: "电控装置少"
        disadvantages: "更耗能，状态模糊"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 双系统耦合关系
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_coupling:
    description: "运维通过控制循环系统来达成耗散系统的功能目标"
    
    coupling_diagram: |
      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
      │                    双系统耦合模型                                    │
      ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
      │                                                                     │
      │   ┌─────────────────────┐      控制      ┌─────────────────────┐   │
      │   │    循环系统         │ ═══════════► │    耗散系统          │   │
      │   │  (Circulation)      │              │  (Dissipation)       │   │
      │   │  ─────────────────  │              │  ─────────────────   │   │
      │   │  · 介质循环路径     │              │  · 能量/物质投送    │   │
      │   │  · 运维视角         │              │  · 用户视角          │   │
      │   │  · 路径效率         │              │  · 服务效率          │   │
      │   └─────────────────────┘              └─────────────────────┘   │
      │            ▲                                     │                 │
      │            │              反馈                   │                 │
      │            └─────────────────────────────────────┘                 │
      │                                                                     │
      └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 二、RDF三元组数据模型

### 2.1 命名空间定义

```yaml
Namespaces:
  
  # 标准命名空间
  standard:
    rdf: "http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
    rdfs: "http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
    owl: "http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
    xsd: "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
    
  # 建筑领域命名空间
  building:
    bot: "https://w3id.org/bot#"
    fso: "https://w3id.org/fso#"
    s4bldg: "https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg#"
    s4syst: "https://saref.etsi.org/saref4syst#"
    brick: "https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#"
    
  # 项目命名空间
  project:
    inst: "https://hospital.example.com/inst#"
    ex: "https://hospital.example.com/ex#"
    
  # Agent体系命名空间
  agents:
    agent01: "https://hospital.example.com/agent01#"  # 系统拓扑
    agent02: "https://hospital.example.com/agent02#"  # 空间本体
    agent03: "https://hospital.example.com/agent03#"  # 设备本体
    agent04: "https://hospital.example.com/agent04#"  # 流动模型
    agent05: "https://hospital.example.com/agent05#"  # 超图拓扑
```

### 2.2 类层次结构 (Class Hierarchy)

```yaml
Class_Hierarchy:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 顶层类定义 (基于FSO对齐)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  fso_System:
    uri: "fso:System"
    label: "流动系统"
    definition: "虚拟的组件集合"
    alignment: "s4syst:System"
    
    subclasses:
      fso_DistributionSystem:
        uri: "fso:DistributionSystem"
        label: "配送系统"
        definition: "用于分配质量和/或能量的系统"
        
        subclasses:
          fso_SupplySystem:
            uri: "fso:SupplySystem"
            label: "供给系统"
            definition: "向下游消费者供给质量和/或能量的系统"
            
          fso_ReturnSystem:
            uri: "fso:ReturnSystem"
            label: "回流系统"
            definition: "从下游消费者回收质量和/或能量的系统"
            
      # 扩展: 耗散系统与循环系统
      ex_DissipationSystem:
        uri: "ex:DissipationSystem"
        label: "耗散系统"
        definition: "将能量/物质投送到末端节点的功能系统"
        subclass_of: "fso:System"
        
      ex_CirculationSystem:
        uri: "ex:CirculationSystem"
        label: "循环系统"
        definition: "承载能量/物质投送的介质循环系统"
        subclass_of: "fso:System"

  fso_Component:
    uri: "fso:Component"
    label: "流动组件"
    definition: "参与质量或能量流动的实体对象"
    alignment: 
      - "s4bldg:DistributionFlowDevice"
      - "agent03:Equipment"
    
    subclasses:
      fso_EnergyConversionDevice:
        uri: "fso:EnergyConversionDevice"
        label: "能量转换设备"
        definition: "用于转换能量形式或在系统间移动能量的设备"
        examples: ["冷水机组", "锅炉", "热泵", "换热器"]
        agent03_mapping: ["EQP-CH-CENT", "EQP-BOILER-GAS", "EQP-HX"]
        
      fso_Fitting:
        uri: "fso:Fitting"
        label: "管件"
        definition: "用于连接管段或其他组件的组件"
        examples: ["三通", "弯头", "变径"]
        
      fso_FlowController:
        uri: "fso:FlowController"
        label: "流量控制器"
        definition: "具有控制网络流量潜力的设备"
        examples: ["阀门", "风阀"]
        agent03_mapping: ["EQP-VALVE", "EQP-DAMPER"]
        
      fso_FlowMovingDevice:
        uri: "fso:FlowMovingDevice"
        label: "流动驱动设备"
        definition: "用于在网络中诱导运动的设备"
        examples: ["泵", "风机"]
        agent03_mapping: ["EQP-PUMP-CHW", "EQP-FAN-SUPPLY"]
        
      fso_Segment:
        uri: "fso:Segment"
        label: "管段"
        definition: "用于实现质量或能量通过的组件"
        examples: ["管道", "风管", "电缆"]
        
      fso_StorageDevice:
        uri: "fso:StorageDevice"
        label: "储存设备"
        definition: "用于储存质量或能量的设备"
        examples: ["水箱", "蓄电池", "蓄冷罐"]
        agent03_mapping: ["EQP-TANK-WATER", "EQP-BATTERY"]
        
      fso_Terminal:
        uri: "fso:Terminal"
        label: "末端设备"
        definition: "系统与环境交互的设备"
        examples: ["散热器", "风口", "龙头"]
        agent03_mapping: ["EQP-FCU-CEILING", "EQP-O2-OUTLET"]
        
      fso_TreatmentDevice:
        uri: "fso:TreatmentDevice"
        label: "处理设备"
        definition: "从流经物质中去除不需要物质的设备"
        examples: ["过滤器", "消毒器"]
        agent03_mapping: ["EQP-FILTER-HEPA"]

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 介质类定义
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  ex_Medium:
    uri: "ex:Medium"
    label: "介质"
    definition: "承载能量或作为被传递物质的载体"
    
    subclasses:
      ex_LiquidMedium:
        uri: "ex:LiquidMedium"
        label: "液态介质"
        instances:
          - uri: "ex:Water"
            label: "水"
          - uri: "ex:Refrigerant"
            label: "制冷剂"
            
      ex_GaseousMedium:
        uri: "ex:GaseousMedium"
        label: "气态介质"
        instances:
          - uri: "ex:Air"
            label: "空气"
          - uri: "ex:Steam"
            label: "蒸汽"
          - uri: "ex:MedicalOxygen"
            label: "医用氧气"
          - uri: "ex:MedicalVacuum"
            label: "负压吸引"
            
      ex_ElectricalMedium:
        uri: "ex:ElectricalMedium"
        label: "电气介质"
        instances:
          - uri: "ex:Electricity"
            label: "电力"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 流动类型类定义
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  ex_FlowType:
    uri: "ex:FlowType"
    label: "流动类型"
    
    subclasses:
      ex_MassFlow:
        uri: "ex:MassFlow"
        label: "物质流"
        definition: "作为能量载体在系统中流动的物质"
        
      ex_EnergyFlow:
        uri: "ex:EnergyFlow"
        label: "能量流"
        definition: "承载于物质或直接传输的能量"
        
      ex_InformationFlow:
        uri: "ex:InformationFlow"
        label: "信息流"
        definition: "控制和监测系统中的信号传递"
```

### 2.3 属性定义 (Property Definitions)

```yaml
Property_Definitions:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 对象属性 (Object Properties)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  object_properties:
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 系统组成属性
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    fso_hasSubSystem:
      uri: "fso:hasSubSystem"
      label: "包含子系统"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "fso:System"
      inverse: "fso:isSubSystemOf"
      alignment: "s4syst:hasSubSystem"
      
    fso_isSubSystemOf:
      uri: "fso:isSubSystemOf"
      label: "是...的子系统"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "fso:System"
      inverse: "fso:hasSubSystem"
      
    fso_hasSupplySystem:
      uri: "fso:hasSupplySystem"
      label: "包含供给子系统"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "fso:SupplySystem"
      subproperty_of: "fso:hasSubSystem"
      
    fso_hasReturnSystem:
      uri: "fso:hasReturnSystem"
      label: "包含回流子系统"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "fso:ReturnSystem"
      subproperty_of: "fso:hasSubSystem"
      
    fso_hasComponent:
      uri: "fso:hasComponent"
      label: "包含组件"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "fso:Component"
      inverse: "fso:isComponentOf"
      alignment: "s4syst:hasSubSystem"
      
    fso_isComponentOf:
      uri: "fso:isComponentOf"
      label: "是...的组件"
      domain: "fso:Component"
      range: "fso:System"
      inverse: "fso:hasComponent"
      
    fso_hasSourceComponent:
      uri: "fso:hasSourceComponent"
      label: "源组件"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "fso:Component"
      description: "系统的能量或物质输入源"
      
    fso_hasConsumerComponent:
      uri: "fso:hasConsumerComponent"
      label: "消费组件"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "fso:Component"
      description: "系统的能量或物质输出消费端"

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 流动连接属性 (核心 - Agent-05超图耦合关键)
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    fso_connectedWith:
      uri: "fso:connectedWith"
      label: "连接"
      domain: ["fso:System", "fso:Component"]
      range: ["fso:System", "fso:Component"]
      symmetric: true
      alignment: "s4syst:connectedTo"
      hypergraph_role: "基础边类型"
      
    # 流体交换属性层次
    fso_exchangesFluidWith:
      uri: "fso:exchangesFluidWith"
      label: "流体交换"
      subproperty_of: "fso:connectedWith"
      symmetric: true
      hypergraph_role: "流体超边"
      
    fso_feedsFluidTo:
      uri: "fso:feedsFluidTo"
      label: "流体供给至"
      subproperty_of: "fso:exchangesFluidWith"
      symmetric: false
      inverse: "fso:hasFluidFedBy"
      hypergraph_role: "有向流体边"
      
    fso_hasFluidFedBy:
      uri: "fso:hasFluidFedBy"
      label: "接受流体自"
      subproperty_of: "fso:exchangesFluidWith"
      symmetric: false
      inverse: "fso:feedsFluidTo"
      
    fso_suppliesFluidTo:
      uri: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
      label: "供给流体至"
      subproperty_of: "fso:feedsFluidTo"
      symmetric: false
      inverse: "fso:hasFluidSuppliedBy"
      description: "供给侧流动方向"
      hypergraph_role: "供给方向边"
      
    fso_hasFluidSuppliedBy:
      uri: "fso:hasFluidSuppliedBy"
      label: "接受供给自"
      subproperty_of: "fso:hasFluidFedBy"
      symmetric: false
      inverse: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
      
    fso_returnsFluidTo:
      uri: "fso:returnsFluidTo"
      label: "回流流体至"
      subproperty_of: "fso:feedsFluidTo"
      symmetric: false
      inverse: "fso:hasFluidReturnedBy"
      description: "回流侧流动方向"
      hypergraph_role: "回流方向边"
      
    fso_hasFluidReturnedBy:
      uri: "fso:hasFluidReturnedBy"
      label: "接受回流自"
      subproperty_of: "fso:hasFluidFedBy"
      symmetric: false
      inverse: "fso:returnsFluidTo"

    # 热量交换属性层次
    fso_exchangesHeatWith:
      uri: "fso:exchangesHeatWith"
      label: "热量交换"
      subproperty_of: "fso:connectedWith"
      symmetric: true
      hypergraph_role: "热量超边"
      
    fso_transfersHeatTo:
      uri: "fso:transfersHeatTo"
      label: "传热至"
      subproperty_of: "fso:exchangesHeatWith"
      symmetric: false
      inverse: "fso:transfersHeatFrom"
      hypergraph_role: "有向传热边"
      
    fso_transfersHeatFrom:
      uri: "fso:transfersHeatFrom"
      label: "接受热量自"
      subproperty_of: "fso:exchangesHeatWith"
      symmetric: false
      inverse: "fso:transfersHeatTo"

    # 电荷交换属性
    fso_exchangesElectricChargeWith:
      uri: "fso:exchangesElectricChargeWith"
      label: "电荷交换"
      subproperty_of: "fso:connectedWith"
      symmetric: true
      hypergraph_role: "电气超边"

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 空间关联属性 (与Agent-02空间本体耦合)
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    bot_containsElement:
      uri: "bot:containsElement"
      label: "包含元素"
      domain: "bot:Space"
      range: "fso:Component"
      description: "空间包含组件"
      
    ex_servesSpace:
      uri: "ex:servesSpace"
      label: "服务于空间"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "bot:Space"
      description: "系统服务的空间"
      
    ex_dissipatesTo:
      uri: "ex:dissipatesTo"
      label: "耗散至"
      domain: "fso:Terminal"
      range: "bot:Space"
      description: "末端向空间耗散能量/物质"

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 介质关联属性
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    ex_hasMedium:
      uri: "ex:hasMedium"
      label: "使用介质"
      domain: ["fso:System", "fso:Component"]
      range: "ex:Medium"
      
    ex_carriesEnergy:
      uri: "ex:carriesEnergy"
      label: "承载能量"
      domain: "ex:Medium"
      range: "ex:EnergyFlow"
      description: "介质承载的能量类型"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 数据属性 (Datatype Properties)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  datatype_properties:
    
    # 流量参数
    ex_massFlowRate:
      uri: "ex:massFlowRate"
      label: "质量流量"
      domain: ["fso:Segment", "fso:Component"]
      range: "xsd:decimal"
      unit: "kg/s"
      
    ex_volumeFlowRate:
      uri: "ex:volumeFlowRate"
      label: "体积流量"
      domain: ["fso:Segment", "fso:Component"]
      range: "xsd:decimal"
      unit: "m³/h"
      
    # 热力参数
    ex_temperature:
      uri: "ex:temperature"
      label: "温度"
      domain: "fso:Component"
      range: "xsd:decimal"
      unit: "°C"
      
    ex_supplyTemperature:
      uri: "ex:supplyTemperature"
      label: "供给温度"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "xsd:decimal"
      unit: "°C"
      
    ex_returnTemperature:
      uri: "ex:returnTemperature"
      label: "回流温度"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "xsd:decimal"
      unit: "°C"
      
    ex_deltaT:
      uri: "ex:deltaT"
      label: "温差"
      domain: "fso:System"
      range: "xsd:decimal"
      unit: "°C"
      
    # 压力参数
    ex_pressure:
      uri: "ex:pressure"
      label: "压力"
      domain: "fso:Component"
      range: "xsd:decimal"
      unit: "kPa"
      
    # 功率/能量参数
    ex_thermalPower:
      uri: "ex:thermalPower"
      label: "热功率"
      domain: ["fso:System", "fso:Component"]
      range: "xsd:decimal"
      unit: "kW"
      
    ex_electricalPower:
      uri: "ex:electricalPower"
      label: "电功率"
      domain: "fso:Component"
      range: "xsd:decimal"
      unit: "kW"
      
    # 效率参数
    ex_COP:
      uri: "ex:COP"
      label: "性能系数"
      domain: "fso:EnergyConversionDevice"
      range: "xsd:decimal"
      
    ex_efficiency:
      uri: "ex:efficiency"
      label: "效率"
      domain: "fso:Component"
      range: "xsd:decimal"
```
