## 三、流动路径RDF模型

### 3.1 冷冻水系统Turtle表示

```turtle
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 冷冻水系统RDF三元组表示 (Turtle格式)
# Chilled Water System RDF Triples
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#> .
@prefix bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#> .
@prefix ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#> .
@prefix inst: <https://hospital.example.com/inst#> .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 系统定义
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 顶层冷冻水系统
inst:ChilledWaterSystem a fso:System ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水系统"@zh ;
    rdfs:label "Chilled Water System"@en ;
    fso:hasSubSystem inst:CHW-SupplySystem, inst:CHW-ReturnSystem ;
    fso:hasSourceComponent inst:Chiller-1, inst:Chiller-2 ;
    fso:hasConsumerComponent inst:AHU-OR-01, inst:AHU-ICU-01, inst:FCU-Ward-01 ;
    ex:hasMedium ex:ChilledWater ;
    ex:supplyTemperature "7.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    ex:returnTemperature "12.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    ex:deltaT "5.0"^^xsd:decimal .

# 供给子系统
inst:CHW-SupplySystem a fso:SupplySystem ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水供给系统"@zh ;
    fso:isSubSystemOf inst:ChilledWaterSystem ;
    fso:hasComponent inst:Chiller-1, inst:Chiller-2, 
                     inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1, inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-2,
                     inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1, inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-2,
                     inst:Header-CHW-Supply,
                     inst:Pipe-CHW-S-001, inst:Pipe-CHW-S-002, inst:Pipe-CHW-S-003 .

# 回流子系统
inst:CHW-ReturnSystem a fso:ReturnSystem ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水回流系统"@zh ;
    fso:isSubSystemOf inst:ChilledWaterSystem ;
    fso:hasComponent inst:Chiller-1, inst:Chiller-2,
                     inst:Header-CHW-Return,
                     inst:Pipe-CHW-R-001, inst:Pipe-CHW-R-002, inst:Pipe-CHW-R-003 .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 组件定义
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 冷水机组 (能量转换设备)
inst:Chiller-1 a fso:EnergyConversionDevice ;
    rdfs:label "1#离心式冷水机组"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem, inst:CHW-ReturnSystem ;
    ex:hasMedium ex:ChilledWater, ex:CondensorWater ;
    ex:thermalPower "2000.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    ex:COP "5.5"^^xsd:decimal ;
    ex:supplyTemperature "7.0"^^xsd:decimal .

inst:Chiller-2 a fso:EnergyConversionDevice ;
    rdfs:label "2#离心式冷水机组"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem, inst:CHW-ReturnSystem ;
    ex:thermalPower "2000.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    ex:COP "5.5"^^xsd:decimal .

# 一次泵 (流动驱动设备)
inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1 a fso:FlowMovingDevice ;
    rdfs:label "1#冷冻水一次泵"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem ;
    ex:volumeFlowRate "400.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    ex:electricalPower "45.0"^^xsd:decimal .

inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-2 a fso:FlowMovingDevice ;
    rdfs:label "2#冷冻水一次泵"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem ;
    ex:volumeFlowRate "400.0"^^xsd:decimal .

# 二次泵 (流动驱动设备)
inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1 a fso:FlowMovingDevice ;
    rdfs:label "1#冷冻水二次泵"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem ;
    ex:volumeFlowRate "600.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    ex:electricalPower "55.0"^^xsd:decimal .

inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-2 a fso:FlowMovingDevice ;
    rdfs:label "2#冷冻水二次泵"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem .

# 分集水器 (连接件)
inst:Header-CHW-Supply a fso:Fitting ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水供水集分水器"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem .

inst:Header-CHW-Return a fso:Fitting ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水回水集水器"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-ReturnSystem .

# 管段
inst:Pipe-CHW-S-001 a fso:Segment ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水供水主管-001"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem ;
    ex:hasMedium ex:ChilledWater .

inst:Pipe-CHW-S-002 a fso:Segment ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水供水立管-OR"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem .

inst:Pipe-CHW-S-003 a fso:Segment ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水供水立管-ICU"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem .

inst:Pipe-CHW-R-001 a fso:Segment ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水回水主管-001"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-ReturnSystem .

# 末端设备 (空调机组)
inst:AHU-OR-01 a fso:Terminal ;
    rdfs:label "手术室空调机组-01"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem, inst:CHW-ReturnSystem ;
    ex:thermalPower "200.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    bot:containedIn inst:Room-OR-01 .

inst:AHU-ICU-01 a fso:Terminal ;
    rdfs:label "ICU空调机组-01"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem, inst:CHW-ReturnSystem ;
    ex:thermalPower "150.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    bot:containedIn inst:Zone-ICU .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 流动连接关系 (核心拓扑 - Agent-05超图耦合)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 供给方向流动路径
inst:Chiller-1 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pipe-CHW-S-001 .
inst:Chiller-2 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pipe-CHW-S-001 .
inst:Pipe-CHW-S-001 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1 .
inst:Pipe-CHW-S-001 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-2 .
inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Header-CHW-Supply .
inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-2 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Header-CHW-Supply .
inst:Header-CHW-Supply fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1 .
inst:Header-CHW-Supply fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-2 .
inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pipe-CHW-S-002 .
inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-2 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pipe-CHW-S-003 .
inst:Pipe-CHW-S-002 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:AHU-OR-01 .
inst:Pipe-CHW-S-003 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:AHU-ICU-01 .

# 回流方向流动路径
inst:AHU-OR-01 fso:returnsFluidTo inst:Pipe-CHW-R-001 .
inst:AHU-ICU-01 fso:returnsFluidTo inst:Pipe-CHW-R-001 .
inst:Pipe-CHW-R-001 fso:returnsFluidTo inst:Header-CHW-Return .
inst:Header-CHW-Return fso:returnsFluidTo inst:Chiller-1 .
inst:Header-CHW-Return fso:returnsFluidTo inst:Chiller-2 .

# 热量传递关系
inst:AHU-OR-01 fso:transfersHeatTo inst:Room-OR-01 .
inst:AHU-ICU-01 fso:transfersHeatTo inst:Zone-ICU .
inst:Chiller-1 fso:transfersHeatTo inst:CoolingTower-1 .
inst:Chiller-2 fso:transfersHeatTo inst:CoolingTower-2 .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 空间关联 (与Agent-02对接)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

inst:Room-OR-01 a bot:Space ;
    rdfs:label "1#手术室"@zh ;
    bot:containsElement inst:AHU-OR-01 .

inst:Zone-ICU a bot:Zone ;
    rdfs:label "ICU病区"@zh ;
    bot:containsElement inst:AHU-ICU-01 .

# 系统服务空间关系
inst:ChilledWaterSystem ex:servesSpace inst:Room-OR-01, inst:Zone-ICU .
```

### 3.2 医疗气体系统Turtle表示

```turtle
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 医用氧气系统RDF三元组表示 (Turtle格式)
# Medical Oxygen System RDF Triples
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#> .
@prefix bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#> .
@prefix ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#> .
@prefix inst: <https://hospital.example.com/inst#> .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 系统定义
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 医用氧气系统 (耗散系统)
inst:MedicalOxygenSystem a fso:System, ex:DissipationSystem ;
    rdfs:label "医用氧气系统"@zh ;
    rdfs:label "Medical Oxygen System"@en ;
    fso:hasSubSystem inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    fso:hasSourceComponent inst:LOX-Tank-1, inst:O2-Manifold-1 ;
    fso:hasConsumerComponent inst:O2-Outlet-OR-01, inst:O2-Outlet-OR-02,
                             inst:O2-Outlet-ICU-01, inst:O2-Outlet-ICU-02 ;
    ex:hasMedium ex:MedicalOxygen ;
    ex:pressure "500.0"^^xsd:decimal .  # kPa

# 供给子系统
inst:O2-SupplySystem a fso:SupplySystem ;
    rdfs:label "氧气供给系统"@zh ;
    fso:isSubSystemOf inst:MedicalOxygenSystem ;
    fso:hasComponent inst:LOX-Tank-1, inst:Vaporizer-1, 
                     inst:PressureReducer-1, inst:PressureReducer-2,
                     inst:Pipe-O2-001, inst:Pipe-O2-002, inst:Pipe-O2-003,
                     inst:ValveBox-O2-OR, inst:ValveBox-O2-ICU .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 组件定义
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 液氧储罐 (储存设备 - 源组件)
inst:LOX-Tank-1 a fso:StorageDevice ;
    rdfs:label "液氧储罐"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    ex:hasMedium ex:LiquidOxygen ;
    ex:pressure "1500.0"^^xsd:decimal .

# 汽化器 (能量转换设备)
inst:Vaporizer-1 a fso:EnergyConversionDevice ;
    rdfs:label "汽化器"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    ex:temperature "5.0"^^xsd:decimal .  # 出口温度 >5°C

# 减压阀 (流量控制器)
inst:PressureReducer-1 a fso:FlowController ;
    rdfs:label "一级减压阀组"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    ex:pressure "800.0"^^xsd:decimal .  # 出口压力

inst:PressureReducer-2 a fso:FlowController ;
    rdfs:label "二级减压阀"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    ex:pressure "400.0"^^xsd:decimal .

# 区域阀箱 (连接件)
inst:ValveBox-O2-OR a fso:Fitting ;
    rdfs:label "手术室区域阀箱"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    ex:pressure "500.0"^^xsd:decimal .

inst:ValveBox-O2-ICU a fso:Fitting ;
    rdfs:label "ICU区域阀箱"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem .

# 管段
inst:Pipe-O2-001 a fso:Segment ;
    rdfs:label "氧气主管-001"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    ex:hasMedium ex:MedicalOxygen .

inst:Pipe-O2-002 a fso:Segment ;
    rdfs:label "氧气支管-手术室"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem .

inst:Pipe-O2-003 a fso:Segment ;
    rdfs:label "氧气支管-ICU"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem .

# 氧气终端 (末端设备 - 消费组件)
inst:O2-Outlet-OR-01 a fso:Terminal ;
    rdfs:label "手术室氧气终端-01"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    ex:pressure "400.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    ex:volumeFlowRate "15.0"^^xsd:decimal ;  # L/min
    bot:containedIn inst:Room-OR-01 .

inst:O2-Outlet-OR-02 a fso:Terminal ;
    rdfs:label "手术室氧气终端-02"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    bot:containedIn inst:Room-OR-01 .

inst:O2-Outlet-ICU-01 a fso:Terminal ;
    rdfs:label "ICU氧气终端-01"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    bot:containedIn inst:Zone-ICU .

inst:O2-Outlet-ICU-02 a fso:Terminal ;
    rdfs:label "ICU氧气终端-02"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    bot:containedIn inst:Zone-ICU .

# 备用气瓶汇流排 (储存设备 - 备用源)
inst:O2-Manifold-1 a fso:StorageDevice ;
    rdfs:label "气瓶汇流排(备用)"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:O2-SupplySystem ;
    ex:pressure "15000.0"^^xsd:decimal .  # 高压气瓶

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 流动连接关系 (耗散型 - 单向)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 供给方向 (液氧 → 终端)
inst:LOX-Tank-1 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Vaporizer-1 .
inst:Vaporizer-1 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:PressureReducer-1 .
inst:PressureReducer-1 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pipe-O2-001 .
inst:Pipe-O2-001 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:PressureReducer-2 .
inst:PressureReducer-2 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:ValveBox-O2-OR .
inst:PressureReducer-2 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:ValveBox-O2-ICU .
inst:ValveBox-O2-OR fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pipe-O2-002 .
inst:ValveBox-O2-ICU fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pipe-O2-003 .
inst:Pipe-O2-002 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:O2-Outlet-OR-01 .
inst:Pipe-O2-002 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:O2-Outlet-OR-02 .
inst:Pipe-O2-003 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:O2-Outlet-ICU-01 .
inst:Pipe-O2-003 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:O2-Outlet-ICU-02 .

# 备用路径
inst:O2-Manifold-1 fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:PressureReducer-1 .

# 耗散关系 (终端 → 空间)
inst:O2-Outlet-OR-01 ex:dissipatesTo inst:Room-OR-01 .
inst:O2-Outlet-OR-02 ex:dissipatesTo inst:Room-OR-01 .
inst:O2-Outlet-ICU-01 ex:dissipatesTo inst:Zone-ICU .
inst:O2-Outlet-ICU-02 ex:dissipatesTo inst:Zone-ICU .
```

### 3.3 换热器双组件模型

```turtle
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 换热器双组件模型 (按FSO论文建议)
# Heat Exchanger Dual-Component Model
# 用于追踪独立流体回路
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#> .
@prefix ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#> .
@prefix inst: <https://hospital.example.com/inst#> .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 换热器作为系统 (包含两个组件)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

inst:HeatExchanger-CHW-1 a fso:System ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水换热器-1"@zh ;
    fso:hasComponent inst:HX-1-PrimarySide, inst:HX-1-SecondarySide ;
    rdfs:comment "换热器建模为包含两个组件的系统，以追踪独立流体回路"@zh .

# 一次侧组件 (区域供冷输入侧)
inst:HX-1-PrimarySide a fso:EnergyConversionDevice ;
    rdfs:label "换热器-1-一次侧"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:HeatExchanger-CHW-1, inst:CHW-SupplySystem ;
    ex:hasMedium ex:ChilledWater ;
    ex:supplyTemperature "5.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    ex:returnTemperature "10.0"^^xsd:decimal .

# 二次侧组件 (建筑空调输出侧)
inst:HX-1-SecondarySide a fso:EnergyConversionDevice ;
    rdfs:label "换热器-1-二次侧"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:HeatExchanger-CHW-1, inst:Building-CHW-System ;
    ex:hasMedium ex:ChilledWater ;
    ex:supplyTemperature "7.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    ex:returnTemperature "12.0"^^xsd:decimal .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 热量交换关系 (两个组件之间)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 一次侧向二次侧传递热量 (实际是吸收二次侧热量)
inst:HX-1-SecondarySide fso:transfersHeatTo inst:HX-1-PrimarySide .
# 或等价地 (对称超属性)
inst:HX-1-PrimarySide fso:exchangesHeatWith inst:HX-1-SecondarySide .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 流体连接关系 (分离的流体回路)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 一次侧流体回路 (区域供冷)
inst:DistrictCooling-Supply fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:HX-1-PrimarySide .
inst:HX-1-PrimarySide fso:returnsFluidTo inst:DistrictCooling-Return .

# 二次侧流体回路 (建筑空调)
inst:HX-1-SecondarySide fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Building-CHW-Supply .
inst:Building-CHW-Return fso:returnsFluidTo inst:HX-1-SecondarySide .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 说明：为什么需要双组件模型
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 
# 如果将换热器建模为单一组件：
#   DistrictCooling-Supply → HeatExchanger → Building-CHW-Supply
# 
# 使用SPARQL路径查询 fso:suppliesFluidTo* 会错误地认为：
#   DistrictCooling的流体流向Building-CHW
# 
# 通过双组件模型，流体回路被正确分离：
#   - 一次侧回路: DistrictCooling ↔ HX-PrimarySide
#   - 二次侧回路: HX-SecondarySide ↔ Building-CHW
#   - 两个回路通过 fso:exchangesHeatWith 热耦合
# 
# 这种建模方式对于Agent-05的超图拓扑耦合至关重要，
# 因为它能正确识别热耦合点而不混淆流体边界。
```

## 四、超图拓扑数据结构 (Agent-05接口)

### 4.1 超图概念定义

```yaml
Hypergraph_Topology_Interface:
  
  description: |
    为Agent-05提供基于FSO本体的超图拓扑数据结构。
    超图允许一条边(hyperedge)连接多个节点，
    适合表示系统中的多元关系如：
    - 一个系统包含多个组件
    - 多个组件共享一个流体回路
    - 多个系统服务于同一空间

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 超图基础概念
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  hypergraph_concepts:
    
    node_types:
      - type_id: "NODE-SYSTEM"
        fso_class: "fso:System"
        description: "系统节点"
        examples: ["inst:ChilledWaterSystem", "inst:MedicalOxygenSystem"]
        
      - type_id: "NODE-COMPONENT"
        fso_class: "fso:Component"
        description: "组件节点"
        subclasses:
          - "fso:EnergyConversionDevice"
          - "fso:FlowMovingDevice"
          - "fso:FlowController"
          - "fso:Terminal"
          - "fso:Segment"
          - "fso:Fitting"
          - "fso:StorageDevice"
          - "fso:TreatmentDevice"
          
      - type_id: "NODE-SPACE"
        fso_class: "bot:Space"
        description: "空间节点"
        source: "Agent-02"
        
      - type_id: "NODE-MEDIUM"
        fso_class: "ex:Medium"
        description: "介质节点"

    hyperedge_types:
      
      # 系统组成超边 (1:N)
      - type_id: "HEDGE-COMPOSITION"
        description: "系统组成超边"
        fso_property: "fso:hasComponent"
        cardinality: "1:N"
        example: |
          系统S包含组件{C1, C2, C3}
          表示为: S --hasComponent--> {C1, C2, C3}
          
      # 流体回路超边 (N:N)
      - type_id: "HEDGE-FLUID-LOOP"
        description: "流体回路超边"
        fso_property: "fso:exchangesFluidWith"
        cardinality: "N:N"
        characteristics:
          - "同一流体回路的组件集合"
          - "通过 suppliesFluidTo/returnsFluidTo 路径连通"
        sparql_pattern: |
          SELECT ?component WHERE {
            ?start (fso:suppliesFluidTo|fso:returnsFluidTo)* ?component .
          }
          
      # 热耦合超边 (N:N)
      - type_id: "HEDGE-THERMAL-COUPLING"
        description: "热耦合超边"
        fso_property: "fso:exchangesHeatWith"
        cardinality: "N:N"
        characteristics:
          - "热交换相关的组件/系统集合"
          - "包括换热器两侧、终端与空间"
          
      # 空间服务超边 (N:N)
      - type_id: "HEDGE-SPACE-SERVICE"
        description: "空间服务超边"
        fso_property: "ex:servesSpace"
        cardinality: "N:N"
        characteristics:
          - "服务于同一空间的系统/组件集合"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 超图数据输出格式
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  hypergraph_output_format:
    
    json_schema:
      nodes:
        description: "节点列表"
        schema: |
          {
            "id": "URI",
            "type": "NODE_TYPE",
            "label": "string",
            "properties": {}
          }
          
      hyperedges:
        description: "超边列表"
        schema: |
          {
            "id": "HEDGE_ID",
            "type": "HEDGE_TYPE",
            "fso_property": "URI",
            "nodes": ["URI1", "URI2", ...],
            "direction": "undirected|directed",
            "properties": {}
          }

    example_output:
      nodes:
        - id: "inst:ChilledWaterSystem"
          type: "NODE-SYSTEM"
          label: "冷冻水系统"
          
        - id: "inst:Chiller-1"
          type: "NODE-COMPONENT"
          subtype: "EnergyConversionDevice"
          label: "1#冷水机组"
          
        - id: "inst:Room-OR-01"
          type: "NODE-SPACE"
          label: "1#手术室"
          
      hyperedges:
        - id: "HEDGE-COMP-CHW-001"
          type: "HEDGE-COMPOSITION"
          fso_property: "fso:hasComponent"
          nodes:
            - head: "inst:ChilledWaterSystem"
            - members:
              - "inst:Chiller-1"
              - "inst:Chiller-2"
              - "inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1"
              - "inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1"
          direction: "directed"
          
        - id: "HEDGE-FLUID-CHW-LOOP-001"
          type: "HEDGE-FLUID-LOOP"
          fso_property: "fso:exchangesFluidWith"
          nodes:
            - "inst:Chiller-1"
            - "inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1"
            - "inst:Header-CHW-Supply"
            - "inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1"
            - "inst:AHU-OR-01"
            - "inst:Header-CHW-Return"
          direction: "undirected"
          medium: "ex:ChilledWater"
          
        - id: "HEDGE-THERMAL-001"
          type: "HEDGE-THERMAL-COUPLING"
          fso_property: "fso:exchangesHeatWith"
          nodes:
            - "inst:HX-1-PrimarySide"
            - "inst:HX-1-SecondarySide"
          direction: "undirected"
          
        - id: "HEDGE-SPACE-OR-01"
          type: "HEDGE-SPACE-SERVICE"
          fso_property: "ex:servesSpace"
          nodes:
            - systems:
              - "inst:ChilledWaterSystem"
              - "inst:VentilationSystem"
              - "inst:MedicalOxygenSystem"
              - "inst:MedicalVacuumSystem"
            - space: "inst:Room-OR-01"
          direction: "directed"
```

### 4.2 SPARQL查询接口 (Agent-05使用)

```yaml
SPARQL_Query_Interface:
  
  description: |
    提供标准SPARQL查询供Agent-05构建超图拓扑。
    所有查询基于FSO本体属性定义。

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统组成查询
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  composition_queries:
    
    # CQ1: 系统包含哪些组件？
    query_system_components:
      id: "CQ1"
      description: "查询系统包含的所有组件"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
        
        SELECT ?system ?component ?componentType ?label
        WHERE {
          ?system a fso:System ;
                  fso:hasComponent ?component .
          ?component a ?componentType ;
                     rdfs:label ?label .
          FILTER(?componentType != fso:Component)
        }
        ORDER BY ?system ?componentType
        
    # CQ2: 系统包含哪些子系统？
    query_subsystems:
      id: "CQ2"
      description: "查询系统的子系统层次"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
        
        SELECT ?system ?subsystem ?subsystemType
        WHERE {
          ?system a fso:System ;
                  fso:hasSubSystem ?subsystem .
          ?subsystem a ?subsystemType .
        }

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 流体回路查询
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  fluid_loop_queries:
    
    # CQ3: 同一流体回路的组件
    query_fluid_loop_components:
      id: "CQ3"
      description: "查询与指定组件在同一流体回路的所有组件"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        
        SELECT DISTINCT ?component
        WHERE {
          # 从指定起点沿供给/回流方向遍历
          ?start (fso:suppliesFluidTo|fso:returnsFluidTo)* ?component .
          
          # 或反向遍历
          UNION {
            ?start ^(fso:suppliesFluidTo|fso:returnsFluidTo)* ?component .
          }
        }
      note: "将?start绑定到具体组件URI执行"
      
    # CQ4: 上游/下游组件查询
    query_upstream_components:
      id: "CQ4"
      description: "查询指定组件的上游组件及距离"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        
        SELECT ?upstreamComponent (COUNT(?mid) AS ?distance)
        WHERE {
          ?target ^fso:suppliesFluidTo+ ?upstreamComponent .
          ?target ^fso:suppliesFluidTo* ?mid .
          ?mid ^fso:suppliesFluidTo+ ?upstreamComponent .
        }
        GROUP BY ?upstreamComponent
        ORDER BY ?distance
        
    query_downstream_components:
      id: "CQ4b"
      description: "查询指定组件的下游组件"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        
        SELECT ?downstreamComponent (COUNT(?mid) AS ?distance)
        WHERE {
          ?target fso:suppliesFluidTo+ ?downstreamComponent .
          ?target fso:suppliesFluidTo* ?mid .
          ?mid fso:suppliesFluidTo+ ?downstreamComponent .
        }
        GROUP BY ?downstreamComponent
        ORDER BY ?distance

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 热耦合查询
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  thermal_coupling_queries:
    
    # 查询热交换连接
    query_heat_exchange:
      id: "CQ5"
      description: "查询所有热交换关系"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        
        SELECT ?source ?target
        WHERE {
          ?source fso:transfersHeatTo ?target .
        }
        
    # 查询换热器两侧
    query_heat_exchanger_sides:
      id: "CQ6"
      description: "查询换热器的一次侧和二次侧"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
        
        SELECT ?hxSystem ?primarySide ?secondarySide
        WHERE {
          ?hxSystem a fso:System ;
                    fso:hasComponent ?primarySide, ?secondarySide .
          ?primarySide fso:exchangesHeatWith ?secondarySide .
          FILTER(?primarySide != ?secondarySide)
        }

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 空间服务查询
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  space_service_queries:
    
    # CQ7: 服务于指定空间的系统
    query_systems_serving_space:
      id: "CQ7"
      description: "查询服务于指定空间的所有系统"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
        PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>
        
        SELECT ?system ?systemLabel
        WHERE {
          ?space a bot:Space .
          ?system ex:servesSpace ?space ;
                  rdfs:label ?systemLabel .
        }
        
    # CQ8: 空间中的终端设备
    query_terminals_in_space:
      id: "CQ8"
      description: "查询空间中的所有终端设备"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
        
        SELECT ?space ?terminal ?terminalType
        WHERE {
          ?space a bot:Space ;
                 bot:containsElement ?terminal .
          ?terminal a fso:Terminal ;
                    a ?terminalType .
          FILTER(?terminalType != fso:Terminal && ?terminalType != fso:Component)
        }

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 超图构建查询
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  hypergraph_construction_queries:
    
    # 构建系统组成超边
    construct_composition_hyperedge:
      id: "HQ1"
      description: "构建系统组成超边图"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        
        CONSTRUCT {
          ?system <http://hypergraph#hasHyperedge> ?hedge .
          ?hedge <http://hypergraph#type> "HEDGE-COMPOSITION" .
          ?hedge <http://hypergraph#containsNode> ?component .
        }
        WHERE {
          ?system a fso:System ;
                  fso:hasComponent ?component .
          BIND(IRI(CONCAT(STR(?system), "-composition")) AS ?hedge)
        }
        
    # 构建流体回路超边
    construct_fluid_loop_hyperedge:
      id: "HQ2"
      description: "构建流体回路超边"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>
        
        SELECT ?medium (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?component; separator=",") AS ?loopComponents)
        WHERE {
          ?component ex:hasMedium ?medium .
          ?component (fso:suppliesFluidTo|fso:returnsFluidTo|
                      ^fso:suppliesFluidTo|^fso:returnsFluidTo)* ?other .
          ?other ex:hasMedium ?medium .
        }
        GROUP BY ?medium
```

## 五、载体-荷载耦合模型 (FSO对齐版)

### 5.1 耦合关系RDF表示

```yaml
Carrier_Payload_Coupling_RDF:
  
  description: |
    基于FSO本体和双系统模型(耗散/循环)，
    将载体-荷载耦合关系表示为RDF三元组。
    
    核心概念：
    - 载体(Carrier): 物质流 - 通过fso:exchangesFluidWith连接
    - 荷载(Payload): 能量流 - 通过fso:exchangesHeatWith传递
    - 耦合方程: 作为属性附加到组件/系统

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 耦合类型定义
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  coupling_types:
    
    # 水-热能耦合
    water_thermal_coupling:
      coupling_id: "ex:WaterThermalCoupling"
      carrier:
        type: "ex:Water"
        flow_property: "fso:exchangesFluidWith"
      payload:
        type: "ex:ThermalEnergy"
        flow_property: "fso:exchangesHeatWith"
      coupling_equation:
        formula: "Q = ρ × V̇ × Cp × ΔT"
        simplified: "Q(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × ΔT(°C) × 1.163"
        
      rdf_representation: |
        @prefix ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#> .
        @prefix fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#> .
        
        ex:WaterThermalCoupling a ex:CarrierPayloadCoupling ;
            ex:hasCarrier ex:Water ;
            ex:hasPayload ex:ThermalEnergy ;
            ex:carrierProperty fso:exchangesFluidWith ;
            ex:payloadProperty fso:exchangesHeatWith ;
            ex:couplingEquation "Q = V × ΔT × 1.163"^^xsd:string ;
            ex:couplingFactor "1.163"^^xsd:decimal ;
            ex:couplingFactorUnit "kW/(m³/h·°C)" .

    # 空气-热能耦合 (显热)
    air_sensible_coupling:
      coupling_id: "ex:AirSensibleCoupling"
      carrier: "ex:Air"
      payload: "ex:SensibleHeat"
      coupling_equation:
        formula: "Qs = ρ × V̇ × Cp × ΔT"
        simplified: "Qs(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × ΔT(°C) × 0.335"
        
    # 空气-热能耦合 (潜热)
    air_latent_coupling:
      coupling_id: "ex:AirLatentCoupling"
      carrier: "ex:Air"
      payload: "ex:LatentHeat"
      coupling_equation:
        formula: "Ql = ρ × V̇ × Δd × γ"
        simplified: "Ql(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × Δd(g/kg) × 0.833"

    # 电力耦合
    electrical_coupling:
      coupling_id: "ex:ElectricalCoupling"
      carrier: "ex:Electricity"
      payload: "ex:ElectricalEnergy"
      flow_property: "fso:exchangesElectricChargeWith"
      coupling_equation:
        three_phase: "P = √3 × U × I × cosφ"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 组件耦合参数RDF表示
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  component_coupling_rdf:
    
    example_chiller: |
      @prefix ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#> .
      @prefix inst: <https://hospital.example.com/inst#> .
      @prefix fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#> .
      @prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
      
      # 冷水机组耦合参数
      inst:Chiller-1 a fso:EnergyConversionDevice ;
          # 蒸发器侧 (冷冻水)
          ex:evaporatorCoupling [
              a ex:WaterThermalCoupling ;
              ex:volumeFlowRate "350.0"^^xsd:decimal ;  # m³/h
              ex:supplyTemperature "7.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:returnTemperature "12.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:deltaT "5.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:thermalPower "2000.0"^^xsd:decimal ;   # kW
              ex:calculatedAs "350 × 5 × 1.163 = 2035 kW"
          ] ;
          # 冷凝器侧 (冷却水)
          ex:condenserCoupling [
              a ex:WaterThermalCoupling ;
              ex:volumeFlowRate "420.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:supplyTemperature "32.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:returnTemperature "37.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:deltaT "5.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:thermalPower "2440.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:note "Q_cond = Q_evap + P_comp"
          ] ;
          # 电力消耗
          ex:electricalInput [
              a ex:ElectricalCoupling ;
              ex:electricalPower "400.0"^^xsd:decimal ;  # kW
          ] ;
          # 性能系数
          ex:COP "5.0"^^xsd:decimal .

    example_ahu: |
      @prefix ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#> .
      @prefix inst: <https://hospital.example.com/inst#> .
      @prefix fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#> .
      
      # 空调机组耦合参数
      inst:AHU-OR-01 a fso:Terminal ;
          # 空气侧耦合
          ex:airSideCoupling [
              a ex:AirSensibleCoupling, ex:AirLatentCoupling ;
              ex:volumeFlowRate "12000.0"^^xsd:decimal ;  # m³/h
              ex:supplyTemperature "18.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:returnTemperature "25.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:deltaT "7.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:sensiblePower "28.14"^^xsd:decimal ;  # kW
              ex:latentPower "27.97"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:totalPower "56.11"^^xsd:decimal
          ] ;
          # 水侧耦合 (冷冻水)
          ex:waterSideCoupling [
              a ex:WaterThermalCoupling ;
              ex:volumeFlowRate "10.0"^^xsd:decimal ;  # m³/h
              ex:supplyTemperature "7.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:returnTemperature "12.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:deltaT "5.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
              ex:thermalPower "58.15"^^xsd:decimal
          ] ;
          # 风机电力
          ex:fanPower "15.0"^^xsd:decimal .
```

### 5.2 能量平衡推理规则

```yaml
Energy_Balance_Inference:
  
  description: |
    基于FSO本体定义推理规则，支持:
    - 能量守恒验证
    - 系统级能量汇总
    - 效率计算

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # SPARQL推理查询
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  inference_queries:
    
    # 系统能量平衡计算
    system_energy_balance:
      id: "INF-1"
      description: "计算系统的能量输入与输出平衡"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>
        
        SELECT ?system 
               (SUM(?sourcePower) AS ?totalInput)
               (SUM(?consumerPower) AS ?totalOutput)
               (SUM(?sourcePower) - SUM(?consumerPower) AS ?balance)
        WHERE {
          ?system a fso:System .
          
          # 源组件能量
          {
            ?system fso:hasSourceComponent ?source .
            ?source ex:thermalPower ?sourcePower .
          }
          UNION
          # 消费组件能量
          {
            ?system fso:hasConsumerComponent ?consumer .
            ?consumer ex:thermalPower ?consumerPower .
          }
        }
        GROUP BY ?system
        
    # 流体回路热量传递链
    fluid_loop_energy_chain:
      id: "INF-2"
      description: "追踪流体回路中的能量传递"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>
        
        SELECT ?source ?target ?power
        WHERE {
          ?source fso:transfersHeatTo ?target .
          ?source ex:thermalPower ?power .
        }
        
    # 系统COP计算
    system_cop_calculation:
      id: "INF-3"
      description: "计算系统综合性能系数"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>
        
        SELECT ?system 
               (SUM(?coolingOutput) AS ?totalCooling)
               (SUM(?electricInput) AS ?totalElectric)
               (SUM(?coolingOutput) / SUM(?electricInput) AS ?systemCOP)
        WHERE {
          ?system a fso:System ;
                  fso:hasComponent ?component .
          
          OPTIONAL { ?component ex:thermalPower ?coolingOutput }
          OPTIONAL { ?component ex:electricalPower ?electricInput }
        }
        GROUP BY ?system
```

## 六、Agent间接口定义

### 6.1 与Agent-01/02/03对接

```yaml
Upstream_Agent_Interface:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Agent-01 系统拓扑 → Agent-04 流动模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  agent01_interface:
    input_format: "YAML (Agent-01拓扑节点定义)"
    
    mapping_rules:
      topology_node_to_fso:
        - agent01_node_type: "SOURCE"
          fso_class: "fso:EnergyConversionDevice | fso:StorageDevice"
          fso_role: "fso:hasSourceComponent"
          
        - agent01_node_type: "DISTRIBUTION"
          fso_class: "fso:FlowMovingDevice | fso:Segment | fso:Fitting"
          fso_role: "fso:hasComponent"
          
        - agent01_node_type: "TERMINAL"
          fso_class: "fso:Terminal"
          fso_role: "fso:hasConsumerComponent"
          
        - agent01_node_type: "CONTROL"
          fso_class: "fso:FlowController"
          fso_role: "fso:hasComponent"
          
      system_dependency_to_fso:
        - dependency_type: "POWER_SUPPLY"
          fso_property: "fso:exchangesElectricChargeWith"
          
        - dependency_type: "THERMAL_SUPPLY"
          fso_property: "fso:exchangesHeatWith"
          
        - dependency_type: "FLUID_SUPPLY"
          fso_property: "fso:exchangesFluidWith"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Agent-02 空间本体 → Agent-04 流动模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  agent02_interface:
    input_format: "YAML (Agent-02空间层级定义)"
    
    mapping_rules:
      space_to_bot:
        - agent02_space_type: "L4_Room"
          bot_class: "bot:Space"
          
        - agent02_space_type: "L3_Zone"
          bot_class: "bot:Zone"
          
        - agent02_space_type: "L2_Floor"
          bot_class: "bot:Storey"
          
      environmental_requirement_to_flow:
        - requirement_type: "temperature"
          generates: "HVAC流动服务需求"
          
        - requirement_type: "cleanliness"
          generates: "洁净送风需求"
          
        - requirement_type: "medical_gas"
          generates: "医疗气体流动需求"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Agent-03 设备本体 → Agent-04 流动模型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  agent03_interface:
    input_format: "YAML (Agent-03设备分类)"
    
    mapping_rules:
      equipment_to_fso_component:
        - agent03_type: "EQP-CH-CENT"
          fso_class: "fso:EnergyConversionDevice"
          flow_roles:
            - produces: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
            - consumes: "ENERGY-ELEC-LV"
            - rejects: "ENERGY-THERMAL-REJECT"
            
        - agent03_type: "EQP-PUMP-CHW"
          fso_class: "fso:FlowMovingDevice"
          flow_roles:
            - transports: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
            - consumes: "ENERGY-ELEC-LV"
            
        - agent03_type: "EQP-AHU-CLEAN"
          fso_class: "fso:Terminal"
          flow_roles:
            - consumes: "MASS-WATER-CHW"
            - produces: "MASS-AIR-CLEAN"
            - consumes: "ENERGY-ELEC-LV"
            
        - agent03_type: "EQP-O2-OUTLET"
          fso_class: "fso:Terminal"
          flow_roles:
            - dissipates: "MASS-MGAS-O2"

    # 4. 耦合参数 (边属性)
    coupling_parameters:
      description: "附加到边/超边的物理参数"
      types:
        - param_group: "FLOW_PARAMS"
          properties:
            - "ex:volumeFlowRate"
            - "ex:massFlowRate"
            - "ex:velocity"
            
        - param_group: "THERMAL_PARAMS"
          properties:
            - "ex:supplyTemperature"
            - "ex:returnTemperature"
            - "ex:deltaT"
            - "ex:thermalPower"
            
        - param_group: "PRESSURE_PARAMS"
          properties:
            - "ex:pressure"
            - "ex:pressureDrop"
            
        - param_group: "EFFICIENCY_PARAMS"
          properties:
            - "ex:COP"
            - "ex:efficiency"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Agent-05超图构建指引
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  hypergraph_construction_guide:
    
    step_1_extract_nodes:
      description: "从RDF提取所有节点"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
        PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
        
        SELECT ?node ?type ?label
        WHERE {
          {
            ?node a fso:System ;
                  rdfs:label ?label .
            BIND("SYSTEM" AS ?type)
          }
          UNION
          {
            ?node a/rdfs:subClassOf* fso:Component ;
                  rdfs:label ?label .
            BIND("COMPONENT" AS ?type)
          }
          UNION
          {
            ?node a bot:Space ;
                  rdfs:label ?label .
            BIND("SPACE" AS ?type)
          }
        }
        
    step_2_extract_binary_edges:
      description: "提取所有二元流动关系"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        
        SELECT ?source ?predicate ?target
        WHERE {
          VALUES ?predicate {
            fso:suppliesFluidTo
            fso:returnsFluidTo
            fso:transfersHeatTo
            fso:exchangesElectricChargeWith
          }
          ?source ?predicate ?target .
        }
        
    step_3_construct_composition_hyperedges:
      description: "构建系统组成超边"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        
        SELECT ?system (GROUP_CONCAT(?component; separator="|") AS ?components)
        WHERE {
          ?system a fso:System ;
                  fso:hasComponent ?component .
        }
        GROUP BY ?system
        
    step_4_construct_fluid_loop_hyperedges:
      description: "构建流体回路超边"
      algorithm: |
        1. 对于每种介质(ex:hasMedium):
           a. 提取所有使用该介质的组件
           b. 使用fso:feedsFluidTo路径构建连通分量
           c. 每个连通分量形成一个FLUID_CIRCUIT超边
           
      sparql_connected_components: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>
        
        # 查找同一介质的连通组件
        SELECT ?medium ?component1 ?component2
        WHERE {
          ?component1 ex:hasMedium ?medium .
          ?component2 ex:hasMedium ?medium .
          ?component1 (fso:suppliesFluidTo|fso:returnsFluidTo|
                       ^fso:suppliesFluidTo|^fso:returnsFluidTo)+ ?component2 .
          FILTER(?component1 != ?component2)
        }
        
    step_5_construct_thermal_hyperedges:
      description: "构建热耦合超边"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        
        # 查找热交换连通分量
        SELECT ?node1 ?node2
        WHERE {
          ?node1 (fso:transfersHeatTo|^fso:transfersHeatTo|
                  fso:exchangesHeatWith)+ ?node2 .
          FILTER(?node1 != ?node2)
        }
        
    step_6_construct_space_service_hyperedges:
      description: "构建空间服务超边"
      sparql: |
        PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
        PREFIX bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#>
        PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>
        
        SELECT ?space (GROUP_CONCAT(?system; separator="|") AS ?systems)
        WHERE {
          ?system ex:servesSpace ?space .
        }
        GROUP BY ?space
```

## 七、完整流动路径模型库

### 7.1 HVAC系统流动路径

```yaml
HVAC_Flow_Paths:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 冷源系统流动路径 (HVAC-CHP)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  CHP_Chilled_Water_Circuit:
    path_id: "PATH-HVAC-CHP-CHW"
    path_name: "冷冻水循环路径"
    system_ref: "inst:ChilledWaterSystem"
    flow_type: "CIRCULATION"
    medium: "ex:ChilledWater"
    
    # FSO RDF表示
    rdf_triples:
      # 供给方向
      supply_chain:
        - subject: "inst:Chiller-1"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Pipe-CHW-S-Main"
          
        - subject: "inst:Pipe-CHW-S-Main"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1"
          
        - subject: "inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Header-CHW-Supply"
          
        - subject: "inst:Header-CHW-Supply"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1"
          
        - subject: "inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Pipe-CHW-S-Riser-OR"
          
        - subject: "inst:Pipe-CHW-S-Riser-OR"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:AHU-OR-01"
          
      # 回流方向
      return_chain:
        - subject: "inst:AHU-OR-01"
          predicate: "fso:returnsFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Pipe-CHW-R-Riser-OR"
          
        - subject: "inst:Pipe-CHW-R-Riser-OR"
          predicate: "fso:returnsFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Header-CHW-Return"
          
        - subject: "inst:Header-CHW-Return"
          predicate: "fso:returnsFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Pipe-CHW-R-Main"
          
        - subject: "inst:Pipe-CHW-R-Main"
          predicate: "fso:returnsFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Chiller-1"
          
    # 热量传递关系
    heat_transfer:
      - subject: "inst:Chiller-1"
        predicate: "fso:transfersHeatTo"
        object: "inst:CoolingTower-1"
        note: "冷凝热排放"
        
      - subject: "inst:AHU-OR-01"
        predicate: "fso:transfersHeatTo"
        object: "inst:Room-OR-01"
        note: "冷量投送至空间"
        
    # 耦合参数
    coupling_parameters:
      design_conditions:
        supply_temperature: 7
        return_temperature: 12
        delta_t: 5
        unit: "°C"
      design_flow:
        primary_flow: 400
        secondary_flow: 600
        unit: "m³/h"
      design_capacity:
        cooling_power: 2000
        unit: "kW"
        calculation: "V̇ × ΔT × 1.163"
        
    # 超图结构
    hypergraph_structure:
      fluid_loop_hyperedge:
        type: "FLUID_CIRCUIT"
        members:
          - "inst:Chiller-1"
          - "inst:Pipe-CHW-S-Main"
          - "inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1"
          - "inst:Header-CHW-Supply"
          - "inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1"
          - "inst:Pipe-CHW-S-Riser-OR"
          - "inst:AHU-OR-01"
          - "inst:Pipe-CHW-R-Riser-OR"
          - "inst:Header-CHW-Return"
          - "inst:Pipe-CHW-R-Main"
        medium: "ex:ChilledWater"
        closed_loop: true

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 冷却水系统流动路径 (HVAC-CHP)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  CHP_Condenser_Water_Circuit:
    path_id: "PATH-HVAC-CHP-CW"
    path_name: "冷却水循环路径"
    system_ref: "inst:CondenserWaterSystem"
    flow_type: "CIRCULATION"
    medium: "ex:CondenserWater"
    
    rdf_triples:
      flow_chain:
        - subject: "inst:Chiller-1-Condenser"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Pipe-CW-Supply"
          
        - subject: "inst:Pipe-CW-Supply"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Pump-CW-1"
          
        - subject: "inst:Pump-CW-1"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:CoolingTower-1"
          
        - subject: "inst:CoolingTower-1"
          predicate: "fso:returnsFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Pipe-CW-Return"
          
        - subject: "inst:Pipe-CW-Return"
          predicate: "fso:returnsFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Chiller-1-Condenser"
          
    heat_transfer:
      - subject: "inst:CoolingTower-1"
        predicate: "fso:transfersHeatTo"
        object: "inst:OutdoorEnvironment"
        note: "废热排放至室外"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 空气处理系统流动路径 (HVAC-AHU)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  AHU_Clean_Room_Air_Path:
    path_id: "PATH-HVAC-AHU-CLEAN"
    path_name: "洁净空调送风路径"
    system_ref: "inst:VentilationSystem-OR"
    flow_type: "DISSIPATION"  # 开式系统
    medium: "ex:CleanAir"
    
    rdf_triples:
      supply_chain:
        - subject: "inst:OutdoorAirIntake"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:PreFilter-G4"
          
        - subject: "inst:PreFilter-G4"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR"
          
        - subject: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Humidifier-AHU-OR"
          
        - subject: "inst:Humidifier-AHU-OR"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:MediumFilter-F8"
          
        - subject: "inst:MediumFilter-F8"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:SupplyFan-AHU-OR"
          
        - subject: "inst:SupplyFan-AHU-OR"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:Duct-Supply-OR"
          
        - subject: "inst:Duct-Supply-OR"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:HEPA-Filter-H14"
          
        - subject: "inst:HEPA-Filter-H14"
          predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
          object: "inst:LaminarFlowCeiling-OR"
          
        - subject: "inst:LaminarFlowCeiling-OR"
          predicate: "ex:dissipatesTo"
          object: "inst:Room-OR-01"
          
    # 盘管与冷冻水系统的热耦合
    heat_exchange_coupling:
      # 盘管建模为双组件 (空气侧 + 水侧)
      cooling_coil_system:
        system_uri: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-System"
        components:
          - uri: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-AirSide"
            type: "fso:EnergyConversionDevice"
            medium: "ex:Air"
            
          - uri: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-WaterSide"
            type: "fso:EnergyConversionDevice"
            medium: "ex:ChilledWater"
            
        heat_exchange:
          - subject: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-AirSide"
            predicate: "fso:transfersHeatTo"
            object: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-WaterSide"
            
        fluid_connections:
          # 空气侧
          - subject: "inst:PreFilter-G4"
            predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
            object: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-AirSide"
          - subject: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-AirSide"
            predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
            object: "inst:Humidifier-AHU-OR"
            
          # 水侧
          - subject: "inst:Pipe-CHW-Branch-AHU"
            predicate: "fso:suppliesFluidTo"
            object: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-WaterSide"
          - subject: "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-WaterSide"
            predicate: "fso:returnsFluidTo"
            object: "inst:Pipe-CHW-Return-AHU"
            
    # 超图结构
    hypergraph_structure:
      # 送风路径超边 (开式，不闭合)
      supply_path_hyperedge:
        type: "FLUID_CIRCUIT"
        members:
          - "inst:OutdoorAirIntake"
          - "inst:PreFilter-G4"
          - "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-AirSide"
          - "inst:Humidifier-AHU-OR"
          - "inst:MediumFilter-F8"
          - "inst:SupplyFan-AHU-OR"
          - "inst:Duct-Supply-OR"
          - "inst:HEPA-Filter-H14"
          - "inst:LaminarFlowCeiling-OR"
        medium: "ex:CleanAir"
        closed_loop: false
        
      # 热耦合超边
      thermal_coupling_hyperedge:
        type: "THERMAL_COUPLING"
        members:
          - "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-AirSide"
          - "inst:CoolingCoil-AHU-OR-WaterSide"
        coupling_type: "HEAT_EXCHANGE"

## 八、守恒模型与验证规则

### 8.1 质量守恒验证

```yaml
Mass_Conservation_Validation:

description: |
 基于FSO流动关系的质量守恒验证规则。
 用于检测模型完整性和数据一致性。

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 节点平衡验证 (Fitting/Junction)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

junction_balance:
 rule_id: "CONS-MASS-001"
 description: "连接件节点的流入等于流出"

 sparql_validation: |
 PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
 PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>

 # 查找不平衡的连接件
 SELECT ?junction ?totalIn ?totalOut ?difference
 WHERE {
 ?junction a fso:Fitting .

 # 计算流入流量
 {
 SELECT ?junction (SUM(?flowIn) AS ?totalIn)
 WHERE {
 ?upstream fso:suppliesFluidTo ?junction .
 ?upstream ex:volumeFlowRate ?flowIn .
 }
 GROUP BY ?junction
 }

 # 计算流出流量
 {
 SELECT ?junction (SUM(?flowOut) AS ?totalOut)
 WHERE {
 ?junction fso:suppliesFluidTo ?downstream .
 ?downstream ex:volumeFlowRate ?flowOut .
 }
 GROUP BY ?junction
 }

 BIND(ABS(?totalIn - ?totalOut) AS ?difference)
 FILTER(?difference > 0.01) # 允许0.01的误差
 }

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 闭合回路验证
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

closed_loop_continuity:
 rule_id: "CONS-MASS-002"
 description: "闭合流体回路的连续性验证"

 sparql_validation: |
 PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>

 # 检查是否所有循环系统都形成闭环
 ASK {
 ?system a fso:System ;
 ex:loopType "closed" .
 ?system fso:hasSourceComponent ?source .
 ?system fso:hasConsumerComponent ?consumer .

 # 验证从源到消费者再回到源的路径存在
 FILTER NOT EXISTS {
 ?source (fso:suppliesFluidTo)+ ?consumer .
 ?consumer (fso:returnsFluidTo)+ ?source .
 }
 }

### 8.2 能量守恒验证

```yaml
Energy_Conservation_Validation:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统能量平衡验证
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_energy_balance:
    rule_id: "CONS-ENERGY-001"
    description: "系统输入能量等于输出能量加损耗"
    
    sparql_validation: |
      PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
      PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>
      
      SELECT ?system ?energyIn ?energyOut ?loss ?balance
      WHERE {
        ?system a fso:System .
        
        # 源组件能量输入
        {
          SELECT ?system (SUM(?power) AS ?energyIn)
          WHERE {
            ?system fso:hasSourceComponent ?source .
            ?source ex:thermalPower ?power .
          }
          GROUP BY ?system
        }
        
        # 消费组件能量输出
        {
          SELECT ?system (SUM(?power) AS ?energyOut)
          WHERE {
            ?system fso:hasConsumerComponent ?consumer .
            ?consumer ex:thermalPower ?power .
          }
          GROUP BY ?system
        }
        
        # 管路损失（如有定义）
        OPTIONAL {
          SELECT ?system (SUM(?pipeLoss) AS ?loss)
          WHERE {
            ?system fso:hasComponent ?segment .
            ?segment a fso:Segment ;
                     ex:heatLoss ?pipeLoss .
          }
          GROUP BY ?system
        }
        
        BIND(COALESCE(?loss, 0) AS ?loss)
        BIND(?energyIn - ?energyOut - ?loss AS ?balance)
        
        FILTER(ABS(?balance) > 1.0)  # 允许1kW误差
      }

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 换热器能量平衡验证
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  heat_exchanger_balance:
    rule_id: "CONS-ENERGY-002"
    description: "换热器两侧热量交换平衡"
    
    sparql_validation: |
      PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
      PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>
      
      SELECT ?hx ?primaryPower ?secondaryPower ?difference
      WHERE {
        ?hx a fso:System .
        ?hx fso:hasComponent ?primary, ?secondary .
        ?primary fso:transfersHeatTo ?secondary .
        
        ?primary ex:thermalPower ?primaryPower .
        ?secondary ex:thermalPower ?secondaryPower .
        
        BIND(ABS(?primaryPower - ?secondaryPower) AS ?difference)
        
        # 允许5%误差（换热效率）
        FILTER(?difference / ?primaryPower > 0.05)
      }

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 冷水机组能量平衡验证
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  chiller_energy_balance:
    rule_id: "CONS-ENERGY-003"
    description: "冷水机组：Q_cond = Q_evap + P_comp"
    
    sparql_validation: |
      PREFIX fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#>
      PREFIX ex: <https://hospital.example.com/ex#>
      
      SELECT ?chiller ?Q_evap ?P_comp ?Q_cond_actual ?Q_cond_expected ?error
      WHERE {
        ?chiller a fso:EnergyConversionDevice ;
                 ex:evaporatorCoupling/ex:thermalPower ?Q_evap ;
                 ex:electricalPower ?P_comp ;
                 ex:condenserCoupling/ex:thermalPower ?Q_cond_actual .
        
        BIND(?Q_evap + ?P_comp AS ?Q_cond_expected)
        BIND(ABS(?Q_cond_actual - ?Q_cond_expected) / ?Q_cond_expected AS ?error)
        
        FILTER(?error > 0.05)  # 5%误差阈值
      }
```

```yaml
Output_Quality_Validation:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # FSO合规性验证
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  fso_compliance:
    
    ontology_version: "FSO 1.0 (based on Kukkonen et al., 2022)"
    
    class_usage:
      fso_System: "已使用"
      fso_Component: "已使用"
      fso_EnergyConversionDevice: "已使用"
      fso_FlowMovingDevice: "已使用"
      fso_FlowController: "已使用"
      fso_Terminal: "已使用"
      fso_Segment: "已使用"
      fso_Fitting: "已使用"
      fso_StorageDevice: "已使用"
      fso_TreatmentDevice: "已使用"
      fso_DistributionSystem: "已使用"
      fso_SupplySystem: "已使用"
      fso_ReturnSystem: "已使用"
      
    property_usage:
      fso_hasSubSystem: "已使用"
      fso_hasComponent: "已使用"
      fso_hasSourceComponent: "已使用"
      fso_hasConsumerComponent: "已使用"
      fso_connectedWith: "已使用"
      fso_exchangesFluidWith: "已使用"
      fso_feedsFluidTo: "已使用"
      fso_suppliesFluidTo: "已使用"
      fso_returnsFluidTo: "已使用"
      fso_exchangesHeatWith: "已使用"
      fso_transfersHeatTo: "已使用"
      fso_exchangesElectricChargeWith: "已使用"
      
    compliance_level: "FULL"

        - "使用全部23个FSO对象属性"
        - "符合Description Logic表达能力 ALRI"
        
    - achievement: "采用RDF三元组数据模型"
      details:
        - "Turtle格式完整表示"
        - "支持SPARQL查询"
        - "与语义网技术兼容"
        
    - achievement: "建立双系统模型框架"
      details:
        - "耗散系统(物流系统): 能量/物质投送"
        - "循环系统(路径系统): 介质循环承载"
        - "系统间耦合关系定义"
        
    - achievement: "实现换热器双组件模型"
      details:
        - "正确分离流体回路"
        - "避免SPARQL路径查询混淆"
        - "支持热耦合点识别"
        
    - achievement: "设计超图拓扑数据结构"
      details:
        - "节点类型: SYSTEM/COMPONENT/SPACE"
        - "超边类型: COMPOSITION/FLUID_CIRCUIT/THERMAL_COUPLING/SPACE_SERVICE"
        - "完整SPARQL查询接口"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 与FSO论文的关键对应
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  fso_paper_alignment:
    
    paper_reference: "Kukkonen et al., 2022 - An ontology to support flow system descriptions"
    
    competency_questions_addressed:
      CQ1: "系统包含哪些组件？ - 通过fso:hasComponent"
      CQ2: "系统包含哪些子系统？ - 通过fso:hasSubSystem"
      CQ3: "系统的源/消费组件？ - 通过fso:hasSourceComponent/hasConsumerComponent"
      CQ4: "同一流体回路的组件？ - 通过SPARQL路径查询"
      CQ5: "上下游组件顺序？ - 通过fso:suppliesFluidTo/returnsFluidTo"
      CQ6: "供给侧/回流侧区分？ - 通过SupplySystem/ReturnSystem"
      CQ7: "组件类型分类？ - 通过8个Component子类"
      
    key_design_patterns_adopted:
      - pattern: "系统可重叠共享子系统"
        implementation: "fso:isSubSystemOf不是函数式属性"
        
      - pattern: "组件可属于多个系统"
        implementation: "fso:isComponentOf不是函数式属性"
        
      - pattern: "换热器双组件模型"
        implementation: "建模为包含两个组件的系统"
        
      - pattern: "供给/回流区分"
        implementation: "fso:suppliesFluidTo vs fso:returnsFluidTo"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Agent-05接口就绪状态
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  agent05_readiness:
    
    deliverables:
      - file: "Agent04_FlowSystems.ttl"
        status: "READY"
        format: "Turtle RDF"
        
      - file: "Agent04_HypergraphNodes.json"
        status: "READY"
        format: "JSON"
        
      - file: "Agent04_HypergraphSuggestions.json"
        status: "READY"
        format: "JSON"
        
      - file: "Agent04_SPARQLQueries.rq"
        status: "READY"
        format: "SPARQL"
        
    interface_compatibility:
      rdf_compatible: true
      sparql_queryable: true
      hypergraph_constructible: true
      
    recommended_next_steps:
      - "Agent-05加载RDF数据到三元组存储"

      - "构建超图数据结构"
      - "执行拓扑网络耦合分析"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 结论
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  conclusion: |
    Agent-04 v2.2 流动模型建模师已完成全部建模任务，
    完全对齐FSO (Flow Systems Ontology)本体框架。
    
    核心创新：
    1. 采用RDF三元组数据模型，支持语义网技术

    3. 实现换热器双组件模型，正确处理流体边界

    提供了完整的RDF数据文件、SPARQL查询接口和超图构建指引。
    
    模型质量评分: 97.7分 (优秀)

## 二、详细对比分析

### 2.1 数据模型架构对比

```yaml
Architecture_Comparison:

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 核心架构差异
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  v2.1_Architecture:
    paradigm: "层次化配置模型"
    structure:
      - "三层流动架构 (物质流/能量流/信息流)"
      - "介质物理属性模型"
      - "流动路径序列定义"
      - "守恒方程模型"
      - "载体-荷载耦合方程"
    
    representation: |
      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
      │  Flow_Classification                    │
      │  ├── mass_flows[]                       │
      │  │   ├── flow_type_id                   │
      │  │   ├── properties[]                   │
      │  │   └── energy_coupling{}              │
      │  ├── energy_flows[]                     │
      │  └── information_flows[]                │
      ├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
      │  Flow_Path_Models                       │
      │  ├── path_id                            │
      │  ├── sequence[]  (step-by-step)         │
      │  │   ├── node_id                        │
      │  │   ├── equipment_ref                  │
      │  │   └── parameters{}                   │
      │  └── operating_conditions{}             │
      └─────────────────────────────────────────┘
      
  v2.2_Architecture:
    paradigm: "语义网本体模型"
    structure:
      - "FSO类层次结构"
      - "RDF三元组关系"
      - "SPARQL查询接口"
      - "超图拓扑结构"
    
    representation: |
      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
      │  RDF Triple Store                       │
      │  ┌───────────────────────────────────┐  │
      │  │ Subject ──Predicate──► Object     │  │
      │  │                                   │  │
      │  │ inst:Chiller-1                    │  │
      │  │   ├── a fso:EnergyConversionDevice│  │
      │  │   ├── fso:suppliesFluidTo ...     │  │
      │  │   └── ex:thermalPower "2000"      │  │
      │  └───────────────────────────────────┘  │
      ├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
      │  Hypergraph Structure                   │
      │  ├── Nodes: {Systems, Components}       │
      │  ├── Binary Edges: {fso:properties}     │
      │  └── Hyperedges: {Composition, Loop}    │
      └─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

        - "难以与外部知识库链接"
        
    query_capability:

        - "复杂拓扑查询困难"
        
    graph_topology:
      description: "图拓扑表达不直接"
      details:
        - "序列化路径不适合图算法"
        - "循环/分支表达复杂"
        - "不支持超图概念"
        
    reasoning_capability:
      description: "缺乏推理能力"

  # Version 2.2 优缺点
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  v2.2_Pros:
    
    semantic_standards:
      description: "符合语义网标准"
      details:
        - "RDF/OWL标准格式"
        - "URI唯一标识"
        - "可与全球知识图谱链接"
        - "支持SPARQL标准查询"
        
    ontology_alignment:
      description: "本体对齐完整"
      details:
        - "完全对齐FSO本体"
        - "与BOT/SAREF/BRICK兼容"
        - "支持本体推理"
      example: |
        # 本体对齐
        fso:System → s4syst:System
        fso:Component → s4bldg:DistributionFlowDevice
        fso:connectedWith → s4syst:connectedTo
        
    graph_topology:
      description: "图拓扑表达自然"
      details:

        - "支持路径查询(Property Path)"
        - "支持超图扩展"
      example: |

      details:

        - "系统级连接自动推断"
      example: |
        # 属性链推理

Fusion_Architecture:
  
  name: "Agent-04 v3.0 - Unified Flow Model"
  subtitle: "工程参数与语义拓扑的统一框架"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 核心设计理念
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  design_principles:
    
    - principle: "双层数据模型"
      description: |
        采用两层数据模型架构：
        - 语义层(Semantic Layer): RDF本体模型，处理拓扑关系和语义推理
        - 工程层(Engineering Layer): 参数化模型，处理物理属性和工程计算
        
    - principle: "本体优先，参数附加"
      description: |
        以FSO本体为骨架建立拓扑结构，
        将v2.1的工程参数作为数据属性附加到本体实例上
        
    - principle: "双向兼容"
      description: |
        - 可导出为纯YAML配置(v2.1兼容)
        - 可导出为纯RDF三元组(v2.2兼容)
        - 原生格式为增强型RDF+JSON-LD
        
    - principle: "渐进增强"
      description: |
        - 基础功能不依赖推理引擎
        - 高级功能启用语义推理
        - 超图分析为可选增强

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 融合架构图
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  architecture_diagram: |
    
    ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
    ║                    Agent-04 v3.0 统一流动模型架构                          ║
    ╠═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
    ║                                                                           ║
    ║  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  ║
    ║  │                        应用接口层                                    │  ║
    ║  │  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐   │  ║

    ║  │  │超图拓扑 │  │ 控制   │  │ 计量   │  │  工具  │  │  工具  │   │  ║
    ║  │  └────┬────┘  └────┬────┘  └────┬────┘  └────┬────┘  └────┬────┘   │  ║
    ║  └───────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────┘  ║

### 3.2 统一数据模式定义

```yaml
Unified_Data_Schema:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 命名空间统一
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  namespaces:
    # 标准本体 (from v2.2)
    fso: "https://w3id.org/fso#"
    bot: "https://w3id.org/bot#"
    s4bldg: "https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg#"
    s4syst: "https://saref.etsi.org/saref4syst#"
    
    # 扩展本体 (融合新增)
    fso-eng: "https://w3id.org/fso-engineering#"  # 工程参数扩展
    fso-med: "https://w3id.org/fso-medical#"      # 医疗建筑扩展
    
    # 项目实例
    inst: "https://hospital.example.com/inst#"
    
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 类扩展定义 (工程参数承载)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  extended_classes:
    
    # 介质类扩展 (融合v2.1物理属性)
    fso-eng_Medium:
      parent: "fso:Component"  # 作为流动系统的隐式组件
      label: "流动介质"
      properties:
        # 基本物理属性
        - fso-eng:density
        - fso-eng:specificHeat
        - fso-eng:thermalConductivity
        - fso-eng:dynamicViscosity
        # 状态参数
        - fso-eng:temperature
        - fso-eng:pressure
        # 工程换算系数
        - fso-eng:energyConversionFactor
        
    # 流动类型扩展 (融合v2.1三层分类)
    fso-eng_FlowType:
      subclasses:
        - fso-eng:MassFlow
        - fso-eng:EnergyFlow
        - fso-eng:InformationFlow
        
    # 耦合关系类 (融合v2.1载体-荷载)
    fso-eng_CarrierPayloadCoupling:
      label: "载体-荷载耦合"
      properties:
        - fso-eng:carrier      # 指向介质
        - fso-eng:payload      # 指向能量类型
        - fso-eng:couplingEquation  # 耦合方程(字符串)
        - fso-eng:couplingFactor    # 换算系数

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 属性扩展定义 (工程参数)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  extended_properties:
    
    # 物理属性 (from v2.1)
    datatype_properties:
      
      # 通用流动参数
      - uri: "fso-eng:volumeFlowRate"
        label: "体积流量"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "m³/h"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:massFlowRate"
        label: "质量流量"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "kg/s"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:velocity"
        label: "流速"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "m/s"
        
      # 热力参数
      - uri: "fso-eng:supplyTemperature"
        label: "供给温度"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "°C"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:returnTemperature"
        label: "回流温度"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "°C"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:deltaT"
        label: "温差"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "°C"
        derived_from: "supplyTemperature - returnTemperature"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:thermalPower"
        label: "热功率"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "kW"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:coolingCapacity"
        label: "制冷量"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "kW"
        
      # 压力参数
      - uri: "fso-eng:pressure"
        label: "压力"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "kPa"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:pressureDrop"
        label: "压降"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "kPa"
        
      # 电气参数
      - uri: "fso-eng:electricalPower"
        label: "电功率"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "kW"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:voltage"
        label: "电压"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "V"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:powerFactor"
        label: "功率因数"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        
      # 效率参数
      - uri: "fso-eng:COP"
        label: "性能系数"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:efficiency"
        label: "效率"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        
      # 介质物性 (from v2.1 Medium Models)
      - uri: "fso-eng:density"
        label: "密度"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "kg/m³"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:specificHeat"
        label: "比热容"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "kJ/(kg·K)"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:thermalConductivity"
        label: "导热系数"
        range: "xsd:decimal"
        unit: "W/(m·K)"

    # 流动路径序列属性 (融合v2.1路径定义)
    object_properties:
      
      - uri: "fso-eng:hasFlowSequence"
        label: "流动序列"
        domain: "fso:System"
        range: "fso-eng:FlowSequence"
        description: "系统包含的有序流动序列"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:hasStep"
        label: "包含步骤"
        domain: "fso-eng:FlowSequence"
        range: "fso-eng:FlowStep"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:stepOrder"
        label: "步骤顺序"
        domain: "fso-eng:FlowStep"
        range: "xsd:integer"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:stepComponent"
        label: "步骤组件"
        domain: "fso-eng:FlowStep"
        range: "fso:Component"
        
      - uri: "fso-eng:hasCoupling"
        label: "具有耦合"
        domain: "fso:Component"
        range: "fso-eng:CarrierPayloadCoupling"
```

### 3.3 融合Turtle示例

```turtle
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Agent-04 v3.0 融合版本 - 冷冻水系统示例
# Unified Flow Model - Chilled Water System Example
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix fso: <https://w3id.org/fso#> .
@prefix fso-eng: <https://w3id.org/fso-engineering#> .
@prefix bot: <https://w3id.org/bot#> .
@prefix inst: <https://hospital.example.com/inst#> .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 介质定义 (融合v2.1物理属性模型)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

inst:ChilledWater a fso-eng:Medium ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水"@zh ;
    rdfs:label "Chilled Water"@en ;
    # 物理属性 (from v2.1)
    fso-eng:density "998"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:specificHeat "4.186"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:thermalConductivity "0.598"^^xsd:decimal ;
    # 工程换算系数 (from v2.1)
    fso-eng:energyConversionFactor "1.163"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:conversionNote "Q(kW) = V̇(m³/h) × ΔT(°C) × 1.163" .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 系统定义 (融合v2.2本体结构 + v2.1系统参数)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

inst:ChilledWaterSystem a fso:System ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水系统"@zh ;
    
    # FSO结构关系 (from v2.2)
    fso:hasSubSystem inst:CHW-SupplySystem, inst:CHW-ReturnSystem ;
    fso:hasSourceComponent inst:Chiller-1 ;
    fso:hasConsumerComponent inst:AHU-OR-01 ;
    
    # 介质关联
    fso-eng:hasMedium inst:ChilledWater ;
    
    # 设计参数 (from v2.1)
    fso-eng:supplyTemperature "7.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:returnTemperature "12.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:deltaT "5.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:designFlowRate "1400.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:designCapacity "8141.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:capacityCalculation "1400 × 5 × 1.163 = 8141 kW" ;
    
    # 双系统分类 (from v2.2)
    fso-eng:systemType fso-eng:CirculationSystem ;
    
    # 流动序列 (融合v2.1路径定义)
    fso-eng:hasFlowSequence inst:CHW-FlowSequence .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 流动序列定义 (将v2.1的step序列融入v2.2)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

inst:CHW-FlowSequence a fso-eng:FlowSequence ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水供给序列"@zh ;
    fso-eng:sequenceType "SupplyPath" ;
    fso-eng:hasStep 
        inst:CHW-Step-01,
        inst:CHW-Step-02,
        inst:CHW-Step-03,
        inst:CHW-Step-04,
        inst:CHW-Step-05 .

inst:CHW-Step-01 a fso-eng:FlowStep ;
    fso-eng:stepOrder "1"^^xsd:integer ;
    fso-eng:stepComponent inst:Chiller-1 ;
    fso-eng:stepAction "generate" ;
    fso-eng:stepNote "冷水机组制取冷冻水" .

inst:CHW-Step-02 a fso-eng:FlowStep ;
    fso-eng:stepOrder "2"^^xsd:integer ;
    fso-eng:stepComponent inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1 ;
    fso-eng:stepAction "pressurize" ;
    fso-eng:stepNote "一次泵加压" .

inst:CHW-Step-03 a fso-eng:FlowStep ;
    fso-eng:stepOrder "3"^^xsd:integer ;
    fso-eng:stepComponent inst:Header-CHW-Supply ;
    fso-eng:stepAction "distribute" ;
    fso-eng:stepNote "供水分水器" .

inst:CHW-Step-04 a fso-eng:FlowStep ;
    fso-eng:stepOrder "4"^^xsd:integer ;
    fso-eng:stepComponent inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1 ;
    fso-eng:stepAction "pressurize" ;
    fso-eng:stepNote "二次泵变频加压" .

inst:CHW-Step-05 a fso-eng:FlowStep ;
    fso-eng:stepOrder "5"^^xsd:integer ;
    fso-eng:stepComponent inst:AHU-OR-01 ;
    fso-eng:stepAction "consume" ;
    fso-eng:stepNote "末端换热消耗冷量" .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 组件定义 (融合两版本)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

inst:Chiller-1 a fso:EnergyConversionDevice ;
    rdfs:label "1#离心式冷水机组"@zh ;
    
    # FSO拓扑关系 (from v2.2)
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem, inst:CHW-ReturnSystem ;
    fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pipe-CHW-S-Main ;
    fso:transfersHeatTo inst:CoolingTower-1 ;
    
    # 设备类型关联 (from v2.1 Agent-03映射)
    fso-eng:equipmentRef "EQP-CH-CENT" ;
    
    # 工程参数 (from v2.1)
    fso-eng:thermalPower "2000.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:electricalPower "400.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:COP "5.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    
    # 载体-荷载耦合 (from v2.1)
    fso-eng:hasCoupling inst:Chiller-1-EvapCoupling .

inst:Chiller-1-EvapCoupling a fso-eng:CarrierPayloadCoupling ;
    rdfs:label "冷水机组蒸发器侧水-冷量耦合"@zh ;
    fso-eng:carrier inst:ChilledWater ;
    fso-eng:payload fso-eng:CoolingEnergy ;
    fso-eng:couplingEquation "Q = V̇ × ΔT × 1.163" ;
    fso-eng:couplingFactor "1.163"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:volumeFlowRate "350.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:supplyTemperature "7.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:returnTemperature "12.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:thermalPower "2035.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:calculationVerification "350 × 5 × 1.163 = 2035 kW" .

inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1 a fso:FlowMovingDevice ;
    rdfs:label "1#冷冻水一次泵"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem ;
    fso:hasFluidFedBy inst:Pipe-CHW-S-Main ;
    fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Header-CHW-Supply ;
    fso-eng:equipmentRef "EQP-PUMP-CHW" ;
    fso-eng:volumeFlowRate "400.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:electricalPower "45.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:controlMode "定流量" .

inst:Header-CHW-Supply a fso:Fitting ;
    rdfs:label "冷冻水供水集分水器"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem ;
    fso:hasFluidFedBy inst:Pump-CHW-Pri-1 ;
    fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1, inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-2 .

inst:Pump-CHW-Sec-1 a fso:FlowMovingDevice ;
    rdfs:label "1#冷冻水二次泵"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem ;
    fso:hasFluidFedBy inst:Header-CHW-Supply ;
    fso:suppliesFluidTo inst:Pipe-CHW-S-Riser-OR ;
    fso-eng:equipmentRef "EQP-PUMP-CHW" ;
    fso-eng:volumeFlowRate "600.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:electricalPower "55.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:controlMode "变频-压差控制" .

inst:AHU-OR-01 a fso:Terminal ;
    rdfs:label "手术室空调机组-01"@zh ;
    fso:isComponentOf inst:CHW-SupplySystem, inst:CHW-ReturnSystem ;
    fso:hasFluidSuppliedBy inst:Pipe-CHW-S-Riser-OR ;
    fso:returnsFluidTo inst:Pipe-CHW-R-Riser-OR ;
    fso:transfersHeatTo inst:Room-OR-01 ;
    
    # 空间关联 (from v2.2 BOT对齐)
    bot:containedIn inst:Room-OR-01 ;
    
    # 工程参数 (from v2.1)
    fso-eng:equipmentRef "EQP-AHU-CLEAN" ;
    fso-eng:thermalPower "200.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:volumeFlowRate "15.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    
    # 水侧耦合参数
    fso-eng:hasCoupling inst:AHU-OR-01-WaterCoupling .

inst:AHU-OR-01-WaterCoupling a fso-eng:CarrierPayloadCoupling ;
    fso-eng:carrier inst:ChilledWater ;
    fso-eng:payload fso-eng:CoolingEnergy ;
    fso-eng:volumeFlowRate "15.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:supplyTemperature "7.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:returnTemperature "12.0"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:thermalPower "87.2"^^xsd:decimal ;
    fso-eng:calculationVerification "15 × 5 × 1.163 = 87.2 kW" .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 空间与服务关系 (融合两版本)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

inst:Room-OR-01 a bot:Space ;
    rdfs:label "1#手术室"@zh ;

    fso-eng:humidityTolerance "5.0"^^xsd:decimal ;

inst:ChilledWaterSystem fso-eng:servesSpace inst:Room-OR-01 .

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    fso-eng:consumerEnergy "1985.0"^^xsd:decimal ; # 末端消耗总和
    fso-eng:pipelineLoss "50.0"^^xsd:decimal ;    # 管路热增益
