## 系统补充1：特种医用气体系统 (CO2/Argon/N2)

```yaml
Special_Medical_Gas_Systems:
  
  system_id: "MGAS-SPECIAL"
  system_name: "特种医用气体系统"
  description: "除O2/VAC/AIR/N2O外的特殊医用气体"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 医用二氧化碳系统 (CO2)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  Medical_CO2_System:
    
    system_id: "MGAS-CO2"
    system_name: "医用二氧化碳系统"
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 应用场景
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    applications:
      
      - application: "腹腔镜手术气腹"
        spaces: ["手术室-腹腔镜", "手术室-妇科", "手术室-普外"]
        consumption: "高"
        pressure: "依气腹机要求"
        purity: "≥99.5%"
        
      - application: "内镜充气"
        spaces: ["内镜中心"]
        consumption: "中"
        pressure: "低压"
        
      - application: "心脏手术吹气"
        spaces: ["手术室-心外"]
        consumption: "低"
        purpose: "术野排气/防栓塞"
        
      - application: "冷冻治疗"
        spaces: ["皮肤科", "妇科"]
        consumption: "低"
        form: "干冰或液态"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 气源配置
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    gas_source:
      
      option_1:
        type: "钢瓶汇流排"
        description: "小规模应用"
        configuration:
          cylinder_type: "40L高压钢瓶"
          pressure: "15 MPa"
          manifold: "双组自动切换"
          capacity: "10+10瓶"
          location: "气瓶间 (独立)"
        advantages: "投资低、灵活"
        disadvantages: "需频繁换瓶"
        
      option_2:
        type: "液态CO2储罐"
        description: "大规模应用"
        configuration:
          tank_type: "低温储罐"
          capacity: "1-3 t"
          pressure: "1.5-2.0 MPa"
          vaporizer: "空温式汽化器"
          location: "室外液态气体区"
        advantages: "供气稳定、换瓶少"
        disadvantages: "投资较高"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 管道系统
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    piping_system:
      
      material: "紫铜管或不锈钢管"
      cleaning: "脱脂处理"
      
      pressure_regulation:
        source_pressure: "1.5-2.0 MPa"
        distribution_pressure: "0.8-1.0 MPa"
        terminal_pressure: "0.4-0.5 MPa"
        
      distribution:
        main_pipe: "DN25-DN32"
        branch_pipe: "DN15-DN20"
        terminal_pipe: "DN10"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 终端配置
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    terminal_configuration:
      
      terminal_type: "CO2专用终端"
      color_code: "灰色"
      connector: "专用接头 (防误接)"
      
      locations:
        - space_type: "腹腔镜手术室"
          terminals_per_room: 1
          mounting: "设备塔/墙装"
          
        - space_type: "内镜检查室"
          terminals_per_room: 1
          mounting: "墙装"
          
        - space_type: "心外手术室"
          terminals_per_room: 1
          mounting: "设备塔"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 安全要求
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    safety_requirements:
      
      storage_room:
        ventilation: "≥6次/h"
        alarm: "CO2浓度监测"
        threshold: "0.5% (TWA)"
        
      usage_area:
        monitoring: "可选CO2监测"
        note: "密闭空间需考虑"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 医用氩气系统 (Argon)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  Medical_Argon_System:
    
    system_id: "MGAS-ARGON"
    system_name: "医用氩气系统"
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 应用场景
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    applications:
      
      - application: "氩气刀 (氩离子凝固)"
        spaces: ["手术室", "内镜中心"]
        equipment: "氩气高频电刀"
        consumption: "中等"
        purity: "≥99.99%"
        
      - application: "氩氦刀 (冷冻消融)"
        spaces: ["介入手术室", "肿瘤科"]
        equipment: "氩氦刀系统"
        consumption: "高 (液氩)"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 气源配置
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    gas_source:
      
      argon_knife:
        type: "钢瓶供应"
        configuration:
          cylinder_type: "40L高压钢瓶"
          pressure: "15 MPa"
          manifold: "2+2瓶汇流排"
          location: "手术部气瓶间"
          
      cryoablation:
        type: "液氩杜瓦罐"
        configuration:
          capacity: "180L"
          quantity: "每台设备配2罐"
          storage: "设备机房"
          note: "移动式，定期更换"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 管道系统
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    piping_system:
      
      material: "不锈钢管 (高纯气体)"
      welding: "氩弧焊"
      cleaning: "高纯脱脂"
      
      distribution:
        main_pipe: "DN15-DN20"
        terminal_pipe: "DN10"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 终端配置
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    terminal_configuration:
      
      terminal_type: "氩气专用终端"
      
      locations:
        - space_type: "手术室 (配氩气刀)"
          terminals_per_room: 1
          
        - space_type: "内镜中心 (配氩气刀)"
          terminals_per_room: 1

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 医用氮气系统 (N2)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  Medical_Nitrogen_System:
    
    system_id: "MGAS-N2"
    system_name: "医用氮气系统"
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 应用场景
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    applications:
      
      - application: "手术气动设备驱动"
        spaces: ["手术室"]
        equipment: "气动骨钻、锯"
        note: "替代压缩空气"
        pressure: "0.7 MPa"
        
      - application: "液氮冷冻治疗"
        spaces: ["皮肤科", "妇科", "眼科"]
        form: "液态氮"
        storage: "杜瓦罐"
        note: "一般不管道供应"
        
      - application: "样本冷冻保存"
        spaces: ["检验科", "生殖中心", "病理科"]
        form: "液态氮"
        equipment: "液氮罐"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 气源配置
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    gas_source:
      
      gaseous_n2:
        application: "手术气动设备"
        type: "钢瓶汇流排或液氮储罐"
        configuration:
          option_1: "高压钢瓶组"
          option_2: "液氮储罐+汽化器"
          location: "室外气体站"
          
      liquid_n2:
        application: "冷冻保存"
        type: "移动式杜瓦罐"
        capacity: "30-50L"
        supply: "定期外购补充"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 液氮安全
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    liquid_nitrogen_safety:
      
      storage:
        ventilation: "良好通风"
        alarm: "氧浓度监测"
        threshold: "<19.5%报警"
        
      handling:
        ppe: "防冻手套、护目镜"
        training: "操作培训"
        
      room_requirements:
        for_liquid_n2_storage:
          ventilation: "≥10次/h"
          floor: "防滑"
          door: "外开"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 特种气体空间服务矩阵
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  Special_Gas_Space_Matrix:
    
    matrix:
      - space: "腹腔镜手术室"
        co2: "✓ (气腹)"
        argon: "○ (可选)"
        n2: "○ (可选)"
        
      - space: "心外手术室"
        co2: "✓ (吹气)"
        argon: "-"
        n2: "○"
        
      - space: "内镜中心"
        co2: "✓ (充气)"
        argon: "○ (氩气刀)"
        n2: "-"
        
      - space: "介入手术室"
        co2: "-"
        argon: "✓ (氩氦刀)"
        n2: "-"
        
      - space: "皮肤科治疗室"
        co2: "-"
        argon: "-"
        n2: "✓ (液氮冷冻)"
        
      - space: "生殖中心"
        co2: "-"
        argon: "-"
        n2: "✓ (样本保存)"
        
    legend:
      "✓": "必须配置"

## 系统补充2：精密冷却系统

```yaml
Precision_Cooling_Systems:
  
  system_id: "HVAC-PCW"
  system_name: "精密冷却系统"
  description: "为精密医疗设备提供稳定冷却的专用系统"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统概述
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_overview:
    
    purpose: |
      为对温度敏感的大型医疗设备提供精确、稳定的冷却，
      区别于舒适性空调系统，强调温度精度和可靠性。
      
    characteristics:
      - "温度精度: ±0.5°C ~ ±1°C"
      - "连续运行: 24/7"
      - "高可靠性: N+1冗余"
      - "独立系统: 与舒适空调分离"
      
    applicable_equipment:
      - "CT扫描仪"
      - "MRI扫描仪"
      - "直线加速器"
      - "PET-CT"
      - "DSA血管机"
      - "体外循环机"
      - "伽玛刀"
      - "大型检验设备"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统类型
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_types:
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 精密空调系统
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    precision_air_conditioning:
      
      type_id: "PAC"
      type_name: "精密空调"
      
      applications:
        - "CT设备室"
        - "MRI设备室"
        - "直线加速器机房"
        - "数据中心"
        
      specifications:
        temperature_control: "±1°C"
        humidity_control: "±5%"
        filtration: "G4+F8"
        sensible_heat_ratio: ">0.9"
        
      configurations:
        
        wind_cooled:
          type: "风冷型精密空调"
          indoor: "室内机"
          outdoor: "室外冷凝器"
          capacity_range: "10-100 kW"
          advantages: "安装简单"
          
        water_cooled:
          type: "水冷型精密空调"
          cooling_source: "冷冻水/冷却水"
          capacity_range: "20-150 kW"
          advantages: "效率高、噪声低"
          
        chilled_water:
          type: "冷冻水型精密空调"
          cooling_source: "中央冷冻水"

## 系统补充3：医疗废水处理系统

```yaml
Medical_Wastewater_Treatment_System:
  
  system_id: "PLUMB-MWT"
  system_name: "医疗废水处理系统"
  description: "医院特殊废水的收集、预处理和处理系统"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 医疗废水分类
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  wastewater_classification:
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 传染性废水
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    infectious_wastewater:
      
      source_spaces:
        - "负压隔离病房"
        - "发热门诊"
        - "肠道门诊"
        - "结核病房"
        - "传染科病房"
        
      characteristics:
        pathogen: "致病微生物"
        risk_level: "高"
        
      treatment_requirement:
        type: "消毒预处理"
        method: "含氯消毒"
        chlorine_dose: "50-100 mg/L"
        contact_time: "≥1.5h"
        residual_chlorine: "≥0.5 mg/L"
        
      collection:
        separate_drain: true
        material: "HDPE或不锈钢"
        pretreatment_tank: "消毒池"
        capacity: "8h污水量"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 化学性废水
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    chemical_wastewater:
      
      subtypes:
        
        - type: "检验废水"
          source: "检验科"
          contaminants:
            - "有机溶剂"
            - "酸碱试剂"
            - "重金属"
          treatment:
            type: "分类收集+预处理"
            acid_base: "中和处理"
            heavy_metal: "沉淀处理"
            organic: "活性炭吸附"
            
        - type: "病理废水"
          source: "病理科"
          contaminants:
            - "甲醛"
            - "二甲苯"
            - "乙醇"
          treatment:
            type: "分类收集"
            organic_solvent: "专业回收"
            formaldehyde: "氧化分解"
            
        - type: "影像废水"
          source: "放射科 (胶片冲洗)"
          contaminants:
            - "银"
            - "显影液"
            - "定影液"
          treatment:
            type: "银回收"
            method: "电解回收或化学沉淀"
          note: "DR普及后已减少"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 放射性废水
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    radioactive_wastewater:
      
      source_spaces:
        - "核医学科"
        - "PET中心"
        - "放射性药物配制室"
        
      characteristics:
        isotopes: "I-131, Tc-99m, F-18等"
        activity: "低放射性"
        
      treatment_requirement:
        type: "衰变池"
        principle: "存储衰变"
        
      衰变池设计:
        capacity: "180天排放量"
        compartments: "≥3格"
        shielding: "混凝土屏蔽"
        monitoring: "出水放射性检测"
        discharge_limit: "≤10倍本底"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 透析废水
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    dialysis_wastewater:
      
      source: "血液透析室"
      
      characteristics:
        volume: "200-300 L/h/台"
        contaminants:
          - "有机物"
          - "残余消毒剂"
          - "血液微量"
        temperature: "常温"
        
      treatment:
        option_1: "直排医院污水系统"
        option_2: "预处理后排放"
        note: "水量大，一般直排"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 口腔科废水
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    dental_wastewater:
      
      source: "口腔科"
      
      characteristics:
        contaminants:
          - "汞 (银汞合金)"
          - "血液"
          - "消毒剂"
          
      treatment:
        type: "汞分离器"
        efficiency: "≥95%"
        location: "治疗台排水口"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 医疗废水处理站
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  wastewater_treatment_station:
    
    description: "医院集中污水处理站"
    
    treatment_process:
      
      stage_1:
        name: "格栅调节"
        components:
          - "机械格栅"
          - "调节池"
        purpose: "去除大块固体、均化水质"
        
      stage_2:
        name: "消毒预处理"
        method: "次氯酸钠消毒"
        dose: "30-50 mg/L有效氯"
        contact_time: "≥1h"
        purpose: "杀灭病原微生物"
        
      stage_3:
        name: "生化处理"
        options:
          - type: "A/O工艺"
            description: "厌氧-好氧"
          - type: "MBR工艺"
            description: "膜生物反应器"
        purpose: "去除有机物、氨氮"
        
      stage_4:
        name: "深度处理"
        components:
          - "过滤"
          - "消毒"
        purpose: "确保达标排放"
        
      stage_5:
        name: "污泥处理"
        method: "脱水+危废处置"
        
    discharge_standard:
      standard: "GB 18466-2005"
      level: "预处理标准或排放标准"
      note: "排入城市污水管网可执行预处理标准"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 空间-废水系统映射
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  space_wastewater_mapping:
    
    - space_type: "负压隔离病房"
      wastewater_type: "传染性废水"
      separate_drain: true
      pretreatment: "消毒池"
      
    - space_type: "检验科"
      wastewater_type: "化学废水"
      separate_drain: true
      pretreatment: "分类预处理"
      
    - space_type: "核医学科"
      wastewater_type: "放射性废水"
      separate_drain: true
      pretreatment: "衰变池"
      
    - space_type: "血液透析室"
      wastewater_type: "透析废水"
      separate_drain: false
      note: "量大，直排污水系统"
      
    - space_type: "口腔科"
      wastewater_type: "含汞废水"
      treatment: "汞分离器"
      
    - space_type: "内镜清洗室"
      wastewater_type: "化学废水"
      contaminants: "消毒剂"
      pretreatment: "中和处理"
      
    - space_type: "供应室"
      wastewater_type: "高温废水"
      temperature: "可达100°C"
      treatment: "冷却后排放"
```

## 系统补充5：医用IT系统（隔离电源）

```yaml
Medical_IT_System:
  
  system_id: "ELEC-IT"
  system_name: "医用IT系统（隔离电源）"
  description: "为手术室等关键医疗区域提供安全隔离电源"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统概述
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_overview:
    
    purpose: |
      采用不接地供电系统(IT系统)，即使发生单相接地故障，
      系统仍可继续运行，同时配合绝缘监测报警，
      确保手术等关键医疗过程不中断。
      
    standards:
      - "IEC 60364-7-710"
      - "GB 16895.24"
      - "JGJ 312 (医疗建筑电气设计规范)"
      
    applicable_spaces:
      - space: "手术室"
        requirement: "必须"
      - space: "ICU"
        requirement: "必须"
      - space: "CCU"
        requirement: "必须"
      - space: "导管室"
        requirement: "必须"
      - space: "血液透析室"
        requirement: "推荐"
      - space: "分娩室"
        requirement: "推荐"
      - space: "早产儿室"
        requirement: "推荐"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统组成
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_components:
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 医用隔离变压器
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    isolation_transformer:
      
      type: "医用隔离变压器"
      
      specifications:
        input: "380V/220V (TN-S系统)"
        output: "230V (IT系统)"
        capacity_range: "3.15-10 kVA"
        typical_capacities:
          - "3.15 kVA (小型手术室)"
          - "5 kVA (中型手术室)"
          - "8 kVA (大型手术室)"
          - "10 kVA (杂交手术室)"
          
      technical_requirements:
        insulation: "双重绝缘"
        coupling_capacitance: "≤500 pF"
        temperature_rise: "≤75K"
        leakage_current: "≤0.5 mA"
        
      configuration:
        primary: "接地 (TN-S)"
        secondary: "不接地 (IT)"
        shield: "静电屏蔽层"
        
      installation:
        location: "手术室配电间或邻近设备间"
        environment: "干燥、通风"
        access: "便于维护"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 绝缘监测装置
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    insulation_monitor:
      
      type: "绝缘监测仪 (IMD)"
      
      function: |
        实时监测IT系统对地绝缘电阻，
        当绝缘电阻降至设定值以下时发出报警。
        
      specifications:
        monitoring_voltage: "AC 230V"
        alarm_threshold: "50 kΩ (可调)"
        response_time: "≤5s"
        measuring_current: "≤1 mA DC"
        
      alarm_outputs:
        visual: "黄色指示灯"
        audible: "蜂鸣器"
        remote: "干接点输出至BA系统"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 外接报警显示
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    remote_alarm_display:
      
      type: "外接报警和显示装置"
      
      installation_location: "手术室内醒目位置"
      
      displays:
        - "IT系统电压"
        - "绝缘电阻值"
        - "变压器负载率"
        - "变压器温度"
        
      alarms:
        - event: "绝缘电阻低"
          indicator: "黄灯+蜂鸣"
        - event: "过负载"
          indicator: "红灯+蜂鸣"
        - event: "超温"
          indicator: "红灯+蜂鸣"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 等电位联结
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    equipotential_bonding:
      
      description: "局部等电位联结"
      
      requirements:
        - "手术台、设备外壳、金属管道等均需联结"
        - "联结导体截面 ≥6 mm² Cu"
        - "等电位端子排设置在手术室内"
        - "联结电阻 ≤0.2 Ω"
        
      bonding_points:
        - "手术台"
        - "手术灯"
        - "吊塔/设备柱"
        - "医用气体终端"
        - "金属门框"
        - "金属管道"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 配电设计
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  distribution_design:
    
    it_system_loads:
      description: "仅关键医疗设备接入IT系统"
      typical_loads:
        - "手术灯"
        - "监护仪"
        - "电刀"
        - "麻醉机"
        - "显微镜"
        - "其他直接用于病人的设备"
        
    non_it_loads:
      description: "非关键设备使用普通TN-S供电"
      typical_loads:
        - "一般照明"
        - "空调设备"
        - "观片灯"
        - "对讲设备"
        
    outlet_identification:
      it_outlets:
        color: "绿色面板"
        label: "IT系统"
        quantity: "依手术室大小，10-20个"
      normal_outlets:
        color: "白色面板"
        label: "普通电源"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 空间配置标准
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  space_configuration_standards:
    
    - space_type: "普通手术室"
      transformer_capacity: "5 kVA"
      it_outlets: 12
      insulation_monitor: 1
      remote_display: 1
      
    - space_type: "大型手术室"
      transformer_capacity: "8 kVA"
      it_outlets: 16
      insulation_monitor: 1
      remote_display: 1
      
    - space_type: "杂交手术室"
      transformer_capacity: "10 kVA"
      it_outlets: 20
      insulation_monitor: 1
      remote_display: 1
      note: "另需普通电源供大型影像设备"
      
    - space_type: "ICU单元"
      configuration: "每2-3床共用一套"
      transformer_capacity: "5 kVA"
      it_outlets: "每床4-6个"
      
    - space_type: "分娩室"
      transformer_capacity: "3.15 kVA"
      it_outlets: 8
```

## 系统补充6：医用气体多源供应系统

```yaml
Medical_Gas_Multi_Source_System:
  
  system_id: "MGAS-MULTI"
  system_name: "医用气体多源供应系统"
  description: "关键医用气体的主备源切换与安全保障"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统设计原则
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  design_principles:
    
    - principle: "双源供应"
      description: "关键气体必须有主备两套气源"
      
    - principle: "自动切换"
      description: "主源故障时自动切换至备源"
      
    - principle: "不间断供应"
      description: "切换过程不影响终端供气"
      
    - principle: "分级保障"
      description: "不同区域不同保障级别"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 医用氧气多源系统
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  oxygen_multi_source:
    
    system_id: "MGAS-O2-MULTI"
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 三源供应方案
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    three_source_configuration:
      
      primary_source:
        type: "液氧储罐系统"
        description: "主供气源"
        components:
          - "液氧储罐 (5-20 m³)"
          - "空温式汽化器"
          - "调压阀组"
        capacity: "满足7-15天用量"
        location: "室外液氧站"
        auto_refill: "液位低自动通知供应商"
        
      secondary_source:
        type: "氧气汇流排"
        description: "备用气源/调峰"
        components:
          - "高压钢瓶组 (10+10或20+20)"
          - "自动切换汇流排"
          - "减压调节阀组"
        capacity: "满足24-48小时用量"
        location: "氧气汇流排间"
        auto_switch: "液氧压力低时自动投入"
        
      emergency_source:
        type: "应急钢瓶组"
        description: "最后保障"
        components:
          - "独立钢瓶 (2-4瓶)"
          - "手动切换装置"
        location: "手术部/ICU就近"
        activation: "手动投入"
        purpose: "极端紧急情况"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 自动切换逻辑
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    automatic_switching:
      
      normal_operation:
        active: "液氧系统"
        standby: "汇流排系统"
        
      switching_triggers:
        - trigger: "液氧压力 < 0.6 MPa"
          action: "切换至汇流排"
          alarm: "主源低压报警"
          
        - trigger: "液氧液位 < 20%"
          action: "预警通知补液"
          
        - trigger: "汇流排一组用完"
          action: "自动切换至另一组"
          alarm: "钢瓶更换提醒"
          
      switching_requirements:
        time: "≤3s"
        pressure_fluctuation: "≤10%"
        interruption: "无"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 分区供应
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    zone_supply:
      
      - zone: "手术部"
        priority: "最高"
        zone_valve: "ZONE-O2-OR"
        emergency_backup: "有"
        
      - zone: "ICU"
        priority: "最高"
        zone_valve: "ZONE-O2-ICU"
        emergency_backup: "有"
        
      - zone: "急诊"
        priority: "高"
        zone_valve: "ZONE-O2-ER"
        
      - zone: "病房楼"
        priority: "中"
        zone_valve: "ZONE-O2-WARD"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 负压吸引多源系统
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  vacuum_multi_source:
    
    system_id: "MGAS-VAC-MULTI"
    
    configuration:
      
      primary_system:
        type: "液环真空泵组"
        quantity: "3台 (2用1备)"
        capacity: "满足100%峰值负荷"
        
      backup_options:
        
        option_1:
          type: "移动式真空泵"
          quantity: 1
          location: "设备库房"
          activation: "应急启用"
          
        option_2:
          type: "手术室独立真空源"
          description: "手术室备用小型真空泵"
          location: "手术室设备间"
          serves: "本手术室"
          
    redundancy:
      pump_configuration: "N+1"
      auto_standby: true
      rotation: "自动轮换运行"
      
    monitoring:
      parameters:
        - "真空度"
        - "泵运行状态"
        - "储罐液位"
      alarm: "真空度不足报警"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 医用空气多源系统
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  air_multi_source:
    
    system_id: "MGAS-AIR-MULTI"
    
    configuration:
      
      primary_system:
        type: "医用空压机组"
        quantity: "3台 (2用1备)"
        type_spec: "无油空压机"
        drying: "冷冻式干燥机 + 吸附式干燥机"
        
      backup_system:
        type: "高压钢瓶组"
        configuration: "10+10瓶汇流排"
        activation: "空压机故障时自动切换"
        duration: "4-8小时"
        
    air_quality:
      standard: "YY/T 0799"
      specifications:
        压力露点: "≤-40°C"
        含油量: "≤0.1 mg/m³"
        颗粒物: "≤0.5 μm, ≤20个/m³"
        CO: "≤5 ppm"
        CO2: "≤500 ppm"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 监控与报警系统
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  monitoring_alarm_system:
    
    central_monitoring:
      location: "中心控制室/值班室"
      display: "医用气体监控屏"
      
    monitoring_points:
      
      - parameter: "供气压力"
        locations: "各气源出口、各楼层"
        alarm: "高压/低压报警"
        
      - parameter: "液氧液位"
        location: "液氧储罐"
        alarm: "低液位报警"
        
      - parameter: "汇流排状态"
        location: "各汇流排间"
        alarm: "切换报警"
        
      - parameter: "设备运行状态"
        locations: "真空泵、空压机"
        alarm: "故障报警"
        
    alarm_hierarchy:
      
      - level: "一级报警 (紧急)"
        events:
          - "供气压力异常"
          - "所有气源故障"
        response: "立即处理"
        notification: "电话+短信+声光"
        
      - level: "二级报警 (警告)"
        events:
          - "单一气源切换"
          - "液位低"
        response: "计划处理"
        notification: "短信+系统显示"
```

## 系统补充7：热水分级系统

```yaml
Hot_Water_Tiered_System:
  
  system_id: "PLUMB-HW-TIER"
  system_name: "热水分级供应系统"
  description: "医院不同用途热水的分级供应"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 热水分级体系
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  hot_water_classification:
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 一级热水：卫生热水
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    tier_1_sanitary:
      
      name: "卫生生活热水"
      temperature: "55-60°C (出水)"
      usage_temperature: "38-42°C (混合后)"
      
      applications:
        - space: "病房卫生间"
          usage: "洗浴、洗手"
        - space: "公共卫生间"
          usage: "洗手"
        - space: "医护更衣室"
          usage: "淋浴"
          
      supply_mode:
        type: "集中热水系统"
        circulation: "机械循环"
        return_temperature: "≥50°C"
        
      heat_source_options:
        - "锅炉热水"
        - "空气源热泵"
        - "太阳能+辅助热源"
        - "市政热力换热"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 二级热水：医疗热水
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    tier_2_medical:
      
      name: "医疗用热水"
      temperature: "依用途不同"
      
      subtypes:
        
        - subtype: "外科洗手热水"
          temperature: "35-38°C"
          locations:
            - "手术室刷手间"
            - "ICU"
            - "产房"
          supply_mode: "局部恒温供水"
          control: "恒温混水阀"
          sensor: "感应式"
          
        - subtype: "婴儿沐浴热水"
          temperature: "37-38°C (精确)"
          locations:
            - "新生儿室"
            - "产房"
            - "NICU"
          supply_mode: "局部电热水器+恒温控制"
          precision: "±1°C"
          
        - subtype: "配奶用热水"
          temperature: "40-45°C"
          locations:
            - "NICU配奶间"
            - "新生儿配奶室"
          supply_mode: "专用开水器/恒温水浴"
          quality: "纯净水加热"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 三级热水：工艺热水
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    tier_3_process:
      
      name: "工艺用热水"
      
      subtypes:
        
        - subtype: "洗衣房热水"
          temperature: "60-80°C"
          location: "洗衣房"
          consumption: "大量"
          heat_source: "蒸汽换热或锅炉直供"
          
        - subtype: "厨房热水"
          temperature: "55-60°C"
          location: "中心厨房"
          consumption: "大量"
          peak_demand: "就餐前后"
          
        - subtype: "供应室热水"
          temperature: "60-80°C"
          location: "消毒供应中心"
          purpose: "器械预洗"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 热水系统配置
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_configurations:
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 集中热水系统
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    centralized_system:
      
      applicable_to: ["病房楼", "门诊楼"]
      
      components:
        
        heat_source:
          option_1:
            type: "空气源热泵"
            advantages: "节能、环保"
            cop: "3.0-4.0"
            capacity: "按峰值设计"
            redundancy: "N+1"
            
          option_2:
            type: "锅炉热水"
            advantages: "稳定可靠"
            fuel: "天然气/蒸汽"
            
          option_3:
            type: "太阳能+辅助热源"
            solar_fraction: "30-50%"
            auxiliary: "空气源热泵或电加热"
            
        storage:
          type: "承压保温水箱"
          material: "不锈钢304"
          capacity: "1-2小时峰值用量"
          insulation: "聚氨酯发泡"
          
        circulation:
          type: "机械循环"
          pump: "变频循环泵"
          control: "温控+定时"
          pipe_insulation: "全程保温"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 局部热水系统
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    localized_system:
      
      applicable_to:
        - "外科刷手间"
        - "婴儿室"
        - "分散卫生间"
        
      equipment_types:
        
        - type: "即热式电热水器"
          power: "5-10 kW"
          advantages: "即开即热、不占空间"
          applications: "洗手、少量用水"
          
        - type: "储水式电热水器"
          capacity: "30-100 L"
          power: "2-3 kW"
          advantages: "水温稳定"
          applications: "淋浴、较大用水量"
          
        - type: "恒温混水阀"
          type_spec: "热力学恒温阀"
          output_temp: "可设定"
          precision: "±2°C"
          applications: "洗手池、淋浴"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 空间热水配置表
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  space_hot_water_mapping:
    
    - space: "普通病房卫生间"
      supply_type: "集中热水"
      temperature: "55°C供/38°C用"
      outlets: "淋浴+洗手池"
      
    - space: "手术室刷手间"
      supply_type: "集中+恒温阀"
      temperature: "36°C (恒温)"
      outlets: "感应式洗手池"
      control: "膝/肘控"
      
    - space: "ICU"
      supply_type: "集中+恒温阀"
      temperature: "38°C"
      outlets: "洗手池"
      
    - space: "NICU"
      supply_type: "局部+精密恒温"
      temperature: "37°C ±1°C"
      outlets: "婴儿浴盆、洗手池"
      
    - space: "洗衣房"
      supply_type: "集中/蒸汽换热"
      temperature: "80°C"
      consumption: "500-1000 L/h"
      
    - space: "厨房"
      supply_type: "集中/锅炉"
      temperature: "60°C"
      consumption: "300-500 L/h (峰值)"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 防军团菌措施
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  legionella_prevention:
    
    measures:
      - measure: "储水温度"
        requirement: "≥60°C"
        purpose: "抑制细菌生长"
        
      - measure: "回水温度"
        requirement: "≥50°C"
        purpose: "全系统保温"
        
      - measure: "热冲洗"
        method: "定期70°C热水冲洗"
        frequency: "每周或每月"
        duration: "末端出水5分钟"
        
      - measure: "避免死水"
        method: "循环系统设计"
        requirement: "消除死角、定期排放"
        
      - measure: "水质检测"
        frequency: "每年"
        standard: "军团菌检测"
```

## 系统补充8：照明分级系统

```yaml
Lighting_Tiered_System:

system_id: "ELEC-LIGHT-TIER"
system_name: "照明分级系统"
description: "医院不同区域照明的分级配置与控制"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 照明分级体系
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

lighting_classification:

 # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 # 一级：手术/治疗照明
 # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

 tier_1_surgical:

 name: "手术/治疗照明"
 criticality: "最高"

 applications:

 - space: "手术室术区"
 equipment: "手术无影灯"
 illuminance: "40,000-160,000 lx"
 specifications:
 color_temperature: "4000-4500 K"

```yaml
Medical_IT_Power_System:
  
  system_id: "ELEC-IT"
  system_name: "医用IT电源系统"
  description: "为医疗场所提供安全隔离供电的专用电气系统"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统概述
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_overview:
    
    definition: |
      医用IT系统是一种不接地或经高阻抗接地的电源系统，
      配合绝缘监测装置使用，在发生第一次接地故障时
      不会导致电源中断，从而保障医疗安全。
      
    standard: "IEC 60364-7-710 / GB 16895.24"
    
    purpose:
      - "防止第一次接地故障导致断电"
      - "减少漏电流对患者的危害"
      - "保障生命支持设备连续运行"
      
    applicable_spaces:
      group_2_locations:
        description: "2类医疗场所 (生命支持)"
        examples:
          - "手术室"
          - "ICU/CCU/NICU"
          - "心导管室"
          - "血液透析室"
          - "麻醉室"
          - "术后恢复室"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统组成
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_components:
    
    isolation_transformer:
      name: "医用隔离变压器"
      function: "提供电气隔离，形成IT系统"
      specifications:
        type: "单相隔离变压器"
        capacity: "3.15 / 5 / 6.3 / 8 / 10 kVA"
        input: "220V/380V AC"
        output: "220V AC (隔离)"
        insulation_class: "H级"
        leakage_current: "≤0.5 mA"
        temperature_rise: "≤100K"
      installation:
        location: "手术室配电间 / IT配电柜内"
        cooling: "自然冷却，预留通风"
        
    insulation_monitor:
      name: "绝缘监测仪"
      function: "实时监测IT系统对地绝缘电阻"
      specifications:
        monitoring: "连续监测"
        alarm_threshold: "≤50 kΩ"
        display: "绝缘电阻值"
        output: "声光报警 + 远传信号"
      installation:
        location: "IT配电柜内"
        remote_display: "手术室内显示面板"
        
    alarm_display_panel:
      name: "报警显示面板"
      function: "在使用场所显示绝缘状态和报警"
      specifications:
        display:
          - "绝缘电阻值"
          - "变压器负载电流"
          - "变压器温度"
        alarm:
          - "绝缘故障报警 (红灯+声)"
          - "过载报警"
          - "过温报警"
        buttons:
          - "声音静音"
          - "测试按钮"
      installation:
        location: "手术室内显眼位置"
        height: "1.5m (便于观察)"
        
    it_distribution_panel:
      name: "IT配电柜"
      function: "IT系统专用配电"
      specifications:
        incoming: "从UPS或应急电源"
        outgoing: "分回路至各IT插座"
        protection: "微型断路器"
        leakage_protection: "不设漏电保护 (IT系统特性)"
        
    it_outlets:
      name: "医用IT插座"
      function: "为医疗设备供电"
      specifications:
        type: "医用插座"
        color: "绿色面板 (区别于普通插座)"
        rating: "10A/16A"
        grounding: "可靠接地 (设备外壳)"
      installation:
        locations:
          - "手术台周围"
          - "设备柱/吊塔"
          - "墙面设备带"
        quantity: "12-20个/手术室"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 典型配置方案
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  typical_configurations:
    
    operating_room:
      space: "手术室"
      configuration:
        transformer:
          capacity: "8 kVA"
          quantity: "1台/间"
        monitor: "1套/间"
        display_panel: "1个/间"
        outlets: "16-20个"
        
    icu_bed:
      space: "ICU床位"
      configuration:
        transformer:
          capacity: "5 kVA"
          coverage: "2-4床共用"
        monitor: "1套/变压器"
        display_panel: "护士站集中显示"
        outlets: "8-10个/床"
        
    cath_lab:
      space: "心导管室"
      configuration:
        transformer:
          capacity: "10 kVA"
          quantity: "1台/间"
        monitor: "1套/间"
        display_panel: "1个/间"
        outlets: "20-25个"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 空间-IT系统服务映射
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  space_it_mapping:
    
    mandatory_spaces:
      description: "必须配置医用IT系统的空间"
      spaces:
        - space: "手术室"
          transformer: "8-10 kVA/间"
          outlets: "16-20个"
          
        - space: "ICU"
          transformer: "5 kVA/2-4床"
          outlets: "8-10个/床"
          
        - space: "CCU"
          transformer: "5 kVA/2-4床"
          outlets: "8-10个/床"
          
        - space: "NICU"
          transformer: "5 kVA/3-4床"
          outlets: "6-8个/床"
          
        - space: "心导管室"
          transformer: "10 kVA/间"
          outlets: "20-25个"
          
        - space: "血液透析室"
          transformer: "8 kVA/10台"
          outlets: "2个/床"
          
        - space: "麻醉诱导室"
          transformer: "5 kVA/间"
          outlets: "8-10个"
          
        - space: "术后恢复室"
          transformer: "5 kVA/4-6床"
          outlets: "4-6个/床"
          
    optional_spaces:
      description: "可选配置IT系统的空间"
      spaces:
        - space: "急诊抢救室"
          note: "推荐配置"
        - space: "产房"
          note: "推荐配置"
```

## 系统补充6：医用气体多源供应系统

```yaml
Medical_Gas_Multi_Source_System:
  
  system_id: "MGAS-MULTI"
  system_name: "医用气体多源供应系统"
  description: "关键医用气体的多源供应与自动切换系统"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统概述
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_overview:
    
    purpose: |
      为确保医用气体供应的连续性和可靠性，
      关键医用气体采用多气源配置和自动切换机制，
      防止单一气源故障导致供气中断。
      
    applicable_gases:
      - "医用氧气 (O2)"
      - "医用压缩空气 (Air)"
      - "负压吸引 (VAC)"
      
    reliability_target:
      availability: "≥99.99%"
      single_failure_tolerance: true

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 医用氧气多源供应
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  oxygen_multi_source:
    
    system_id: "MGAS-O2-MULTI"
    
    source_hierarchy:
      
      primary_source:
        type: "液氧储罐"
        capacity: "≥7天用量"
        pressure: "自动汽化供气"
        monitoring: "液位、压力监测"
        alarm: "低液位报警"
        
      secondary_source:
        type: "氧气汇流排"
        configuration: "双组自动切换"
        capacity: "≥2天用量"
        trigger: "主气源压力低于设定值"
        
      emergency_source:
        type: "备用汇流排或瓶装氧"
        configuration: "手动切换"
        capacity: "≥1天用量"
        location: "关键区域就近"
        
    automatic_switchover:
      
      control_logic:
        normal: "液氧供气"
        low_pressure_1: "自动切换至汇流排组1"
        low_pressure_2: "自动切换至汇流排组2"
        alarm: "同时发出报警"
        
      pressure_settings:
        normal_supply: "0.8-1.0 MPa"
        switchover_threshold: "0.6 MPa"
        alarm_threshold: "0.5 MPa"
        
      switchover_device:
        type: "自动切换阀组"
        response_time: "≤2秒"
        monitoring: "状态远传至监控中心"
        
    zone_valves:
      description: "分区域控制阀"
      locations:
        - "每层竖井出口"
        - "手术部入口"
        - "ICU入口"
        - "急诊入口"
      function:
        - "区域检修隔离"
        - "紧急关断"
      type: "手动+远程控制"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 医用压缩空气多源供应
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  compressed_air_multi_source:
    
    system_id: "MGAS-AIR-MULTI"
    
    source_configuration:
      
      main_compressors:
        type: "医用空气压缩机组"
        configuration: "N+1 (2用1备或3用1备)"
        redundancy: true
        auto_rotation: true
        
      dryer_system:
        type: "冷冻式+吸附式干燥机"
        configuration: "双路并联"
        dew_point: "≤-40°C"
        
      receiver_tank:
        type: "储气罐"
        capacity: "≥30分钟用量"
        quantity: 2
        purpose: "缓冲+检修隔离"
        
      emergency_backup:
        type: "钢瓶汇流排"
        capacity: "≥4小时用量"
        trigger: "主系统压力低"
        
    control_strategy:
      
      normal_operation:
        mode: "主用机组运行"
        standby: "备用机组待命"
        rotation: "定期轮换"
        
      high_demand:
        mode: "多机并联运行"
        trigger: "压力降低"
        
      failure_mode:
        action: "自动启动备用机组"
        alarm: "故障报警"
        backup: "汇流排自动投入"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 负压吸引多源供应
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  vacuum_multi_source:
    
    system_id: "MGAS-VAC-MULTI"
    
    source_configuration:
      
      main_pumps:
        type: "医用真空泵组"
        subtypes:
          - "水环式真空泵"
          - "旋片式真空泵"
          - "干式真空泵"
        configuration: "N+1 (2用1备或3用1备)"
        redundancy: true
        auto_rotation: true
        
      vacuum_tank:
        type: "真空储罐"
        capacity: "≥10分钟用量"
        quantity: 2
        purpose: "稳压+缓冲"
        
      exhaust_treatment:
        type: "细菌过滤器"
        efficiency: "≥99.97%"
        discharge: "室外高空排放"
        
    control_strategy:
      
      normal_operation:
        mode: "主用泵组运行"
        vacuum_level: "-40 kPa ~ -60 kPa"
        standby: "备用泵组待命"
        
      high_demand:
        mode: "多泵并联运行"
        trigger: "真空度降低"
        
      failure_mode:
        action: "自动启动备用泵组"
        alarm: "故障报警"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 多源供应系统监控
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  monitoring_system:
    
    central_monitoring:
      location: "医用气体监控中心 / 设备科"
      functions:
        - "所有气源状态监控"
        - "压力/液位/流量显示"
        - "切换状态显示"
        - "报警记录与处理"
        
    local_monitoring:
      location: "护士站/设备间"
      display:
        - "区域供气压力"
        - "报警状态"
        
    alarm_management:
      levels:
        - level: "提示"
          example: "液位低于50%"
          action: "准备补充"
        - level: "警告"
          example: "压力接近切换值"
          action: "检查气源"
        - level: "紧急"
          example: "主气源故障切换"
          action: "立即处理"
```

## 系统补充7：热水分级供应系统

```yaml
Hot_Water_Stratified_System:
  
  system_id: "PLUMB-HW"
  system_name: "热水分级供应系统"
  description: "按用途和温度需求分级供应热水"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统概述
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_overview:
    
    purpose: |
      医院不同区域对热水的温度、水质、可靠性要求不同，
      采用分级供应策略，满足各类需求的同时确保安全和节能。
      
    design_principles:
      - "按需供应，避免过度加热"
      - "防烫伤保护"
      - "防军团菌控制"
      - "节能优先"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 热水分级定义
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  hot_water_levels:
    
    level_1_high_temp:
      name: "高温热水"
      temperature: "60-65°C"
      purpose: "供应室、洗衣房、厨房"
      applications:
        - space: "供应室"
          usage: "清洗消毒"
          temperature: "≥60°C"
        - space: "洗衣房"
          usage: "洗涤"
          temperature: "60-70°C"
        - space: "中心厨房"
          usage: "洗涤消毒"
          temperature: "≥60°C"
      anti_legionella:
        method: "高温储存"
        storage_temp: "≥60°C"
        note: "军团菌在60°C以上无法存活"
        
    level_2_medium_temp:
      name: "中温热水"
      temperature: "50-55°C"
      purpose: "一般洗手、淋浴"
      applications:
        - space: "病房卫生间"
          usage: "淋浴、洗手"
          delivery_temp: "45-50°C"
        - space: "公共卫生间"
          usage: "洗手"
          delivery_temp: "40-45°C"
      safety:
        thermostatic_mixing_valve: true
        anti_scald_temp: "≤49°C"
        
    level_3_low_temp:
      name: "低温热水"
      temperature: "40-45°C"
      purpose: "特殊人群使用"
      applications:
        - space: "新生儿科"
          usage: "婴儿沐浴"
          delivery_temp: "37-38°C"
          control: "精密恒温"
        - space: "烧伤科"
          usage: "患者清洗"
          delivery_temp: "35-38°C"
        - space: "康复科水疗"
          usage: "水疗池"
          delivery_temp: "35-40°C"
      safety:
        thermostatic_control: "精密恒温阀"
        max_temp_limit: "≤40°C"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 热水系统配置
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_configurations:
    
    central_hot_water:
      name: "中央热水系统"
      applicable: "大型综合医院"
      
      heat_source:
        options:
          - type: "蒸汽换热"
            description: "蒸汽-水换热器"
            source: "锅炉房蒸汽"
          - type: "热水锅炉"
            description: "燃气热水锅炉"
            efficiency: "≥95%"
          - type: "空气源热泵"
            description: "热泵热水机组"
            cop: "≥3.5"
          - type: "太阳能+辅助"
            description: "太阳能集热+电辅助"
            solar_fraction: "≥40%"
            
      storage:
        type: "承压保温水箱"
        capacity: "2-4小时用量"
        temperature: "60°C"
        insulation: "聚氨酯保温"
        
      circulation:
        type: "全天候热水循环"
        purpose: "即开即热"
        return_temp: "≥50°C"
        pump: "变频循环泵"
        
    distributed_hot_water:
      name: "分散式热水系统"
      applicable: "小型医院、门诊部"
      
      configurations:
        - type: "电热水器"
          location: "就近安装"
          capacity: "40-100L"
          applications: "诊室、小型卫生间"
          
        - type: "即热式电热水器"
          power: "6-12 kW"
          applications: "洗手池"
          advantage: "无储水、即用即热"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 空间-热水系统服务映射
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  space_hot_water_mapping:
    
    - space: "病房卫生间"
      hot_water_level: "中温 (50°C)"
      delivery_temp: "45°C"
      mixing_valve: true
      flow_rate: "10 L/min"
      
    - space: "手术室洗手区"
      hot_water_level: "中温 (50°C)"
      delivery_temp: "40°C"
      control: "膝控或感应"
      water_quality: "软化水"
      
    - space: "ICU"
      hot_water_level: "中温 (50°C)"
      delivery_temp: "40°C"
      
    - space: "新生儿沐浴室"
      hot_water_level: "低温 (40°C)"
      delivery_temp: "37-38°C"
      control: "精密恒温阀"
      max_temp: "40°C硬限制"
      
    - space: "供应室清洗区"
      hot_water_level: "高温 (65°C)"
      delivery_temp: "60°C"
      consumption: "大量"
      
    - space: "洗衣房"
      hot_water_level: "高温 (65-70°C)"
      consumption: "大量"
      recovery: "热回收"
      
    - space: "厨房洗涤区"
      hot_water_level: "高温 (65°C)"
      delivery_temp: "60°C"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 安全与节能措施
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  safety_and_efficiency:
    
    anti_scald_measures:
      - measure: "恒温混水阀"
        location: "所有淋浴和洗手池"
        max_temp: "49°C"
      - measure: "温度限制器"
        location: "儿科、老年科、精神科"
        max_temp: "40°C"
      - measure: "分级供水"
        description: "高温热水不直接供应患者使用点"
        
    legionella_prevention:
      - measure: "高温储存"
        temperature: "≥60°C"
      - measure: "定期高温消毒"
        frequency: "每周一次"
        temperature: "70°C × 10分钟"
      - measure: "避免死水段"
        method: "循环回水系统"
      - measure: "末端冲洗"
        frequency: "长期未用后使用前"
        
    energy_efficiency:
      - measure: "热回收"
        source: "排水热回收"
        application: "洗衣房、厨房"
      - measure: "变频循环泵"
        control: "根据回水温度调节"
      - measure: "分时加热"
        strategy: "利用低谷电价"
      - measure: "太阳能预热"
        fraction: "≥30%"
```

## 系统补充8：照明分级系统

```yaml
Lighting_Stratified_System:
  
  system_id: "ELEC-LTG"
  system_name: "照明分级系统"
  description: "按医疗功能需求分级配置的照明系统"
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 系统概述
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  system_overview:
    
    purpose: |
      医院不同区域对照明有特殊要求，包括照度、显色性、
      可调节性、应急备份等，采用分级配置满足各类需求。
      
    design_standards:
      - "GB 50034-2013 建筑照明设计标准"
      - "GB 50333-2013 医院洁净手术部建筑技术规范"
      - "JGJ 312-2013 医疗建筑电气设计规范"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 照明分级定义
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  lighting_levels:
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Level 1: 手术照明
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    level_1_surgical:
      name: "手术照明"
      applicable_spaces:
        - "手术室"
        - "分娩室"
        - "介入手术室"
        
      components:
        
        surgical_light:
          type: "无影灯"
          technology: "LED无影手术灯"
          specifications:
            illuminance: "40,000-160,000 lx (可调)"
            color_temp: "3500-5000K (可调)"
            cri: "≥95 (Ra)"
            r9: "≥90"
            shadow_dilution: "无影"
            depth_of_field: "≥70 cm"
          mounting: "吊顶悬臂式"
          power_supply: "UPS供电"
          backup: "内置电池 (≥3小时)"
          
        ambient_light:
          type: "一般照明"
          illuminance: "500-750 lx"
          control: "可调光 (0-100%)"
          fixture: "LED洁净灯盘"
          
        local_light:
          type: "局部照明"
          applications:
            - "麻醉工作区"
            - "器械台"
          illuminance: "1000 lx"
          
      control:
        type: "场景控制"
        scenes:
          - "手术模式: 无影灯全亮 + 环境调暗"
          - "清洁模式: 环境全亮"
          - "待机模式: 低照度"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Level 2: 诊疗照明
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    level_2_examination:
      name: "诊疗照明"
      applicable_spaces:
        - "诊室"
        - "治疗室"
        - "换药室"
        - "检查室"
        
      specifications:
        general_illuminance: "300-500 lx"
        examination_illuminance: "1000 lx"
        color_temp: "4000-5000K"
        cri: "≥90"
        glare_control: "UGR≤19"
        
      components:
        ceiling_light:
          type: "LED面板灯"
          illuminance: "300-500 lx"
          
        examination_light:
          type: "检查灯"
          illuminance: "10,000-50,000 lx"
          mounting: "壁挂式/移动式"
          applications:
            - "耳鼻喉检查"
            - "眼科检查"
            - "皮肤检查"
            
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Level 3: 护理照明
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    level_3_nursing:
      name: "护理照明"
      applicable_spaces:
        - "病房"
        - "ICU"
        - "新生儿科"
        
      specifications:
        general_illuminance: "100-200 lx"
        reading_illuminance: "300 lx"
        night_illuminance: "5-10 lx"
        examination_illuminance: "300-500 lx"
        color_temp: "3000-4000K (舒适)"
        
      components:
        
        ceiling_light:
          type: "LED面板灯/吸顶灯"
          control: "可调光"
          
        bed_light:
          type: "床头阅读灯"
          illuminance: "300 lx"
          control: "患者独立控制"
          
        night_light:
          type: "夜间低位灯"
          illuminance: "5-10 lx"
          location: "床边地面/走廊踢脚"
          color: "暖白色 (减少干扰)"
          
        examination_light:
          type: "检查灯"
          illuminance: "500 lx"
          mounting: "床头壁挂"
          
      special_requirements:
        
        circadian_lighting:
          applicable: "ICU, 新生儿科"
          description: "昼夜节律照明"
          daytime: "高色温 (5000K), 高照度"
          nighttime: "低色温 (2700K), 低照度"
          control: "自动+手动"
          
        infant_protection:
          applicable: "新生儿科"
          max_illuminance: "500 lx (暖箱区)"
          eye_protection: "避免直射"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Level 4: 公共区域照明
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    level_4_public:
      name: "公共区域照明"
      applicable_spaces:
        - "门诊大厅"
        - "走廊"
        - "候诊区"
        - "电梯厅"
        
      specifications:
        lobby_illuminance: "200-300 lx"
        corridor_illuminance: "100-150 lx"
        waiting_illuminance: "150-200 lx"
        color_temp: "4000K"
        
      components:
        general_light:
          type: "LED面板/筒灯/线条灯"
          control: "分区控制+调光"
          
        decorative_light:
          type: "装饰照明"
          location: "大厅、特色区域"
          
      energy_saving:
        daylight_sensing: "利用自然采光"
        occupancy_sensing: "人员感应"
        time_scheduling: "分时段控制"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 应急照明系统
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  emergency_lighting:
    
    types:
      
      evacuation_lighting:
        name: "疏散照明"
        purpose: "火灾等紧急情况下的人员疏散"
        specifications:
          floor_illuminance: "≥1 lx (疏散通道)"
          stair_illuminance: "≥5 lx"
          duration: "≥90分钟"
        components:
          - "疏散指示灯"
          - "出口标志"
          - "楼梯照明"
        power_source: "自带电池"
        
      backup_lighting:
        name: "备用照明"
        purpose: "重要区域电源中断时保持工作照明"
        specifications:
          illuminance: "正常照明的10-100%"
          duration: "≥90分钟"
        applicable_spaces:
          - space: "手术室"
            level: "50%正常照度"
            switchover: "0秒 (UPS)"
          - space: "ICU"
            level: "30%正常照度"
            switchover: "0秒 (UPS)"
          - space: "急诊"
            level: "50%正常照度"
            switchover: "15秒 (发电机)"
        power_source: "UPS + 柴油发电机"
        
      safety_lighting:
        name: "安全照明"
        purpose: "防止意外伤害"
        specifications:
          illuminance: "≥15 lx"
        applicable_spaces:
          - "配电室"
          - "水泵房"
          - "消防控制室"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 空间-照明系统服务映射
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  space_lighting_mapping:
    
    - space: "手术室"
      lighting_level: "Level 1 (手术照明)"
      general: "500 lx (可调)"
      task: "40,000-160,000 lx (无影灯)"
      cri: "≥95"
      power: "UPS"
      control: "场景控制"
      
    - space: "ICU"
      lighting_level: "Level 3 (护理照明)"
      general: "150-200 lx"
      examination: "500 lx"
      night: "5-10 lx"
      circadian: true
      power: "UPS (部分)"
      
    - space: "病房"
      lighting_level: "Level 3 (护理照明)"
      general: "100-150 lx"
      reading: "300 lx"
      night: "5 lx"
      
    - space: "诊室"
      lighting_level: "Level 2 (诊疗照明)"
      general: "300 lx"
      examination: "1000 lx"
      cri: "≥90"
      
    - space: "门诊大厅"
      lighting_level: "Level 4 (公共照明)"
      general: "200-300 lx"
      energy_saving: "日光感应+分时"
      
    - space: "走廊"
      lighting_level: "Level 4 (公共照明)"
      general: "100-150 lx"
      night: "50 lx"
      emergency: "≥1 lx"
```

# Part 2: 通用统一耦合单元数据结构 (DML)

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    PART 2: UNIVERSAL COUPLING UNIT DATA STRUCTURE
#                    通用耦合单元数据模型语言 (CU-DML)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Coupling_Unit_Data_Model_Language:
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 2.1 耦合单元基本定义
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_2_1_Basic_Definition:
    
    definition: |
      耦合单元(Coupling Unit, CU)是医疗建筑系统-空间融合的基本原子单位。
      每个CU描述一个空间节点与一个系统节点之间的完整服务关系，
      包含物质流、能量流、信息流三个维度的完整表达。
      
    design_principles:
      - principle: "拓扑保持性"
        description: "CU必须显式引用Agent-01的系统拓扑和Agent-02的空间拓扑"
      - principle: "三流动完备性"
        description: "每个CU必须包含物质流、能量流、信息流的完整定义"
      - principle: "行为场景绑定"
        description: "CU必须关联Agent-02定义的空间功能-行为场景"
      - principle: "物理方程引用"
        description: "CU应引用Agent-04的物理模型方程"
      - principle: "可计算性"
        description: "CU的所有属性应支持数值计算和仿真"
        
    naming_convention:
      pattern: "CU-{SPACE_ID}-{SYSTEM_ID}-{FLOW_TYPE}"
      examples:
        - "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
        - "CU-ICU001-MGAS_O2-SUPPLY"
        - "CU-NICU-ELEC_UPS-POWER"
      components:
        SPACE_ID: "Agent-02定义的空间标识符"
        SYSTEM_ID: "Agent-01定义的系统标识符"
        FLOW_TYPE: "主导流动类型或服务类型"

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 2.2 耦合单元数据结构模式 (Schema)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_2_2_Coupling_Unit_Schema:
    
    schema_version: "2.0"
    
    CouplingUnit:
      
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # 标识与元数据
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      
      identity:
        unit_id:
          type: "string"
          pattern: "CU-{SPACE_ID}-{SYSTEM_ID}-{FLOW_TYPE}"
          required: true
          description: "耦合单元唯一标识符"
          
        unit_name:
          type: "string"
          required: true
          description: "耦合单元人类可读名称"
          example: "手术室OR-001冷却服务耦合"
          
        unit_class:
          type: "enum"
          values: ["HVAC", "MGAS", "ELEC", "PLUMB", "FIRE", "INT", "MULTI"]
          required: true
          description: "耦合单元所属系统大类"
          
        criticality_grade:
          type: "enum"
          values: ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"]
          required: true
          description: "关键性等级"
          
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # 拓扑节点绑定
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      
      topology_binding:
        
        space_node:
          node_id:
            type: "string"
            source: "Agent-02"
            required: true
            description: "空间节点ID（来自Agent-02空间模型）"
            
          space_type:
            type: "string"
            source: "Agent-02"
            required: true
            description: "空间类型分类"
            example: "手术室-I级"
            
          space_topology_path:
            type: "string"
            source: "Agent-02"
            required: true
            description: "空间在建筑拓扑中的路径"
            example: "Building/Floor3/SurgicalDept/OR-Zone/OR-001"
            
          parent_spaces:
            type: "array[string]"
            source: "Agent-02"
            description: "上级空间节点"
            
          adjacent_spaces:
            type: "array[string]"
            source: "Agent-02"
            description: "相邻空间节点"
            
        system_node:
          node_id:
            type: "string"
            source: "Agent-01"
            required: true
            description: "系统节点ID（来自Agent-01系统模型）"
            
          system_type:
            type: "string"
            source: "Agent-01"
            required: true
            description: "系统类型"
            example: "HVAC-CLN (洁净空调)"
            
          system_topology_path:
            type: "string"
            source: "Agent-01"
            required: true
            description: "系统在MEP拓扑中的路径"
            example: "MEP/HVAC/ColdSource/ChillerPlant/CHP-001"
            
          upstream_systems:
            type: "array[string]"
            source: "Agent-01"
            description: "上游系统节点"
            
          downstream_systems:
            type: "array[string]"
            source: "Agent-01"
            description: "下游系统节点"
            
        device_nodes:
          type: "array[DeviceNode]"
          source: "Agent-03"
          description: "关联的设备节点列表"
          
          DeviceNode:
            device_id: "string"
            device_type: "string"
            device_location: "string"
            device_role: "enum[SOURCE, DISTRIBUTION, TERMINAL, CONTROL, SENSOR]"
            
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # Agent-02 功能行为场景绑定
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      
      functional_behavior_binding:
        
        behavior_scenario:
          scenario_id:
            type: "string"
            source: "Agent-02"
            required: true
            description: "行为场景ID"
            
          scenario_name:
            type: "string"
            source: "Agent-02"
            required: true
            description: "行为场景名称"
            example: "手术进行中"
            
          scenario_phase:
            type: "string"
            source: "Agent-02"
            description: "场景阶段"
            example: "术中-体外循环期"
            
          actors:
            type: "array[string]"
            source: "Agent-02"
            description: "参与者列表"
            example: ["外科医生", "麻醉医生", "灌注师", "护士"]
            
        environmental_requirement:
          requirement_id:
            type: "string"
            source: "Agent-02"
            required: true
            
          parameters:
            type: "array[EnvironmentalParameter]"
            required: true
            
            EnvironmentalParameter:
              parameter_name:
                type: "string"
                required: true
                example: "temperature"
              target_value:
                type: "number"
                required: true
                example: 22
              unit:
                type: "string"
                required: true
                example: "°C"
              tolerance:
                type: "number"
                required: true
                example: 0.5
              control_precision:
                type: "enum"
                values: ["PRECISION", "STANDARD", "COARSE"]
                example: "PRECISION"
              priority:
                type: "enum"
                values: ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"]
                example: "CRITICAL"
                
        behavior_trigger:
          trigger_type:
            type: "enum"
            values: ["CONTINUOUS", "EVENT_BASED", "SCHEDULED", "CONDITION_BASED"]
            required: true
            
          trigger_condition:
            type: "string"
            description: "触发条件表达式"
            example: "scenario.phase == '术中' AND oxygen_demand > threshold"
            
          trigger_source:
            type: "enum"
            values: ["MEDICAL_PROCESS", "SENSOR", "SCHEDULE", "MANUAL", "EMERGENCY"]
            
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # 三流动耦合定义 (核心)
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      
      three_flow_coupling:
        
        # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        # 物质流
        # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        
        material_flow:
          
          enabled:
            type: "boolean"
            required: true
            description: "是否存在物质流"
            
          carrier:
            type: "string"
            required_if: "enabled == true"
            description: "物质载体"
            examples: ["冷冻水", "冷却水", "氧气", "压缩空气", "蒸汽", "电缆", "污水"]
            
          carrier_properties:
            type: "object"
            description: "载体物理属性"
            properties:
              medium_type:
                type: "enum"
                values: ["LIQUID", "GAS", "SOLID", "ELECTRICAL"]
              phase:
                type: "string"
                example: "液态"
              composition:
                type: "string"
                example: "纯水 + 乙二醇15%"
                
          flow_path:
            origin:
              type: "string"
              required: true
              description: "起点位置"
              example: "B1层冷冻站CHL-19XR-001"
            destination:
              type: "string"
              required: true
              description: "终点位置"
              example: "3F手术室OR-001 AHU-OR-001"
            route:
              type: "array[string]"
              description: "途经路径"
              example: ["B1竖井", "3F水平管廊", "手术部管井"]
            pipe_id:
              type: "string"
              source: "Agent-04"
              description: "管路ID引用"
              
          flow_parameters:
            flow_rate:
              value: "number"
              unit: "string"
              example: { value: 150, unit: "m³/h" }
            velocity:
              value: "number"
              unit: "string"
              example: { value: 1.5, unit: "m/s" }
            pressure:
              supply_pressure:
                value: "number"
                unit: "string"
              return_pressure:
                value: "number"
                unit: "string"
              pressure_drop:
                value: "number"
                unit: "string"
                
          lifecycle_phases:
            type: "object"
            required: true
            description: "物质流全生命周期"
            
            supply:
              description: "供给阶段"
              source_capacity:
                type: "number"
                unit: "string"
              supply_condition:
                type: "object"
                properties:
                  temperature: "number"
                  pressure: "number"
                  quality: "string"
                  
            consumption:
              description: "消耗阶段"
              consumption_rate:
                type: "number"
                unit: "string"
              consumption_pattern:
                type: "enum"
                values: ["CONTINUOUS", "INTERMITTENT", "PEAK_VALLEY"]
              peak_demand:
                type: "number"
                unit: "string"
              average_demand:
                type: "number"
                unit: "string"
                
            return_or_discharge:
              description: "回收或排放阶段"
              return_type:
                type: "enum"
                values: ["CLOSED_LOOP", "OPEN_DISCHARGE", "TREATMENT_REQUIRED", "NONE"]
              return_condition:
                type: "object"
                properties:
                  temperature: "number"
                  pressure: "number"
                  quality: "string"
              treatment:
                type: "string"
                description: "处理要求"
                example: "消毒后排放"
                
          agent04_physics_ref:
            equation_id:
              type: "string"
              source: "Agent-04"
              description: "物理方程引用"
              example: "EQ-FLUID-BERNOULLI-001"
            model_type:
              type: "string"
              example: "Darcy-Weisbach管道压降模型"
              
        # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        # 能量流
        # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        
        energy_flow:
          
          enabled:
            type: "boolean"
            required: true
            description: "是否存在能量流"
            
          energy_form:
            type: "enum"
            values: ["THERMAL_COOLING", "THERMAL_HEATING", "ELECTRICAL", "PNEUMATIC", "HYDRAULIC", "RADIANT"]
            required_if: "enabled == true"
            description: "能量形式"
            
          energy_carrier:
            type: "string"
            description: "能量载体（与物质流载体关联）"
            example: "冷冻水"
            
          source_specification:
            source_capacity:
              type: "number"
              unit: "string"
              description: "源端供能能力"
              example: { value: 600, unit: "kW" }
            source_condition:
              type: "object"
              description: "源端能量品质"
              example:
                supply_temperature: 7
                return_temperature: 12
                unit: "°C"
                
          demand_specification:
            design_demand:
              type: "number"
              unit: "string"
              description: "设计需求"
              example: { value: 50, unit: "kW" }
            peak_demand:
              type: "number"
              unit: "string"
              description: "峰值需求"
            average_demand:
              type: "number"
              unit: "string"
              description: "平均需求"
            demand_profile:
              type: "string"
              description: "需求曲线类型"
              example: "手术日高峰型"
              
          energy_balance:
            supply_energy:
              type: "number"
              unit: "string"
              description: "供给能量"
            consumed_energy:
              type: "number"
              unit: "string"
              description: "消耗能量"
            conversion_efficiency:
              type: "number"
              unit: "%"
              description: "转换效率"
              example: 98
            losses:
              type: "object"
              description: "损耗分解"
              properties:
                transmission_loss:
                  value: "number"
                  unit: "%"
                conversion_loss:
                  value: "number"
                  unit: "%"
                  
          surplus_handling:
            surplus_type:
              type: "enum"
              values: ["WASTE_HEAT", "EXCESS_COOLING", "REGENERATIVE", "NONE"]
              description: "余能类型"
            handling_method:
              type: "string"
              description: "处理方式"
              example: "回水进入回水管网，热量回收利用"
            recovery_efficiency:
              type: "number"
              unit: "%"
              
          agent04_physics_ref:
            equation_id:
              type: "string"
              source: "Agent-04"
              example: "EQ-THERMO-HEAT-TRANSFER-001"
            model_type:
              type: "string"
              example: "热交换器NTU-ε模型"
              
        # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        # 信息流
        # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        
        information_flow:
          
          enabled:
            type: "boolean"
            required: true
            description: "是否存在信息流"
            
          control_mode:
            type: "enum"
            values: ["OPEN_LOOP", "CLOSED_LOOP", "CASCADE", "FEEDFORWARD", "HYBRID"]
            required_if: "enabled == true"
            description: "控制模式"
            
          sensing_layer:
            sensors:
              type: "array[Sensor]"
              description: "传感器列表"
              
              Sensor:
                sensor_id:
                  type: "string"
                  required: true
                sensor_type:
                  type: "string"
                  required: true
                  example: "温度传感器"
                measured_parameter:
                  type: "string"
                  required: true
                  example: "supply_air_temperature"
                location:
                  type: "string"
                  required: true
                  example: "AHU-OR-001送风口"
                accuracy:
                  type: "number"
                  unit: "string"
                  example: { value: 0.1, unit: "°C" }
                sampling_rate:
                  type: "number"
                  unit: "string"
                  example: { value: 1, unit: "Hz" }
                protocol:
                  type: "string"
                  example: "BACnet/IP"
                  
          transmission_layer:
            network_type:
              type: "enum"
              values: ["BACNET", "MODBUS", "LONWORKS", "KNX", "PROPRIETARY", "WIRELESS"]
            transmission_path:
              type: "string"
              description: "信号传输路径"
              example: "传感器→DDC控制器→BACnet网络→BA主站"
            latency:
              type: "number"
              unit: "string"
              description: "传输延迟"
              example: { value: 100, unit: "ms" }
              
          control_layer:
            controller:
              controller_id:
                type: "string"
                required: true
              controller_type:
                type: "string"
                required: true
                example: "DDC控制器"
              control_algorithm:
                type: "string"
                required: true
                example: "PID温度控制"
              control_parameters:
                type: "object"
                description: "控制参数"
                example:
                  Kp: 2.5
                  Ki: 0.1
                  Kd: 0.5
                  setpoint: 22
                  deadband: 0.5
                  
          actuation_layer:
            actuators:
              type: "array[Actuator]"
              description: "执行器列表"
              
              Actuator:
                actuator_id:
                  type: "string"
                  required: true
                actuator_type:
                  type: "string"
                  required: true
                  example: "电动调节阀"
                controlled_parameter:
                  type: "string"
                  required: true
                  example: "冷冻水流量"
                location:
                  type: "string"
                  required: true
                  example: "AHU-OR-001冷冻水入口"
                range:
                  type: "object"
                  example:
                    min: 0
                    max: 100
                    unit: "%"
                response_time:
                  type: "number"
                  unit: "string"
                  example: { value: 30, unit: "s" }
                  
          feedback_loop:
            loop_type:
              type: "enum"
              values: ["SINGLE_LOOP", "MULTI_LOOP", "CASCADE", "RATIO"]
              required: true
            loop_description:
              type: "string"
              description: "反馈回路描述"
              example: "送风温度→PID控制器→冷冻水阀开度→送风温度"
            stability:
              type: "enum"
              values: ["STABLE", "MARGINALLY_STABLE", "OSCILLATORY"]
            response_characteristics:
              type: "object"
              properties:
                rise_time:
                  value: "number"
                  unit: "string"
                settling_time:
                  value: "number"
                  unit: "string"
                overshoot:
                  value: "number"
                  unit: "%"
                  
          alarm_management:
            alarms:
              type: "array[Alarm]"
              
              Alarm:
                alarm_id:
                  type: "string"
                alarm_condition:
                  type: "string"
                  example: "supply_temperature > 25°C"
                severity:
                  type: "enum"
                  values: ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW", "INFO"]
                notification:
                  type: "array[string]"
                  example: ["BA主站", "手术室显示屏", "值班手机"]
                response_action:
                  type: "string"
                  example: "自动切换备用AHU"
                  
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # 可靠性与冗余
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      
      reliability:
        
        reliability_grade:
          type: "enum"
          values: ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"]
          required: true
          description: "可靠性等级"
          
        availability_target:
          type: "number"
          unit: "%"
          description: "可用性目标"
          example: 99.99
          
        redundancy:
          redundancy_type:
            type: "enum"
            values: ["N+1", "2N", "NONE"]
          backup_system:
            type: "string"
            description: "备用系统"
          switchover_time:
            type: "number"
            unit: "string"
            description: "切换时间"
            example: { value: 0, unit: "s" }
            
        failure_mode:
          failure_scenarios:
            type: "array[FailureScenario]"
            
            FailureScenario:
              scenario_name:
                type: "string"
              probability:
                type: "number"
              impact:
                type: "enum"
                values: ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"]
              mitigation:
                type: "string"
                
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # 验证与审计
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      
      validation:
        
        topology_validation:
          space_topology_preserved:
            type: "boolean"
            required: true
          system_topology_preserved:
            type: "boolean"
            required: true
          cross_reference_valid:
            type: "boolean"
            required: true
            
        three_flow_completeness:
          material_flow_complete:
            type: "boolean"
            required: true
          energy_flow_complete:
            type: "boolean"
            required: true
          information_flow_complete:
            type: "boolean"
            required: true
            
        agent_cross_reference:
          agent01_ref_valid:
            type: "boolean"
          agent02_ref_valid:
            type: "boolean"
          agent03_ref_valid:
            type: "boolean"
          agent04_ref_valid:
            type: "boolean"
```
