# Part 3: 超图拓扑耦合模型

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    PART 3: HYPERGRAPH TOPOLOGY COUPLING MODEL
#                    超图拓扑耦合模型
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Hypergraph_Coupling_Model:
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 3.1 多维超图定义
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_3_1_Hypergraph_Definition:
    
    formal_definition: |
      医疗建筑系统-空间耦合超图 H = (V, E, A) 定义如下：
      
      V = V_space ∪ V_system ∪ V_device  (节点集)
        - V_space: 空间节点集（源自Agent-02，保持空间拓扑）
        - V_system: 系统节点集（源自Agent-01，保持系统拓扑）
        - V_device: 设备节点集（源自Agent-03）
        
      E = {e₁, e₂, ..., eₙ}  (超边集)
        - 每条超边 eᵢ ⊆ V 代表一个完整的耦合单元
        - 超边连接多个不同类型的节点
        
      A: E → (M × N × I)  (超边属性映射)
        - M: 物质流属性
        - N: 能量流属性
        - I: 信息流属性
        
    mathematical_notation:
      node_sets:
        V_space: "{s₁, s₂, ..., sₘ} where sᵢ ∈ Agent-02.Spaces"
        V_system: "{y₁, y₂, ..., yₙ} where yⱼ ∈ Agent-01.Systems"
        V_device: "{d₁, d₂, ..., dₖ} where dₖ ∈ Agent-03.Devices"
        
      hyperedge_definition: |
        eᵢ = (sₐ, yᵦ, D_subset) where:
        - sₐ ∈ V_space: 被服务的空间节点
        - yᵦ ∈ V_system: 提供服务的系统节点
        - D_subset ⊆ V_device: 参与的设备节点集
        
      attribute_triple:
        A(eᵢ) = (Mᵢ, Nᵢ, Iᵢ) where:
        - Mᵢ: MaterialFlow (物质流完整定义)
        - Nᵢ: EnergyFlow (能量流完整定义)
        - Iᵢ: InformationFlow (信息流完整定义)
        
    hypergraph_properties:
      - property: "多层关联"
        description: "单条超边可连接3层节点（空间、系统、设备）"
      - property: "属性丰富"
        description: "每条超边携带三流动完整属性"
      - property: "拓扑保持"
        description: "子图分别保持Agent-01/02的原始拓扑"

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 3.2 节点集定义
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_3_2_Node_Sets:
    
    space_nodes_V_space:
      
      source: "Agent-02 空间模型"
      
      topology_preservation: |
        空间节点集必须保持Agent-02定义的空间拓扑结构：
        - 建筑层级: Building → Floor → Department → Zone → Room
        - 邻接关系: 空间之间的物理邻接
        - 功能分区: 洁净区/污染区/辅助区
        
      node_structure:
        space_node:
          node_id: "string (Agent-02定义)"
          node_type: "SPACE"
          space_type: "string (如：手术室-I级)"
          hierarchy_level: "enum [BUILDING, FLOOR, DEPARTMENT, ZONE, ROOM]"
          parent_node: "string (上级空间)"
          child_nodes: "array[string] (下级空间)"
          adjacent_nodes: "array[string] (相邻空间)"
          functional_zone: "string (功能分区)"
          agent02_behavior_scenarios: "array[string] (行为场景ID)"
          
      key_space_nodes_example:
        - node_id: "OR-001"
          space_type: "手术室-I级-心外"
          hierarchy_path: "Building/3F/SurgicalDept/OR-Zone/OR-001"
          parent: "OR-Zone"
          adjacent: ["OR-002", "Corridor-OR", "Scrub-001"]
          functional_zone: "洁净区-核心"
          
    system_nodes_V_system:
      
      source: "Agent-01 系统模型"
      
      topology_preservation: |
        系统节点集必须保持Agent-01定义的系统拓扑结构：
        - 系统层级: 大系统 → 子系统 → 设备组
        - 能流关系: 源-干-支-终端
        - 冗余关系: 主备关系
        
      node_structure:
        system_node:
          node_id: "string (Agent-01定义)"
          node_type: "SYSTEM"
          system_type: "string (如：HVAC-CLN)"
          hierarchy_level: "enum [MAJOR_SYSTEM, SUBSYSTEM, EQUIPMENT_GROUP]"
          parent_system: "string (上级系统)"
          child_systems: "array[string] (下级系统)"
          upstream_systems: "array[string] (上游系统-能流)"
          downstream_systems: "array[string] (下游系统-能流)"
          redundant_pair: "string (冗余对)"
          
      key_system_nodes_example:
        - node_id: "HVAC-CLN-OR"
          system_type: "洁净空调-手术部"
          hierarchy_path: "MEP/HVAC/CLN/HVAC-CLN-OR"
          parent: "HVAC-CLN"
          upstream: ["HVAC-CHP (冷源)", "HVAC-HWS (热源)"]
          downstream: ["各手术室终端"]
          
    device_nodes_V_device:
      
      source: "Agent-03 设备模型"
      
      node_structure:
        device_node:
          node_id: "string (Agent-03定义)"
          node_type: "DEVICE"
          device_type: "string (如：组合式空调机组)"
          role: "enum [SOURCE, DISTRIBUTION, TERMINAL, CONTROL, SENSOR]"
          parent_system: "string (所属系统)"
          location: "string (安装位置)"
          served_spaces: "array[string] (服务的空间)"
          
      key_device_nodes_example:
        - node_id: "AHU-OR-001"
          device_type: "组合式空调机组"
          role: "DISTRIBUTION"
          parent_system: "HVAC-CLN-OR"
          location: "3F空调机房"
          served_spaces: ["OR-001", "OR-002"]

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 3.3 超边集定义
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_3_3_Hyperedge_Set:
    
    hyperedge_structure:
      
      hyperedge:
        edge_id: "string (唯一标识)"
        edge_name: "string (描述性名称)"
        coupling_unit_id: "string (关联的耦合单元ID)"
        
        connected_nodes:
          space_node: "string (空间节点ID)"
          system_node: "string (系统节点ID)"
          device_nodes: "array[string] (设备节点ID列表)"
          
        flow_attributes:
          material_flow: "MaterialFlowAttribute"
          energy_flow: "EnergyFlowAttribute"
          information_flow: "InformationFlowAttribute"
          
        criticality: "enum [CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW]"
        reliability_requirement: "number (可用性%)"
        
    hyperedge_examples:
      
      - edge_id: "HE-OR001-HVAC-CLN-COOLING"
        edge_name: "手术室OR-001洁净冷却服务"
        coupling_unit_id: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
        
        connected_nodes:
          space_node: "OR-001"
          system_node: "HVAC-CLN-OR"
          device_nodes: 
            - "CHL-19XR-001 (冷水机)"
            - "CHWP-001 (冷冻水泵)"
            - "AHU-OR-001 (空调机组)"
            - "TS-OR-001 (温度传感器)"
            - "CV-OR-001 (冷冻水阀)"
            
        flow_attributes:
          material_flow:
            carrier: "冷冻水"
            path: "CHL-19XR-001→CHWP-001→AHU-OR-001→CHL-19XR-001"
            flow_rate: "150 m³/h"
            lifecycle: "闭式循环"
          energy_flow:
            form: "冷量"
            supply: "600 kW @ 7°C"
            demand: "50 kW"
            efficiency: "98%"
          information_flow:
            sensors: ["TS-OR-001送风温度", "TS-OR-002回风温度"]
            controller: "DDC-HVAC-001"
            actuators: ["CV-OR-001冷冻水阀"]
            loop: "送风温度PID控制"
            
        criticality: "CRITICAL"
        reliability_requirement: 99.99
        
      - edge_id: "HE-OR001-MGAS-O2-SUPPLY"
        edge_name: "手术室OR-001氧气供应服务"
        coupling_unit_id: "CU-OR001-MGAS_O2-SUPPLY"
        
        connected_nodes:
          space_node: "OR-001"
          system_node: "MGAS-O2"
          device_nodes:
            - "LOX-001 (液氧储罐)"
            - "VAP-001 (汽化器)"
            - "REG-001 (减压器)"
            - "ZV-OR-001 (区域阀)"
            - "OT-OR-001 (氧气终端)"
            - "PS-OR-001 (压力传感器)"
            
        flow_attributes:
          material_flow:
            carrier: "医用氧气"
            path: "LOX-001→VAP-001→REG-001→ZV-OR-001→OT-OR-001"
            flow_rate: "15 L/min (终端)"
            lifecycle: "开式供应"
          energy_flow:
            form: "气体压力能"
            supply: "400 kPa @ 汇流排"
            demand: "400 kPa @ 终端"
            losses: "管道压降 5%"
          information_flow:
            sensors: ["PS-OR-001终端压力", "PS-MAIN主管压力"]
            controller: "MGAS-MC-001"
            actuators: ["切换阀 (自动切换)"]
            alarms: ["低压报警 < 350 kPa"]
            
        criticality: "CRITICAL"
        reliability_requirement: 99.999

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 3.4 拓扑保持性验证
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_3_4_Topology_Preservation:
    
    verification_requirements:
      
      space_topology_preservation:
        requirement: |
          超图中的空间节点子图必须与Agent-02的空间拓扑同构：
          - 保持层级关系 (parent-child)
          - 保持邻接关系 (adjacent)
          - 保持功能分区 (functional zone)
          
        verification_method:
          - step: "提取超图中的空间节点子图 G_space"
          - step: "从Agent-02获取原始空间拓扑 T_space"
          - step: "验证 G_space ≅ T_space (图同构)"
          - step: "验证所有边和属性保持一致"
          
        verification_status:
          for_space: "OR-001"
          hierarchy_preserved: true
          adjacent_preserved: true
          functional_zone_preserved: true
          
      system_topology_preservation:
        requirement: |
          超图中的系统节点子图必须与Agent-01的系统拓扑同构：
          - 保持系统层级 (major → sub → equipment)
          - 保持能流关系 (upstream → downstream)
          - 保持冗余关系 (redundant pair)
          
        verification_method:
          - step: "提取超图中的系统节点子图 G_system"
          - step: "从Agent-01获取原始系统拓扑 T_system"
          - step: "验证 G_system ≅ T_system (图同构)"
          - step: "验证能流方向和冗余关系"
          
        verification_status:
          for_system: "HVAC-CLN-OR"
          hierarchy_preserved: true
          energy_flow_preserved: true
          redundancy_preserved: true
          
      cross_topology_consistency:
        requirement: |
          超边连接的节点必须满足语义一致性：
          - 系统节点确实服务于连接的空间节点
          - 设备节点确实属于连接的系统节点
          - 设备节点确实位于或服务于连接的空间节点
          
        verification_method:
          - step: "对每条超边 e = (s, y, D)"
          - step: "验证 y.serves(s) == true"
          - step: "验证 ∀d ∈ D: d.belongs_to(y) == true"
          - step: "验证 ∀d ∈ D: d.serves(s) || d.located_in(s)"

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 3.5 超图可视化模型
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_3_5_Visualization:
    
    visualization_layers:
      
      layer_1_space_topology:
        description: "空间拓扑层（底层）"
        display: "建筑平面/剖面视图"
        nodes: "空间节点（房间、区域）"
        edges: "邻接关系、层级关系"
        color_scheme:
          critical_spaces: "红色"
          clinical_spaces: "蓝色"
          support_spaces: "绿色"
          
      layer_2_system_topology:
        description: "系统拓扑层（中层）"
        display: "系统流程图"
        nodes: "系统节点"
        edges: "能流关系、冗余关系"
        color_scheme:
          hvac_systems: "天蓝色"
          electrical_systems: "黄色"
          medical_gas_systems: "绿色"
          plumbing_systems: "深蓝色"
          
      layer_3_coupling_hyperedges:
        description: "耦合超边层（顶层）"
        display: "三维耦合关系图"
        hyperedges: "跨层连接线"
        attributes: "物质流/能量流/信息流标注"
        color_scheme:
          material_flow: "蓝色虚线"
          energy_flow: "红色实线"
          information_flow: "绿色点线"
          
    visualization_example:
      title: "手术室OR-001超图耦合可视化"
      
      ascii_representation: |
        
        ┌─────────────────────── Layer 3: 耦合超边 ───────────────────────┐
        │                                                                  │
        │   [CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN]─────[CU-OR001-MGAS_O2]─────[CU-OR001-ELEC] │
        │         │                       │                      │        │
        │         │ M:冷冻水              │ M:氧气               │ M:电缆  │
        │         │ E:冷量                │ E:压力能             │ E:电能  │
        │         │ I:温度控制            │ I:压力监测           │ I:负荷  │
        │         │                       │                      │        │
        └─────────┼───────────────────────┼──────────────────────┼────────┘
                  │                       │                      │
        ┌─────────┼───────── Layer 2: 系统拓扑 ──────────────────┼────────┐
        │         ▼                       ▼                      ▼        │
        │   [HVAC-CLN-OR]           [MGAS-O2]              [ELEC-UPS]     │
        │      │    │                  │                      │           │
        │   [CHP]  [AHU]            [LOX]──[VAP]──[REG]    [UPS]──[IT]   │
        │                                                                  │
        └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                  │                       │                      │
        ┌─────────┼───────── Layer 1: 空间拓扑 ──────────────────┼────────┐
        │         ▼                       ▼                      ▼        │
        │   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
        │   │                         OR-001                          │   │
        │   │                    (手术室-I级-心外)                    │   │
        │   │   ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐   │   │
        │   │   │ 层流区  │  │ 手术台  │  │ 设备区  │  │ 麻醉区  │   │   │
        │   │   └─────────┘  └─────────┘  └─────────┘  └─────────┘   │   │
        │   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
        │         │                                              │        │
        │   [OR-002]◄──Adjacent──►[Corridor-OR]◄──Adjacent──►[Scrub-001] │
        │                                                                  │
        └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

# Part 4: Agent-02融合模块

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    PART 4: AGENT-02 INTEGRATION MODULE
#                    Agent-02 空间功能-行为场景融合模块
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Agent02_Integration_Module:
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 4.1 空间功能-行为场景导入
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_4_1_Behavior_Scenario_Import:
    
    import_interface:
      source: "Agent-02 医疗工艺流程模型"
      format: "YAML/JSON"
      update_frequency: "与Agent-02同步"
      
    imported_data_structure:
      
      SpaceBehaviorScenario:
        scenario_id: "string"
        space_id: "string (关联空间)"
        scenario_name: "string"
        scenario_type: "enum [MEDICAL_PROCEDURE, DAILY_OPERATION, EMERGENCY, MAINTENANCE]"
        
        actors:
          type: "array[Actor]"
          Actor:
            role: "string"
            count: "number"
            skill_requirement: "string"
            
        timeline:
          type: "array[Phase]"
          Phase:
            phase_id: "string"
            phase_name: "string"
            duration: "number (minutes)"
            start_condition: "string"
            end_condition: "string"
            
        equipment_usage:
          type: "array[EquipmentUse]"
          EquipmentUse:
            equipment_type: "string"
            usage_phase: "array[string] (phase_ids)"
            power_demand: "number (kW)"
            gas_demand: "object {O2, VAC, AIR, N2O, CO2}"
            
        environmental_requirements_by_phase:
          type: "map[phase_id → EnvironmentalRequirement]"
          
    imported_scenarios_for_priority_spaces:
      
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # 手术室 OR-001 行为场景
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      
      OR_001_Scenarios:
        
        - scenario_id: "SCN-OR001-CARDIAC-SURGERY"
          space_id: "OR-001"
          scenario_name: "心脏外科手术"
          scenario_type: "MEDICAL_PROCEDURE"
          
          actors:
            - role: "主刀医生"
              count: 1
            - role: "一助"
              count: 1
            - role: "麻醉医生"
              count: 1
            - role: "灌注师"
              count: 1
            - role: "器械护士"
              count: 1
            - role: "巡回护士"
              count: 2
              
          timeline:
            - phase_id: "P1-PREP"
              phase_name: "术前准备"
              duration: 30
              start_condition: "手术室已清洁消毒"
              end_condition: "患者入室"
              
            - phase_id: "P2-ANESTHESIA"
              phase_name: "麻醉诱导"
              duration: 30
              start_condition: "患者入室"
              end_condition: "麻醉完成，体位摆放完毕"
              
            - phase_id: "P3-PRE-CPB"
              phase_name: "术前准备-建立监测"
              duration: 30
              start_condition: "麻醉完成"
              end_condition: "体外循环准备就绪"
              
            - phase_id: "P4-CPB-ON"
              phase_name: "体外循环期"
              duration: 120
              start_condition: "体外循环启动"
              end_condition: "心脏复跳"
              
            - phase_id: "P5-CPB-WEAN"
              phase_name: "撤离体外循环"
              duration: 60
              start_condition: "心脏复跳"
              end_condition: "完全撤离体外循环"
              
            - phase_id: "P6-CLOSE"
              phase_name: "关胸止血"
              duration: 60
              start_condition: "撤离体外循环"
              end_condition: "手术结束"
              
            - phase_id: "P7-TRANSFER"
              phase_name: "转运"
              duration: 15
              start_condition: "手术结束"
              end_condition: "患者离开手术室"
              
          equipment_usage:
            - equipment_type: "体外循环机"
              usage_phase: ["P4-CPB-ON", "P5-CPB-WEAN"]
              power_demand: 20
              gas_demand:
                O2: "10 L/min"
                
            - equipment_type: "麻醉机"
              usage_phase: ["P2-ANESTHESIA", "P3-PRE-CPB", "P4-CPB-ON", "P5-CPB-WEAN", "P6-CLOSE"]
              power_demand: 0.5
              gas_demand:
                O2: "8 L/min"
                N2O: "4 L/min"
                AIR: "2 L/min"
                
            - equipment_type: "无影灯"
              usage_phase: ["P3-PRE-CPB", "P4-CPB-ON", "P5-CPB-WEAN", "P6-CLOSE"]
              power_demand: 0.8
              
            - equipment_type: "电刀"
              usage_phase: ["P3-PRE-CPB", "P4-CPB-ON", "P5-CPB-WEAN", "P6-CLOSE"]
              power_demand: 0.5
              
            - equipment_type: "监护仪"
              usage_phase: ["P2-ANESTHESIA", "P3-PRE-CPB", "P4-CPB-ON", "P5-CPB-WEAN", "P6-CLOSE", "P7-TRANSFER"]
              power_demand: 0.2
              
          environmental_requirements_by_phase:
            
            P1-PREP:
              temperature:
                setpoint: 22
                tolerance: 2
                unit: "°C"
              humidity:
                setpoint: 50
                tolerance: 10
                unit: "%"
              pressure:
                setpoint: 15
                unit: "Pa"
                reference: "相对洁净走廊"
              cleanliness:
                class: "ISO5"
                laminar_flow: "ON"
              lighting:
                level: "HIGH"
                lux: 500
                
            P2-ANESTHESIA:
              temperature:
                setpoint: 24
                tolerance: 1
                unit: "°C"
              humidity:
                setpoint: 50
                tolerance: 10
                unit: "%"
              pressure:
                setpoint: 15
                unit: "Pa"
              oxygen_demand:
                fio2: "100%"
                flow: "8 L/min"
                
            P4-CPB-ON:
              temperature:
                setpoint: 18
                tolerance: 1
                unit: "°C"
                note: "低温心脏停跳，需要降温"
              humidity:
                setpoint: 50
                tolerance: 5
                unit: "%"
              cooling_demand:
                type: "INCREASED"
                reason: "体外循环机散热 + 房间降温"
                additional_load: 30
                unit: "kW"
              power_demand:
                type: "PEAK"
                ecmo_power: 20
                unit: "kW"
                note: "体外循环机必须UPS保障"
                
            P5-CPB-WEAN:
              temperature:
                setpoint: 22
                tolerance: 1
                unit: "°C"
                note: "逐步复温"
              transition:
                from_temp: 18
                to_temp: 22
                rate: "1°C/10min"
                
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # ICU 行为场景
      # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      
      ICU_001_Scenarios:
        
        - scenario_id: "SCN-ICU001-POST-CARDIAC"
          space_id: "ICU-001"
          scenario_name: "心外术后监护"
          scenario_type: "MEDICAL_PROCEDURE"
          
          actors:
            - role: "ICU主治医生"
              count: 1
            - role: "ICU护士"
              count: 2
              note: "1:1或1:2护理"
              
          timeline:
            - phase_id: "P1-ADMIT"
              phase_name: "术后转入"
              duration: 30
              
            - phase_id: "P2-STABILIZE"
              phase_name: "稳定期"
              duration: 360
              
            - phase_id: "P3-WEAN-VENT"
              phase_name: "脱机"
              duration: 120
              
            - phase_id: "P4-TRANSFER"
              phase_name: "转出"
              duration: 30
              
          environmental_requirements_by_phase:
            
            P1-ADMIT:
              temperature:
                setpoint: 24
                tolerance: 1
                unit: "°C"
                note: "术后患者保温"
              pressure:
                setpoint: 10
                unit: "Pa"
              oxygen_demand:
                type: "MECHANICAL_VENTILATION"
                fio2: "60-100%"
                
            P2-STABILIZE:
              temperature:
                setpoint: 24
                tolerance: 1
                unit: "°C"
              humidity:
                setpoint: 50
                tolerance: 10
                unit: "%"
              circadian_lighting:
                enabled: true
                daytime_cct: 5000
                nighttime_cct: 2700
                
            P3-WEAN-VENT:
              oxygen_demand:
                type: "REDUCING"
                note: "逐步降低FiO2，准备脱机"

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 4.2 环境参数需求→系统响应映射
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_4_2_Requirement_Response_Mapping:
    
    mapping_principle: |
      每个空间环境参数需求必须映射到具体的系统响应：
      需求(Agent-02) → 耦合单元(Agent-05) → 系统配置(Agent-01) → 设备动作(Agent-03)
      
    requirement_response_pairs:
      
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # 温度控制映射
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      temperature_control_mappings:
        
        - mapping_id: "MAP-OR001-TEMP"
          
          requirement:
            source: "Agent-02"
            space: "OR-001"
            parameter: "temperature"
            scenario: "心脏外科手术"
            phase: "P4-CPB-ON (体外循环期)"
            value: 18
            tolerance: 1
            unit: "°C"
            priority: "CRITICAL"
            
          system_responses:
            
            - response_id: "RSP-OR001-TEMP-1"
              system: "HVAC-CHP (冷冻站)"
              role: "冷源供给"
              coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CHP-COOLING"
              
              actions:
                - action: "确保冷冻水供水温度"
                  parameter: "supply_water_temp"
                  setpoint: 7
                  unit: "°C"
                  control_method: "冷水机组温度控制"
                  
                - action: "确保冷冻水流量"
                  parameter: "chilled_water_flow"
                  setpoint: 150
                  unit: "m³/h"
                  control_method: "变频泵调节"
                  
              three_flow_impact:
                material_flow: "冷冻水流量增加至设计值"
                energy_flow: "冷量供给 50 kW → 80 kW (增加30kW)"
                information_flow: "冷水机组负荷指令增加"
                
            - response_id: "RSP-OR001-TEMP-2"
              system: "HVAC-CLN-OR (洁净空调)"
              role: "送风温度调节"
              coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
              
              actions:
                - action: "调节送风温度"
                  parameter: "supply_air_temp"
                  setpoint: 16
                  unit: "°C"
                  control_method: "AHU冷冻水阀调节"
                  
                - action: "关闭再热器"
                  parameter: "reheat_valve"
                  setpoint: 0
                  unit: "%"
                  
              three_flow_impact:
                material_flow: "冷冻水阀开度 60% → 100%"
                energy_flow: "送风冷量增加"
                information_flow: "送风温度PID控制，设定值由22°C降至16°C"
                
            - response_id: "RSP-OR001-TEMP-3"
              system: "INT-BA (楼控系统)"
              role: "监控与报警"
              coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-INT_BA-MONITOR"
              
              actions:
                - action: "室内温度监测"
                  parameter: "room_temperature"
                  sampling_rate: "1 Hz"
                  display: "手术室内显示屏"
                  
                - action: "温度报警设置"
                  alarm_high: 20
                  alarm_low: 16
                  unit: "°C"
                  notification: ["BA主站", "手术室护士站"]
                  
              three_flow_impact:
                information_flow: "温度实时监测 + 趋势分析 + 报警"
                
          control_sequence:
            - step: 1
              trigger: "医生下达降温指令"
              actor: "麻醉医生/灌注师"
              
            - step: 2
              action: "BA系统接收温度设定值变更"
              system: "INT-BA"
              
            - step: 3
              action: "AHU送风温度设定值降低"
              system: "HVAC-CLN-OR"
              response_time: "即时"
              
            - step: 4
              action: "冷冻水阀开度增加"
              system: "HVAC-CLN-OR (AHU)"
              response_time: "30s"
              
            - step: 5
              action: "冷水机组负荷增加"
              system: "HVAC-CHP"
              response_time: "2-5min"
              
            - step: 6
              action: "室内温度开始下降"
              expected_rate: "1°C / 5min"
              
            - step: 7
              check: "温度达到设定值"
              action: "进入稳态控制"
              
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # 压力梯度控制映射
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      pressure_control_mappings:
        
        - mapping_id: "MAP-ICU001-PRESSURE"
          
          requirement:
            source: "Agent-02"
            space: "ICU-001"
            parameter: "pressure_gradient"
            scenario: "ICU日常运行"
            value: 10
            unit: "Pa"
            reference: "相对走廊"
            direction: "正压"
            priority: "HIGH"
            
          system_responses:
            
            - response_id: "RSP-ICU001-PRES-1"
              system: "HVAC-AHU-ICU"
              role: "送排风平衡"
              coupling_unit: "CU-ICU001-HVAC_AHU-PRESSURE"
              
              actions:
                - action: "维持送排风差"
                  parameter: "supply_exhaust_ratio"
                  value: 1.1
                  note: "送风量比排风量大10%"
                  
                - action: "调节送风量"
                  parameter: "supply_air_volume"
                  setpoint: 3000
                  unit: "m³/h"
                  
                - action: "调节排风量"
                  parameter: "exhaust_air_volume"
                  setpoint: 2700
                  unit: "m³/h"
                  
              three_flow_impact:
                material_flow: "送风3000m³/h，排风2700m³/h"
                energy_flow: "送风机能耗+排风机能耗"
                information_flow: "送排风联动控制"
                
            - response_id: "RSP-ICU001-PRES-2"
              system: "INT-BA"
              role: "压差监控"
              
              actions:
                - action: "压差实时监测"
                  parameter: "differential_pressure"
                  sensor: "DP-ICU-001"
                  sampling_rate: "1 Hz"
                  
                - action: "压差报警"
                  alarm_high: 15
                  alarm_low: 5
                  unit: "Pa"
                  
                - action: "联动控制"
                  condition: "pressure < 5 Pa"
                  action: "增加送风量"
                  
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # 氧气供应映射
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      oxygen_supply_mappings:
        
        - mapping_id: "MAP-OR001-O2"
          
          requirement:
            source: "Agent-02"
            space: "OR-001"
            parameter: "oxygen_supply"
            scenario: "心脏外科手术-麻醉诱导"
            phase: "P2-ANESTHESIA"
            demand:
              fio2: "100%"
              flow: "8 L/min"
            priority: "CRITICAL"
            
          system_responses:
            
            - response_id: "RSP-OR001-O2-1"
              system: "MGAS-O2"
              role: "氧气供给"
              coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-MGAS_O2-SUPPLY"
              
              actions:
                - action: "确保终端供气压力"
                  parameter: "terminal_pressure"
                  setpoint: 400
                  tolerance: 40
                  unit: "kPa"
                  
                - action: "确保流量能力"
                  parameter: "flow_capacity"
                  minimum: 15
                  unit: "L/min"
                  
              three_flow_impact:
                material_flow:
                  carrier: "医用氧气"
                  path: "液氧站→汇流排→手术部区域阀→OR-001终端"
                  flow_rate: "8-15 L/min"
                  lifecycle:
                    supply: "液氧储罐 → 汽化 → 减压"
                    consumption: "麻醉机消耗"
                    return: "无 (开式系统)"
                    
                energy_flow:
                  form: "压力势能"
                  supply_pressure: "400 kPa"
                  consumption: "麻醉机减压使用"
                  
                information_flow:
                  sensors: ["终端压力", "区域阀压力", "主管压力"]
                  alarms: ["低压报警 < 350 kPa"]
                  display: "医用气体监控面板"

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 4.3 医疗工艺流程→系统协调
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_4_3_Medical_Process_System_Coordination:
    
    process_system_timeline:
      
      example_cardiac_surgery_timeline:
        
        process: "心脏外科手术"
        space: "OR-001"
        total_duration: "约6小时"
        
        timeline_with_system_states:
          
          - time: "T-60min"
            phase: "术前准备"
            medical_action: "手术室清洁消毒完成"
            system_states:
              HVAC-CLN:
                status: "运行"
                mode: "清洁模式"
                air_change: "20次/h"
                laminar_flow: "ON"
              HVAC-CHP:
                status: "待机"
                load: "40%"
              MGAS-O2:
                status: "待机"
                pressure: "400 kPa"
              ELEC-IT:
                status: "正常"
                load: "20%"
                
          - time: "T-30min"
            phase: "设备检查"
            medical_action: "麻醉设备、体外循环设备检查"
            system_states:
              MGAS-O2:
                status: "测试"
                action: "检查终端流量"
              MGAS-VAC:
                status: "测试"
                action: "检查吸引负压"
              ELEC-IT:
                status: "正常"
                action: "麻醉机、监护仪自检"
                
          - time: "T0"
            phase: "患者入室"
            medical_action: "患者进入手术室"
            system_states:
              HVAC-CLN:
                mode: "手术模式"
                temperature: "24°C"
                laminar_flow: "ON"
              lighting:
                mode: "高亮度"
                lux: 500
                
          - time: "T+30min"
            phase: "麻醉诱导"
            medical_action: "全麻诱导、插管"
            system_states:
              MGAS-O2:
                status: "使用中"
                demand: "8 L/min"
                fio2: "100%"
              MGAS-N2O:
                status: "使用中"
                demand: "4 L/min"
              ELEC-IT:
                load: "40%"
                devices_active: ["麻醉机", "监护仪", "输液泵"]
                
          - time: "T+60min"
            phase: "开胸、建立体外循环"
            medical_action: "正中开胸、插管、建立体外循环"
            system_states:
              HVAC-CLN:
                temperature: "22→18°C"
                mode: "降温模式"
                action: "开始降温"
              HVAC-CHP:
                load: "60%→80%"
                action: "增加冷量供给"
              ELEC-UPS:
                load: "增加"
                critical_load: "体外循环机上线"
                
          - time: "T+90min to T+210min"
            phase: "体外循环期"
            medical_action: "心脏停跳、手术操作"
            system_states:
              HVAC-CLN:
                temperature: "18°C"
                status: "维持"
              ELEC-UPS:
                load: "峰值"
                ecmo_power: "20 kW"
                priority: "CRITICAL"
              MGAS-O2:
                demand: "10 L/min (体外循环)"
              cooling:
                status: "PEAK"
                additional_load: "30 kW"
                
          - time: "T+210min"
            phase: "心脏复跳、撤离体外循环"
            medical_action: "复温、心脏复跳"
            system_states:
              HVAC-CLN:
                temperature: "18→22°C"
                action: "开始复温"
                rate: "1°C/10min"
              ELEC-UPS:
                load: "下降"
                ecmo: "逐步撤离"
                
          - time: "T+270min"
            phase: "关胸"
            medical_action: "止血、关胸"
            system_states:
              HVAC-CLN:
                temperature: "22°C"
                mode: "正常手术"
              ELEC:
                load: "正常"
                
          - time: "T+330min"
            phase: "转运"
            medical_action: "患者转ICU"
            system_states:
              HVAC-CLN:
                mode: "待机→清洁"
              MGAS:
                status: "关闭"
              lighting:
                mode: "清洁模式"

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 4.4 空间分类与系统配置矩阵
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Section_4_4_Space_Classification_System_Matrix:
    
    description: |
      基于Agent-02的空间功能分类，直接映射到系统配置需求。
      这是Agent-05的核心输出之一，供Agent-06/07/08使用。
      
    classification_system_matrix:
      
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # 手术室类空间
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      surgical_spaces:
        
        - classification: "手术室-I级 (心外/神外/器官移植)"
          agent02_space_types:
            - "心脏外科手术室"
            - "神经外科手术室"
            - "器官移植手术室"
            
          mandatory_systems:
            HVAC:
              - system: "HVAC-CLN"
                specification:
                  cleanliness: "ISO 5"
                  air_change: "≥25次/h (其中层流≥15)"
                  laminar_flow_area: "3.0m×3.0m"
                  filtration: "H13 HEPA"
              - system: "HVAC-CHP"
                coupling: "提供冷源"
              - system: "HVAC-HWS"
                coupling: "提供热源 (再热)"
                
            MGAS:
              - system: "MGAS-O2"
                terminals: 4
              - system: "MGAS-VAC"
                terminals: 4
              - system: "MGAS-AIR"
                terminals: 2
              - system: "MGAS-N2O"
                terminals: 1
              - system: "MGAS-CO2"
                terminals: 1
                condition: "心外科"
                
            ELEC:
              - system: "ELEC-IT"
                capacity: "10 kVA"
              - system: "ELEC-UPS"
                capacity: "60 kVA"
                note: "含体外循环机专用"
                
            INT:
              - system: "INT-BA"
              - system: "INT-NUR"
              - system: "INT-NET"
              
          environmental_parameters:
            temperature:
              range: "18-26°C"
              precision: "±1°C"
              adjustable: true
            humidity:
              range: "40-60%"
              precision: "±10%"
            pressure:
              value: "+15Pa"
              gradient: "洁净区>走廊>污物区"
              
          special_requirements:
            - "体外循环工艺冷却水接口"
            - "杂交手术室需增加射线防护"
            
        - classification: "手术室-II级 (骨科/普外/妇产)"
          agent02_space_types:
            - "骨科手术室"
            - "普外科手术室"
            - "妇产科手术室"
            
          mandatory_systems:
            HVAC:
              - system: "HVAC-CLN"
                specification:
                  cleanliness: "ISO 6"
                  air_change: "≥20次/h"
                  laminar_flow_area: "2.4m×2.4m"
                  
            MGAS:
              - system: "MGAS-O2"
                terminals: 2
              - system: "MGAS-VAC"
                terminals: 2
              - system: "MGAS-AIR"
                terminals: 1
              - system: "MGAS-N2O"
                terminals: 1
              - system: "MGAS-CO2"
                terminals: 1
                condition: "腹腔镜手术"
                
            ELEC:
              - system: "ELEC-IT"
                capacity: "8 kVA"
              - system: "ELEC-UPS"
                capacity: "15 kVA"
                
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # ICU类空间
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      icu_spaces:
        
        - classification: "ICU-综合/心外术后"
          agent02_space_types:
            - "综合ICU"
            - "心外ICU"
            - "神外ICU"
            
          mandatory_systems:
            HVAC:
              - system: "HVAC-AHU-ICU"
                specification:
                  cleanliness: "ISO 7"
                  air_change: "≥12次/h"
                  pressure: "+10Pa"
                  
            MGAS:
              - system: "MGAS-O2"
                terminals_per_bed: 2
              - system: "MGAS-VAC"
                terminals_per_bed: 2
              - system: "MGAS-AIR"
                terminals_per_bed: 1
                
            ELEC:
              - system: "ELEC-IT"
                capacity: "5 kVA/4床"
              - system: "ELEC-UPS"
                scope: "生命支持设备"
                
          special_requirements:
            - "昼夜节律照明"
            - "2-3床负压隔离能力"
            
        - classification: "NICU (新生儿重症)"
          agent02_space_types:
            - "新生儿重症监护室"
            
          mandatory_systems:
            HVAC:
              - system: "HVAC-PAC"
                specification:
                  temperature_precision: "±0.5°C"
                  humidity_precision: "±5%"
                  cleanliness: "ISO 7"
                  zone_control: true
                  
            MGAS:
              - system: "MGAS-O2"
                terminals_per_bed: 2
                feature: "氧气-空气混合器"
              - system: "MGAS-VAC"
                terminals_per_bed: 2
                
            ELEC:
              - system: "ELEC-IT"
                capacity: "5 kVA/4床"
              - system: "ELEC-UPS"
                scope: "暖箱必须保障"
                
          special_requirements:
            - "恒温恒湿精密控制"
            - "噪声≤40dB(A)"
            - "可调光照明"
```

# Part 5: 5个关键空间耦合单元实例库

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    PART 5: COUPLING UNIT INSTANCE LIBRARY
#                    5个关键空间的完整耦合单元实例库
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Coupling_Unit_Instance_Library:
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 5.1 手术室 OR-001 完整耦合单元集
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  OR_001_Coupling_Units:
    
    space_id: "OR-001"
    space_name: "心脏外科手术室"
    space_type: "手术室-I级-心外"
    coupling_unit_count: 12
    
    units:
      
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # CU-1: 洁净空调冷却服务
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      
      - unit_id: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
        unit_name: "手术室OR-001洁净空调冷却服务"
        unit_class: "HVAC"
        criticality_grade: "CRITICAL"
        
        topology_binding:
          space_node:
            node_id: "OR-001"
            space_type: "手术室-I级-心外"
            space_topology_path: "Building/3F/SurgicalDept/OR-Zone/OR-001"
            parent_spaces: ["OR-Zone", "SurgicalDept"]
            adjacent_spaces: ["OR-002", "Corridor-OR", "Scrub-001"]
            
          system_node:
            node_id: "HVAC-CLN-OR"
            system_type: "洁净空调系统-手术部"
            system_topology_path: "MEP/HVAC/CLN/HVAC-CLN-OR"
            upstream_systems: ["HVAC-CHP", "HVAC-HWS"]
            downstream_systems: ["终端设备"]
            
          device_nodes:
            - device_id: "CHL-19XR-001"
              device_type: "离心式冷水机组"
              device_role: "SOURCE"
              location: "B1冷冻站"
            - device_id: "CHWP-001"
              device_type: "冷冻水循环泵"
              device_role: "DISTRIBUTION"
              location: "B1冷冻站"
            - device_id: "AHU-OR-001"
              device_type: "组合式空调机组"
              device_role: "DISTRIBUTION"
              location: "3F空调机房"
            - device_id: "HEPA-OR-001"
              device_type: "高效过滤送风单元"
              device_role: "TERMINAL"
              location: "OR-001天花板"
              
        functional_behavior_binding:
          behavior_scenario:
            scenario_id: "SCN-OR001-CARDIAC-SURGERY"
            scenario_name: "心脏外科手术"
            scenario_phase: "P4-CPB-ON (体外循环期)"
            actors: ["主刀医生", "灌注师", "麻醉医生", "护士"]
            
          environmental_requirement:
            requirement_id: "REQ-OR001-TEMP-CPB"

              - parameter_name: "temperature"
                target_value: 18
                unit: "°C"
                tolerance: 1
                control_precision: "PRECISION"
                priority: "CRITICAL"
                
          behavior_trigger:
            trigger_type: "EVENT_BASED"
            trigger_condition: "phase == 'P4-CPB-ON' AND surgeon_command == 'cool_down'"
            trigger_source: "MEDICAL_PROCESS"
            
        three_flow_coupling:
          
          material_flow:
            enabled: true
            carrier: "冷冻水"
            carrier_properties:
              medium_type: "LIQUID"
              phase: "液态"
              composition: "纯水 + 乙二醇15%"
              
            flow_path:
              origin: "B1层冷冻站CHL-19XR-001"
              destination: "3F手术室AHU-OR-001表冷器"
              route: ["B1竖井SH-01", "3F水平管廊", "手术部管井MR-OR"]
              pipe_id: "PIPE-CHW-OR-001"
              
            flow_parameters:
              flow_rate:
                value: 150
                unit: "m³/h"
              velocity:
                value: 1.5
                unit: "m/s"
              pressure:
                supply_pressure:
                  value: 0.6
                  unit: "MPa"
                return_pressure:
                  value: 0.4
                  unit: "MPa"
                pressure_drop:
                  value: 0.2
                  unit: "MPa"
                  
            lifecycle_phases:
              supply:
                source_capacity:
                  value: 600
                  unit: "kW"
                supply_condition:
                  temperature: 7
                  pressure: 0.6
                  unit: "°C / MPa"
                  
              consumption:
                consumption_rate:
                  design: 50
                  peak: 80
                  unit: "kW"
                consumption_pattern: "PEAK_VALLEY"
                note: "体外循环期峰值"
                
              return_or_discharge:
                return_type: "CLOSED_LOOP"
                return_condition:
                  temperature: 12
                  pressure: 0.4
                  
            agent04_physics_ref:
              equation_id: "EQ-FLUID-PIPE-001"
              model_type: "Darcy-Weisbach管道压降模型"
              
          energy_flow:
            enabled: true
            energy_form: "THERMAL_COOLING"
            energy_carrier: "冷冻水"
            
            source_specification:
              source_capacity:
                value: 600
                unit: "kW"
              source_condition:
                supply_temperature: 7
                return_temperature: 12
                unit: "°C"
                delta_t: 5
                
            demand_specification:
              design_demand:
                value: 50
                unit: "kW"
              peak_demand:
                value: 80
                unit: "kW"
                condition: "体外循环期 + 房间降温"
              average_demand:
                value: 40
                unit: "kW"
              demand_profile: "手术日高峰型"
              
            energy_balance:
              supply_energy:
                value: 80
                unit: "kW"
              consumed_energy:
                value: 78.4
                unit: "kW"
              conversion_efficiency:
                value: 98
                unit: "%"
              losses:
                transmission_loss:
                  value: 2
                  unit: "%"
                  note: "管道热损失"
                  
            surplus_handling:
              surplus_type: "NONE"
              note: "按需供给，无余能"
              
            agent04_physics_ref:
              equation_id: "EQ-THERMO-HX-001"
              model_type: "表冷器热交换模型 Q=m·Cp·ΔT"
              
          information_flow:
            enabled: true
            control_mode: "CLOSED_LOOP"
            
            sensing_layer:
              sensors:
                - sensor_id: "TS-OR-001-SA"
                  sensor_type: "温度传感器"
                  measured_parameter: "supply_air_temperature"
                  location: "AHU-OR-001送风口"
                  accuracy:
                    value: 0.1
                    unit: "°C"
                  sampling_rate:
                    value: 1
                    unit: "Hz"
                  protocol: "BACnet/IP"
                  
                - sensor_id: "TS-OR-001-RA"
                  sensor_type: "温度传感器"
                  measured_parameter: "return_air_temperature"
                  location: "OR-001回风口"
                  accuracy:
                    value: 0.1
                    unit: "°C"
                    
                - sensor_id: "TS-OR-001-RM"
                  sensor_type: "温度传感器"
                  measured_parameter: "room_temperature"
                  location: "OR-001室内"
                  accuracy:
                    value: 0.1
                    unit: "°C"
                    
            transmission_layer:
              network_type: "BACNET"
              transmission_path: "传感器→DDC-OR-001→BACnet网络→BA主站"
              latency:
                value: 100
                unit: "ms"
                
            control_layer:
              controller:
                controller_id: "DDC-OR-001"
                controller_type: "DDC控制器"
                control_algorithm: "PID温度控制"
                control_parameters:
                  Kp: 2.5
                  Ki: 0.1
                  Kd: 0.5
                  setpoint: 22
                  deadband: 0.5
                  
            actuation_layer:
              actuators:
                - actuator_id: "CV-OR-001"
                  actuator_type: "电动调节阀"
                  controlled_parameter: "冷冻水流量"
                  location: "AHU-OR-001冷冻水入口"
                  range:
                    min: 0
                    max: 100
                    unit: "%"
                  response_time:
                    value: 30
                    unit: "s"
                    
                - actuator_id: "VFD-AHU-OR-001"
                  actuator_type: "变频器"
                  controlled_parameter: "送风量"
                  location: "AHU-OR-001"
                  range:
                    min: 30
                    max: 100
                    unit: "%"
                    
            feedback_loop:
              loop_type: "CASCADE"
              loop_description: |
                外环：室温→设定值比较→送风温度设定
                内环：送风温度→PID控制→冷冻水阀开度→送风温度
              stability: "STABLE"
              response_characteristics:
                rise_time:
                  value: 5
                  unit: "min"
                settling_time:
                  value: 15
                  unit: "min"
                overshoot:
                  value: 5
                  unit: "%"
                  
            alarm_management:
              alarms:
                - alarm_id: "ALM-OR-001-TEMP-HIGH"
                  alarm_condition: "room_temperature > 26°C"
                  severity: "HIGH"
                  notification: ["BA主站", "手术室显示屏", "值班手机"]
                  response_action: "检查AHU、冷水机运行状态"
                  
                - alarm_id: "ALM-OR-001-TEMP-LOW"
                  alarm_condition: "room_temperature < 16°C"
                  severity: "MEDIUM"
                  notification: ["BA主站", "手术室显示屏"]
                  response_action: "检查控制设定"
                  
        reliability:
          reliability_grade: "CRITICAL"
          availability_target: 99.99
          redundancy:
            redundancy_type: "N+1"
            backup_system: "AHU-OR-002可部分支援"

              note: "冷水机N+1自动切换"
              
      # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

              - parameter_name: "backup_duration"
```

```yaml
        surplus_type: "NONE"
        note: "按需供冷，无冷量过剩"
        
      agent04_physics_reference:
        
        cooling_load_model:
          equation_id: "EQ-LOAD-CLG-001"
          model_name: "冷负荷计算"
          equation: "Q_total = Q_envelope + Q_lighting + Q_equipment + Q_people + Q_fresh_air"
          reference: "Agent-04 Section 4.1.2"
          
        energy_efficiency_model:
          equation_id: "EQ-EER-001"
          model_name: "系统能效比"
          equation: "EER_system = Q_cooling / (P_chiller + P_pump + P_fan)"
          reference: "Agent-04 Section 4.3.1"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 信息流详细分析
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    information_flow_detailed:
      
      flow_id: "IF-OR001-TEMP-CTRL"
      flow_name: "温度控制信息流"
      
      control_objective: "维持手术室温度在设定值±1°C"
      control_mode: "CASCADE"
      
      sensing_layer_detailed:
        
        sensor_inventory:
          
          - sensor_id: "TS-OR-001-RM"
            sensor_type: "室内温度传感器"
            technology: "Pt100 RTD"
            range: "0-50°C"
            accuracy: "±0.1°C"
            resolution: "0.01°C"
            location: "OR-001室内 (非层流区)"
            mounting: "壁挂 H=1.5m"
            sampling_rate: "1 Hz"
            signal_output: "4-20mA"
            protocol: "BACnet/IP"
            calibration: "年度校准"
            
          - sensor_id: "TS-OR-001-SA"
            sensor_type: "送风温度传感器"
            technology: "Pt100 RTD"
            location: "AHU-OR-001送风段"
            purpose: "内环控制"
            accuracy: "±0.1°C"
            
          - sensor_id: "TS-OR-001-RA"
            sensor_type: "回风温度传感器"
            technology: "Pt100 RTD"
            location: "OR-001回风口"
            purpose: "能量计算/故障诊断"
            
          - sensor_id: "TS-CHW-S"
            sensor_type: "冷冻水供水温度"
            location: "AHU冷冻水进口"
            purpose: "监测水温/诊断"
            
          - sensor_id: "TS-CHW-R"
            sensor_type: "冷冻水回水温度"
            location: "AHU冷冻水出口"
            purpose: "ΔT监测/能量计算"
            
        signal_conditioning:
          input_module: "AI模块 8通道"
          resolution: "16-bit"
          update_rate: "100ms"
          filtering: "数字滤波 τ=2s"
          
      transmission_layer_detailed:
        
        network_architecture:
          level_1:
            name: "现场总线层"
            protocol: "BACnet MS/TP"
            medium: "RS-485"
            devices: ["传感器", "执行器", "现场DDC"]
            speed: "76.8 kbps"
            
          level_2:
            name: "控制网络层"
            protocol: "BACnet/IP"
            medium: "以太网"
            devices: ["DDC控制器", "区域控制器"]
            speed: "100 Mbps"
            
          level_3:
            name: "管理网络层"
            protocol: "BACnet/IP + Web Services"
            medium: "以太网"
            devices: ["BA服务器", "工作站", "移动终端"]
            speed: "1 Gbps"
            
        transmission_path:
          path: "TS-OR-001-RM → DDC-OR-001 → BACnet/IP → BA-Server → 显示终端"
          latency: "< 200ms (端到端)"
          reliability: "99.9%"
          
        data_points:
          - point_id: "OR001.RM_TEMP"
            type: "AI (Analog Input)"
            engineering_unit: "°C"
            cov_increment: "0.2°C"
            
          - point_id: "OR001.RM_TEMP_SP"
            type: "AO (Analog Output)"
            engineering_unit: "°C"
            writeable: true
            range: "18-26°C"
            
      control_layer_detailed:
        
        control_architecture:
          type: "级联PID控制 (Cascade PID)"
          
          outer_loop:
            name: "室温控制回路"
            controlled_variable: "OR001.RM_TEMP"
            setpoint: "OR001.RM_TEMP_SP (22°C default)"
            output: "送风温度设定值"
            controller: "PI控制器"
            parameters:
              Kp: 2.0
              Ki: 0.05
              output_range: "14-20°C"
              
          inner_loop:
            name: "送风温度控制回路"
            controlled_variable: "OR001.SA_TEMP"
            setpoint: "外环输出"
            output: "冷冻水阀开度"
            controller: "PID控制器"
            parameters:
              Kp: 3.0
              Ki: 0.1
              Kd: 0.5
              output_range: "0-100%"
              
        control_logic:
          
          normal_operation:
            sequence:
              - step: "读取室温 T_room"
              - step: "计算偏差 e = SP - T_room"
              - step: "外环PI计算送风温度设定值 T_sa_sp"
              - step: "读取送风温度 T_sa"
              - step: "内环PID计算阀门开度 V_chw"
              - step: "输出阀门指令"
            cycle_time: "1 s"
            
          pulldown_mode:
            trigger: "手术医生请求降温"
            action: 
              - "降低室温设定值至18°C"
              - "切换至快速响应参数"
              - "预开冷冻水阀至50%"
            parameters:
              Kp: 4.0
              Ki: 0.2
              
        controller_hardware:
          controller_id: "DDC-OR-001"
          manufacturer: "Honeywell / Siemens / Johnson Controls"
          model: "可编程DDC控制器"
          io_capacity: "16AI, 8AO, 16DI, 8DO"
          memory: "256KB"
          battery_backup: "72 hours"
          
      actuation_layer_detailed:
        
        actuator_inventory:
          
          - actuator_id: "CV-OR-001"
            actuator_type: "电动二通调节阀"
            manufacturer: "Siemens / Belimo"
            model: "DN50 等百分比"
            function: "冷冻水流量调节"
            
            specifications:
              valve_size: "DN50"
              kvs: "40 m³/h"
              characteristic: "等百分比"
              rangeability: "50:1"
              close_off_pressure: "1.0 MPa"
              
            actuator_specs:
              type: "电动执行器"
              control_signal: "0-10V / 4-20mA"
              stroke_time: "60s (全行程)"
              feedback: "阀位反馈 4-20mA"
              fail_position: "失电关闭"
              manual_override: "手动操作轮"
              
            location: "AHU-OR-001冷冻水进口"
            
          - actuator_id: "VFD-AHU-OR-001-SF"
            actuator_type: "变频器"
            function: "送风机转速调节"
            motor_power: "15 kW"
            frequency_range: "20-50 Hz"
            control_signal: "4-20mA"
            feedback: "实际频率/电流"
            
      feedback_loop_detailed:
        
        loop_analysis:
          
          open_loop_transfer_function:
            description: "送风温度对阀位的响应"
            model: "一阶加滞后 G(s) = K × e^(-τd×s) / (τ×s + 1)"
            parameters:
              K: "0.15 °C/%"
              τ: "30 s"
              τd: "10 s"
              
          closed_loop_characteristics:
            stability: "STABLE"
            gain_margin: "> 6 dB"
            phase_margin: "> 45°"
            
          response_characteristics:
            step_response:
              rise_time: "3 min"
              settling_time: "8 min"
              overshoot: "< 5%"
              steady_state_error: "< 0.2°C"
              
        disturbance_rejection:
          
          - disturbance: "手术灯开启 (+2kW)"
            response_time: "5 min"
            max_deviation: "0.5°C"
            
          - disturbance: "人员进入 (+0.8kW)"
            response_time: "3 min"
            max_deviation: "0.3°C"
            
          - disturbance: "体外循环机启动 (+20kW)"
            response_time: "10 min"
            max_deviation: "1.0°C"
            mitigation: "前馈控制"
            
      alarm_management_detailed:
        
        alarm_points:
          
          - alarm_id: "ALM-OR001-TEMP-HH"
            description: "室温过高报警"
            condition: "OR001.RM_TEMP > 26°C"
            severity: "CRITICAL"
            priority: 1
            delay: "0 s"
            notification:
              - target: "手术室内显示屏"
                method: "声光报警"
              - target: "BA主站"
                method: "弹窗+声音"
              - target: "值班手机"
                method: "短信+推送"
            response_action: "检查AHU运行、冷水机状态"
            auto_action: "启动备用AHU"
            
          - alarm_id: "ALM-OR001-TEMP-H"
            description: "室温偏高警告"
            condition: "OR001.RM_TEMP > 25°C"
            severity: "HIGH"
            priority: 2
            delay: "60 s"
            notification: ["BA主站"]
            
          - alarm_id: "ALM-OR001-TEMP-L"
            description: "室温偏低警告"
            condition: "OR001.RM_TEMP < 17°C"
            severity: "MEDIUM"
            priority: 3
            delay: "120 s"
            note: "体外循环期间可能正常"
            
          - alarm_id: "ALM-OR001-CHW-VALVE-FAIL"
            description: "冷冻水阀故障"
            condition: "阀位反馈与指令偏差>10%持续60s"
            severity: "HIGH"
            response_action: "切换手动、检修阀门"
            
      operator_interface:
        
        local_display:
          location: "OR-001室内"
          display_type: "触摸屏 7寸"
          display_content:
            - "当前室温 / 设定值"
            - "送风温度"
            - "湿度"
            - "压差"
            - "运行模式"
          control_authority:
            - "温度设定值调节 (限18-26°C)"
            - "运行模式切换"
          security: "密码保护"
          
        central_station:
          location: "设备科BA控制室"
          functions:
            - "所有参数监视"
            - "报警确认与处理"
            - "趋势记录与分析"
            - "参数修改 (授权)"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # CU-2: 氧气供应服务 (详细三流动)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  CU_OR001_MGAS_O2_SUPPLY:
    
    unit_id: "CU-OR001-MGAS_O2-SUPPLY"
    unit_name: "手术室OR-001氧气供应服务"
    criticality_grade: "CRITICAL"
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 物质流详细分析
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    material_flow_detailed:
      
      flow_id: "MF-OR001-O2"
      flow_name: "医用氧气流动"
      
      carrier_specification:
        medium: "医用氧气"
        purity: "≥99.5% O2"
        standard: "YY/T 0298"
        moisture: "≤43 ppm"
        oil: "≤0.1 mg/m³"
        co: "≤5 ppm"
        co2: "≤300 ppm"
        
      flow_topology:
        
        multi_source_configuration:
          
          primary_source:
            source_id: "LOX-001"
            type: "液氧储罐"
            location: "室外液氧站 (东北角)"
            capacity: "3000 L液氧"
            working_pressure: "1.6 MPa"
            gasification_capacity: "100 Nm³/h"
            days_supply: "≥7天"
            
          secondary_source:
            source_id: "MAN-O2-001"
            type: "汇流排 (组1)"
            location: "气瓶间"
            configuration: "10瓶 × 40L"
            pressure: "15 MPa"
            days_supply: "≥1天"
            trigger: "主气源压力 < 0.6 MPa"
            
          tertiary_source:
            source_id: "MAN-O2-002"
            type: "汇流排 (组2)"
            location: "气瓶间"
            configuration: "10瓶 × 40L"
            trigger: "组1压力 < 0.6 MPa"
            
          emergency_source:
            source_id: "CYL-O2-ER"
            type: "便携式氧气瓶"
            location: "手术室内"
            capacity: "2瓶 × 10L"
            purpose: "紧急备用"
            
        distribution_path:
          
          - segment: "气源出口"
            from: "LOX-001"
            to: "汽化器 VAP-001"
            pipe_spec: "不锈钢管 DN40"
            
          - segment: "汽化后主管"
            from: "VAP-001"
            to: "一级减压器 REG-O2-P"
            pipe_spec: "紫铜管 DN32"
            pressure: "1.6→0.8 MPa"
            
          - segment: "站内输出管"
            from: "REG-O2-P"
            to: "建筑入口"
            pipe_spec: "紫铜管 DN32"
            
          - segment: "主立管"
            from: "建筑入口"
            to: "各楼层"
            pipe_spec: "脱脂紫铜管 DN25"
            location: "医用气体竖井"
            
          - segment: "楼层水平干管"
            from: "竖井出口"
            to: "手术部区域阀箱"
            pipe_spec: "脱脂紫铜管 DN20"
            
          - segment: "手术部分配管"
            from: "区域阀箱 ZV-OR-O2"
            to: "各手术室"
            pipe_spec: "脱脂紫铜管 DN15"
            
          - segment: "室内分支"
            from: "房间入口"
            to: "终端 OT-OR-001"
            pipe_spec: "脱脂紫铜管 DN10"
            
        terminal_configuration:
          terminal_count: 4
          terminal_locations:
            - "手术床头设备塔 × 2"
            - "麻醉塔 × 1"
            - "壁挂终端 × 1"
          terminal_type: "快插自封终端"
          terminal_pressure: "400 ±40 kPa"
          terminal_flow: "≥60 L/min (满载)"
          
      flow_parameters_detailed:
        
        pressure_profile:
          storage_pressure: "1.6 MPa (液氧储罐)"
          primary_regulation: "1.6→0.8 MPa"
          secondary_regulation: "0.8→0.45 MPa (区域阀前)"
          terminal_pressure: "400 kPa ±10%"
          
        flow_rate:
          single_terminal: "0-15 L/min"
          or001_total: "0-40 L/min"
          surgical_dept_total: "0-200 L/min"
          
        flow_scenarios:
          
          scenario_1:
            name: "麻醉诱导"
            fio2: "100%"
            fresh_gas_flow: "8 L/min"
            o2_flow: "8 L/min"
            duration: "10-15 min"
            
          scenario_2:
            name: "麻醉维持"
            fio2: "50-60%"
            fresh_gas_flow: "2-4 L/min"
            o2_flow: "1-2 L/min"
            duration: "手术全程"
            
          scenario_3:
            name: "体外循环"
            ecmo_o2_flow: "10 L/min"
            麻醉机: "暂停"
            total: "10-12 L/min"
            
      lifecycle_detailed:
        
        supply_phase:
          process: |
            液氧储存 → 自然汽化(空温式) → 一级减压 → 
            管网输送 → 二级减压 → 区域阀 → 终端
          capacity_calculation:
            daily_consumption: "500 Nm³/day (全院)"
            storage_days: "3000L液氧 × 800倍 / 500 = 4.8天 (实际≥7天)"
          replenishment:
            trigger: "液位 < 30%"
            supplier: "医用气体供应商"
            lead_time: "24小时内"
            
        consumption_phase:
          consumers:
            - "麻醉机"
            - "呼吸机"
            - "体外循环机"
            - "急救复苏设备"
          consumption_monitoring:
            terminal_flowmeter: "麻醉机内置"
            area_flowmeter: "区域阀处 (可选)"
            
        return_phase:
          return_type: "OPEN_SYSTEM"
          discharge: "呼出气体排至室外"
          exhaust_path: "麻醉废气排放系统"
          treatment: "无 (氧气安全)"
          
      agent04_physics_reference:
        
        gas_flow_model:
          equation_id: "EQ-GAS-FLOW-001"
          model_name: "可压缩气体管道流动"
          equation: "Q = C × A × √(2×ρ×ΔP)"
          for_sizing: "Panhandle / Weymouth公式"
          reference: "Agent-04 Section 2.2.1"
          
        pressure_drop_model:
          equation_id: "EQ-GAS-DP-001"
          model_name: "气体管道压降"
          equation: "P1² - P2² = K × Q² × L × T / D⁵"
          reference: "Agent-04 Section 2.2.3"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 能量流详细分析
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    energy_flow_detailed:
      
      flow_id: "EF-OR001-O2"
      flow_name: "氧气压力势能流"
      
      energy_form: "PNEUMATIC"
      energy_carrier: "压缩氧气"
      
      energy_content:
        pressure_energy:
          calculation: "E = P × V"
          storage_energy: "液氧潜热+压力"
          
        available_pressure:
          terminal: "400 kPa"
          work_capacity: "驱动麻醉机/呼吸机"
          
      energy_consumption:
        
        麻醉机:
          function: "气体混合、流量控制"
          pressure_drop: "400→100 kPa (内部减压)"
          energy_use: "驱动气路阀门"
          
        呼吸机:
          function: "正压通气"
          pressure_requirement: "满足PEEP需求"
          
      losses:
        pipe_pressure_drop: "5%"
        terminal_losses: "minimal"
        
      agent04_physics_reference:
        equation_id: "EQ-GAS-ENERGY-001"
        model_name: "气体压力能"
        equation: "W = nRT×ln(P1/P2) (等温过程)"
        reference: "Agent-04 Section 5.1.2"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 信息流详细分析
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    information_flow_detailed:
      
      flow_id: "IF-OR001-O2-MONITOR"
      flow_name: "氧气供应监控信息流"
      
      control_mode: "MONITORING + ALARM"
      note: "氧气系统主要为监控，非闭环控制"
      
      sensing_layer_detailed:
        
        sensor_inventory:
          
          - sensor_id: "PS-LOX-001"
            sensor_type: "液氧储罐压力传感器"
            range: "0-2.5 MPa"
            accuracy: "±0.5%"
            location: "液氧储罐"
            
          - sensor_id: "LS-LOX-001"
            sensor_type: "液氧液位计"
            type: "差压式液位计"
            range: "0-100%"
            accuracy: "±1%"
            location: "液氧储罐"
            
          - sensor_id: "PS-O2-MAIN"
            sensor_type: "主管压力传感器"
            range: "0-1.0 MPa"
            accuracy: "±0.5%"
            location: "气源站出口"
            
          - sensor_id: "PS-O2-ZV-OR"
            sensor_type: "区域压力传感器"
            range: "0-0.6 MPa"
            accuracy: "±0.5%"
            location: "手术部区域阀后"
            
          - sensor_id: "SS-MAN-O2"
            sensor_type: "汇流排状态"
            type: "开关量"
            indication: "主组/备组/切换中"
            
      transmission_layer_detailed:
        
        network: "医用气体监控专网"
        protocol: "Modbus TCP / BACnet/IP"
        path: "传感器→MGAS-MC→BA系统"
        
        data_integration:
          to_ba_system: true
          to_nurse_station: true
          to_equipment_dept: true
          
      monitoring_layer:
        
        monitoring_parameters:
          - "液氧液位"
          - "各级压力"
          - "汇流排状态"
          - "区域阀状态"
          
        display_locations:
          - "医用气体监控室"
          - "手术部护士站"
          - "BA主站"
          
      alarm_management_detailed:
        
        alarm_strategy: "多级报警"
        
        alarm_points:
          
          - alarm_id: "ALM-LOX-LL"
            description: "液氧液位低低"
            condition: "液位 < 20%"
            severity: "CRITICAL"
            notification: ["气体监控室", "设备科", "供应商"]
            action: "紧急送气"
            
          - alarm_id: "ALM-LOX-L"
            description: "液氧液位低"
            condition: "液位 < 30%"
            severity: "HIGH"
            notification: ["设备科", "供应商"]
            action: "安排送气"
            
          - alarm_id: "ALM-O2-MAIN-L"
            description: "氧气主管压力低"
            condition: "压力 < 0.5 MPa"
            severity: "CRITICAL"
            notification: ["气体监控室", "手术部"]
            action: "检查气源、切换汇流排"
            
          - alarm_id: "ALM-O2-ZV-L"
            description: "区域压力低"
            condition: "压力 < 350 kPa"
            severity: "CRITICAL"
            notification: ["手术室内", "护士站"]
            action: "检查区域阀、检修"
            
          - alarm_id: "ALM-MAN-SWITCHOVER"
            description: "汇流排切换"
            condition: "主组→备组切换"
            severity: "HIGH"
            notification: ["设备科"]
            action: "更换空瓶"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # CU-3 到 CU-12 简化表示 (结构相同，详细程度相当)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  CU_OR001_Summary:
    
    - unit_id: "CU-OR001-MGAS_VAC-SUCTION"
      three_flow_summary:
```

# 空间3：NICU 完整三流动分析

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    SPACE 3: NICU (新生儿重症监护室)
#                    COMPLETE THREE-FLOW COUPLING ANALYSIS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

NICU_Complete_Analysis:
  
  space_profile:
    space_id: "NICU-001"
    space_name: "新生儿重症监护室"
    space_type: "ICU-NICU"
    床位数: 15
    floor_area: "400 m²"
    床均面积: "20 m²/床"
    cleanliness_class: "ISO 7"
    
  special_requirements:
    temperature_precision: "±0.5°C"
    humidity_precision: "±5%"
    noise_limit: "40 dB(A)"
    lighting: "可调光，保护婴儿眼睛"
    
  coupling_unit_inventory:
    total_units: 12
    
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # CU-1: NICU精密恒温服务 (核心)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  CU_NICU_HVAC_PAC_PRECISION_TEMP:
    
    unit_id: "CU-NICU-HVAC_PAC-PRECISION_TEMP"
    unit_name: "NICU精密恒温服务"
    criticality_grade: "CRITICAL"
    
    design_basis:
      reason: |
        新生儿尤其是早产儿体温调节能力差，
        环境温度波动可导致低体温或高热，危及生命。
        必须采用精密空调实现±0.5°C的温度控制精度。
        
    material_flow_detailed:
      carrier: "冷冻水/热水 + 送风"
      
      system_configuration:
        type: "精密空调机组 (PAC)"
        quantity: "3台 (2用1备)"
        capacity: "30 kW/台"
        
      zone_control:
        zones: 4
        zone_definition:
          - zone: "暖箱区 (床位1-6)"
            setpoint: "26°C"
            note: "暖箱有独立温控"
          - zone: "辐射台区 (床位7-10)"
            setpoint: "25°C"
          - zone: "恢复区 (床位11-15)"
            setpoint: "24°C"
          - zone: "操作区"
            setpoint: "24°C"
            
    energy_flow_detailed:
      form: "冷量/热量"
      
      cooling_load:
        sensible: "60 kW"
        latent: "15 kW"
        total: "75 kW"
        sensible_heat_ratio: "0.8"
        
      heating_load:
        reheat_capacity: "30 kW"
        purpose: "精确温度控制"
        
    information_flow_detailed:
      
      control_strategy: "多区精密控制"
      
      sensing:
        temperature_sensors:
          type: "高精度铂电阻"
          accuracy: "±0.1°C"
          quantity: "每区2个 (冗余)"
          sampling: "1 Hz"
          
      control_loop:
        type: "PID + 前馈"
        setpoint_precision: "0.1°C"
        control_output: "变频压缩机 + 电加热器"
        
      response_characteristics:
        temperature_fluctuation: "≤±0.5°C"
        recovery_time: "< 5 min (开门后)"
        
      alarms:
        - "温度高于27°C"
        - "温度低于23°C"
        - "温度波动超限"
        
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # CU-2: NICU精密恒湿服务
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  CU_NICU_HVAC_PAC_PRECISION_HUMIDITY:
    
    unit_id: "CU-NICU-HVAC_PAC-PRECISION_HUMIDITY"
    unit_name: "NICU精密恒湿服务"
    criticality_grade: "HIGH"
    
    design_basis:
      reason: |
        新生儿皮肤薄，经皮水分丢失大，
        环境湿度过低会导致脱水，过高会增加感染风险。
        需维持50-60% ±5%的精密湿度控制。
        
    material_flow_detailed:
      carrier: "加湿蒸汽/除湿冷凝水"
      
      humidification:
        type: "电极加湿器"
        capacity: "30 kg/h"
        water_quality: "软化水"
        
      dehumidification:
        type: "表冷器+再热"
        capacity: "依冷量"
        
    energy_flow_detailed:
      humidification_power: "25 kW (电极加湿)"
      latent_load: "15 kW"
      
    information_flow_detailed:
      
      sensing:
        humidity_sensors:
          type: "高精度湿度传感器"
          accuracy: "±1.5%"
          quantity: "每区1个"
          
      control:
        setpoint: "55% ±5%"
        method: "加湿器调节 + 新风比例"
        
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # CU-3: NICU氧气-空气混合服务 (特殊)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  CU_NICU_MGAS_O2_BLENDER:
    
    unit_id: "CU-NICU-MGAS_O2-BLENDER"
    unit_name: "NICU氧气-空气混合服务"
    criticality_grade: "CRITICAL"
    
    design_basis:
      reason: |
        新生儿尤其是早产儿对氧气敏感，
        高浓度氧气可导致视网膜病变（ROP），
        必须精确控制FiO2，通常使用氧气-空气混合器。
        
    material_flow_detailed:
      carriers:
        - "医用氧气 (O2)"
        - "医用压缩空气 (Air)"
        
      terminal_configuration:
        oxygen_terminals: "30 (2/床)"
        air_terminals: "30 (2/床)"
        
      blender_configuration:
        type: "气体混合器"
        fio2_range: "21-100%"
        precision: "±2%"
        每床配置: "1台混合器"
        
      consumption_profile:
        low_flow: "0.5-2 L/min"
        high_flow: "up to 10 L/min (CPAP)"
        fio2_typical: "25-40%"
        
    energy_flow_detailed:
      form: "压力势能"
      o2_pressure: "400 kPa"
      air_pressure: "400 kPa"
      note: "两种气体压力必须匹配"
      
    information_flow_detailed:
      
      monitoring:
        - fio2_monitor: "床旁FiO2监测"
        - spo2_monitor: "患儿SpO2监测"
        
      alarm:
        - "FiO2超出设定范围"
        - "SpO2低于设定下限"
        - "气体压力不匹配"
        
      closed_loop_possible:
        description: "闭环氧疗"
        principle: "SpO2→自动调节FiO2"
        equipment: "智能氧疗仪"
        
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # CU-4: NICU暖箱专用UPS
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  CU_NICU_ELEC_UPS_INCUBATOR:
    
    unit_id: "CU-NICU-ELEC_UPS-INCUBATOR"
    unit_name: "NICU暖箱专用UPS服务"
    criticality_grade: "CRITICAL"
    
    design_basis:
      reason: |
        暖箱是早产儿生存的关键设备，
        断电会导致箱内温度快速下降，危及生命。
        必须保障0秒切换和长备用时间。
        
    material_flow_detailed:
      carrier: "电缆"
      path: "UPS→配电箱→暖箱插座"
      
    energy_flow_detailed:
      form: "电能"
      
      load_calculation:
        incubator_power: "0.5 kW/台"
        incubator_count: 10
        total_load: "5 kW"
        diversity: "1.0 (全部同时运行)"
        
      ups_specification:
        capacity: "10 kVA"
        backup_time: "≥60 min"
        switchover: "0 ms"
        topology: "在线式双变换"
        
    information_flow_detailed:
      monitoring:
        - "UPS输入/输出电压"
        - "电池电量/健康状态"
        - "负载率"
        
      alarms:
        - alarm: "市电中断→电池供电"
          severity: "CRITICAL"
          action: "检查发电机启动"
        - alarm: "电池电量低"
          severity: "CRITICAL"
          action: "准备应急措施"
          
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 其他耦合单元简化表示
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  NICU_Other_CUs:
    
    - unit_id: "CU-NICU-MGAS_VAC-SUCTION"
      purpose: "负压吸引"
      terminals: "30 (2/床)"
      
    - unit_id: "CU-NICU-ELEC_IT-POWER"
      purpose: "IT系统供电"
      capacity: "5 kVA/4床"
      
    - unit_id: "CU-NICU-ELEC_LTG-DIMMABLE"
      purpose: "可调光照明"
      feature: "保护婴儿眼睛，最大500 lx"
      
    - unit_id: "CU-NICU-INT_BA-MONITOR"
      purpose: "环境监控"
      extra: "噪声监测"
      
    - unit_id: "CU-NICU-HVAC_PRESSURE"
      purpose: "压差控制"
      setpoint: "+10 Pa"
      
    - unit_id: "CU-NICU-PLUMB_HW-BATHING"
      purpose: "婴儿沐浴热水"
      temperature: "37-38°C"
      precision: "±0.5°C"
      safety: "防烫伤恒温阀"
```

# 空间4：急诊抢救室 完整三流动分析
