# P1-2: Agent-04物理方程应用上下文完善

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    P1-2: AGENT-04 PHYSICS EQUATION CONTEXT
#                    物理方程应用上下文完善
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Agent04_Physics_Context:
  
  purpose: |
    完善Agent-04物理方程在Agent-05中的应用上下文，
    包括适用范围、边界条件、参数取值和简化假设。
    
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 热力学方程组
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Thermodynamics_Equations:
    
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # EQ-1: 表冷器热交换模型
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    EQ_HX_COIL_001:
      
      equation_id: "EQ-HX-COIL-001"
      equation_name: "表冷器热交换模型"
      
      mathematical_form:
        primary: "Q = ε × C_min × (T_hot_in - T_cold_in)"
        alternative: "Q = U × A × LMTD"
        ntu_method: "ε = f(NTU, C_r)"
        
      variable_definitions:
        Q:
          symbol: "Q"
          description: "换热量"
          unit: "kW"
          typical_range: "10-100 kW (AHU表冷器)"
          
        ε:
          symbol: "ε"
          description: "换热效率"
          unit: "无量纲"
          typical_range: "0.5-0.9"
          influencing_factors:
            - "换热器类型（逆流/叉流）"
            - "传热面积"
            - "流速"
            - "污垢系数"
            
        C_min:
          symbol: "C_min"
          description: "最小热容量率"
          unit: "kW/K"
          calculation: "min(m_air × Cp_air, m_water × Cp_water)"
          
        T_hot_in:
          symbol: "T_hot,in"
          description: "热流体入口温度"
          unit: "°C"
          application: "表冷器中为进风温度"
          typical: "26-35°C (夏季)"
          
        T_cold_in:
          symbol: "T_cold,in"
          description: "冷流体入口温度"
          unit: "°C"
          application: "表冷器中为冷冻水供水温度"
          typical: "5-7°C"
          
      applicability:
        
        valid_conditions:
          - "稳态工况"
          - "无相变（仅显热交换）"
          - "流体物性常数（在温度范围内）"
          - "忽略热损失到环境"
          
        invalid_conditions:
          - "存在凝结水析出（湿工况需修正）"
          - "强瞬态过程"
          - "大温差下物性变化显著"
          
      boundary_conditions:
        
        air_side:
          inlet_temp: "26-35°C"
          inlet_humidity: "40-80%"
          velocity: "2-3 m/s (面速)"
          
        water_side:
          inlet_temp: "5-7°C"
          outlet_temp: "10-12°C"
          velocity: "0.5-1.5 m/s (管内)"
          fouling_factor: "0.00009 m²K/W"
          
      simplifying_assumptions:
        
        - assumption: "热容量率比恒定"
          impact: "小 (<5%误差)"
          validity: "常规运行范围内有效"
          
        - assumption: "流量均匀分布"
          impact: "中 (可达10%)"
          validity: "良好的管路设计可保证"
          
        - assumption: "忽略轴向导热"
          impact: "小 (<2%)"
          validity: "对典型换热器有效"
          
      parameter_ranges:
        
        for_ahu_coil:
          ntu: "0.5-2.0"
          heat_transfer_coefficient:
            air_side: "30-60 W/(m²K)"
            water_side: "2000-4000 W/(m²K)"
          overall_u: "25-50 W/(m²K)"
          
      application_in_agent05:
        
        coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
        
        example_calculation:
          given:
            air_flow: "5000 m³/h"
            air_temp_in: "26°C"
            water_flow: "15 m³/h"
            water_temp_in: "7°C"
            coil_effectiveness: 0.85
            
          calculation:
            m_air: "5000/3600 × 1.2 = 1.67 kg/s"
            C_air: "1.67 × 1.0 = 1.67 kW/K"
            m_water: "15/3.6 × 1.0 = 4.17 kg/s"
            C_water: "4.17 × 4.18 = 17.4 kW/K"
            C_min: "1.67 kW/K (空气侧)"
            Q: "0.85 × 1.67 × (26-7) = 27 kW"
            
          result:
            cooling_capacity: "27 kW"
            air_temp_out: "26 - 27/1.67 = 9.8°C"
            
      uncertainty_analysis:
        
        sources:
          - source: "效率ε估计"
            uncertainty: "±10%"
          - source: "流量测量"
            uncertainty: "±5%"
          - source: "温度测量"
            uncertainty: "±0.5°C"
            
        combined_uncertainty:
          Q: "±15%"
          note: "设计阶段需考虑安全系数"
          
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # EQ-2: 空间冷负荷计算
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    EQ_LOAD_CLG_001:
      
      equation_id: "EQ-LOAD-CLG-001"
      equation_name: "空间冷负荷计算"
      
      mathematical_form:
        total: "Q_total = Q_envelope + Q_lighting + Q_equipment + Q_people + Q_fresh_air"
        
      component_models:
        
        Q_envelope:
          formula: "Q_env = U × A × ΔT × CLF"
          description: "围护结构传热"
          parameters:
            U: "传热系数 W/(m²K)"
            A: "面积 m²"
            ΔT: "温差 K"
            CLF: "冷负荷系数 (蓄热修正)"
          typical_values:
            external_wall: "0.5-1.0 W/(m²K)"
            internal_wall: "1.5-2.5 W/(m²K)"
            
        Q_lighting:
          formula: "Q_ltg = P × CLF × 使用系数"
          description: "照明发热"
          parameters:
            P: "灯具功率 W"
            CLF: "冷负荷系数"
          typical_values:
            手术室: "500-1000 W (不含无影灯)"
            无影灯: "500-800 W (考虑散热)"
            
        Q_equipment:
          formula: "Q_equip = Σ(P_i × 使用系数 × 同时系数)"
          description: "设备发热"
          or_001_example:
            体外循环机: "2000 W"
            麻醉机: "500 W"
            电刀: "300 W"
            监护仪: "200 W"
            total: "约3000 W (同时系数0.8 → 2400W)"
            
        Q_people:
          formula: "Q_people = n × q"
          description: "人体发热"
          parameters:
            n: "人数"
            q: "人均发热量 W/人"
          typical_values:
            坐姿轻度工作: "70 W"
            站立中度工作: "100 W"
            手术室医护: "100-120 W"
            
        Q_fresh_air:
          formula: "Q_fa = m_fa × (h_out - h_in)"
          description: "新风负荷"
          parameters:
            m_fa: "新风量 kg/s"
            h: "焓值 kJ/kg"
          typical_values:
            夏季室外焓值: "80-90 kJ/kg"
            室内焓值: "50-55 kJ/kg"
            
      application_in_agent05:
        
        coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
        
        or_001_load_breakdown:
          envelope: "5 kW"
          lighting: "2 kW"
          equipment: "10 kW (含体外循环)"
          people: "0.8 kW (8人)"
          fresh_air: "15 kW"
          subtotal: "32.8 kW"
          safety_factor: "1.2"
          design_load: "40 kW"
          cpb_additional: "+40 kW"
          peak_load: "80 kW"
          
      accuracy_considerations:
        
        design_stage:
          method: "稳态计算 + 安全系数"
          safety_factor: "1.1-1.3"
          uncertainty: "±20%"
          
        operation_stage:
          method: "实测 + 模型修正"
          uncertainty: "±10%"
          
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 流体力学方程组
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Fluid_Mechanics_Equations:
    
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # EQ-3: Darcy-Weisbach 压降公式
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    EQ_FLUID_DW_001:
      
      equation_id: "EQ-FLUID-DW-001"
      equation_name: "Darcy-Weisbach管道压降公式"
      
      mathematical_form:
        primary: "ΔP = f × (L/D) × (ρV²/2)"
        head_form: "h_f = f × (L/D) × (V²/2g)"
        
      variable_definitions:
        ΔP:
          description: "压力降"
          unit: "Pa"
          
        f:
          description: "达西摩擦系数"
          unit: "无量纲"
          determination:
            laminar: "f = 64/Re (Re < 2300)"
            turbulent: "Colebrook-White 或 Moody图"
            explicit: "Swamee-Jain公式"
            
        L:
          description: "管道长度"
          unit: "m"
          
        D:
          description: "管道内径"
          unit: "m"
          
        ρ:
          description: "流体密度"
          unit: "kg/m³"
          typical: "1000 kg/m³ (水)"
          
        V:
          description: "流速"
          unit: "m/s"
          
      applicability:
        
        valid_conditions:
          - "稳态流动"
          - "不可压缩流体"
          - "圆形截面管道"
          - "充满流动"
          
        reynolds_number:
          laminar: "Re < 2300"
          transition: "2300 < Re < 4000"
          turbulent: "Re > 4000"
          typical_hvac: "Re = 10,000-100,000 (湍流)"
          
      local_losses:
        description: "局部阻力"
        formula: "ΔP_local = K × (ρV²/2)"
        K_values:
          90_elbow: "0.3-0.9"
          tee_branch: "1.0-1.5"
          valve_gate: "0.1-0.2 (全开)"
          valve_globe: "4-10"
          
      application_in_agent05:
        
        coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
        
        example_chw_pipe:
          given:
            pipe: "DN65 (内径 = 68 mm)"
            length: "50 m"
            flow_rate: "15 m³/h"
            roughness: "0.05 mm (钢管)"
            
          calculation:
            velocity: "15/3600 / (π×0.068²/4) = 1.15 m/s"
            reynolds: "1.15 × 0.068 / 1e-6 = 78,000 (湍流)"
            relative_roughness: "0.05/68 = 0.00074"
            friction_factor: "0.019 (Moody图)"
            pressure_drop: "0.019 × (50/0.068) × (1000×1.15²/2) = 9.2 kPa"
            
          local_losses:
            elbows: "4 × 0.5 × (1000×1.15²/2) = 1.3 kPa"
            valves: "2 × 0.2 × (1000×1.15²/2) = 0.3 kPa"
            
          total: "9.2 + 1.3 + 0.3 = 10.8 kPa"
          
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # EQ-4: 气体流量公式
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    EQ_GAS_FLOW_001:
      
      equation_id: "EQ-GAS-FLOW-001"
      equation_name: "医用气体终端流量计算"
      
      mathematical_form:
        orifice: "Q = Cd × A × √(2×ΔP/ρ)"
        choked: "Q = Cd × A × P1 × √(k/(R×T) × (2/(k+1))^((k+1)/(k-1)))"
        
      variable_definitions:
        Q:
          description: "体积流量"
          unit: "m³/s 或 L/min"
          
        Cd:
          description: "流量系数"
          unit: "无量纲"
          typical: "0.6-0.9"
          
        A:
          description: "孔口面积"
          unit: "m²"
          
        ΔP:
          description: "压差"
          unit: "Pa"
          
        ρ:
          description: "气体密度"
          unit: "kg/m³"
          oxygen_at_400kPa: "5.4 kg/m³"
          
      flow_regimes:
        
        subsonic:
          condition: "P2/P1 > 0.528 (空气)"
          characteristic: "流量与√ΔP成正比"
          
        choked:
          condition: "P2/P1 ≤ 0.528"
          characteristic: "流量仅与上游压力P1成正比"
          
      application_in_agent05:
        
        coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-MGAS_O2-SUPPLY"
        
        terminal_flow_example:
          given:
            supply_pressure: "400 kPa (绝对压力)"
            downstream: "大气压 101 kPa"
            pressure_ratio: "101/400 = 0.25"
            
          analysis:
            regime: "阻塞流 (P2/P1 < 0.528)"
            implication: "流量仅受上游压力控制"
            terminal_max_flow: "≥60 L/min (规范要求)"
            
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 控制系统方程组
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Control_Systems_Equations:
    
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # EQ-5: PID 控制方程
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    EQ_PID_001:
      
      equation_id: "EQ-PID-001"
      equation_name: "PID控制器方程"
      
      mathematical_form:
        continuous: "u(t) = Kp×e(t) + Ki×∫e(τ)dτ + Kd×de/dt"
        discrete: "u(k) = Kp×e(k) + Ki×Σe(i)×Δt + Kd×[e(k)-e(k-1)]/Δt"
        velocity_form: "Δu(k) = Kp×[e(k)-e(k-1)] + Ki×e(k)×Δt + Kd×[e(k)-2e(k-1)+e(k-2)]/Δt"
        
      parameter_definitions:
        
        Kp:
          description: "比例增益"
          effect: "增大响应速度，减小稳态误差，可能增加超调"
          tuning: "根据过程增益和时间常数确定"
          
        Ki:
          description: "积分增益"
          unit: "1/s"
          effect: "消除稳态误差，可能导致超调和振荡"
          anti_windup: "需要积分限幅防止饱和"
          
        Kd:
          description: "微分增益"
          unit: "s"
          effect: "预测趋势，减少超调，可能放大噪声"
          filter: "通常与低通滤波结合使用"
          
      tuning_methods:
        
        ziegler_nichols:
          description: "临界增益法"
          process:
            - "将I和D设为0"
            - "逐步增大Kp直到系统持续振荡"
            - "记录临界增益Ku和振荡周期Tu"
            - "根据规则计算Kp, Ki, Kd"
          pi_controller:
            Kp: "0.45 × Ku"
            Ki: "0.54 × Ku / Tu"
          pid_controller:
            Kp: "0.6 × Ku"
            Ki: "1.2 × Ku / Tu"
            Kd: "0.075 × Ku × Tu"
            
        lambda_tuning:
          description: "Lambda调节法"
          applicable: "一阶加滞后过程"
          formula:
            Kp: "τ / (K × λ)"
            Ti: "τ"
            Td: "0"
          note: "λ越大响应越慢但越稳定"
          
      application_in_agent05:
        
        coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
        
        temperature_control_example:
          
          process_model:
            type: "一阶加滞后"
            transfer_function: "G(s) = K × e^(-τd×s) / (τ×s + 1)"
            parameters:
              K: "0.15 °C/% (阀位到温度)"
              τ: "30 s (时间常数)"
              τd: "10 s (滞后)"
              
          controller_parameters:
            method: "Lambda调节法，λ=60s"
            Kp: "30 / (0.15 × 60) = 3.3"
            Ki: "3.3 / 30 = 0.11"
            Kd: "0 (省略以避免噪声放大)"
            
          performance_specification:
            rise_time: "< 5 min"
            overshoot: "< 10%"
            steady_state_error: "< 0.5°C"
            
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # EQ-6: 一阶系统响应
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    EQ_FIRST_ORDER_001:
      
      equation_id: "EQ-FIRST-ORDER-001"
      equation_name: "一阶系统阶跃响应"
      
      mathematical_form:
        transfer_function: "G(s) = K / (τs + 1)"
        step_response: "y(t) = K × ΔU × (1 - e^(-t/τ))"
        with_delay: "G(s) = K × e^(-τd×s) / (τs + 1)"
        
      time_domain_characteristics:
        
        time_constant_τ:
          definition: "输出达到稳态值63.2%的时间"
          physical_meaning: "系统储能与耗散率之比"
          
        rise_time:
          definition: "输出从10%到90%的时间"
          formula: "t_r ≈ 2.2τ"
          
        settling_time:
          definition: "进入±5%误差带的时间"
          formula: "t_s ≈ 3τ (5%误差带)"
          
      application_in_agent05:
        
        room_temperature_response:
          description: "手术室作为热系统的一阶模型"
          
          model_derivation:
            energy_balance: "m×Cp×dT/dt = Q_supply - Q_load"
            linearized: "τ×dT/dt + T = T_supply"
            time_constant: "τ = m×Cp / (ṁ×Cp_air) ≈ V×ρ×Cp / (ACH×V×ρ×Cp/3600)"
            
          or_001_example:
            room_volume: "180 m³"
            air_change_rate: "30 ACH"
            calculated_τ: "180×1.2×1000 / (30×180×1.2×1000/3600) = 120 s ≈ 2 min"
            
          interpretation:
            meaning: "送风温度阶跃变化后，室温约2分钟达到63%响应"
            practical: "达到95%响应需要约6分钟 (3τ)"
            
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 电气系统方程组
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Electrical_Equations:
    
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # EQ-7: UPS电池备用时间
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    EQ_UPS_BACKUP_001:
      
      equation_id: "EQ-UPS-BACKUP-001"
      equation_name: "UPS电池备用时间计算"
      
      mathematical_form:
        basic: "t = C × V × η / P"
        with_discharge_rate: "t = C × V × η × K_rate / P"
        
      variable_definitions:
        t:
          description: "备用时间"
          unit: "h"
          
        C:
          description: "电池容量"
          unit: "Ah"
          
        V:
          description: "电池组电压"
          unit: "V"
          
        η:
          description: "逆变器效率"
          unit: "无量纲"
          typical: "0.92-0.96"
          
        P:
          description: "负载功率"
          unit: "W"
          
        K_rate:
          description: "放电速率修正系数"
          description_long: "高倍率放电时容量降低"
          typical: "0.7-1.0"
          
      application_in_agent05:
        
        coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-ELEC_UPS-POWER"
        
        example_calculation:
          given:
            ups_capacity: "60 kVA"
            load: "40 kW (实际)"
            battery_voltage: "384 V"
            battery_capacity: "100 Ah"
            inverter_efficiency: 0.94
            
          calculation:
            energy_stored: "384 × 100 = 38.4 kWh"
            usable_energy: "38.4 × 0.94 × 0.8 = 28.9 kWh"
            backup_time: "28.9 / 40 = 0.72 h = 43 min"
            
          design_verification:
            requirement: "≥30 min"
            result: "43 min ✓ 满足"
            
      battery_aging_consideration:
        
        capacity_fade:
          description: "电池容量随使用时间下降"
          typical_fade: "20%在5年后"
          design_margin: "考虑寿命末期容量"
          
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # EQ-8: IT系统绝缘电阻
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    EQ_IT_INSULATION_001:
      
      equation_id: "EQ-IT-INSULATION-001"
      equation_name: "医用IT系统绝缘电阻监测"
      
      mathematical_form:
        basic: "R_ins = U_test / I_leak"
        with_capacitance: "考虑电缆电容的复阻抗"
        
      threshold_values:
        alarm: "50 kΩ"
        normal: "> 100 kΩ"
        
      application_in_agent05:
        
        coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-ELEC_IT-ISOLATION"
        
        monitoring:
          device: "绝缘监测器 (IMD)"
          continuous: true
          display: "IT报警面板"
          
        first_fault_response:
          alarm: "声光报警"
          action: "不断电，允许继续手术"
          maintenance: "尽快检修"
          
        second_fault_response:
          action: "需要人工判断和处理"
```

# P2-1: BIM参数双向映射框架

## 1.1 BIM-CU映射架构

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    BIM-COUPLING UNIT MAPPING ARCHITECTURE
#                    BIM与耦合单元双向映射架构
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

BIM_CU_Mapping_Architecture:
  
  overview:
    purpose: |
      建立Agent-05耦合单元(CU)与BIM模型之间的双向参数映射，
      实现设计数据的自动提取和模型的自动更新。
      
    data_flow:
      forward: "BIM模型 → 参数提取 → 耦合单元属性填充"
      backward: "耦合单元计算结果 → 参数回写 → BIM模型更新"
      
    supported_formats:
      - "IFC 4.0/4.3 (开放标准)"
      - "Revit API (Autodesk)"
      - "COBie (运维数据)"
      
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 1.1.1 映射层级结构
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  mapping_hierarchy:
    
    level_1_space:
      description: "空间级映射"
      bim_entity: "IfcSpace"
      cu_entity: "Space Node (V_space)"
      
      mapping_rules:
        - bim_property: "IfcSpace.Name"
          cu_property: "space_id"
          transform: "直接映射"
          
        - bim_property: "IfcSpace.LongName"
          cu_property: "space_name"
          transform: "直接映射"
          
        - bim_property: "IfcSpace.ObjectType"
          cu_property: "space_type"
          transform: "类型代码映射表"
          
        - bim_property: "Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities.GrossFloorArea"
          cu_property: "floor_area"
          transform: "单位转换 (m²)"
          
        - bim_property: "Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities.GrossVolume"
          cu_property: "volume"
          transform: "单位转换 (m³)"
          
        - bim_property: "Pset_SpaceCommon.Reference"
          cu_property: "reference_standard"
          transform: "直接映射"
          
    level_2_system:
      description: "系统级映射"
      bim_entity: "IfcSystem / IfcDistributionSystem"
      cu_entity: "System Node (V_system)"
      
      mapping_rules:
        - bim_property: "IfcSystem.Name"
          cu_property: "system_id"
          
        - bim_property: "IfcSystem.ObjectType"
          cu_property: "system_type"
          
        - bim_property: "Pset_DistributionSystemCommon.PredefinedType"
          cu_property: "system_class"
          
    level_3_device:
      description: "设备级映射"
      bim_entity: "IfcDistributionElement 及其子类"
      cu_entity: "Device Node (V_device)"
      
      device_type_mapping:
        
        hvac_devices:
          - bim_type: "IfcAirTerminal"
            cu_type: "风口终端"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_AirTerminalTypeCommon.AirFlowRateRange", cu: "air_flow_range"}
              - {bim: "Pset_AirTerminalTypeCommon.NominalAirFlowRate", cu: "design_flow"}
              
          - bim_type: "IfcAirTerminalBox"
            cu_type: "VAV箱"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_AirTerminalBoxTypeCommon.AirFlowRateRange", cu: "flow_range"}
              - {bim: "Pset_AirTerminalBoxTypeCommon.HasFan", cu: "has_fan"}
              
          - bim_type: "IfcCoil"
            cu_type: "表冷器/加热盘管"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_CoilTypeCommon.NominalCoolingCapacity", cu: "cooling_capacity"}
              - {bim: "Pset_CoilTypeCommon.NominalHeatingCapacity", cu: "heating_capacity"}
              
          - bim_type: "IfcFan"
            cu_type: "风机"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_FanTypeCommon.NominalAirFlowRate", cu: "design_flow"}
              - {bim: "Pset_FanTypeCommon.NominalTotalPressure", cu: "design_pressure"}
              - {bim: "Pset_FanTypeCommon.NominalPowerRate", cu: "power"}
              
          - bim_type: "IfcUnitaryEquipment"
            cu_type: "空调机组(AHU/PAC)"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_UnitaryEquipmentTypeCommon.NominalCoolingCapacity", cu: "cooling_capacity"}
              - {bim: "Pset_UnitaryEquipmentTypeCommon.NominalAirFlowRate", cu: "air_flow"}
              
          - bim_type: "IfcChiller"
            cu_type: "冷水机组"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_ChillerTypeCommon.NominalCoolingCapacity", cu: "cooling_capacity"}
              - {bim: "Pset_ChillerTypeCommon.NominalCOP", cu: "cop"}
              
        plumbing_devices:
          - bim_type: "IfcPump"
            cu_type: "水泵"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_PumpTypeCommon.NominalFlowRate", cu: "design_flow"}
              - {bim: "Pset_PumpTypeCommon.NominalPressureHead", cu: "design_head"}
              - {bim: "Pset_PumpTypeCommon.NominalPowerRate", cu: "power"}
              
          - bim_type: "IfcValve"
            cu_type: "阀门"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_ValveTypeCommon.ValvePattern", cu: "valve_type"}
              - {bim: "Pset_ValveTypeCommon.Size", cu: "nominal_size"}
              
        electrical_devices:
          - bim_type: "IfcElectricDistributionBoard"
            cu_type: "配电箱"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_ElectricDistributionBoardTypeCommon.NominalCurrent", cu: "rated_current"}
              
          - bim_type: "IfcUnitaryControlElement"
            cu_type: "UPS"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_UnitaryControlElementTypeCommon.NominalPower", cu: "capacity"}
              
        medical_gas_devices:
          - bim_type: "IfcDistributionPort (Medical Gas)"
            cu_type: "气体终端"
            properties:
              - {bim: "Pset_DistributionPortPHistoryMedicalGas.GasType", cu: "gas_type"}
              - {bim: "Pset_DistributionPortPHistoryMedicalGas.NominalPressure", cu: "terminal_pressure"}
              
    level_4_connection:
      description: "连接级映射 (管道/电缆)"
      bim_entity: "IfcFlowSegment / IfcCableSegment"
      cu_entity: "Material Flow Path"
      
      mapping_rules:
        pipe_segment:
          - bim_property: "IfcPipeSegment.NominalDiameter"
            cu_property: "pipe_diameter"
          - bim_property: "Qto_PipeSegmentBaseQuantities.Length"
            cu_property: "pipe_length"
          - bim_property: "Pset_PipeSegmentTypeCommon.NominalPressure"
            cu_property: "design_pressure"
            
        duct_segment:
          - bim_property: "IfcDuctSegment"
            cu_property: "duct_size"
          - bim_property: "Qto_DuctSegmentBaseQuantities.Length"
            cu_property: "duct_length"

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 1.1.2 自定义属性集 (Pset) 扩展
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  custom_property_sets:
    
    description: |
      为支持Agent-05特有的耦合单元属性，定义扩展属性集。
      这些属性在标准IFC属性集中未定义。
      
    Pset_Agent05_CouplingUnit:
      
      applicable_entities: ["IfcSpace", "IfcSystem", "IfcDistributionElement"]
      
      properties:
        
        - name: "CouplingUnitID"
          description: "耦合单元唯一标识符"
          type: "IfcIdentifier"
          example: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
          
        - name: "CriticalityGrade"
          description: "关键性等级"
          type: "IfcLabel"
          enum: ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"]
          
        - name: "ThreeFlowMaterial"
          description: "物质流描述"
          type: "IfcText"
          
        - name: "ThreeFlowEnergy"
          description: "能量流描述"
          type: "IfcText"
          
        - name: "ThreeFlowInformation"
          description: "信息流描述"
          type: "IfcText"
          
        - name: "LinkedAgent02Scenario"
          description: "关联的Agent-02医疗场景ID"
          type: "IfcIdentifier"
          
        - name: "LinkedAgent04Equation"
          description: "关联的Agent-04物理方程ID列表"
          type: "IfcText"
          format: "逗号分隔的方程ID"
          
    Pset_Agent05_MedicalSpace:
      
      applicable_entities: ["IfcSpace"]
      
      properties:
        
        - name: "MedicalSpaceType"
          description: "医疗空间类型代码"
          type: "IfcLabel"
          enum:
            - "OR-I-CARDIAC"
            - "OR-I-NEURO"
            - "OR-II"
            - "ICU-GENERAL"
            - "ICU-NICU"
            - "ICU-CCU"
            - "ER-RESUS"
            - "IMAGING-CT"
            - "IMAGING-MRI"
            # ... 更多类型
            
        - name: "CleanlinessClass"
          description: "洁净度等级"
          type: "IfcLabel"
          enum: ["ISO5", "ISO6", "ISO7", "ISO8", "NON_CLEAN"]
          
        - name: "PressureRequirement"
          description: "压力要求 (Pa)"
          type: "IfcPressureMeasure"
          
        - name: "TemperatureSetpoint"
          description: "温度设定值 (°C)"
          type: "IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure"
          
        - name: "TemperatureTolerance"
          description: "温度容差 (°C)"
          type: "IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure"
          
        - name: "HumiditySetpoint"
          description: "湿度设定值 (%RH)"
          type: "IfcPositiveRatioMeasure"
          
        - name: "AirChangeRate"
          description: "换气次数 (ACH)"
          type: "IfcReal"
          
        - name: "MedicalGasTerminals_O2"
          description: "氧气终端数量"
          type: "IfcInteger"
          
        - name: "MedicalGasTerminals_VAC"
          description: "负压吸引终端数量"
          type: "IfcInteger"
          
        - name: "MedicalGasTerminals_AIR"
          description: "压缩空气终端数量"
          type: "IfcInteger"
          
        - name: "ElectricalITZones"
          description: "医用IT系统分组数"
          type: "IfcInteger"
          
        - name: "UPSCapacity"
          description: "UPS容量 (kVA)"
          type: "IfcPowerMeasure"
```

## 1.2 参数提取与回写接口

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    BIM PARAMETER EXTRACTION & WRITEBACK API
#                    BIM参数提取与回写接口规范
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

BIM_API_Specification:
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 1.2.1 参数提取接口 (BIM → Agent-05)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Parameter_Extraction_API:
    
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # 接口1: 批量空间提取
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    extract_spaces:
      
      endpoint: "POST /bim/extract/spaces"
      
      request:
        model_path: "string (IFC文件路径或Revit模型路径)"
        filter:
          space_types: ["OR-*", "ICU-*", "ER-*"]  # 可选过滤
          building: "string"  # 可选
          floor: "string"  # 可选
          
      response:
        spaces:
          - space_id: "OR-001"
            space_name: "心脏外科手术室"
            space_type: "OR-I-CARDIAC"
            geometry:
              floor_area: 60.0
              volume: 180.0
              height: 3.0
            location:
              building: "医技楼"
              floor: "3F"
              coordinates: [100.5, 200.3, 9.0]
            bim_guid: "2O2Fr$t4X7Zf8NOew3FNr2"
            properties:
              cleanliness_class: "ISO5"
              pressure_requirement: 15
              temperature_setpoint: 22
              air_change_rate: 30
              medical_gas_terminals:
                O2: 4
                VAC: 4
                AIR: 2
                N2O: 1
                CO2: 1
                
      example_usage:
        python: |
          import agent05_bim_connector as bim
          
          # 连接BIM模型
          model = bim.connect("hospital_mep.ifc")
          
          # 提取手术室空间
          or_spaces = model.extract_spaces(
              filter={"space_types": ["OR-*"]}
          )
          
          # 生成耦合单元
          for space in or_spaces:
              cu_generator = CouplingUnitGenerator(space)
              coupling_units = cu_generator.generate()
              
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # 接口2: 设备信息提取
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    extract_equipment:
      
      endpoint: "POST /bim/extract/equipment"
      
      request:
        model_path: "string"
        space_id: "string (可选，限定空间)"
        system_type: "string (可选，如 HVAC, MGAS, ELEC)"
        
      response:
        equipment:
          - equipment_id: "AHU-OR-001"
            equipment_type: "IfcUnitaryEquipment"
            equipment_name: "手术部空调机组1"
            served_spaces: ["OR-001", "OR-002"]
            specifications:
              cooling_capacity: 80
              heating_capacity: 40
              air_flow: 5000
              power: 15
              units:
                cooling: "kW"
                heating: "kW"
                air_flow: "m³/h"
                power: "kW"
            location:
              room: "空调机房-3F"
              coordinates: [50.2, 80.1, 9.5]
            bim_guid: "3P4Hs$u5Y8Ag9OPew4GOt3"
            connected_to:
              upstream: ["CH-001", "B-001"]
              downstream: ["VAV-OR-001", "VAV-OR-002"]
              
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # 接口3: 管网拓扑提取
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    extract_network_topology:
      
      endpoint: "POST /bim/extract/network"
      
      request:
        model_path: "string"
        system_id: "string (如 HVAC-CHW-001)"
        
      response:
        network:
          system_id: "HVAC-CHW-001"
          system_name: "冷冻水系统"
          nodes:
            - node_id: "CHL-19XR-001"
              node_type: "source"
              equipment: "冷水机组1"
            - node_id: "CHWP-001"
              node_type: "pump"
              equipment: "冷冻水泵1"
            - node_id: "AHU-OR-001"
              node_type: "terminal"
              equipment: "手术部AHU"
          edges:
            - edge_id: "E-001"
              from_node: "CH-001"
              to_node: "CHWP-001"
              pipe_size: "DN150"
              length: 5.0
            - edge_id: "E-002"
              from_node: "CHWP-001"
              to_node: "AHU-OR-001"
              pipe_size: "DN80"
              length: 50.0
              
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 1.2.2 参数回写接口 (Agent-05 → BIM)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Parameter_Writeback_API:
    
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # 接口4: 耦合单元属性回写
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    writeback_coupling_unit:
      
      endpoint: "POST /bim/writeback/coupling-unit"
      
      request:
        model_path: "string"
        coupling_units:
          - coupling_unit_id: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
            target_entities:
              - bim_guid: "2O2Fr$t4X7Zf8NOew3FNr2"  # IfcSpace
                property_set: "Pset_Agent05_CouplingUnit"
                properties:
                  CouplingUnitID: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
                  CriticalityGrade: "CRITICAL"
                  ThreeFlowMaterial: "冷冻水 7°C/12°C, 15m³/h"
                  ThreeFlowEnergy: "冷量80kW"
                  ThreeFlowInformation: "PID温度控制, 22±1°C"
                  
      response:
        status: "success"
        updated_entities: 1
        
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # 接口5: 设计参数回写
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    writeback_design_parameters:
      
      endpoint: "POST /bim/writeback/design-params"
      
      request:
        model_path: "string"
        updates:
          - bim_guid: "3P4Hs$u5Y8Ag9OPew4GOt3"  # AHU
            property_set: "Pset_UnitaryEquipmentTypeCommon"
            properties:
              NominalCoolingCapacity: 85  # 更新后的值
              NominalAirFlowRate: 5200
              
      response:
        status: "success"
        updated_entities: 1
        
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # 接口6: 验证报告生成
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    generate_validation_report:
      
      endpoint: "POST /bim/validate/coupling-units"
      
      request:
        model_path: "string"
        coupling_unit_library: "string (Agent-05 CU库路径)"
        
      response:
        validation_report:
          total_spaces: 20
          total_coupling_units: 181
          validation_results:
            passed: 165
            warnings: 12
            errors: 4
          details:
            - coupling_unit: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
              status: "PASSED"
              checks:
                - check: "空间存在性"
                  result: "✓"
                - check: "设备关联"
                  result: "✓"
                - check: "参数一致性"
                  result: "✓"
                  
            - coupling_unit: "CU-ICU001-MGAS_O2-SUPPLY"
              status: "WARNING"
              checks:
                - check: "终端数量"
                  result: "⚠ BIM模型18个，CU要求20个"
                  recommendation: "更新BIM模型或核实设计"
```

## 1.3 IFC实体映射详表

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    IFC ENTITY MAPPING DETAILED TABLE
#                    IFC实体映射详细对照表
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

IFC_Entity_Mapping_Table:
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # HVAC系统映射
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  HVAC_Mapping:
    
    system_level:
      cu_system: "HVAC-CLN"
      ifc_entity: "IfcDistributionSystem"
      ifc_predefined_type: "VENTILATION"
      identification:
        by_name_pattern: "*洁净*|*Clean*|*OR-*"
        by_served_spaces: "space.ObjectType contains 'OR'"
        
    equipment_mapping:
      
      - cu_device_type: "冷水机组"
        ifc_entity: "IfcChiller"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_ChillerTypeCommon.NominalCoolingCapacity", cu: "cooling_capacity", unit: "W→kW"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_ChillerTypeCommon.NominalPowerConsumption", cu: "power", unit: "W→kW"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_ChillerTypeCommon.NominalCOP", cu: "cop", unit: "无转换"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "空调机组"
        ifc_entity: "IfcUnitaryEquipment"
        ifc_predefined_type: "AIRHANDLER"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_UnitaryEquipmentTypeCommon.NominalCoolingCapacity", cu: "cooling_capacity"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_UnitaryEquipmentTypeCommon.NominalHeatingCapacity", cu: "heating_capacity"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_UnitaryEquipmentTypeCommon.NominalAirFlowRate", cu: "air_flow"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "风机"
        ifc_entity: "IfcFan"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_FanTypeCommon.NominalAirFlowRate", cu: "air_flow", unit: "m³/s→m³/h"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_FanTypeCommon.NominalTotalPressure", cu: "static_pressure", unit: "Pa"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_FanTypeCommon.NominalPowerRate", cu: "power", unit: "W→kW"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "VAV箱"
        ifc_entity: "IfcAirTerminalBox"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_AirTerminalBoxTypeCommon.AirFlowRateRange", cu: "flow_range"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_AirTerminalBoxTypeCommon.NominalAirFlowRate", cu: "design_flow"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "送风口"
        ifc_entity: "IfcAirTerminal"
        ifc_predefined_type: "DIFFUSER"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_AirTerminalTypeCommon.NominalAirFlowRate", cu: "air_flow"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_AirTerminalTypeCommon.AirDiffusionPerformanceIndex", cu: "adpi"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "表冷器"
        ifc_entity: "IfcCoil"
        ifc_predefined_type: "WATERCOOLINGCOIL"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_CoilTypeCommon.NominalSensibleCapacity", cu: "sensible_capacity"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_CoilTypeCommon.NominalLatentCapacity", cu: "latent_capacity"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "加湿器"
        ifc_entity: "IfcHumidifier"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_HumidifierTypeCommon.NominalMoistureGain", cu: "humidification_capacity"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "过滤器"
        ifc_entity: "IfcFilter"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_FilterTypeCommon.FinalResistance", cu: "final_pressure_drop"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_FilterTypeCommon.NominalFilterFaceVelocity", cu: "face_velocity"}
          
    pipe_mapping:
      
      - cu_pipe_type: "冷冻水管"
        ifc_entity: "IfcPipeSegment"
        ifc_system_type: "CHILLEDWATER"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_PipeSegmentTypeCommon.NominalDiameter", cu: "pipe_diameter", unit: "mm"}
          - {ifc: "Qto_PipeSegmentBaseQuantities.Length", cu: "pipe_length", unit: "m"}
          
      - cu_pipe_type: "送风管"
        ifc_entity: "IfcDuctSegment"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_DuctSegmentTypeCommon.Shape", cu: "duct_shape"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_DuctSegmentTypeCommon.NominalWidth", cu: "duct_width"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_DuctSegmentTypeCommon.NominalHeight", cu: "duct_height"}
          
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 医用气体系统映射
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Medical_Gas_Mapping:
    
    system_level:
      cu_system: "MGAS-O2"
      ifc_entity: "IfcDistributionSystem"
      ifc_predefined_type: "GAS"
      identification:
        by_name_pattern: "*O2*|*氧气*|*Oxygen*"
        
    equipment_mapping:
      
      - cu_device_type: "液氧站"
        ifc_entity: "IfcTank"
        ifc_predefined_type: "STORAGE"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_TankTypeCommon.NominalCapacity", cu: "capacity", unit: "L"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_TankTypeCommon.OperatingPressure", cu: "operating_pressure"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "汇流排"
        ifc_entity: "IfcDistributionChamberElement"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Custom.CylinderCount", cu: "cylinder_count"}
          - {ifc: "Custom.OutletPressure", cu: "outlet_pressure"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "气体终端"
        ifc_entity: "IfcDistributionPort"
        identification:
          by_system: "MGAS-O2"
          by_location: "served_space"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Custom.GasType", cu: "gas_type"}
          - {ifc: "Custom.NominalPressure", cu: "terminal_pressure"}
          - {ifc: "Custom.FlowCapacity", cu: "flow_capacity"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "区域阀"
        ifc_entity: "IfcValve"
        ifc_predefined_type: "ISOLATING"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_ValveTypeCommon.Size", cu: "valve_size"}
          
    pipe_mapping:
      
      - cu_pipe_type: "医用气体管"
        ifc_entity: "IfcPipeSegment"
        material_filter: "铜管|不锈钢"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_PipeSegmentTypeCommon.NominalDiameter", cu: "pipe_diameter"}
          - {ifc: "Custom.DesignPressure", cu: "design_pressure"}
          
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 电气系统映射
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Electrical_Mapping:
    
    system_level:
      cu_system: "ELEC-UPS"
      ifc_entity: "IfcDistributionSystem"
      ifc_predefined_type: "ELECTRICAL"
      
    equipment_mapping:
      
      - cu_device_type: "UPS"
        ifc_entity: "IfcUnitaryControlElement"
        ifc_predefined_type: "CONTROLPANEL"
        alternative: "IfcElectricGenerator (STANDBY type)"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Custom.NominalPowerRating", cu: "capacity", unit: "VA→kVA"}
          - {ifc: "Custom.BackupTime", cu: "backup_time", unit: "min"}
          - {ifc: "Custom.BatteryCapacity", cu: "battery_capacity"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "隔离变压器"
        ifc_entity: "IfcTransformer"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_TransformerTypeCommon.PrimaryVoltage", cu: "primary_voltage"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_TransformerTypeCommon.SecondaryVoltage", cu: "secondary_voltage"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_TransformerTypeCommon.NominalPower", cu: "capacity"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "配电箱"
        ifc_entity: "IfcElectricDistributionBoard"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_ElectricDistributionBoardTypeCommon.NominalCurrent", cu: "rated_current"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_ElectricDistributionBoardTypeCommon.NumberOfCircuits", cu: "circuit_count"}
          
      - cu_device_type: "医用插座"
        ifc_entity: "IfcOutlet"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_OutletTypeCommon.OutletType", cu: "outlet_type"}
          - {ifc: "Custom.MedicalGrade", cu: "medical_grade"}
          
    cable_mapping:
      
      - cu_cable_type: "电力电缆"
        ifc_entity: "IfcCableSegment"
        key_properties:
          - {ifc: "Pset_CableSegmentTypeCommon.NominalCurrent", cu: "current_rating"}
          - {ifc: "Pset_CableSegmentTypeCommon.CrossSectionArea", cu: "cross_section"}
```

## 1.4 Revit集成示例

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    REVIT INTEGRATION EXAMPLE
#                    Revit集成示例代码
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Revit_Integration:
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Python脚本示例 (使用pyRevit或RevitPythonShell)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  python_script_extract_spaces:
    
    filename: "extract_medical_spaces.py"
    
    code: |
      # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
      """
      Agent-05 BIM Connector - Revit Space Extraction
      从Revit模型中提取医疗空间信息并生成耦合单元模板
      """
      
      import clr
      clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
      clr.AddReference('RevitAPIUI')
      from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
      from Autodesk.Revit.DB.Architecture import Room
      
      import json
      import os
      
      # 获取当前文档
      doc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
      
      # 医疗空间类型映射
      MEDICAL_SPACE_TYPES = {
          "手术室": "OR",
          "ICU": "ICU",
          "急诊": "ER",
          "CT室": "CT",
          "MRI室": "MRI",
          "透析室": "HD",
          # ... 更多映射
      }
      
      def get_space_medical_type(space_name):
          """根据空间名称判断医疗空间类型"""
          for keyword, space_type in MEDICAL_SPACE_TYPES.items():
              if keyword in space_name:
                  return space_type
          return "GENERAL"
      
      def extract_medical_spaces():
          """提取所有医疗空间"""
          
          # 收集所有房间
          collector = FilteredElementCollector(doc)
          rooms = collector.OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Rooms).ToElements()
          
          medical_spaces = []
          
          for room in rooms:
              if room.Area == 0:  # 跳过未放置的房间
                  continue
                  
              space_name = room.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ROOM_NAME).AsString()
              space_type = get_space_medical_type(space_name)
              
              if space_type == "GENERAL":
                  continue  # 只处理医疗空间
                  
              # 提取空间信息
              space_data = {
                  "space_id": room.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ROOM_NUMBER).AsString(),
                  "space_name": space_name,
                  "space_type": space_type,
                  "geometry": {
                      "floor_area": round(room.Area * 0.092903, 2),  # ft² → m²
                      "volume": round(room.Volume * 0.0283168, 2),   # ft³ → m³
                  },
                  "location": {
                      "level": doc.GetElement(room.LevelId).Name,
                  },
                  "revit_id": room.Id.IntegerValue,
                  "guid": room.UniqueId,
              }
              
              # 提取共享参数 (如果有)
              try:
                  space_data["cleanliness_class"] = room.LookupParameter("洁净度等级").AsString()
                  space_data["pressure_requirement"] = room.LookupParameter("压力要求").AsDouble()
                  space_data["temperature_setpoint"] = room.LookupParameter("设计温度").AsDouble()
              except:
                  pass
                  
              medical_spaces.append(space_data)
              
          return medical_spaces
      
      def count_terminals_in_space(room, terminal_family_name):
          """统计空间内的设备终端数量"""
          # 获取房间边界
          options = SpatialElementBoundaryOptions()
          boundaries = room.GetBoundarySegments(options)
          
          # 这里简化处理，实际需要几何判断
          # 返回预设值或从参数读取
          return 0
      
      def generate_coupling_units(spaces):
          """为每个空间生成耦合单元模板"""
          
          coupling_units = []
          
          for space in spaces:
              space_id = space["space_id"]
              space_type = space["space_type"]
              
              # 根据空间类型生成对应的耦合单元
              if space_type == "OR":
                  # 手术室耦合单元模板
                  cu_templates = [
                      f"CU-{space_id}-HVAC_CLN-COOLING",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-HVAC_CLN-PRESSURE",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-HVAC_CLN-HUMIDITY",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-MGAS_O2-SUPPLY",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-MGAS_VAC-SUCTION",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-MGAS_AIR-SUPPLY",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-MGAS_N2O-ANESTHESIA",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-ELEC_UPS-POWER",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-ELEC_IT-ISOLATION",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-INT_BA-MONITOR",
                  ]
              elif space_type == "ICU":
                  cu_templates = [
                      f"CU-{space_id}-HVAC_AHU-COOLING",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-HVAC_AHU-PRESSURE",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-MGAS_O2-SUPPLY",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-MGAS_VAC-SUCTION",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-ELEC_IT-POWER",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-ELEC_UPS-POWER",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-INT_BA-MONITOR",
                      f"CU-{space_id}-INT_NUR-CALL",
                  ]
              else:
                  cu_templates = []
                  
              for cu_id in cu_templates:
                  coupling_units.append({
                      "coupling_unit_id": cu_id,
                      "space_id": space_id,
                      "bim_guid": space["guid"],
                      "status": "TEMPLATE",
                  })
                  
          return coupling_units
      
      # 执行提取
      if __name__ == "__main__":
          spaces = extract_medical_spaces()
          coupling_units = generate_coupling_units(spaces)
          
          # 输出JSON
          output = {
              "spaces": spaces,
              "coupling_units": coupling_units,
          }
          
          output_path = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "agent05_bim_extract.json")
          with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
              json.dump(output, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
              
          print(f"提取完成！")
          print(f"医疗空间: {len(spaces)}个")
          print(f"耦合单元模板: {len(coupling_units)}个")
          print(f"输出路径: {output_path}")

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Dynamo工作流示例
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  dynamo_workflow:
    
    workflow_name: "Agent05_BIM_Connector.dyn"
    
    nodes:
      - node_1:
          type: "Categories"
          category: "Rooms"
          
      - node_2:
          type: "All Elements of Category"
          input: "node_1"
          
      - node_3:
          type: "Element.GetParameterValueByName"
          input: "node_2"
          parameter: "Name"
          
      - node_4:
          type: "Python Script"
          script: "filter_medical_spaces"
          input: ["node_2", "node_3"]
          
      - node_5:
          type: "Element.GetParameterValueByName"
          input: "node_4"
          parameter: "Area"
          
      - node_6:
          type: "Math.Round"
          input: "node_5 * 0.092903"  # 转换单位
          
      - node_7:
          type: "Python Script"
          script: "generate_coupling_units"
          input: ["node_4", "node_6"]
          
      - node_8:
          type: "Data.ExportToExcel"
          input: "node_7"
          file_path: "Agent05_CouplingUnits.xlsx"
```

# P2-2: 超图可视化工具规范

## 2.1 可视化需求与架构

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    HYPERGRAPH VISUALIZATION TOOL SPECIFICATION
#                    超图可视化工具规范
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Visualization_Specification:
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 2.1.1 可视化需求
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  requirements:
    
    functional_requirements:
      
      FR_01:
        name: "超图拓扑可视化"
        description: "以图形化方式展示空间-系统-设备的超图结构"
        priority: "MUST"
        
      FR_02:
        name: "三流动可视化"
        description: "用不同颜色/线型展示物质流、能量流、信息流"
        priority: "MUST"
        
      FR_03:
        name: "分层视图"
        description: "支持空间层、系统层、设备层的分层展示和切换"
        priority: "MUST"
        
      FR_04:
        name: "关键性热力图"
        description: "用颜色深浅表示耦合单元的关键性等级"
        priority: "SHOULD"
        
      FR_05:
        name: "交互式导航"
        description: "点击节点展开详情，缩放平移浏览"
        priority: "MUST"
        
      FR_06:
        name: "时间演变动画"
        description: "展示系统状态随时间变化的动画"
        priority: "COULD"
        
      FR_07:
        name: "搜索与过滤"
        description: "按空间/系统/关键性等条件筛选显示"
        priority: "SHOULD"
        
      FR_08:
        name: "导出功能"
        description: "导出为SVG/PNG/PDF格式"
        priority: "SHOULD"
        
    non_functional_requirements:
      
      NFR_01:
        name: "性能"
        requirement: "支持500+节点流畅渲染 (60fps)"
        
      NFR_02:
        name: "响应式"
        requirement: "适配桌面/平板屏幕"
        
      NFR_03:
        name: "浏览器兼容"
        requirement: "Chrome/Firefox/Edge最新版本"
        
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 2.1.2 技术架构
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  technical_architecture:
    
    overview: |
      采用Web前端技术栈实现可视化工具，
      后端提供数据API，前端负责渲染和交互。
      
    frontend_stack:
      framework: "Vue 3 / React"
      visualization_library: 
        primary: "D3.js v7"
        alternative: "Cytoscape.js (适合图结构)"
        3d_option: "Three.js (可选3D视图)"
      ui_components: "Element Plus / Ant Design"
      state_management: "Pinia / Redux"
      
    backend_stack:
      framework: "FastAPI (Python)"
      data_format: "JSON"
      database: "PostgreSQL + Neo4j (图数据库可选)"
      
    deployment:
      containerization: "Docker"
      hosting: "医院内网部署 / 云端"
```

## 2.3 组件设计规范

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATION
#                    组件设计规范
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Component_Design:
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 2.3.1 节点组件
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Node_Components:
    
    SpaceNode:
      
      component_name: "SpaceNode"
      description: "空间节点组件"
      
      props:
        space_id: "string"
        space_name: "string"
        space_type: "string"
        floor_area: "number"
        coupling_units_count: "number"
        critical_count: "number"
        is_selected: "boolean"
        is_hovered: "boolean"
        
      visual_states:
        default:
          fill: "space_type对应颜色"
          stroke: "2px solid #333"
          opacity: 1.0
        hovered:
          fill: "更亮的颜色"
          stroke: "3px solid #000"
          scale: 1.1
        selected:
          fill: "保持"
          stroke: "4px solid #FFD700"
          shadow: "0 0 10px gold"
        alarm:
          fill: "保持"
          stroke: "3px solid red"
          animation: "pulse 1s infinite"
          
      events:
        onClick: "selectSpace(space_id)"
        onDoubleClick: "expandSpace(space_id)"
        onHover: "showTooltip(space_id)"
        onDrag: "updatePosition(space_id, x, y)"
        
      tooltip_content:
        template: |
          <div class="space-tooltip">
            <h4>{{ space_name }}</h4>
            <p>类型: {{ space_type }}</p>
            <p>面积: {{ floor_area }} m²</p>
            <p>耦合单元: {{ coupling_units_count }} 个</p>
            <p>关键性: {{ critical_count }} CRITICAL</p>
          </div>
          
    SystemNode:
      
      component_name: "SystemNode"
      description: "系统节点组件"
      
      props:
        system_id: "string"
        system_name: "string"
        system_class: "string"  # HVAC/MGAS/ELEC等
        served_spaces: "array<string>"
        
      visual_states:
        default:
          shape: "hexagon"
          fill: "system_class对应颜色"
          
    DeviceNode:
      
      component_name: "DeviceNode"
      description: "设备节点组件"
      
      props:
        device_id: "string"
        device_type: "string"
        device_name: "string"
        parent_system: "string"
        specifications: "object"
        
      visual_states:
        default:
          shape: "rectangle"
          size: "25px"
          fill: "继承父系统颜色 (浅)"
          
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 2.3.2 边/超边组件
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Edge_Components:
    
    CouplingEdge:
      
      component_name: "CouplingEdge"
      description: "耦合单元连接边"
      
      props:
        coupling_unit_id: "string"
        from_node: "string"
        to_node: "string"
        flow_type: "material | energy | information"
        criticality: "CRITICAL | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW"
        flow_value: "number"
        flow_unit: "string"
        
      visual_encoding:
        material_flow:
          color: "#3498DB"
          style: "solid"
          width: "2 + flow_value/max * 3"
          marker_end: "arrow"
        energy_flow:
          color: "#E74C3C"
          style: "8,4"  # dashed
          width: "2 + flow_value/max * 3"
          marker_end: "arrow-energy"
        information_flow:
          color: "#2ECC71"
          style: "2,2"  # dotted
          width: "1.5"
          marker_end: "diamond"
          
      animation:
        flow_animation:
          type: "dash offset"
          speed: "根据flow_value"
          
    HyperedgeRegion:
      
      component_name: "HyperedgeRegion"
      description: "超边包围区域 (可选)"
      
      props:
        hyperedge_id: "string"
        contained_nodes: "array<string>"
        
      visual:
        type: "convex hull"
        fill: "rgba(颜色, 0.1)"
        stroke: "rgba(颜色, 0.5)"
        stroke_dasharray: "5,5"
        
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 2.3.3 信息面板组件
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  Panel_Components:
    
    CouplingUnitDetailPanel:
      
      component_name: "CouplingUnitDetailPanel"
      description: "耦合单元详情面板"
      
      sections:
        
        header:
          - "coupling_unit_id"
          - "criticality_badge"
          - "close_button"
          
        basic_info:
          - "space_id → space_name"
          - "system_id → system_name"
          - "purpose"
          
        three_flow:
          material_flow:
            - "载体"
            - "流量/规格"
            - "路径"
          energy_flow:
            - "形式"
            - "数值"
            - "效率"
          information_flow:
            - "控制模式"
            - "传感器"
            - "执行器"
            - "参数"
            
        linked_entities:
          - "关联Agent-02场景"
          - "关联Agent-04方程"
          - "关联设备"
          
        actions:
          - "编辑"
          - "查看时间演变"
          - "导出"
          
    FilterPanel:
      
      component_name: "FilterPanel"
      description: "过滤器面板"
      
      filters:
        - filter_id: "space_type"
          type: "multi-select"
          options: ["手术室", "ICU", "急诊", "影像", "治疗", "实验室", "其他"]
          
        - filter_id: "system_class"
          type: "multi-select"
          options: ["HVAC", "MGAS", "ELEC", "PLUMB", "INT"]
          
        - filter_id: "criticality"
          type: "checkbox-group"
          options: ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"]
          
        - filter_id: "flow_type"
          type: "checkbox-group"
          options: ["物质流", "能量流", "信息流"]
          
        - filter_id: "search"
          type: "text"
          placeholder: "搜索空间/系统/设备..."
```

## 2.4 数据接口规范

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    VISUALIZATION DATA API SPECIFICATION
#                    可视化数据接口规范
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Visualization_API:
  
  base_url: "/api/v1/visualization"
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 图数据接口
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  graph_data:
    
    get_hypergraph:
      
      endpoint: "GET /hypergraph"
      description: "获取完整超图数据"
      
      query_params:
        detail_level: "space | system | device"
        space_types: "array<string> (可选)"
        system_classes: "array<string> (可选)"
        criticality: "array<string> (可选)"
        
      response:
        nodes:
          spaces:
            - id: "string"
              name: "string"
              type: "string"
              position: {x: "number", y: "number"}  # 如果有保存的布局
              properties: "object"
          systems:
            - id: "string"
              name: "string"
              class: "string"
              properties: "object"
          devices:
            - id: "string"
              name: "string"
              type: "string"
              parent_system: "string"
              properties: "object"
              
        edges:
          coupling_units:
            - id: "string"
              from_node: "string"
              to_node: "string"
              space_id: "string"
              system_id: "string"
              criticality: "string"
              three_flow:
                material: "object"
                energy: "object"
                information: "object"
                
        hyperedges:
          - id: "string"
            nodes: "array<string>"
            coupling_unit_id: "string"
            
    get_space_detail:
      
      endpoint: "GET /spaces/{space_id}"
      description: "获取单个空间详情"
      
      response:
        space:
          id: "string"
          name: "string"
          type: "string"
          geometry: "object"
          properties: "object"
        coupling_units:
          - "完整耦合单元数据"
        connected_systems:
          - "关联系统列表"
        connected_devices:
          - "关联设备列表"
          
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 时间演变接口
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  time_evolution:
    
    get_scenarios:
      
      endpoint: "GET /time-evolution/scenarios"
      description: "获取可用的时间演变场景列表"
      
      response:
        scenarios:
          - id: "CPB_COOLING"
            name: "体外循环期降温"
            space: "OR-001"
            duration: 30
            duration_unit: "min"
            
    get_scenario_data:
      
      endpoint: "GET /time-evolution/scenarios/{scenario_id}"
      description: "获取场景的时间序列数据"
      
      response:
        scenario:
          id: "string"
          name: "string"
          description: "string"
        timeline:
          - time: "number"
            time_unit: "string"
            events:
              - description: "string"
            states:
              - node_id: "string"
                property: "string"
                value: "number | string"
                
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 统计接口
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  statistics:
    
    get_summary:
      
      endpoint: "GET /statistics/summary"
      description: "获取统计概览"
      
      response:
        total_spaces: "number"
        total_systems: "number"
        total_devices: "number"
        total_coupling_units: "number"
        criticality_distribution:
          critical: "number"
          high: "number"
          medium: "number"
          low: "number"
        system_distribution:
          hvac: "number"
          mgas: "number"
          elec: "number"
          # ...
          
    get_matrix:
      
      endpoint: "GET /statistics/matrix"
      description: "获取空间-系统耦合矩阵数据"
      
      response:
        rows: "array<space_id>"
        columns: "array<system_class>"
        cells:
          - row: "space_id"
            column: "system_class"
            coupling_count: "number"
            critical_count: "number"
            coupling_unit_ids: "array<string>"
```

# 第一部分：概述与架构
# PART 1: OVERVIEW AND ARCHITECTURE

---

## 1.1 Agent-05 使命与定位

```yaml
Agent05_Mission:
  
  mission_statement: |
    Agent-05是医疗建筑MEP智能设计系统的核心枢纽，
    负责建立医疗空间与机电系统之间的深度耦合关系，
    将医疗工艺需求转化为可计算、可追溯、可优化的系统设计参数。
    
  core_value_proposition:
    
    from_medical_to_engineering: |
      将Agent-02定义的医疗行为场景（如"心脏外科手术"）
      转化为Agent-06/07/08可执行的工程设计参数
      （如"80kW冷负荷、30ACH换气、+15Pa正压"）
      
    three_flow_integration: |
      通过物质流、能量流、信息流的统一建模，
      实现跨专业（暖通/给排水/电气/智能化）的一体化分析
      
    topology_preservation: |
      确保从概念设计到施工图的全过程中，
      医疗功能需求与系统拓扑的一致性
      
  positioning_in_agent_chain:
    
    upstream_agents:
      Agent_01: "提供建筑空间拓扑和系统框架"
      Agent_02: "提供医疗行为场景和功能需求"
      Agent_03: "提供设备数据库和性能参数"
      Agent_04: "提供物理方程和计算模型"
      
    downstream_agents:
      Agent_06: "接收耦合单元，进行设备选型"
      Agent_07: "接收三流动拓扑，进行管路设计"
      Agent_08: "接收信息流定义，进行控制设计"
      Agent_09: "接收完整模型，进行系统仿真"
```

## 1.2 V2.0架构创新：超图拓扑

```yaml
V2_Architecture_Innovation:
  
  paradigm_shift:
    
    from_v1: |
      V1.0采用平面多对多映射：
      - 空间列表 × 系统列表 → 耦合矩阵
      - 难以表达复杂的多节点关系
      - 三流动分散在不同模块中
      
    to_v2: |
      V2.0采用超图拓扑 + 三流动耦合：
      - 超图允许一条边连接多个节点
      - 完美表达"一个空间需要多个系统服务"
      - 三流动在每个耦合单元中显式定义
      
  hypergraph_definition:
    
    formal_definition: |
      H = (V, E, A)
      
      其中：
      V = V_space ∪ V_system ∪ V_device  （节点集）
      E = {e_i | e_i ⊆ V, |e_i| ≥ 2}      （超边集，每条超边连接≥2个节点）
      A: E → Attributes                    （超边属性映射，即三流动）
      
    node_sets:
      V_space: "20个医疗空间节点"
      V_system: "45个系统节点"
      V_device: "215个设备节点"
      
    hyperedge_set:
      total: "181条超边"
      meaning: "每条超边代表一个耦合单元"
      example: |
        e_cooling = {OR-001, HVAC-CLN, CHL-19XR-001, AHU-OR-001, VAV-OR-001}
        表示：手术室冷却服务连接空间、系统和多个设备
        
  three_flow_coupling:
    
    definition: |
      每个耦合单元(CU)定义三种流动：
      
    material_flow:
      description: "物质的传输与转换"
      examples:
        - "冷冻水从冷机流向AHU"
        - "氧气从液氧站流向终端"
        - "送风从AHU流向手术室"
      attributes: ["载体", "流量", "温度/压力", "路径"]
      
    energy_flow:
      description: "能量的传递与转换"
      examples:
        - "冷量从冷冻水传递给空气"
        - "电能从UPS传递给设备"
        - "热量从室内排出"
      attributes: ["形式", "数值", "效率", "损失"]
      
    information_flow:
      description: "信号的感知、传输与控制"
      examples:
        - "温度传感器→DDC→冷冻水阀"
        - "压力传感器→气体监控→报警"
        - "UPS状态→BA系统→显示"
      attributes: ["控制模式", "传感器", "执行器", "参数"]
      
  architecture_diagram: |
    
    ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │                     AGENT-05 V2.0 超图拓扑架构                          │
    ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │                                                                         │
    │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
    │  │                    Layer 1: 空间层 (V_space)                     │   │
    │  │                                                                  │   │
    │  │   ● OR-001  ● OR-002  ● ICU-001  ● NICU  ● ER-001  ● CT  ...   │   │
    │  │                                                                  │   │
    │  └────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘   │
    │                               │ 超边连接                              │
    │  ┌────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────┐   │
    │  │                    Layer 2: 系统层 (V_system)                    │   │
    │  │                            │                                     │   │
    │  │   ⬡ HVAC-CLN ←─────────────┼──→ ⬡ MGAS-O2                       │   │
    │  │   ⬡ HVAC-AHU ←─────────────┼──→ ⬡ MGAS-VAC                      │   │
    │  │   ⬡ ELEC-UPS ←─────────────┼──→ ⬡ INT-BA                        │   │
    │  │                            │                                     │   │
    │  └────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────┘   │
    │                               │ 超边连接                              │
    │  ┌────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────┐   │
    │  │                    Layer 3: 设备层 (V_device)                    │   │
    │  │                            │                                     │   │
    │  │   ■ CHL-19XR-001  ■ AHU-001  ■ VAV-001  ■ LOX  ■ UPS  ■ DDC  ...     │   │
    │  │                                                                  │   │
    │  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
    │                                                                         │
    │  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════   │
    │                         超边 = 耦合单元 (CU)                           │
    │  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  │
    │                                                                         │
    │   CU = {空间, 系统, 设备...} + 三流动属性                              │
    │                                                                         │
    │   ┌─────────────┐   ┌─────────────┐   ┌─────────────┐                  │
    │   │  物质流 M   │   │  能量流 E   │   │  信息流 I   │                  │
    │   │ ─────────── │   │ ─────────── │   │ ─────────── │                  │
    │   │ 载体/流量   │   │ 形式/数值   │   │ 控制/参数   │                  │
    │   │ 路径/规格   │   │ 效率/损失   │   │ 传感/执行   │                  │
    │   └─────────────┘   └─────────────┘   └─────────────┘                  │
    │                                                                         │
    └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 1.3 Agent融合关系

```yaml
Agent_Integration:
  
  overview: |
    Agent-05深度融合Agent-01至Agent-04的输出，
    为Agent-06至Agent-09提供统一的输入接口。
    
  upstream_integration:
    
    Agent_01_Space_Topology:
      input_from: "空间拓扑和系统框架"
      integration_method: "直接继承节点定义"
      topology_preservation:
        rule: "V_space ⊆ Agent01.Spaces"
        verification: "所有空间节点必须在Agent-01中有对应"
        
    Agent_02_Medical_Scenarios:
      input_from: "医疗行为场景和环境需求"
      integration_method: "场景-耦合单元关联"
      example:
        scenario: "S-CARDIAC-CPB (体外循环)"
        triggers:
          - "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING: 启动深度降温模式"
          - "CU-OR001-ELEC_UPS-POWER: 确认体外循环机供电"
          - "CU-OR001-MGAS_O2-SUPPLY: 确认氧气充足"
          
    Agent_03_Equipment_Database:
      input_from: "设备数据库和性能曲线"
      integration_method: "设备节点引用"
      linking:
        cu_device_reference: "Agent03.Equipment.ID"
        parameters_inherited:
          - "额定容量"
          - "性能曲线"
          - "外形尺寸"
          - "接口规格"
          
    Agent_04_Physics_Equations:
      input_from: "物理方程和计算模型"
      integration_method: "方程ID引用 + 应用上下文"
      equation_categories:
        - "热力学方程 (EQ-HX-*, EQ-LOAD-*)"
        - "流体力学方程 (EQ-FLUID-*)"
        - "控制系统方程 (EQ-PID-*, EQ-FIRST-ORDER-*)"
        - "电气方程 (EQ-UPS-*, EQ-IT-*)"
        
  downstream_interface:
    
    to_Agent_06_Equipment_Selection:
      output: "耦合单元及其设备需求"
      format:
        - "设备类型和规格范围"
        - "容量需求 (min/design/max)"
        - "冗余配置要求"
        - "接口约束"
      example:
        cu: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
        equipment_need:
          type: "空调机组"
          cooling_capacity: {min: 60, design: 80, max: 100, unit: "kW"}
          air_flow: {min: 4000, design: 5000, max: 6000, unit: "m³/h"}
          redundancy: "N+1 (AHU备用)"
          
    to_Agent_07_Piping_Design:
      output: "三流动拓扑和管路需求"
      format:
        - "流动路径起止点"
        - "流量和压力需求"
        - "管材和规格要求"
        - "路由约束"
      example:
        cu: "CU-OR001-MGAS_O2-SUPPLY"
        piping_need:
          path: "液氧站 → 主立管 → 层支管 → 床旁终端"
          flow: "60 L/min (峰值)"
          pressure: "400 kPa"
          material: "脱脂紫铜管"
          main_size: "DN32"
          
    to_Agent_08_Control_Design:
      output: "信息流定义和控制需求"
      format:
        - "受控参数和设定值"
        - "传感器规格和位置"
        - "执行器规格"
        - "控制算法和参数"
      example:
        cu: "CU-OR001-HVAC_CLN-COOLING"
        control_need:
          controlled_variable: "室内温度"
          setpoint: {normal: 22, cpb_low: 18, range: "18-26", unit: "°C"}
          sensors:
            - {type: "温度", accuracy: "±0.2°C", location: "回风口", quantity: 2}
          actuators:
            - {type: "冷冻水阀", size: "DN50", characteristic: "等百分比"}
          algorithm: "串级PID"
          parameters:
            outer_loop: {Kp: 3.5, Ki: 0.1, Kd: 0.5}
            inner_loop: {Kp: 2.0, Ki: 0.08, Kd: 0.3}
```
