# 系统级控制回路完整定义 (50个)

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#                    系统级控制回路完整库
#                    SYSTEM-LEVEL CONTROL LOOPS (50个)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

System_Level_Control_Loops:
  
  total_count: 50
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 一、冷冻站系统控制回路 (SYS-CHP-001 ~ SYS-CHP-010)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  Chiller_Plant_Loops:
    
    SYS-CHP-001:
      loop_id: "SYS-CHP-001"
      loop_name: "冷水机组台数控制"
      loop_type: "逻辑控制"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      description: |
        根据系统冷负荷自动调节冷水机组运行台数，
        在满足冷量需求的同时保持最佳能效。
        
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-CHW-S"
          name: "冷冻水供水温度"
          type: "AI"
          sensor: "TH-01-IM"
          range: "2~15°C"
          
        - input_id: "TS-CHW-R"
          name: "冷冻水回水温度"
          type: "AI"
          sensor: "TH-01-IM"
          range: "5~20°C"
          
        - input_id: "FM-CHW-MAIN"
          name: "冷冻水总流量"
          type: "AI"
          sensor: "FL-03-EM"
          range: "0~600 m³/h"
          
        - input_id: "CH-{N}-STS"
          name: "冷机运行状态"
          type: "DI"
          count: 3
          
        - input_id: "CH-{N}-FLT"
          name: "冷机故障状态"
          type: "DI"
          count: 3
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "CH-{N}-CMD"
          name: "冷机启停命令"
          type: "DO"
          count: 3
          
      controller:
        type: "PLC"
        id: "PLC-CHP-01"
        
      control_logic: |
        # 冷负荷计算
        Q_load = ρ × Cp × V̇ × (T_return - T_supply)
        Q_load_kW = 4.18 × FM-CHW-MAIN × (TS-CHW-R - TS-CHW-S) / 3600
        
        # 冷机配置：3台×500kW，N+1冗余
        Q_per_chiller = 500 kW
        
        # 台数决策逻辑
        N_required = ceiling(Q_load_kW / (Q_per_chiller × 0.85))
        N_required = max(1, min(N_required, 3))
        
        # 启动条件
        IF Q_load_kW > N_running × Q_per_chiller × 0.85 AND N_running < 3:
            启动下一台冷机 (延时5分钟)
            
        # 停止条件
        IF Q_load_kW < (N_running - 1) × Q_per_chiller × 0.60 AND N_running > 1:
            停止一台冷机 (延时10分钟)
            
        # 轮换策略
        每168小时(一周)切换主机顺序
        运行时间最短的机组优先启动
        
      interlocks:
        - "冷机启动前确认冷冻水泵运行"
        - "冷机启动前确认冷却水泵运行"
        - "冷机启动前确认冷却塔风机运行"
        - "冷机故障时自动切换到备用机组"
        
      alarms:
        - {condition: "所有冷机故障", level: "CRITICAL", action: "紧急通知"}
        - {condition: "冷量不足", level: "HIGH", action: "报警+启动备用"}
        - {condition: "频繁启停", level: "MEDIUM", action: "调整死区"}
        
    SYS-CHP-002:
      loop_id: "SYS-CHP-002"
      loop_name: "冷冻水供水温度控制"
      loop_type: "PID控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      description: "调节冷水机组容量以维持冷冻水供水温度设定值"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-CHW-S"
          name: "冷冻水供水温度"
          type: "AI"
          sensor: "TH-01-IM"
          
        - input_id: "TS-OA"
          name: "室外温度"
          type: "AI"
          sensor: "TH-04"
          note: "用于供水温度重设"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "CH-{N}-CAP"
          name: "冷机容量指令"
          type: "AO"
          range: "0-100%"
          
      setpoint:
        default: 7.0
        range: [5.0, 12.0]
        unit: "°C"
        reset_strategy: |
          # 供水温度重设(节能)
          IF T_outdoor < 25°C:
            SP = 7.0 + (25 - T_outdoor) × 0.1
            SP = min(SP, 12.0)
          ELSE:
            SP = 7.0
            
      pid_parameters:
        Kp: 5.0
        Ki: 0.1
        Kd: 0.5
        sample_time: 10  # 秒
        output_limits: [30, 100]  # %
        
      tuning_method: "Lambda整定法"
      process_characteristics:
        gain: 0.15  # °C/%
        time_constant: 180  # 秒
        dead_time: 30  # 秒
        
    SYS-CHP-003:
      loop_id: "SYS-CHP-003"
      loop_name: "一次冷冻水泵变频控制"
      loop_type: "恒流量控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      description: "维持一次侧冷冻水流量与冷机需求匹配"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "FM-CHW-PRI"
          name: "一次泵流量"
          type: "AI"
          sensor: "FL-03-EM"
          
        - input_id: "CH-{N}-STS"
          name: "冷机运行状态"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "VFD-CHWP-PRI-{N}"
          name: "一次泵变频指令"
          type: "AO"
          range: "20-50 Hz"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 一次泵定流量控制
        Q_required = N_running × Q_per_chiller_flow
        
        # 变频器频率计算
        f = f_rated × (Q_required / Q_design)^(1/3)  # 泵相似定律
        f = max(20, min(f, 50))
        
    SYS-CHP-004:
      loop_id: "SYS-CHP-004"
      loop_name: "二次冷冻水泵变频控制（末端压差）"
      loop_type: "PID控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      description: "根据最不利末端压差调节二次泵转速"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "DP-CHW-END-{N}"
          name: "末端压差"
          type: "AI"
          sensor: "FL-02"
          count: 3
          note: "选取最不利点"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "VFD-CHWP-SEC-{N}"
          name: "二次泵变频指令"
          type: "AO"
          range: "20-50 Hz"
          
      setpoint:
        default: 150
        range: [100, 200]
        unit: "kPa"
        
      pid_parameters:
        Kp: 2.0
        Ki: 0.05
        Kd: 0.2
        
      special_logic: |
        # 选择最不利点
        DP_actual = min(DP-CHW-END-1, DP-CHW-END-2, DP-CHW-END-3)
        
        # 压差设定值重设
        IF all_valve_positions < 80%:
            SP = SP - 5 kPa (每10分钟)
        IF any_valve_position > 95%:
            SP = SP + 10 kPa (立即)
            
    SYS-CHP-005:
      loop_id: "SYS-CHP-005"
      loop_name: "冷却水泵变频控制"
      loop_type: "PID控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      description: "根据冷却水流量需求调节冷却水泵转速"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-CW-S"
          name: "冷却水供水温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-CW-R"
          name: "冷却水回水温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "FM-CW"
          name: "冷却水流量"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "VFD-CWP-{N}"
          name: "冷却水泵变频指令"
          type: "AO"
          
      setpoint:
        approach: 5.0  # °C，冷却水出塔温度与湿球温差
        
      control_logic: |
        # 根据冷却塔出水温度控制
        # 冷却水泵与冷机联动启停
        
    SYS-CHP-006:
      loop_id: "SYS-CHP-006"
      loop_name: "冷却塔风机台数/变频控制"
      loop_type: "台数+变频控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      description: "根据冷却水回水温度控制冷却塔风机"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-CW-R"
          name: "冷却水回水温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-WB"
          name: "湿球温度"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "VFD-CTF-{N}"
          name: "冷却塔风机变频指令"
          type: "AO"
          count: 3
          
      setpoint:
        default: 32
        range: [28, 35]
        unit: "°C"
        
      control_logic: |
        # 台数控制
        IF TS-CW-R > 35°C: 全部风机高速
        IF TS-CW-R > 32°C: 增加风机或提高转速
        IF TS-CW-R < 28°C: 减少风机或降低转速
        
        # 变频控制
        每台风机独立变频，目标温度32°C
        
    SYS-CHP-007:
      loop_id: "SYS-CHP-007"
      loop_name: "冷冻站旁通阀控制"
      loop_type: "压差控制"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      description: "一二次泵系统的旁通阀控制"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "DP-CHW-BYPASS"
          name: "旁通管压差"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "CV-CHW-BYPASS"
          name: "旁通阀开度"
          type: "AO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 维持一次侧最小流量
        IF Q_primary < Q_secondary:
            开启旁通阀，使 Q_primary = Q_chiller_min
            
    SYS-CHP-008:
      loop_id: "SYS-CHP-008"
      loop_name: "冷却水补水控制"
      loop_type: "液位控制"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "LT-CW-TANK"
          name: "膨胀水箱液位"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "SV-CW-MAKEUP"
          name: "补水阀"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        IF LT-CW-TANK < 30%: 开启补水阀
        IF LT-CW-TANK > 70%: 关闭补水阀
        IF LT-CW-TANK < 20%: 低液位报警
        IF LT-CW-TANK > 80%: 高液位报警
        
    SYS-CHP-009:
      loop_id: "SYS-CHP-009"
      loop_name: "冷冻站节能优化控制"
      loop_type: "优化控制"
      priority: "LOW"
      
      description: "在满足需求前提下优化冷冻站整体能效"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "PM-CHP-TOTAL"
          name: "冷冻站总功率"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "所有阀门开度"
          type: "AI"
          count: "N"
          
      optimization_objective: |
        minimize: PM-CHP-TOTAL
        subject_to:
          - 所有空间温度满足设定值
          - 所有阀门开度 < 95%
          
      strategy: |
        # 供水温度重设
        IF 所有阀门开度 < 80% 持续20分钟:
            TS-CHW-S setpoint += 0.5°C
            
        # 压差重设
        IF 所有阀门开度 < 75% 持续20分钟:
            DP-CHW setpoint -= 5 kPa
            
    SYS-CHP-010:
      loop_id: "SYS-CHP-010"
      loop_name: "冷冻站自由冷却控制"
      loop_type: "逻辑控制"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      description: "当室外温度足够低时，利用冷却塔直接供冷"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-OA"
          name: "室外温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-CHW-S"
          name: "冷冻水供水温度"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "CV-FREE-COOLING"
          name: "自由冷却换热器阀门"
          type: "AO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 自由冷却条件
        IF TS-OA < TS-CHW-SP - 5°C:
            启用自由冷却模式
            逐步开启自由冷却换热器阀门
            减少冷机负荷
            
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 二、热源系统控制回路 (SYS-HTG-011 ~ SYS-HTG-018)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  Heating_Plant_Loops:
    
    SYS-HTG-011:
      loop_id: "SYS-HTG-011"
      loop_name: "锅炉台数控制"
      loop_type: "逻辑控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      description: "根据热负荷自动调节锅炉运行台数"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-HW-S"
          name: "热水供水温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-HW-R"
          name: "热水回水温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "FM-HW"
          name: "热水流量"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "BLR-{N}-STS"
          name: "锅炉运行状态"
          type: "DI"
          count: 3
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "BLR-{N}-CMD"
          name: "锅炉启停命令"
          type: "DO"
          count: 3
          
      control_logic: |
        # 热负荷计算
        Q_heat = 4.18 × FM-HW × (TS-HW-S - TS-HW-R) / 3600  # kW
        
        # 台数决策
        与冷机台数控制逻辑类似
        
    SYS-HTG-012:
      loop_id: "SYS-HTG-012"
      loop_name: "热水供水温度控制"
      loop_type: "PID控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-HW-S"
          name: "热水供水温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-OA"
          name: "室外温度"
          type: "AI"
          note: "用于气候补偿"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "BLR-{N}-FIRE"
          name: "锅炉燃烧器调节"
          type: "AO"
          
      setpoint:
        default: 60
        range: [45, 70]
        unit: "°C"
        reset_curve: |
          # 气候补偿曲线
          TS-OA = -10°C → SP = 70°C
          TS-OA = 0°C → SP = 60°C
          TS-OA = 10°C → SP = 50°C
          TS-OA = 15°C → SP = 45°C
          
      pid_parameters:
        Kp: 4.0
        Ki: 0.08
        Kd: 0.4
        
    SYS-HTG-013:
      loop_id: "SYS-HTG-013"
      loop_name: "热水泵变频控制"
      loop_type: "PID控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "DP-HW-END"
          name: "末端压差"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "VFD-HWP-{N}"
          name: "热水泵变频指令"
          type: "AO"
          
      setpoint:
        default: 100
        range: [80, 150]
        unit: "kPa"
        
    SYS-HTG-014:
      loop_id: "SYS-HTG-014"
      loop_name: "锅炉燃烧空燃比控制"
      loop_type: "比例控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "O2-EXHAUST"
          name: "烟气含氧量"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "FM-GAS"
          name: "燃气流量"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "DA-COMBUSTION-AIR"
          name: "助燃风阀"
          type: "AO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 维持最佳空燃比
        O2_target = 3~5%  # 烟气含氧量目标
        调节助燃风阀使O2接近目标值
        
    SYS-HTG-015:
      loop_id: "SYS-HTG-015"
      loop_name: "蒸汽压力控制"
      loop_type: "PID控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      description: "蒸汽锅炉压力控制(供应CSSD、厨房等)"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "PS-STM"
          name: "蒸汽压力"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "BLR-STM-FIRE"
          name: "蒸汽锅炉燃烧调节"
          type: "AO"
          
      setpoint:
        default: 0.7
        range: [0.5, 1.0]
        unit: "MPa"
        
    SYS-HTG-016:
      loop_id: "SYS-HTG-016"
      loop_name: "热回收系统控制"
      loop_type: "优化控制"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      description: "烟气余热回收控制"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-EXHAUST"
          name: "烟气温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-HW-R"
          name: "热水回水温度"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "CV-HEAT-RECOVERY"
          name: "热回收阀门"
          type: "AO"
          
      control_logic: |
        IF TS-EXHAUST > 150°C AND TS-HW-R < 50°C:
            开启热回收阀门
            
    SYS-HTG-017:
      loop_id: "SYS-HTG-017"
      loop_name: "膨胀水箱压力控制"
      loop_type: "压力控制"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "PS-EXP-TANK"
          name: "膨胀水箱压力"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "SV-MAKEUP"
          name: "补水阀"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "SV-RELIEF"
          name: "泄压阀"
          type: "DO"
          
    SYS-HTG-018:
      loop_id: "SYS-HTG-018"
      loop_name: "供暖季节切换控制"
      loop_type: "逻辑控制"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      description: "根据室外温度自动切换供暖/停暖模式"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-OA"
          name: "室外温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "DATE"
          name: "日期"
          type: "系统"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "HEATING-MODE"
          name: "供暖模式"
          type: "MODE"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 供暖开始条件
        IF TS-OA连续3天低于12°C 且 DATE在10/15~4/15:
            启动供暖
            
        # 供暖停止条件
        IF TS-OA连续5天高于18°C 或 DATE超过4/15:
            停止供暖
            
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 三、AHU系统控制回路 (SYS-AHU-019 ~ SYS-AHU-028)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  AHU_System_Loops:
    
    SYS-AHU-019:
      loop_id: "SYS-AHU-019"
      loop_name: "洁净AHU群控制"
      loop_type: "群控"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      description: "手术部多台洁净AHU的协调控制"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "AHU-OR-{N}-STS"
          name: "AHU运行状态"
          type: "DI"
          count: 8
          
        - input_id: "DP-OR-{N}"
          name: "手术室压差"
          type: "AI"
          count: 8
          
      outputs:
        - input_id: "AHU-OR-{N}-CMD"
          name: "AHU启停命令"
          type: "DO"
          count: 8
          
      control_logic: |
        # 手术室AHU群控制
        优先级: 正在手术的房间 > 准备中 > 空闲
        
        # 资源分配
        当冷量/风量资源不足时:
        1. 保证正在手术的房间
        2. 降低空闲房间的换气次数
        
    SYS-AHU-020:
      loop_id: "SYS-AHU-020"
      loop_name: "AHU送风静压优化控制"
      loop_type: "优化控制"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      description: "根据VAV末端位置优化送风静压设定值"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "VAV-{N}-POS"
          name: "VAV阀位"
          type: "AI"
          count: "N"
          
        - input_id: "DP-DUCT-SA"
          name: "送风静压"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "DP-DUCT-SA-SP"
          name: "静压设定值"
          type: "AO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 静压重设
        VAV_max = max(VAV-{1..N}-POS)
        
        IF VAV_max < 80% 持续15分钟:
            SP = SP - 25 Pa
        IF VAV_max > 95%:
            SP = SP + 50 Pa (立即)
            
        SP = 限制在 [150, 400] Pa
        
    SYS-AHU-021:
      loop_id: "SYS-AHU-021"
      loop_name: "AHU经济循环控制"
      loop_type: "逻辑控制"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-OA"
          name: "室外温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "RH-OA"
          name: "室外湿度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-RA"
          name: "回风温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "RH-RA"
          name: "回风湿度"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "DA-OA"
          name: "新风阀"
          type: "AO"
          
        - output_id: "DA-RA"
          name: "回风阀"
          type: "AO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 焓值经济循环
        h_outdoor = f(TS-OA, RH-OA)  # 室外焓值
        h_return = f(TS-RA, RH-RA)   # 回风焓值
        
        IF h_outdoor < h_return - 5 kJ/kg:
            # 室外空气更"冷"
            新风比例 = 调节到满足冷却需求
        ELSE:
            # 最小新风
            新风比例 = 30%
            
    SYS-AHU-022:
      loop_id: "SYS-AHU-022"
      loop_name: "AHU防冻保护"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-MA"
          name: "混风温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-OA"
          name: "室外温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-CHW-COIL"
          name: "表冷器表面温度"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "DA-OA"
          name: "新风阀"
          type: "AO"
          
        - output_id: "CV-HW"
          name: "热水阀"
          type: "AO"
          
        - output_id: "SF-CMD"
          name: "送风机启停"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 防冻保护等级
        
        # 等级1：预警
        IF TS-MA < 8°C OR TS-CHW-COIL < 5°C:
            减小新风阀开度
            增大热水阀开度
            发送预警
            
        # 等级2：保护
        IF TS-MA < 5°C:
            关闭新风阀至最小(10%)
            热水阀开至100%
            发送报警
            
        # 等级3：紧急停机
        IF TS-MA < 3°C 持续30秒:
            停止送风机
            关闭新风阀
            热水阀保持100%
            发送紧急报警
            
    SYS-AHU-023:
      loop_id: "SYS-AHU-023"
      loop_name: "AHU过滤器监测与报警"
      loop_type: "监测"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "DP-FILTER-{N}"
          name: "过滤器压差"
          type: "AI"
          count: 3  # 初效/中效/高效
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "ALM-FILTER-{N}"
          name: "过滤器报警"
          type: "DO"
          
      alarm_thresholds:
        primary_filter:
          warning: 200
          alarm: 250
          unit: "Pa"
        medium_filter:
          warning: 300
          alarm: 350
        hepa_filter:
          warning: 400
          alarm: 450
          
    SYS-AHU-024:
      loop_id: "SYS-AHU-024"
      loop_name: "AHU夜间节能模式"
      loop_type: "时间表控制"
      priority: "LOW"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TIME"
          name: "时间"
          type: "系统"
          
        - input_id: "OCC-SENSOR"
          name: "人员占用"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "AHU-MODE"
          name: "AHU运行模式"
          type: "MODE"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 非关键区域AHU
        
        工作时间 (06:00-22:00):
            正常运行
            
        非工作时间 (22:00-06:00):
            IF 无人员占用:
                降低送风量至50%
                扩大温度死区±2°C
                
    SYS-AHU-025:
      loop_id: "SYS-AHU-025"
      loop_name: "AHU变风量控制"
      loop_type: "变频控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      description: "根据负荷调节风量"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "DP-DUCT-SA"
          name: "送风静压"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "VFD-SF"
          name: "送风机变频"
          type: "AO"
          
        - output_id: "VFD-RF"
          name: "回风机变频"
          type: "AO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 送风机控制
        通过PID维持送风静压
        
        # 回风机跟踪
        VFD-RF = VFD-SF × 0.9  # 保持正压
        或根据回风静压独立控制
        
    SYS-AHU-026:
      loop_id: "SYS-AHU-026"
      loop_name: "AHU预冷/预热控制"
      loop_type: "优化控制"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      description: "上班前提前启动AHU达到舒适温度"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "TS-ZONE"
          name: "区域温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-OA"
          name: "室外温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "SCHEDULE"
          name: "日程表"
          type: "系统"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "AHU-START-TIME"
          name: "AHU启动时间"
          type: "计算值"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 计算预启动时间
        ΔT = |TS-ZONE - TS-SETPOINT|
        
        预热时间 = f(ΔT, 建筑热惯性)
        
        在上班时间前 预启动时间 启动AHU
        
    SYS-AHU-027:
      loop_id: "SYS-AHU-027"
      loop_name: "AHU需求控制通风(DCV)"
      loop_type: "CO2控制"
      priority: "MEDIUM"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "CO2-ZONE"
          name: "区域CO2浓度"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "DA-OA"
          name: "新风阀"
          type: "AO"
          
      setpoint:
        default: 800
        range: [600, 1000]
        unit: "ppm"
        
      control_logic: |
        # CO2控制新风量
        IF CO2-ZONE > 1000 ppm:
            增加新风比例
        IF CO2-ZONE < 600 ppm:
            减少新风比例至最小值
            
    SYS-AHU-028:
      loop_id: "SYS-AHU-028"
      loop_name: "AHU皮带断裂检测"
      loop_type: "故障检测"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "SF-STS"
          name: "送风机运行状态"
          type: "DI"
          
        - input_id: "AF-SWITCH"
          name: "气流开关"
          type: "DI"
          
        - input_id: "VFD-SF-CURRENT"
          name: "送风机电流"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "ALM-BELT-BREAK"
          name: "皮带断裂报警"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        IF SF-STS = ON AND AF-SWITCH = OFF 持续30秒:
            皮带断裂报警
            停止风机
            
        IF SF-STS = ON AND VFD-SF-CURRENT < 正常值的50%:
            皮带松弛预警
            
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 四、医用气体系统控制回路 (SYS-MGAS-029 ~ SYS-MGAS-038)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  Medical_Gas_System_Loops:
    
    SYS-MGAS-029:
      loop_id: "SYS-MGAS-029"
      loop_name: "氧气气源自动切换"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      description: "主气源故障时自动无缝切换到备用气源"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "PS-O2-LOX"
          name: "液氧站压力"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "PS-O2-MANIFOLD"
          name: "汇流排压力"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "LT-LOX"
          name: "液氧液位"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "SV-O2-PRIMARY"
          name: "主气源阀"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "SV-O2-SECONDARY"
          name: "备用气源阀"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 正常状态
        主气源(液氧)供气，备用(汇流排)待命
        
        # 切换条件
        IF PS-O2-LOX < 800 kPa 持续30秒:
            切换到备用气源
        OR IF LT-LOX < 20%:
            切换到备用气源
        OR IF 手动切换命令:
            切换到指定气源
            
        # 切换动作
        1. 开启备用气源阀 (< 0.5秒)
        2. 等待备用压力建立 (< 2秒)
        3. 关闭主气源阀
        4. 发送切换报警
        
        # 切换时间
        总切换时间 < 1秒，压力波动 < 5%
        
    SYS-MGAS-030:
      loop_id: "SYS-MGAS-030"
      loop_name: "液氧站液位监控"
      loop_type: "监测报警"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "LT-LOX"
          name: "液氧液位"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "PS-LOX"
          name: "液氧罐压力"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "TS-LOX"
          name: "液氧温度"
          type: "AI"
          
      alarms:
        - level: 50
          type: "预警"
          action: "通知供应商补充"
          
        - level: 30
          type: "报警"
          action: "紧急通知+准备切换"
          
        - level: 20
          type: "紧急"
          action: "自动切换到备用"
          
    SYS-MGAS-031:
      loop_id: "SYS-MGAS-031"
      loop_name: "医用负压泵群控制"
      loop_type: "台数控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "PS-VAC"
          name: "真空压力"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "VP-{N}-STS"
          name: "真空泵运行状态"
          type: "DI"
          count: 3
          
        - input_id: "VP-{N}-FLT"
          name: "真空泵故障状态"
          type: "DI"
          count: 3
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "VP-{N}-CMD"
          name: "真空泵启停命令"
          type: "DO"
          count: 3
          
      setpoint:
        default: -60
        range: [-70, -40]
        unit: "kPa"
        
      control_logic: |
        # 正常运行：1台运行，2台备用
        
        # 启动逻辑
        IF PS-VAC > -50 kPa:  # 真空不足
            启动第2台泵
        IF PS-VAC > -40 kPa:
            启动第3台泵
            发送真空不足报警
            
        # 停止逻辑
        IF PS-VAC < -70 kPa:  # 真空过高
            停止备用泵
            
        # 轮换
        每24小时切换主泵
        故障泵自动退出
        
    SYS-MGAS-032:
      loop_id: "SYS-MGAS-032"
      loop_name: "医用压缩空气干燥控制"
      loop_type: "露点控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "DP-AIR"
          name: "压缩空气露点"
          type: "AI"
          unit: "°C"
          
        - input_id: "PS-AIR"
          name: "压缩空气压力"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "DRYER-CMD"
          name: "干燥机控制"
          type: "DO"
          
      setpoint:
        dewpoint: -40
        unit: "°C"
        
      alarm:
        dewpoint_high: -20
        action: "露点过高报警，检查干燥机"
        
    SYS-MGAS-033:
      loop_id: "SYS-MGAS-033"
      loop_name: "医用压缩空气泵群控制"
      loop_type: "压力控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "PS-AIR-MAIN"
          name: "压缩空气主管压力"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "COMP-{N}-CMD"
          name: "压缩机启停命令"
          type: "DO"
          count: 3
          
      setpoint:
        default: 0.8
        range: [0.7, 0.9]
        unit: "MPa"
        
    SYS-MGAS-034:
      loop_id: "SYS-MGAS-034"
      loop_name: "医用气体区域阀远程控制"
      loop_type: "逻辑控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "ZV-{ZONE}-{GAS}-POS"
          name: "区域阀位置反馈"
          type: "DI"
          
        - input_id: "FIRE-ZONE-{N}"
          name: "区域火灾信号"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "ZV-{ZONE}-{GAS}-CMD"
          name: "区域阀开关命令"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 消防联动
        IF FIRE-ZONE-{N} = 火灾确认:
            关闭该区域所有可燃气体阀门 (O2, N2O)
            保持负压系统运行
            发送医气切断报警
            
        # 手动控制
        护士站可远程开关区域阀
        
    SYS-MGAS-035:
      loop_id: "SYS-MGAS-035"
      loop_name: "WAGD麻醉废气排放控制"
      loop_type: "联动控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "OR-{N}-USE"
          name: "手术室使用状态"
          type: "DI"
          
        - input_id: "N2O-USE-{N}"
          name: "笑气使用状态"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "VFD-WAGD"
          name: "WAGD风机变频"
          type: "AO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 使用手术室数量
        N_active = count(OR-{N}-USE = ON)
        
        # 风机调速
        IF N_active = 0:
            VFD-WAGD = 30%  # 最小运行
        ELSE:
            VFD-WAGD = 30% + N_active × 10%
            
    SYS-MGAS-036:
      loop_id: "SYS-MGAS-036"
      loop_name: "氦气泄漏监测与排放"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      description: "MRI室氦气泄漏检测与紧急排放"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "O2-MRI-ROOM"
          name: "MRI室氧浓度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "HE-LEAK"
          name: "氦气泄漏检测"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "EF-MRI-QUENCH"
          name: "淬火排风机"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "ALM-HE-LEAK"
          name: "氦气泄漏报警"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 氧浓度监测
        IF O2-MRI-ROOM < 19.5%:  # 正常21%
            氧浓度低报警
            启动淬火排风机
            人员撤离警报
            
        # 氦气泄漏检测
        IF HE-LEAK = TRUE:
            启动淬火排风机
            发送报警
            
    SYS-MGAS-037:
      loop_id: "SYS-MGAS-037"
      loop_name: "医用气体压力监测总系统"
      loop_type: "监测报警"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "PS-O2-{ZONE}"
          name: "各区域氧气压力"
          type: "AI"
          count: 10
          
        - input_id: "PS-VAC-{ZONE}"
          name: "各区域负压"
          type: "AI"
          count: 10
          
        - input_id: "PS-AIR-{ZONE}"
          name: "各区域压缩空气"
          type: "AI"
          count: 10
          
      alarm_matrix:
        oxygen:
          low_alarm: 380
          high_alarm: 520
          unit: "kPa"
        vacuum:
          low_alarm: -40
          unit: "kPa"
        compressed_air:
          low_alarm: 350
          high_alarm: 450
          
    SYS-MGAS-038:
      loop_id: "SYS-MGAS-038"
      loop_name: "PSA制氧机控制"
      loop_type: "过程控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      description: "PSA制氧机的启停和纯度控制"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "O2-PURITY"
          name: "氧气纯度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "PS-O2-PSA"
          name: "PSA出口压力"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "PSA-CMD"
          name: "PSA启停命令"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "PSA-CYCLE"
          name: "PSA循环时间"
          type: "AO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 纯度控制
        目标纯度: ≥ 93%
        
        IF O2-PURITY < 93%:
            延长吸附时间
            发送低纯度报警
            
        IF O2-PURITY < 90%:
            PSA输出旁通
            切换到液氧供应
            发送PSA故障报警
            
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 五、消防联动控制回路 (SYS-FIRE-039 ~ SYS-FIRE-045)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  Fire_Protection_Loops:
    
    SYS-FIRE-039:
      loop_id: "SYS-FIRE-039"
      loop_name: "消防联动-HVAC系统"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "FIRE-CONFIRM-{ZONE}"
          name: "火灾确认信号"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "AHU-{N}-STOP"
          name: "AHU停止命令"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "FD-{N}-CLOSE"
          name: "防火阀关闭命令"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 火灾确认时
        着火区域:
            停止所有AHU
            关闭所有防火阀
            关闭新风/回风阀
            
        非着火区域:
            继续运行 (维持正压防止烟气蔓延)
            
    SYS-FIRE-040:
      loop_id: "SYS-FIRE-040"
      loop_name: "排烟系统联动控制"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "SMOKE-CONFIRM-{ZONE}"
          name: "烟感确认信号"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "SEF-{N}-START"
          name: "排烟风机启动"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "SED-{N}-OPEN"
          name: "排烟口开启"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "AMD-{N}-OPEN"
          name: "补风口开启"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 排烟联动时序
        T+0s: 烟感确认
        T+5s: 开启着火区域排烟口
        T+10s: 启动排烟风机
        T+15s: 开启补风口
        
    SYS-FIRE-041:
      loop_id: "SYS-FIRE-041"
      loop_name: "正压送风联动控制"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "FIRE-CONFIRM"
          name: "火灾确认信号"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "PSF-{N}-START"
          name: "正压送风机启动"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "PSV-{N}-OPEN"
          name: "正压送风口开启"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 正压送风联动
        着火层及其上下各一层:
            开启正压送风口
            
        启动正压送风机
        
        维持楼梯间压力: 25~50 Pa
        前室压力: 25~30 Pa
        
    SYS-FIRE-042:
      loop_id: "SYS-FIRE-042"
      loop_name: "消防泵自动启动控制"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "PS-FIRE-MAIN"
          name: "消防管网压力"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "FLOW-FIRE"
          name: "消防流量开关"
          type: "DI"
          
        - input_id: "FIRE-CONFIRM"
          name: "火灾确认"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "FIRE-PUMP-START"
          name: "消防泵启动"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 自动启动条件
        IF PS-FIRE-MAIN < 设定压力:
            启动稳压泵
            
        IF FLOW-FIRE = ON:  # 有消防水流
            启动消防主泵
            
        IF FIRE-CONFIRM = TRUE:
            启动消防主泵
            
    SYS-FIRE-043:
      loop_id: "SYS-FIRE-043"
      loop_name: "气体灭火联动控制"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      description: "数据中心/配电室气体灭火"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "SMOKE-DOUBLE-CONFIRM"
          name: "双感烟确认"
          type: "DI"
          
        - input_id: "DOOR-{N}-STS"
          name: "门状态"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "HVAC-STOP"
          name: "HVAC停止"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "FD-CLOSE"
          name: "防火阀关闭"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "GAS-RELEASE"
          name: "气体释放"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 气体灭火联动时序
        T+0s: 双感烟确认
        T+0s: 声光报警启动
        T+0s: 停止HVAC
        T+5s: 关闭防火阀
        T+30s: 确认门关闭
        T+30s: 气体释放 (如门未关则延时)
        
    SYS-FIRE-044:
      loop_id: "SYS-FIRE-044"
      loop_name: "消防联动-医用气体"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "FIRE-ZONE-{N}"
          name: "区域火灾信号"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "ZV-O2-{ZONE}"
          name: "氧气区域阀"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "ZV-N2O-{ZONE}"
          name: "笑气区域阀"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 着火区域
        关闭氧气区域阀 (助燃)
        关闭笑气区域阀
        
        # 其他区域
        保持医气供应 (抢救需要)
        
        # 特殊情况
        如手术正在进行:
            延时关闭，发送紧急转移警报
            
    SYS-FIRE-045:
      loop_id: "SYS-FIRE-045"
      loop_name: "消防联动-电气系统"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "FIRE-CONFIRM"
          name: "火灾确认"
          type: "DI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "ELEVATOR-RECALL"
          name: "电梯迫降"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "EMERGENCY-LIGHT"
          name: "应急照明启动"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "NON-FIRE-POWER-OFF"
          name: "非消防电源切断"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 消防联动
        T+0s: 电梯迫降到首层
        T+0s: 应急照明启动
        T+0s: 疏散指示灯启动
        T+30s: 切断非消防电源 (可选)
        
        # 保持供电
        消防设备电源
        应急照明
        医疗生命支持设备
        
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 六、电气系统控制回路 (SYS-ELEC-046 ~ SYS-ELEC-050)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  Electrical_System_Loops:
    
    SYS-ELEC-046:
      loop_id: "SYS-ELEC-046"
      loop_name: "发电机自动启动与ATS切换"
      loop_type: "安全联锁"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "V-MAINS-{PHASE}"
          name: "市电电压"
          type: "AI"
          count: 3
          
        - input_id: "GEN-{N}-STS"
          name: "发电机状态"
          type: "DI"
          count: 2
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "GEN-{N}-START"
          name: "发电机启动命令"
          type: "DO"
          
        - output_id: "ATS-{N}-POS"
          name: "ATS位置命令"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 市电故障检测
        IF 任一相电压 < 85% × 额定电压 持续3秒:
            市电故障确认
            
        # 发电机启动
        T+0s: 市电故障确认
        T+0s: 发送发电机启动命令
        T+10s: 发电机达到额定转速和电压
        T+12s: ATS切换到发电机
        
        # 市电恢复
        IF 市电恢复正常 持续60秒:
            ATS切换回市电
            发电机冷却运行5分钟后停机
            
    SYS-ELEC-047:
      loop_id: "SYS-ELEC-047"
      loop_name: "发电机并联运行控制"
      loop_type: "同步控制"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "GEN-{N}-V"
          name: "发电机电压"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "GEN-{N}-F"
          name: "发电机频率"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "GEN-{N}-PHASE"
          name: "发电机相位"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "GEN-{N}-GOV"
          name: "调速器控制"
          type: "AO"
          
        - output_id: "GEN-{N}-AVR"
          name: "励磁调节"
          type: "AO"
          
        - output_id: "GEN-{N}-CB"
          name: "发电机断路器"
          type: "DO"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 并联条件
        电压差 < 5%
        频率差 < 0.5 Hz
        相位差 < 10°
        
        # 负荷分配
        按容量比例分配有功功率
        按容量比例分配无功功率
        
    SYS-ELEC-048:
      loop_id: "SYS-ELEC-048"
      loop_name: "UPS电池管理"
      loop_type: "监测控制"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "UPS-{N}-BATT-V"
          name: "电池电压"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "UPS-{N}-BATT-I"
          name: "电池电流"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "UPS-{N}-BATT-T"
          name: "电池温度"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "UPS-{N}-SOC"
          name: "电池荷电状态"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "UPS-{N}-CHARGE-MODE"
          name: "充电模式"
          type: "MODE"
          
      control_logic: |
        # 充电管理
        正常: 浮充模式
        放电后: 均充模式 → 浮充模式
        
        # 告警
        SOC < 50%: 电池低预警
        SOC < 30%: 电池低报警
        SOC < 10%: 电池临界, 准备关机
        
        # 温度保护
        T > 40°C: 降低充电电流
        T > 45°C: 停止充电, 报警
        
    SYS-ELEC-049:
      loop_id: "SYS-ELEC-049"
      loop_name: "医用IT系统绝缘监测"
      loop_type: "安全监测"
      priority: "CRITICAL"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "IMD-{N}-INSULATION"
          name: "绝缘电阻"
          type: "AI"
          unit: "kΩ"
          
        - input_id: "IMD-{N}-LEAKAGE"
          name: "漏电流"
          type: "AI"
          unit: "mA"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "IMD-{N}-ALM"
          name: "绝缘故障报警"
          type: "DO"
          
      alarm_thresholds:
        insulation_prewarning: 100  # kΩ
        insulation_alarm: 50  # kΩ
        leakage_alarm: 5  # mA
        
      control_logic: |
        # 绝缘监测
        IF R_insulation < 100 kΩ:
            预警灯亮, 蜂鸣
            
        IF R_insulation < 50 kΩ:
            报警灯亮, 持续蜂鸣
            通知维护人员
            
        # 不切断电源
        医用IT系统不会因绝缘故障自动断电
        确保手术/抢救不中断
        
    SYS-ELEC-050:
      loop_id: "SYS-ELEC-050"
      loop_name: "负荷管理与卸载"
      loop_type: "优先级控制"
      priority: "HIGH"
      
      description: "电源容量不足时按优先级卸载负荷"
      
      inputs:
        - input_id: "P-TOTAL"
          name: "总负荷功率"
          type: "AI"
          
        - input_id: "P-AVAILABLE"
          name: "可用容量"
          type: "AI"
          
      outputs:
        - output_id: "LOAD-{N}-SHED"
          name: "负荷卸载命令"
          type: "DO"
          
      load_priority:
        1: "生命支持设备"
        2: "手术室/ICU"
        3: "医用气体"
        4: "关键照明"
        5: "电梯/消防"
        6: "普通照明"
        7: "空调/暖通"
        8: "非关键负荷"
        
      control_logic: |
        # 负荷卸载
        IF P-TOTAL > P-AVAILABLE × 90%:
            按优先级从低到高卸载负荷
            
        # 负荷恢复
        IF P-TOTAL < P-AVAILABLE × 70%:
            按优先级从高到低恢复负荷
            
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 修正后的L1: 空间-需求映射 (静态、描述性)
# 将控制要求分离到L5/L6
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Layer_1_Corrected:
  
  design_principle: |
    L1定义的是"空间需要什么样的环境"（静态需求）
    而不是"如何控制达到这个环境"（动态控制）
    
    L1内容应该是：
    - 医学/规范驱动的环境参数要求
    - 可以直接引用标准文献
    - 不包含控制响应时间、PID参数等
    
    控制相关内容归属：
    - 控制响应时间 → L5基础控制回路
    - 场景模式切换 → L6场景控制
    - 快速降温等特殊模式 → L6场景控制

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 手术室空间需求（修正后）
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  OR_Operating_Room_Corrected:
    
    space_id: "OR"
    space_name: "手术室"
    space_category: "诊疗空间"
    criticality: "CRITICAL"
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 环境需求定义（纯静态参数）
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    environment_requirements:
      
      temperature:
        requirement_description: "维持患者体温稳定，保证手术条件"
        baseline_setpoint: 22
        acceptable_range: [18, 26]
        unit: "°C"
        tolerance: "±2°C"
        
        regulatory_basis:
          - source: "GB 50333-2013 医院洁净手术部建筑技术规范"
            clause: "4.0.4"
            requirement: "洁净手术室温度应为22~25°C"
            
          - source: "ASHRAE 170-2021"
            clause: "Table 7-1"
            requirement: "Operating Room: 68-75°F (20-24°C)"
            
        medical_rationale: |
          - 患者麻醉后体温调节能力下降
          - 过低温度导致术中低体温（<36°C核心体温）
          - 过高温度增加外科医生疲劳
          - 特殊手术（CPB、器官移植）需要可调范围更宽
          
      humidity:
        requirement_description: "防止静电、保持呼吸道舒适"
        baseline_setpoint: 50
        acceptable_range: [40, 60]
        unit: "%RH"
        tolerance: "±10%"
        
        regulatory_basis:
          - source: "GB 50333-2013"
            clause: "4.0.5"
            requirement: "洁净手术室相对湿度应为40%~60%"
            
        medical_rationale: |
          - <40%RH：静电风险增加，麻醉气体爆炸风险
          - >60%RH：微生物繁殖风险增加
          - 维持呼吸道黏膜湿润
          
      pressure:
        requirement_description: "正压隔离，防止污染空气进入"
        baseline_setpoint: "+15 Pa"
        acceptable_range: ["+10 Pa", "+25 Pa"]
        reference_zone: "邻近走廊"
        tolerance: "±5 Pa"
        
        regulatory_basis:
          - source: "GB 50333-2013"
            clause: "4.0.7"
            requirement: "洁净手术室与相邻低级别洁净区压差≥5Pa，与非洁净区压差≥10Pa"
            
        medical_rationale: |
          - 正压防止走廊污染空气进入
          - 门开启时仍需维持气流方向向外
          - 压差过高导致门开启困难
          
      cleanliness:
        requirement_description: "控制空气中微粒和微生物数量"
        
        by_classification:
          class_I:
            iso_class: "ISO 5"
            particles_0_5um: "≤ 3,520/m³"
            particles_5um: "≤ 29/m³"
            bacteria_cfu: "≤ 5 CFU/皿·30min"
            applications: ["器官移植", "心脏手术", "神经外科"]
            
          class_II:
            iso_class: "ISO 6"
            particles_0_5um: "≤ 35,200/m³"
            particles_5um: "≤ 293/m³"
            bacteria_cfu: "≤ 25 CFU/皿·30min"
            applications: ["骨科", "眼科", "普外科"]
            
          class_III:
            iso_class: "ISO 7"
            particles_0_5um: "≤ 352,000/m³"
            particles_5um: "≤ 2,930/m³"
            bacteria_cfu: "≤ 75 CFU/皿·30min"
            applications: ["普通手术", "小型手术"]
            
        regulatory_basis:
          - source: "GB 50333-2013"
            clause: "3.0.2"
            
      air_change:
        requirement_description: "维持洁净度和换气需求"
        
        by_classification:
          class_I: "≥ 30 ACH"
          class_II: "≥ 25 ACH"
          class_III: "≥ 20 ACH"
          
        fresh_air_ratio: "≥ 30%"
        
        regulatory_basis:
          - source: "GB 50333-2013"
            clause: "5.3.3"
            
      medical_gas:
        requirement_description: "手术所需的医用气体终端"
        
        oxygen:
          terminals_required: 2
          working_pressure: "400 kPa"
          peak_flow_capacity: "60 L/min"
          
        vacuum:
          terminals_required: 2
          working_pressure: "-40~-60 kPa"
          peak_flow_capacity: "80 L/min"
          
        compressed_air:
          terminals_required: 2
          working_pressure: "400 kPa"
          
        nitrous_oxide:
          terminals_required: 1
          working_pressure: "400 kPa"
          wagd_required: true
          
        nitrogen:
          terminals_required: 1
          working_pressure: "800 kPa"
          application: "气动手术工具"
          
        regulatory_basis:
          - source: "GB 50751-2012 医用气体工程技术规范"
            
      electrical:
        requirement_description: "电力供应和安全要求"
        
        power_supply:
          normal_power: true
          ups_backup: true
          backup_time: "≥ 30分钟"
          
        it_system:
          isolated_power: true
          imd_monitoring: true
          alarm_threshold: "50 kΩ"
          
        regulatory_basis:
          - source: "GB 16895.24 医疗场所电气装置特殊要求"
            
      noise:
        requirement_description: "控制噪声保证手术沟通"
        limit: "≤ 45 dB(A)"
        
        regulatory_basis:
          - source: "GB 50333-2013"
            clause: "4.0.9"
            
      lighting:
        requirement_description: "满足手术视觉需求"
        
        general_illumination: "500 lux (可调)"
        surgical_field: "40,000~160,000 lux (无影灯)"
        emergency_illumination: "≥ 50 lux"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 特殊医学需求说明（静态描述）
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    special_medical_needs:
      
      cpb_surgery:
        description: "体外循环手术的特殊环境需求"
        temperature_range: [18, 28]
        rationale: "体外循环期间需要控制患者体温（低温脑保护或复温）"
        note: "具体控制方式见L6场景控制"
        
      infant_surgery:
        description: "婴幼儿手术的特殊环境需求"
        temperature_range: [24, 28]
        humidity_range: [50, 60]
        rationale: "婴幼儿体温调节能力差，需要更温暖的环境"
        
      transplant_surgery:
        description: "器官移植手术的特殊环境需求"
        cleanliness: "ISO 5"
        positive_pressure: "+25 Pa"
        rationale: "免疫抑制患者感染风险极高"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 引用到其他层级（明确分离）
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    cross_layer_references:
      
      control_requirements:
        layer: "L5"
        reference: "L5-TEMP-OR, L5-PRESS-OR, L5-HUMID-OR"
        note: "温度/压差/湿度的控制回路设计"
        
      scenario_modes:
        layer: "L6"
        reference: "L6-OR-SCN-01 ~ L6-OR-SCN-08"
        note: "8种运营场景模式定义（包含CPB快速降温等）"
        
      response_time_requirements:
        layer: "L5"
        reference: "L5-TEMP-OR"
        note: "控制响应时间在控制回路定义中规定"
        
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # ICU空间需求（修正后）
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  ICU_Intensive_Care_Corrected:
    
    space_id: "ICU"
    space_name: "重症监护室"
    space_category: "诊疗空间"
    criticality: "CRITICAL"
    
    environment_requirements:
      
      temperature:
        requirement_description: "维持患者舒适，支持各类重症监护"
        baseline_setpoint: 24
        acceptable_range: [22, 26]
        unit: "°C"
        tolerance: "±2°C"
        per_bed_control: "推荐（如条件允许）"
        
        regulatory_basis:
          - source: "ASHRAE 170-2021"
            requirement: "ICU: 70-75°F (21-24°C)"
            
      humidity:
        baseline_setpoint: 50
        acceptable_range: [40, 60]
        unit: "%RH"
        
      pressure:
        standard_mode:
          setpoint: "+5 Pa"
          reference: "走廊"
          
        isolation_capable:
          description: "部分床位需具备隔离能力"
          positive_isolation: "+10 Pa"
          negative_isolation: "-10 Pa"
          switchable: true
          
        regulatory_basis:
          - source: "GB 50333-2013"
            note: "ICU压力要求根据感染控制需要确定"
            
      air_change:
        minimum: "12 ACH"
        recommended: "15 ACH"
        fresh_air_ratio: "≥ 2 ACH或15%"
        
      medical_gas:
        per_bed:
          oxygen_terminals: 2
          vacuum_terminals: 2
          compressed_air_terminals: 1
          
        high_flow_capability:
          required: true
          description: "支持高流量氧疗(60L/min以上)"
          
      electrical:
        per_bed:
          ups_backup: true
          it_system: true
          imd_monitoring: "每个分区"
          
      lighting:
        circadian_rhythm_support: "推荐"
        day_mode: "300 lux"
        night_mode: "50 lux"
        examination_mode: "1000 lux"
        
    special_medical_needs:
      
      nicu:
        description: "新生儿ICU特殊需求"
        temperature_range: [24, 28]
        humidity_range: [50, 70]
        noise_limit: "≤ 40 dB(A)"
        
      burn_icu:
        description: "烧伤ICU特殊需求"
        temperature_range: [28, 32]
        humidity_range: [40, 50]
        
    cross_layer_references:
      control_requirements: "L5-TEMP-ICU, L5-PRESS-ICU"
      scenario_modes: "L6-ICU-SCN-01 ~ L6-ICU-SCN-05"
      
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 隔离病房空间需求（修正后）
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  ISO_Isolation_Room_Corrected:
    
    space_id: "ISO"
    space_name: "隔离病房"
    space_category: "诊疗空间"
    criticality: "CRITICAL"
    
    environment_requirements:
      
      temperature:
        baseline_setpoint: 24
        acceptable_range: [22, 26]
        unit: "°C"
        
      pressure:
        negative_isolation:
          description: "空气传播疾病隔离"
          setpoint: "-10 Pa"
          tolerance: "±2 Pa"
          reference: "走廊"
          
          regulatory_basis:
            - source: "CDC Guidelines for Isolation Precautions"
              requirement: "AIIR: ≥12 ACH, negative pressure"
              
        positive_isolation:
          description: "免疫缺陷患者保护"
          setpoint: "+10 Pa"
          tolerance: "±2 Pa"
          reference: "走廊"
          
        anteroom:
          description: "缓冲间压力梯度"
          gradient: "病房 → 缓冲间 → 走廊"
          
      air_change:
        negative_isolation: "≥ 12 ACH"
        positive_isolation: "≥ 15 ACH"
        
      exhaust:
        negative_isolation:
          requirement: "100%排出，不得回风"
          filtration: "HEPA过滤后排放"
          discharge: "高空排放，远离进风口"
          
      airlock:
        door_interlock: "必须（防止两门同时开启）"
        
    special_medical_needs:
      
      airborne_infection:
        description: "空气传播疾病（TB、麻疹、水痘）"
        pressure: "-10 Pa或更低"
        air_change: "≥ 12 ACH"
        exhaust: "HEPA过滤后高空排放"
        
      droplet_infection:
        description: "飞沫传播疾病"
        pressure: "-5 Pa"
        special_ppe: true
        
      contact_infection:
        description: "接触传播疾病"
        pressure: "0 Pa（无特殊要求）"
        dedicated_equipment: true
        
    cross_layer_references:
      control_requirements: "L5-PRESS-ISO"
      scenario_modes: "L6-ISO-SCN-01 ~ L6-ISO-SCN-05"
      patient_transfer: "L7-TRANSFER-01, L7-TRANSFER-12"

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 其他空间类型（按相同模式修正）
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  # 以下空间按相同原则进行修正：
  # - ED_Emergency (急诊)
  # - WARD_Patient_Room (病房)
  # - DIAG_Diagnostic (诊断治疗室)
  # - CSSD_Sterile_Supply (供应室)
  # - PHARM_Pharmacy (药房)
  # - LAB_Laboratory (实验室)
  # - MECH_Mechanical (机房)
  # - ELEC_Electrical (电气机房)
  # - WASTE_Management (污物处理)
  # - LOBBY_Waiting (候诊大厅)
  # - CORRIDOR_Circulation (走廊)
  # - STAIR_Vertical (楼梯间)
  
  # [为简洁起见，此处省略其他空间的详细定义，实际文档应完整展开]
```

---

# 缺陷二修正：第二层设备-控制模式映射
# CORRECTION 2: L2 DEVICE-CONTROL ARCHITECTURE MAPPING

---

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 修正后的L2: 系统-设备-控制架构映射
# 补充设备如何被控制的架构说明
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Layer_2_Corrected:
  
  design_principle: |
    L2不仅列出"有什么设备和I/O"，
    还需说明"设备如何被控制"和"设备间如何协调"
    
    补充内容包括：
    - 控制架构（PID/逻辑/串级等）
    - 设备冗余策略
    - 设备间协调关系
    - 故障模式处理

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 手术室洁净空调系统（修正后）
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  HVAC_CLN_OR_Corrected:
    
    subsystem_id: "HVAC-CLN-OR"
    subsystem_name: "手术室洁净空调系统"
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 设备清单
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    equipment_inventory:
      
      ahu:
        count: 8
        naming: "AHU-OR-001 ~ AHU-OR-008"
        
        per_ahu_configuration:
          type: "组合式洁净空调机组"
          capacity: "5000 m³/h"
          zones_served: 2  # 每台AHU服务2间手术室
          
          components:
            - "初效过滤段 (G4)"
            - "中效过滤段 (F8)"
            - "表冷段"
            - "加热段"
            - "加湿段"
            - "送风机段 (变频)"
            - "消声段"
            
          terminal_hepa:
            location: "送风口处"
            efficiency: "H13"
            
      mau:
        count: 2
        naming: "MAU-OR-001, MAU-OR-002"
        type: "新风处理机组"
        capacity: "15000 m³/h each"
        serves: "所有8台AHU的新风"
        
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # I/O清单（详细位置）
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    io_inventory:
      
      sensors:
        
        temperature:
          - point_id: "TS-SA-OR-{N}"
            description: "送风温度"
            location: "AHU送风管道，距AHU出口2m"
            count: 8
            sensor_type: "TH-02-SG"
            signal: "4-20mA"
            
          - point_id: "TS-RA-OR-{N}"
            description: "回风温度"
            location: "AHU回风管道"
            count: 8
            sensor_type: "TH-02-SG"
            
          - point_id: "TS-RM-OR-{N}"
            description: "室内温度"
            location: "手术室墙面1.5m高"
            count: 16  # 每间手术室2个（冗余）
            sensor_type: "TH-03-OR"
            
          - point_id: "TS-OA"
            description: "室外温度"
            location: "室外百叶箱"
            count: 1
            sensor_type: "TH-04"
            
        humidity:
          - point_id: "RH-SA-OR-{N}"
            description: "送风湿度"
            location: "AHU送风管道"
            count: 8
            
          - point_id: "RH-RM-OR-{N}"
            description: "室内湿度"
            location: "手术室墙面"
            count: 16
            
        pressure:
          - point_id: "DP-OR-{N}"
            description: "室内压差（室内-走廊）"
            location: "手术室墙面"
            count: 16  # 每间2个（冗余）
            sensor_type: "FL-02-OR"
            accuracy: "±1 Pa"
            
          - point_id: "DP-DUCT-SA-OR-{N}"
            description: "送风静压"
            location: "送风主管"
            count: 8
            
          - point_id: "DP-FILTER-{N}-{STAGE}"
            description: "过滤器压差"
            location: "初效/中效/高效过滤器两侧"
            count: 24  # 8 AHU × 3 stages
            
      actuators:
        
        - point_id: "CV-CHW-OR-{N}"
          description: "冷冻水阀"
          type: "VL-01-2W"
          signal: "4-20mA"
          count: 8
          fail_position: "关闭"
          
        - point_id: "CV-HW-OR-{N}"
          description: "热水阀"
          type: "VL-01-2W"
          count: 8
          fail_position: "关闭"
          
        - point_id: "VFD-SF-OR-{N}"
          description: "送风机变频器"
          type: "DR-01-FAN"
          count: 8
          
        - point_id: "VFD-RF-OR-{N}"
          description: "回风机变频器"
          type: "DR-01-FAN"
          count: 8
          
        - point_id: "DA-OA-OR-{N}"
          description: "新风阀"
          type: "DM-01-STD"
          count: 8
          
        - point_id: "DA-RA-OR-{N}"
          description: "回风阀"
          type: "DM-01-STD"
          count: 8
          
        - point_id: "HUM-OR-{N}"
          description: "加湿器"
          type: "SP-01-EL"
          count: 8
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 控制架构（新增）
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    control_architecture:
      
      overall_strategy: |
        手术室AHU采用"串级温度控制 + 独立压差控制"架构：
        - 温度控制：室内温度(主回路) → 送风温度(副回路) → 冷冻水阀
        - 压差控制：室内压差 → 送风量/回风量比例
        - 湿度控制：室内湿度 → 加湿器调节
        - 静压控制：送风静压 → 送风机变频
        
        各AHU独立控制，但共享冷冻水供应，
        需通过L5的冷冻水流量平衡确保公平分配
        
      temperature_control:
        architecture: "串级PID"
        
        outer_loop:
          name: "室内温度控制"
          cv: "TS-RM-OR-{N}"
          sp: "22°C (来自L1需求或L6场景)"
          output: "送风温度设定值"
          
        inner_loop:
          name: "送风温度控制"
          cv: "TS-SA-OR-{N}"
          sp: "来自外环输出"
          mv: "CV-CHW-OR-{N} / CV-HW-OR-{N}"
          
        rationale: |
          串级控制的优势：
          - 送风温度响应快，干扰（冷冻水温度变化）在副回路消除
          - 室内温度响应稳定，主回路专注于最终控制目标
          
      pressure_control:
        architecture: "比例控制 + 门开前馈"
        
        main_loop:
          name: "压差控制"
          cv: "DP-OR-{N}"
          sp: "+15 Pa (来自L1需求)"
          mv: "DA-RA-OR-{N} (回风阀)"
          
        feed_forward:
          name: "门开补偿"
          trigger: "门磁开关 DI-DOOR-OR-{N}"
          action: "立即增加送风量20%，减小回风阀开度"
          
        rationale: |
          压差控制优先于温度控制：
          - 压差变化快（门开时1-2秒内失压）
          - 需要快速响应的比例控制
          - 前馈补偿进一步加快响应
          
      humidity_control:
        architecture: "PID控制"
        
        main_loop:
          cv: "RH-RM-OR-{N}"
          sp: "50%RH (来自L1需求)"
          mv: "HUM-OR-{N}"
          
      static_pressure_control:
        architecture: "PID控制"
        
        main_loop:
          cv: "DP-DUCT-SA-OR-{N}"
          sp: "250 Pa (或压差优化重设)"
          mv: "VFD-SF-OR-{N}"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 设备冗余策略（新增）
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    redundancy_strategy:
      
      sensor_redundancy:
        
        room_temperature:
          configuration: "每间手术室2个温度传感器"
          voting_logic: |
            if |T1 - T2| < 0.5°C:
                使用 (T1 + T2) / 2
            else:
                发送"传感器不一致"报警
                使用T1（优先传感器）
                安排维修检查
                
        room_pressure:
          configuration: "每间手术室2个压差传感器"
          voting_logic: |
            同温度传感器
            压差控制使用平均值
            
      actuator_redundancy:
        
        chw_valve:
          configuration: "每台AHU 1个冷冻水阀"
          fail_safe: "阀门失电时自动关闭"
          backup: "无（依赖AHU级别冗余）"
          
      ahu_level_redundancy:
        
        configuration: |
          8台AHU服务16间手术室（2间/AHU）
          AHU之间不共享服务空间
          
        failure_mode_1:
          scenario: "单台AHU故障"
          impact: "2间手术室失去空调"
          mitigation:
            - "立即发送AHU故障报警"
            - "通知手术调度避免使用受影响手术室"
            - "启动紧急维修工单"
            - "其他AHU继续正常运行（无法补偿）"
            
        failure_mode_2:
          scenario: "MAU故障（新风机组）"
          impact: "所有AHU失去新风"
          mitigation:
            - "切换到备用MAU"
            - "如果都故障，AHU转为全回风模式（临时）"
            - "发送紧急报警，限制手术室使用"
            
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 设备间协调关系（新增）
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    inter_equipment_coordination:
      
      ahu_to_ahu:
        relationship: "独立运行"
        coordination_point: "共享冷冻水供应"
        coordination_mechanism: |
          通过冷冻站的供水温度和压差控制
          确保所有AHU公平获得冷量
          见L5-SYS-CHP-004
          
      ahu_to_chiller_plant:
        relationship: "负荷-供应关系"
        coordination_point: "冷冻水流量分配"
        coordination_mechanism: |
          冷冻站根据总负荷调整冷机台数
          二次泵根据末端压差调整流量
          见L5-SYS-CHP-001~004
          
      ahu_to_mau:
        relationship: "新风供应关系"
        coordination_mechanism: |
          MAU预处理新风（除湿/预冷/预热）
          AHU混合新风和回风
          MAU容量 = Σ(AHU新风量)
          
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 冷冻站系统（修正后）
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  HVAC_CHILLER_Corrected:
    
    subsystem_id: "HVAC-CHILLER"
    subsystem_name: "冷冻站"
    
    equipment_inventory:
      
      chillers:
        count: 3
        configuration: "N+1冗余"
        per_chiller:
          type: "离心式冷水机组"
          capacity: "500 kW"
          cop: "5.5"
          chw_flow: "85 m³/h"
          
      chw_pumps:
        primary:
          count: 3
          type: "一次泵（恒流量）"
          configuration: "每台冷机配一台"
          
        secondary:
          count: 3
          type: "二次泵（变流量）"
          configuration: "N+1冗余"
          vfd: true
          
      cooling_towers:
        count: 3
        type: "逆流式"
        vfd: true
        
      cw_pumps:
        count: 3
        vfd: true
        
    control_architecture:
      
      overall_strategy: |
        冷冻站采用"台数控制 + 供水温度控制 + 压差控制"架构：
        - 台数控制：根据冷负荷决定冷机运行台数
        - 供水温度控制：调节冷机容量维持供水温度
        - 压差控制：调节二次泵变频维持末端压差
        
      chiller_staging:
        architecture: "逻辑控制"
        inputs: ["冷冻水供/回水温度", "冷冻水流量"]
        outputs: ["冷机启停命令"]
        reference: "L5-SYS-CHP-001"
        
      supply_temperature:
        architecture: "PID控制"
        cv: "冷冻水供水温度"
        sp: "7°C"
        mv: "冷机容量"
        reference: "L5-SYS-CHP-002"
        
      secondary_pump_pressure:
        architecture: "PID控制"
        cv: "末端压差"
        sp: "150 kPa"
        mv: "二次泵变频"
        reference: "L5-SYS-CHP-004"
        
    redundancy_strategy:
      
      chiller_redundancy:
        configuration: "3台冷机，N+1冗余"
        failure_mode:
          scenario: "1台冷机故障"
          impact: "冷量减少33%"
          mitigation:
            - "自动启动备用冷机"
            - "如果所有冷机都已运行，触发冷量不足报警"
            - "启动负荷分配优先级控制"
            
      pump_redundancy:
        configuration: "二次泵3台，N+1冗余"
        
    inter_equipment_coordination:
      
      chiller_to_pump:
        relationship: "冷机启动前必须先启动对应水泵"
        interlock: "水流开关确认"
        
      chiller_to_cooling_tower:
        relationship: "冷机启动前必须先启动冷却塔"
        interlock: "冷却水温度确认"
```

# 缺陷三修正：L3-L5约束追溯
# CORRECTION 3: L3-L5 CONSTRAINT TRACEABILITY

---

```yaml
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 修正后的L5控制回路：补充约束追溯和失效模式
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Layer_5_Corrected:
  
  design_principle: |
    每个控制回路必须说明：
    1. 满足哪些L3/L4约束
    2. 如何满足这些约束
    3. 约束被违反时的处理
    4. 失效模式和降级策略

  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 示例：冷冻水泵变频控制（完整约束追溯）
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  L5_FLOW_DEV_001_Corrected:
    
    loop_id: "L5-FLOW-DEV-001"
    loop_name: "二次冷冻水泵变频控制（末端压差）"
    loop_type: "PID控制"
    priority: "HIGH"
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 基本定义
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    io_configuration:
      
      cv:
        point_id: "DP-CHW-END"
        description: "最不利末端压差"
        sensor_type: "FL-02"
        location: "最远端AHU冷冻水支管"
        range: "0~300 kPa"
        
      mv:
        point_id: "VFD-CHWP-SEC"
        description: "二次冷冻水泵变频指令"
        type: "DR-01-PUMP"
        range: "20~50 Hz"
        
    setpoint:
      default: 150
      range: [100, 200]
      unit: "kPa"
      
    pid_parameters:
      Kp: 2.0
      Ki: 0.05
      Kd: 0.2
      sample_time: 5  # 秒
      
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 约束追溯（新增）
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    constraint_traceability:
      
      satisfies_constraints:
        
        - constraint_id: "L3-FLC-01"
          constraint_layer: "L3"
          constraint_description: "层级流量约束：Q_total ≤ 600 m³/h"
          
          how_satisfied: |
            1. 泵变频PID控制末端压差
            2. 当系统总流量增加时，管道阻力增加，末端压差降低
            3. PID检测到压差偏低，增加泵速
            4. 但泵速受限于50Hz（额定），自然限制了最大流量
            5. 额定频率下的最大流量 = 600 m³/h（设计流量）
            
          verification: |
            Q_total = f(DP, 管网特性曲线)
            当DP_setpoint = 150 kPa，管网阻力系数S时：
            Q_max = sqrt(DP_pump_max - DP_setpoint) / S
            设计确保Q_max ≤ 600 m³/h
            
        - constraint_id: "L3-PC-03"
          constraint_layer: "L3"
          constraint_description: "最大压力约束：P < P_design × 1.5"
          
          how_satisfied: |
            1. 泵变频限制在50Hz，对应的最大扬程已知
            2. 系统设计确保最大扬程下压力 < 管道设计压力 × 1.5
            3. 额外的泄压阀作为安全备份
            
        - constraint_id: "L3-SC-01"
          constraint_layer: "L3"
          constraint_description: "最小流量约束：Q > Q_min（防止冷机蒸发器结冰）"
          
          how_satisfied: |
            1. 二次泵最低频率设为20Hz
            2. 20Hz对应的最小流量 > 冷机最小流量要求
            3. 额外的旁通阀确保一次侧流量不低于最小值
            
        - constraint_id: "L3-SC-02"
          constraint_layer: "L3"
          constraint_description: "变频器最低频率约束：f > 20 Hz（防止电机过热）"
          
          how_satisfied: |
            PID输出限制范围：[20, 50] Hz
            
      constraint_violation_handling:
        
        violation_1:
          constraint: "压差过低（流量可能超限）"
          detection: "DP-CHW-END < 100 kPa 持续30秒"
          actions:
            - "发送压差低报警"
            - "检查末端阀门是否全开（可能需求过大）"
            - "如果已在最高频率，触发冷量不足报警"
            
        violation_2:
          constraint: "压差过高（流量不足）"
          detection: "DP-CHW-END > 200 kPa"
          actions:
            - "发送压差高报警"
            - "检查是否有管道堵塞"
            - "降低泵速防止能耗浪费"
            
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 失效模式和降级策略（新增）
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    failure_modes:
      
      sensor_failure:
        scenario: "末端压差传感器故障"
        detection: "传感器信号超出范围 或 变化率异常"
        
        mitigation:
          immediate:
            - "发送传感器故障报警"
            - "切换到备用控制模式"
            
          backup_control_mode:
            strategy: "开环控制"
            action: "泵固定运行在40Hz（中间值）"
            limitation: "无法优化能耗，但保证基本供水"
            
          recovery:
            condition: "传感器更换并校准"
            action: "恢复闭环PID控制"
            
      actuator_failure:
        scenario: "变频器故障"
        detection: "变频器报警信号"
        
        mitigation:
          immediate:
            - "发送变频器故障报警"
            - "如有备用泵，自动切换"
            
          if_no_backup:
            - "手动旁路变频器，泵工频运行"
            - "增加能耗，但保证供水"
            
      controller_failure:
        scenario: "DDC控制器故障"
        detection: "控制器通信中断"
        
        mitigation:
          - "变频器保持最后一个指令值"
          - "发送控制器故障报警"
          - "启动备用控制器（如有）"
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 性能保证（新增）
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    performance_guarantees:
      
      steady_state:
        accuracy: "压差稳态误差 < ±5 kPa"
        condition: "在设计负荷范围内"
        
      dynamic_response:
        rise_time: "< 60秒"
        settling_time: "< 120秒"
        overshoot: "< 10%"
        
      disturbance_rejection:
        scenario: "末端阀门开度变化20%"
        recovery_time: "< 90秒"
        
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 示例：手术室温度控制（完整约束追溯）
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  
  L5_TEMP_OR_001_Corrected:
    
    loop_id: "L5-TEMP-OR-001"
    loop_name: "手术室温度串级控制"
    loop_type: "串级PID"
    priority: "CRITICAL"
    
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 基本定义
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    io_configuration:
      
      outer_loop_cv:
        point_id: "TS-RM-OR-{N}"
        description: "室内温度"
        sensor_type: "TH-03-OR"
        accuracy: "±0.2°C"
        redundancy: 2
        
      inner_loop_cv:
        point_id: "TS-SA-OR-{N}"
        description: "送风温度"
        sensor_type: "TH-02"
        
      mv:
        point_id: "CV-CHW-OR-{N}"
        description: "冷冻水阀"
        type: "VL-01-2W"
        characteristic: "等百分比"
        
    setpoint:
      source: "L1空间需求或L6场景模式"
      default: 22
      range: [18, 26]
      unit: "°C"
      
    pid_parameters:
      
      outer_loop:
        Kp: 3.5
        Ki: 0.1
        Kd: 0.5
        output_range: [12, 20]  # 送风温度设定值范围
        rationale: |
          较高的Kp保证快速响应
          Ki消除稳态误差
          Kd抑制温度振荡
          
      inner_loop:
        Kp: 2.0
        Ki: 0.08
        Kd: 0.3
        output_range: [0, 100]  # 阀门开度
        rationale: |
          较低的Kp避免阀门动作过快
          内环响应速度本身较快
          
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 约束追溯
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    constraint_traceability:
      
      satisfies_constraints:
        
        - constraint_id: "L1-OR-TEMP"
          constraint_layer: "L1"
          constraint_description: "手术室温度需求：22°C ±2°C"
          
          how_satisfied: |
            串级PID控制器持续调节冷冻水阀开度
            维持室内温度在设定值附近
            稳态误差 < ±0.5°C（优于±2°C要求）
            
        - constraint_id: "L3-TC-03"
          constraint_layer: "L3"
          constraint_description: "送风温度范围：12~18°C"
          
          how_satisfied: |
            外环PID输出限制在[12, 20]°C范围内
            即使室温偏差很大，送风温度设定值也不会超出合理范围
            
        - constraint_id: "L3-TC-04"
          constraint_layer: "L3"
          constraint_description: "温度变化率：dT/dt < 3°C/min（防止冷冲击）"
          
          how_satisfied: |
            内环PID的积分和微分作用限制了阀门的快速变化
            阀门行程时间60秒进一步限制了温度变化率
            
        - constraint_id: "L4-HEC-01"
          constraint_layer: "L4"
          constraint_description: "超边协调约束：温度控制不能影响压差控制"
          
          how_satisfied: |
            温度控制仅通过冷冻水阀调节
            不改变送风量（由压差控制决定）
            两个控制回路解耦
            
      constraint_violation_handling:
        
        violation_1:
          constraint: "室温超出范围"
          detection: "TS-RM-OR < 18°C 或 > 26°C"
          actions:
            - "发送室温超限报警"
            - "检查冷冻水供水温度"
            - "检查AHU运行状态"
            
        violation_2:
          constraint: "控制无法稳定"
          detection: "室温振荡 > ±1°C 持续10分钟"
          actions:
            - "发送控制不稳定报警"
            - "临时降低PID增益"
            - "安排PID参数重新整定"
            
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 失效模式
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    failure_modes:
      
      sensor_failure:
        scenario: "室内温度传感器故障"
        detection: "两个传感器读数差异 > 1°C"
        
        mitigation:
          immediate:
            - "发送传感器故障报警"
            - "使用正常传感器继续控制"
            
          if_both_fail:
            - "切换到开环控制"
            - "冷冻水阀固定在50%开度"
            - "发送紧急报警，等待维修"
            
      valve_failure:
        scenario: "冷冻水阀故障（卡死）"
        detection: "阀门位置反馈与指令严重不符"
        
        mitigation:
          if_stuck_open:
            - "室温会下降"
            - "发送阀门故障报警"
            - "临时切换到热水阀调节（如有）"
            
          if_stuck_closed:
            - "室温会上升"
            - "发送紧急报警"
            - "考虑使用备用AHU（如有）"
            
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 性能保证
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    
    performance_guarantees:
      
      steady_state:
        accuracy: "室温稳态误差 < ±0.5°C"
        
      dynamic_response:
        setpoint_change:
          from_22_to_20: "< 10分钟"
          from_22_to_18: "< 15分钟 (L6场景CPB降温要求)"
          
      special_scenario:
        cpb_cooling:
          description: "体外循环快速降温"
          target: "18°C"
          time: "< 15分钟"
          control_mode: "L6场景模式激活时切换"
```
